maruta nilam, māṟṟuyarnta poṉṉilam eṉṟu pulavarkaḷ pukaḻvar.  ēṉiya mūṉṟu nilamakkaḷum taṅkaḷ nilattiṟkiṭitta ceyporuḷkaḷiyum, viḷiporuḷiyum maruta nilamakkaḷiṭam paṇṭamāṟṟāka aḷittu nel pul, eḷ, koḷ, payaṟu mutaliya poruḷkaḷip peṟṟuc ceṉṟaṉar.  poruḷ vaḷattāl aṅku iyal ici nāṭakam pōṉṟa nuṇkalikaḷ vaḷarntiruppati makkaḷ kaṇṭukaḷittuc ceṉṟaṉar.  aṅku, eṅkum kāyum kaṉiyum niṟintiruntaṉa.  malarkaḷ kottuk kottāy malarntu toṅkiṉa.  kampaṉ ivaṟṟiyellām kūṟātu mayilkaḷ tāmari malarkaḷ, kuvaḷip pūkkaḷ vaṇṭukaḷ ākiyavikaḷiṉ āṭṭattiyum aḻakiyum maṇattiyum, rīṅkārattiyum vittu maruta nilattiṉ māṇpi eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṟāṉ.  āṭaka araṅkil āy mayilkaḷ āṭavum anta āṭṭattiṟku ēṟṟavāṟu tāmari taṉatu pūvākiya viḷakkik kāṭṭutākavum, kuvaḷi malarkaḷi nāṭakam pārppavar kaḷākavum nīril eḻum alikaḷit tiric cīlikaḷākavum vaṇṭukaḷiṉ iṉiya ōciyi yāḻākavum maruta nilam kaliyiṉṟu vīṟṟirukkum oru perum nilappirapuvākavum oru putiya nāṭaka araṅki namakkuk kaṟpaṉi ceytu kampaṉ kāṭṭiyuḷḷāṉ.  nāṭakam, ici, viḷakku, tiriccīli ākiyavikaḷ nāṭṭiyattiṟku iṉṟiyamiyāta pāttiraṅkaḷ.  itaṉik kampaṉ kaviṉuṟa eṭuttuk kāṭṭuvatu cuvittu iṉpuṟattakkatākum.
iḵtaṉṟi, maruta nilattil poruḷātāra vaḷattālum, aṟiviṉ āṟṟalālum, kaṟpaṉit tiṟattālum makkaḷ civaṉi maruta nilat teyvamāka uyarttiṉar.  avaṉi viṇṇil kōṭāṉu kōṭi kal tolivil cuḻaṉṟōṭum ceññāṉṟiṉukkum mēlum uyarttiṉar. pattari māṟṟup pacumpoṉṉilum māṟṟuyarnta pacumpoṉṉākap pukaḻntaṉar.  avaṉ ēḻulakiṟkum ataṟku appāl eṇṇilāt toliviṟkum ellāp pirapañcattiṟkum mutalvaṉākak koṇṭaṉar ulakil civaṉit tavira vēṟu teyvamē illi.  ulakilē aiyāyiram āṇṭukaṭku muṉpē tamiḻarkaḷ kumari toṭṭu imayam vari maṭṭumalla īḻam, malayam, ciṅkapuram, cāvakam, cumattirā pōrṉiyō, tāylāntu, kampōṭiyā, antamāṉ pōṉṟa kiḻakkāciya nāṭukaḷil maṭṭumalla āppirikkā mecapottāmiyā, pāpilōṉ, cumēriyā, ellam, cīriyā, acīriyā akkēṭiyā cālṭiyā, pālatīṉam, ciṉṉa āciyā kākaca ittāli, kirīpāku turuyitiyar (Druids) amerikkā pōṉṟa nāṭukaḷukkellām ceṉṟu civaṉ eṉṉum nāmattip parappi, kōyilkaḷ kaṭṭi, kalivaḷarttu ici payiṉṟu paṇpāṭu parappi oḻukkam ōmpi vantaṉar.  ulakil mutaṉ mutalāka camayatti aṉṉiya nāṭṭārkkup parappa 1600- āṇṭukaṭku muṉ vantavarkaḷ kiṟittavarkaḷ eṉṟu 20  -āṇṭukaṭku muṉ cila veḷḷiyarkaḷ kūṟivantaṉar.  50 - āṇṭukaṭku muṉ intiyā, ilaṅki, malēciyā, ciṅkapuram, cāvakam, kampōṭiyā, tāylāntu, intōcīṉam, campāṉ, cīṉā, raciyā, koriyā mutaliya nāṭukaḷukkellām putta canniyācikaḷ ceṉṟu putta neṟiyip parappi vantaṉar eṉṟu cila vaṭa intiyarkaḷ kūṟivantaṉar.  iṉṟu, cumār aiyāyiram āṇṭukaṭku muṉ, civarkaḷ civa neṟiyi kumari toṭṭu nēppāḷam vari, parmātoṭṭu paluccitāṉ vari maṭṭumalla ekiptu, amerikkā, pāpilōṉ, pālatīṉam mutaliya ulaka nāṭukaḷ aṉittiṟkum civa muṉivarkaḷ ceṉṟu civaneṟiyip parappi, tirukkōyilkaḷi eḻuppi, civap paṇpāṭṭiyum civakkalikaḷiyum parappi vantuḷḷaṉar eṉṟum uṇmi uṇarap peṟṟuḷḷatu. 1922- ām āṇṭu cintuveḷi akaḻ āyviṟkup piṉ 5000-m āṇṭukaṭkumuṉ cintu veḷiyil civaṉ, umi, civaliṅkam murukaṉ, piḷḷiyār, nilatteyvam, nīrtteyvam marat teyvam pōṉṟa teyvaṅkaḷ vaḻipaṭappaṭṭu vantaṉar eṉṟum āriyar varumuṉ intiyā muḻuvatum civaṉeṟi paraviyiruntatu eṉṟum intiya miya araciṉ akaḻ ārāyccit tuṟiyiṉar kaṇṭu ulakiṟku inta uṇmiyi uṇarttiyuḷḷaṉar.  itaṉi viḷakki i.pi. hēval eṉṉum aṟiñarum, pēṭrik kērlṭṭaṉ pōṉṟa aṟiñarum ulakiṟku mutaṉ mutalāka uṇarttiyuḷḷaṉar atōṭu tamiḻ moḻikku ēṟṟam aḷittatil ciṟanta paṅku nallāyar kālṭuvel avarkaḷukku uṇṭu.1
oru kālattil intiyā muḻuvatum tirāviṭarkaḷum civacamayamum niṟivuṟṟiruntatu.  intiyāvil cumār 4000-m āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ nilaviya tirāviṭarkaḷ camayam civam eṉappaṭum.  itu intiyāviṉ tēciya matam. civam  ulakaḷāviya paḻamperum camayam.  itu āriyam, puttam, kiṟittavam ekōvā neṟi (yūtar neṟi), epirēyarkaḷiṉ el neṟi ākiya ellāc camayattiṟkum muntiya neṟi; nīṇṭa vāṇāḷip peṟṟa palam vāynta paḻamperum camayam; iṉṟum iḷami kuṉṟātu eḻil māṟātu iḷamip polivuṭaṉ ēṟṟamuṭaṉ tikaḻum naṉṉeṟi eṉṟu poruḷ tarum muṟiyil cintuveḷi akaḻ āyvi naṭattiya iyakkunarkaḷiṉ talivarum, intiya miya araciṉ tol poruḷ āyvuttuṟi iyakkunarkaḷiṉ taḷapatiyumāṉa cāṇmārcal ulakiṟku eṭuttukkāṭṭiṉār.2
civam paḻamperum camayantāṉ; ulakaḷāviya uyarnta neṟitāṉ; eṉṟālum atu cumār ki.mu. 7500-kku muṉṉar āriyarkaḷāl peruntākkutalukku āṭpaṭṭu cintu āṟṟaṅkariyi ṉiṉṟu taṇporuni āṟṟaṅkari vari piṉ taḷḷappaṭṭatu.  ataṉāl civam aḻiyavilli; citiyavilli. āriyam, civac caṭaṅkukaḷ palavaṟṟi taḻuviyatu; āriyarkaḷiṟ palar civarāyiṉar. āriyap pārppaṉar āriya neṟiyit tuṟantu, āriyaneṟiyit tākki ataṉ akattiyum mukattiyum māṟṟiviṭṭaṉar.  pala āriyap pārppaṉar civantaḻuvi pulāl uṇavit tuṟantu, yākatti maṟantu, uṭalil tirunīṟu aṇintu kaḻuttil uruttirākkam pūṇṭu ciciṉatēvar eṉṟu oru kālattil tam muṉṉōr iḻittuk kūṟiya civaliṅkatti vaḻipaṭa muṉvantaṉar.  cilar aṟupattu mūṉṟu nāyaṉmārkaḷiṉ iṭaṅkaḷik kūṭa kippaṟṟiṉar.  campantar, cuntarar, māṇikkavācakar pōṉṟōr civa camaya kuravarkaḷāy āriya (camayattiyum) putta camaṇa
camayaṅkaḷiyellām etirttu veṟṟiyīṭṭiṉar.  intiyāviṟkuḷ āriyarkaḷ intiraṉ talimiyil pukuntu tirāviṭarkaḷik koñcam koñcamākat teṉ intiyāvarip piṉ taḷḷiṉar.  itaṉāl āriyarkaḷ intiyāvil pukuntu innāṭṭil taṅkum iṭattip peṟṟaṉar.  eṉṟālum avarkaḷ veṟṟi veṟum pōli veṟṟi eṉpati oru āṅkilap pēraṟiñar, intiraṉ ciṟu pūcalil tirāviṭari veṉṟāṉ; āṉāl civaṉ pōril āriyari veṉṟāṉ eṉṟu āṇittaramāka eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷār.1  civantaḻuvāta āriyarkaḷ civam oru camayam alla eṉṟu ulakam muḻuvatum paṟi aṭittu vantaṉar.  civattiṟku oru tattuvacātiram (Philosophy) kūṭa uṇṭu eṉṟu airōppiya tattuva ñāṉikaḷ palar aṟintu koḷḷā vaṇṇam iruṭṭaṭippuc ceytuḷḷaṉar.  puttar kaḷum, camaṇarkaḷum muculimkaḷum, kiṟittavarkaḷum civaneṟiyit tākkit tamiḻakattil taṅkaḷ camayattiṟku āḷcērkkum paṇiyil tamiḻarkaḷukkum, tamiḻp paṇpāṭṭiṟkum, tamiḻ neṟikkum iṭarviḷittuḷḷaṉar.  āṉāl tamiḻnāṭṭiṉ varalāṟu, tamiḻakattil nāṭṭiṟku putitāka vanta intiya tēcīyamatamallāta enta camayamum nilittu niṟka
villi eṉṟu kūṟukiṟatu.  intiyāviyum, tamiḻ nāṭṭiyum putta camaṇa neṟikaḷ āṭci celuttiya kālattil civacamaya kuravarkaḷ tōṉṟi avviru camayarkaḷiyum tamiḻakattiṉiṉṟu atu irunta taṭam kūṭa aṟiya muṭiyā vaṇṇam avaṟṟit tuṭittu aḻittuviṭṭaṉar.  putta, camaṇa camayaṅkaḷi nāṭṭiviṭṭu viraṭṭiyaṭitta varalāṟu, tēvāra tiruvācakaṅkaḷil iṉṟum poṉṟātu poli vuṟṟut tikaḻkiṉṟatu.
aṉittintiya neṟiyākiya camaṇattiyum aṉittulaka neṟiyāka niṉṟa putta camayattiyum mika eḷitil etirttu oru coṭṭu utiramum cintātu  intiya tēcīya neṟiyāṉa civam veṟṟiyīṭṭiyuḷḷatu.  ayal neṟiyāḷarkaḷi veṉṟa civacamayat talivarkaḷil appar cariyi vaḻi niṉṟavar eṉṟum campantar kiriyi vaḻi niṉṟavar eṉṟum, cuntarar yōkaneṟi niṉṟavar eṉṟum māṇikkavācakar ñāṉaneṟi niṉṟavar eṉṟum, tamiḻ neṟiyāka eḻunta cariyi, kiriyi, yōkam, ñāṉam (aṟivu) eṉṉum pēroḷiyiṉ muṉ camaṇa putta anniya nāṭṭu neṟikaḷ eḷitil maṟintaṉa eṉṟum tamiḻaka varalāṟu kūṟukiṟatu.  ēḻām nūṟṟāṇṭil cēra, cōḻa, pāṇṭiya, toṇṭi nāṭṭu aracar
kaḷiṉ pērātaravi camaṇa putta camayaṅkaḷ muṟṟākap peṟṟiruntum avikaḷi tamiḻppaṇ iyinta oru cila tēvarāp pāṭalkaḷiṉ mūlam aṭiyaṟṟa marampōl viḻuntu maṟintu oḻiyumāṟu ceytuviṭṭatu civanaṉṉeṟi. maṉṉarkaḷ aṉivarum tam tavaṟukku maṉṉippukkōri civaṉ aṭiyārkaḷ kālil vīḻntu vaṇaṅki civaṉukku āṭpaṭṭuviṭṭaṉar.
appar aṭikaḷ talimiyil campantar, cuntarar, māṇikka vācakar mutaliyōr āṟṟiya civat toṇṭiṉ mūlam intiya nāṭṭiṉ tēcīya neṟiyākiya civaneṟi veṟṟiyīṭṭiyatu. camaṇa putta neṟikaḷi etirppatil civaneṟiyāḷarkaḷukku āriyarkaḷ palar tuṇi niṉṟaṉar.  ataṉ mūlam āriyarkaḷ tamiḻnāṭṭil taṅkaḷukkum taṅkaḷ moḻikkum ōraḷavu iṭam tēṭik koṇṭaṉar eṉpatu maṟukka muṭiyāta uṇmitāṉ eṉṟālum maṉōṉmaṇiyam āciriyar cuntaram piḷḷi, nelli kā. cu. piḷḷi, nāki maṟimali aṭikaḷ muyaṟciyāl civamum, tamiḻum puṉitamuṟivum āriya māyiviṭṭu akalavum orupēr iyakkattiṟku aṭi kōlap peṟṟuḷḷatu.
civaṉi vaḻipaṭum kūṭṭattār civar eṉṟu tēvāra āciriyar kālattiṟkuc ciṟitumuṟpaṭṭup peyar vittirukkalām  eṉṟālum ki.mu. 3000 - āṇṭaḷavil arappaṉ paṇpāṭu arumpiya kālattilē cintuveḷiyil civaṉ, āṭavallāṉ, pacupati, umātēvi pōṉṟa civat teyvaṅkaḷ tōṉṟat toṭaṅkiyuḷḷaṉa.  iṉṟu antat teyva uruvaṅkaḷ poṟitta muttirikaḷum, tāyattukaḷum ērāḷamākak kiṭittuḷḷaṉa.
ātikālat tamiḻar vaḻipaṭṭa cemporuḷākiya civattiṟku caṅka kālattilum ataṟku muṉṉarum iṟiyōṉ, kaṭavuḷ, periyōṉ eṉṟa peyarkaḷ kūṟap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  nutal vaḻi nāṭṭat tiṟivaṉ, eṉa maṇimēkaliyilum kaṭavuḷ eṉa puṟanāṉūṟṟilum piṟavā yākkip periyōṉ eṉac cilappatikārattilum cemporuḷ eṉṟu tirukkuṟaḷilum kūṟap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa. pala aṟiñarkaḷ īcaṉ, kaṇṇutaṟ peruṅkaṭavuḷ, mukkaṇṇaṉ, vēlaṉ, cūlaṉ, caṭiyaṉ, mukkaṭ kaṭavuḷ, maṅkipaṅkaṉ, muḻumutaṟkaṭavuḷ eṉṟellām kūṟivantuḷḷaṉar.
mēlum civaṉ, ciyaṉ, cipā, ciyōṉ, el, elcaṭi, viricaṭi, al, il, ol pāl, (pakal) āṇpil acur, attāt, ṭayōṉica, martūk naṉṉar, taṅkaḷ eṉṟa peyarkaḷil palvēṟu nāṭukaḷil civaperumāṉ vaḻipaṭappaṭṭuḷḷār.  avar kāḷi mītu niṟpatum, avar kiyil tiricūlam tāṅki niṟpatum avar civaṉ eṉpati uṟutippaṭuttum civa vaḻipāṭṭit toṭarntu umātēvi vaḻipāṭum nanti vaḻipāṭum civaliṅka vaḻipāṭum pala nāṭukaḷil paravi uḷḷaṉa.
niṟka, makkaḷ tamiḻakattil mikat toṉmiyāṉa kālattilē teyva vaḻipāṭṭit toṭaṅkiviṭṭaṉar.  paḻaṅkaṟkālattilē āla marattiṉ aṭiyil oru ciṟiya kuraṭu eḻuppi atil oru kalli nāṭṭi vaḻipaṭat toṭaṅkiviṭṭaṉar.  oru ciṟiya kaṭuku pōṉṟa vittiṉiṉṟu muḷittuk kiḷittu paṉṉūṟu pēr taṅkak kūṭiya periya marattiṉ kīḻ taṅkaḷ teyva uruvaṅkaḷi vittu vaḻipaṭum iṭamākak koṇṭaṉar.
tamiḻarkaḷiṉ muṉṉōrkaḷ ātiyil iṟivaṉik kallāla marattiṉ kīḻ kaṇṭaṉar eṉpatu tamiḻarkaḷiṉ aitīkam; nampikki; uṟuti. tamiḻarkaḷiṉ teyva vaḻipāṭu mutaṉ mutalāka ālamarattiṉ aṭiyiṉiṉṟu arumpiyatu eṉṟu aṉumāṉikkappaṭukiṟatu.  makēntiramaliyil civaperumāṉ taṭcaṇāmūrttiyāy atāvatu teṉmukak kaṭavuḷāy, kurumūrttamāy  kal ālamarattiṉ aṭiyil amarntu caṉakar, caṉāntarar, caṉaṟkumārar, ākiya nāṉku tamiḻ muṉivarkaḷukku nāṉmaṟikaḷi aruḷiṉār eṉṟu tamiḻarkaḷiṉ camayanūṟkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟaṉa.  ataṉāl civaperumāṉi ālamar kaṭavuḷ eṉṟu iṉṟum pōṟṟi varukiṉṟārkaḷ.

coṉṉa ākamam tōṟṟuvit taruḷiyum - 
eṉṟa tiruvākku ati uṟutippaṭuttukiṟatu.
ālamaram, tamiḻarkaḷiṉ uḷḷattiṟku ukantatāyum karuttik kavarntatāyum iruntatu.  aṇup pōṉṟa oru ciṟiya kaṭukupōṉṟa vitiyiṉiṉṟu eḻunta oru nīṇṭa paranta periya maram taṉ nīṇṭa kiḷikaḷit tāṅka iṭi iṭiyē viḻutu viṭṭu nilattit toṭṭu, vērviṭṭuḷḷatu.  periya pantalit tāṅka iṭi iṭiyē tūṇkaḷ naṭṭiyatu pōl viḻutukaḷ vērviṭṭu maram evvaḷavu peritākap paṭarntālum kiḷikaḷ noṭintu viḻāmal tāṅki niṟpatiyum paṉṉūṟu makkaḷ ataṉ aṭiyil taṅki ataṉ niḻali nukarntum paḻattit tiṉṟu makiḻvatiyum tamiḻarkaḷ kaṇṭu viyantaṉar.  ālamarattiyum ataṉ payaṉiyum aṟintu ataṉip puṉita maramāka eṇṇip pōṟṟiṉar.
āla marattiṉ aṭiyil maṇṇik kuvittu mēṭākki atic camataḷamākac ceytu, antac camataḷamāka uḷḷa kuraṭṭiṉ naṭuvil oru mukkōṇa vaṭivilāṉa kalliyō, allatu nīṇṭa marakkaṭṭiyiyō, naṭṭu vaḻipaṭṭu vantaṉar.  mukkōṇa vaṭivamāṉa kal tāyiṉ ciṉṉamākavum, nīṇṭa marak kompu tantiyiṉ ciṉṉamākavum karutappaṭṭatu.  ulakil mutalil tāy āṭciyum tāy vaḻipāṭum nilaviyatu.  appāl tanti āṭciyum tantit teyva vaḻipāṭum nilaviyatu eṉṟu pala camūka iyal nūli uṇarnta aṟiñarkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟārkaḷ.
ūr tōṟum ālamarattiṉ aṭiyil tiruuruvam amittu vaḻipaṭum oru marapu tamiḻakattil eḻuntatu.  inta vaḻipaṭum iṭam potu il eṉappaṭṭatu.  appāl atu ampalamāka māṟiyatu.  ampalattil teyvat tiruuruvam iṭampeṟṟatu. ampalattil teyvam uṟiyum  taṟiyākiya tūṇ oṉṟu naṭappaṭṭatu.  nīrāṭit tūymi yuṭiyōrāy makaḷir ampalatti aṭintu meḻuki, kōlamiṭṭu, nantā viḷakkēṟṟi malar tūvi pōṟṟi vaḻipaṭṭu vantaṉar.  piṉṉar pakivarkaḷ ūriṉiṉṟu ciṟipiṭittu vanta makaḷiriyum inta vaḻipāṭṭil īṭupaṭac ceytaṉar.  ūrukkup putiyavarkaḷ vantāl ampalattil taṅkuvatum uṇṭu.  paṭṭiṉappāli eṉṉum paḻam perum caṅka nūl aṭiyil varumāṟu kūṟukiṟatu.
koṇṭi makaḷir uṇṭuṟi mūḻki
anti māṭṭiya nantā viḷakkiṉ
malaraṇi meḻukkam ēṟippalar toḻa
vampalar cērkkum kantuṭip potiyil -
ippāṭṭiṟku nacciṉārk kiṉiyar, pakivar maṉiyōrāyp piṭittu vanta makaḷir palarum, nīruṇṇun tuṟiyilē ceṉṟu muḻuki, meḻukum vaḻakkattiṉiyum avarkaḷ anti kālattē koḻuttiṉa aviyāta viḷakkattiṉiyum naṟumaṇam nāṟum nalla pūkkaḷiyum cūṭṭiya taṟiyiṉiyuṭiya ampalam eṉṟu kūṟukiṟār.  kantu teyvam uṟiyum taṟiyākum.  vampalar cērkkum potiyil putiyavarkaḷ palarum ēṟit toḻuvataṟkum taṅkuvataṟkum uriya iṭamāyiṟṟu potiyili meḻuki viḷakkum iṭṭirukka vampa makaḷiri vittār.  ataṉāl tamakkup pukaḻ uḷatām eṉṟu karutiṉar eṉṟu virivuri tarappaṭṭatu.
ivvāṟu tamiḻarkaḷ ūr tōṟum ālamarattiṉ aṭiyil kantiṉi vittu vaḻipaṭṭu vantaṉar.  ālamarattiṉ aṭiyil kantu vittu vaḻipaṭum iṭam ālamuṟṟam eṉappēr peṟṟatu.

nāṉmaṟi mutunūl mukkaṇ celvam

poyki cūḻnta poḻiṉmaṉi makaḷir -  
eṉap puṟanāṉūṟṟuc ceyyuḷ pukaḻkiṟatu.
ālamar kaṭavuḷ aṉṉa niṉ celvam 
vēlkeḻu kuricilkaṇ ṭēṉākaliṉ
eṉṟa puṟanāṉūṟṟuc ceyyuḷum ālamarattiṉ aṭiyil araṉāriṉ tiru uruvi vittu vaḻipaṭuvatu paṇṭik kālat tamiḻar marapu eṉpati naṉku pulappaṭukiṟatu.
ātikālattil tamiḻarkaḷ ālamarattiṉ aṭiyil kantuvi vittu vaḻipaṭṭa vaḻakkam nīṇṭa kālamāka avarkaḷ kumukāyatti viṭṭu akalavilli.  ālamaraṅkaḷ illāta ūril taṅkaḷ ūril uḷḷa vēṟu maraṅkaḷiṉ aṭiyil teyva uruvaṅ kaḷi vittu vaḻipaṭṭu vantaṉar.
tamiḻar kumukāyam vaḷarcci peṟṟu kōyilkaḷ kaṭṭi ataṉ uḷḷē teyva uruvaṅkaḷi vittu vaḻipaṭum nākarikam eḻunta kālattum avarkaḷ ātikālattil teyva uruvaṅkaḷi vittu vaḻipaṭṭa maratti maṟakkavilli.  ati tala viruṭcamākak koṇṭu kōyiluḷ ataṟku oru ciṟappāṉa iṭam aḷittuḷḷaṉar.  tirupputtūril talaviruṭcam koṉṟi, akattiyāṉ paḷḷiyil tala viruṭcam vaṉṉimaram,  tiruvāṭāṉiyil  tala viruṭcam vilvamaram,  tiruāmarttūril tala viruṭcam vaṉṉi maram,  tiruāṉikkāvil tala viruṭcam veṇṇāval, tirukaḷ eṉṟum ūriṉ tala viruṭcam pāricātam, cikkal eṉṉum ūriṉ talaviruṭcam malliki; tirunelvēli nelliyappar kōyil talaviruṭcam mūṅkil, tirukkuṟṟālattil talaviruṭcam palāmaram;  tiruvīḻimiḻaliyil tala viruṭcam vīḻic ceṭi;  maturiyil tala viruṭcam kaṭappamaram; tiruppātirip puliyūril tala viruṭcam pātiri maram, tiruppukalūril tala viruṭcam puṉṉimaram;  tirumaḻapāṭiyil talaviruṭcam paṉimaram;  tirunellikkāvil talaviruṭcam nellimaram; ivvāṟu ovvoru ūrilum ovvoru maram tala viruṭcamāka uḷḷatu.  itu tirukkōyil eḻumuṉ ātiyil marattiṉ kīḻ teyva uruvam vittu vaḻipaṭappaṭṭatu eṉpati naṉku eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṟatu.
ālamum kaṭampum, nalyāṟṟu naṭuvum
kāl vaḻak kaṟunilik kuṉṟamum
eṉṟa paripāṭal ceyyuḷum,
kāṭum kāvum kaviṉ peṟu turuttiyum 
yāṟum kuḷaṉum vēṟupal vippum
catukkamum cantiyum putuppūṅkaṭampum
maṉṟamum potiyilum kantuṭi niliyum
eṉṟa tirumurukāṟṟup pāṭalum muṟkālattil maraṅkaḷiṉ aṭiyil kāṭukaḷilum mēṭukaḷilum, āṟṟaṅkarikaḷilum,  kuḷakkari kaḷilum, kaṭaṟkarikaḷilum kuṉṟukaḷilum, maṉṟukaḷilum teyva uruvaṅkaḷ vittu vaḻipaṭappaṭṭu vantaṉa eṉpati eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṉṟaṉa.
periya nākarikam eḻunta ikkālattum perumpālāṉa teyvattiru uruvaṅkaḷ maraṅkaḷiṉ aṭiyilē iruntu varukiṉṟaṉa.  perumpālum oru ūrukku iraṇṭu mūṉṟu piḷḷiyār uruvaṅkaḷ irukkum.  avikaḷ perumpālum vēmpu, aracu maraṅkaḷ aṭiyilē iruntu varukiṉṟaṉa.  cila ūrkaḷiltāṉ piḷḷiyār kōyilil iṭam peṟṟuḷḷār.
iḵtaṉṟi tamiḻ nāṭṭil pala tāyt teyvaṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  avikaḷ perumpālum nāṉku puṟamum cuvar eḻuppap peṟṟu mēlē caṭṭamum viṭṭamum vittu malluk kikaḷ vittu ōṭukaḷ vēynta kūrik kōyilkaḷil iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
iṉṟum ciṟṟūrkaḷilum, ēṉ? pērūrkaḷilum cila tāyt teyvaṅkaḷukku aṭi peruttum nuṉi ciṟuttum caturat tūṇ vaṭivil 4, 5 aṭimutal 8 vari maṇṇāl kaṭṭap peṟṟō, allatu ceṅkaṟkaḷāl kaṭṭappeṟṟō mēlē cuṇṇaccāntu pūcappeṟṟa pīṭaṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa. cila pīṭaṅkaḷil teyva uruvaṅkaḷum palavita vaṇṇattil tīṭṭap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
ātikālattil oṉṟu allatu nāṉku aintu āka irunta teyvaṅkaḷ palavāki āyirakkaṇakkāṉa kōyilkaḷip peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.

kaṭṭiṭak kali 
kaviṉ kalikaḷil kaṭṭiṭak kali oṉṟu.  kaṭṭiṭak kaliyiviṭa, makkaḷukku iṉṟiyamiyāta kali etuvum illi.  makkaḷiṉ uṭal nalattiṟku ūṟu viḷivikkum veyyil maḻi, kāṟṟu iṉṉōraṉṉa iyaṟkiyiṉ kōpattiṟkut tappuvikka  maṉitaṉ uṟiyuḷi uruvākkiṉāṉ.  muṟkālattil illaṅkaḷ makkaḷik koṭiya vilaṅkukaḷiṉ pacikku tappum araṇkaḷāvum viḷaṅkiṉa.
ātikālattil maṉitaṉ kāṭukaḷil vilaṅkukaḷiṉ naṭuvē, vilaṅkukaḷ pōl vāḻntu vantāṉ.  avaṉukku akkālattil uṭukka uṭiyum, paṭukkap pāyum uṇṇa uṇavum, oṇṭak kuṭiciyum iṉṟi aṅkum iṅkum alintu tirintāṉ.  avaṉ uyiri ōmpa uṭalip pātukākkat talippaṭṭāṉ.  uṇavup poruḷkaḷic cēkarikka muṟpaṭṭāṉ.  vilaṅkukaḷi etirttu veṭṭavum, marañceṭi koṭikaḷit tuṇṭikkavum, maraṅkaḷi luḷḷa paḻaṅkaḷi kīḻē vīḻttavum kaṟkaḷip payaṉpaṭuttavum muṉ vantāṉ.  kal avaṉatu vāḻkkiyiṉ muṉṉēṟṟattiṟkum, ciṟappiṟkum nākarikattiṟkum tuṇiyāka iruntatu.
makkaḷ nāḷaṭivil paṭippaṭiyāka nākarikam aṭintaṉar.  aṟivu vaḷarcci peṟṟaṉar.  vacikka vīṭum pucikka uṇavum uṇṭākkik koḷḷa uṇarntaṉar.  vilaṅkiṉ oru pirivāka vāḻnta maṉitaṉ aṟivāṟṟal peṟṟu nākarika vāḻkkiyi eytiṉāṉ.  avaṉ nākarika vāḻkkiyi aṭivataṟkup pallāyiram āṇṭukaḷ kaḻintaṉa.
maṉita vāḻkkikku iṉṟiyamiyāta uṇavu, uṭi uṟiyuḷ ākiyavaṟṟip peṟa  iṭiviṭātu muyaṉṟāṉ avaṉatu ariya muyaṟciyiṉ payaṉāy palavitat toḻilkaḷi uṇarntāṉ.  mutalil avaṉ payirt toḻilit toṭaṅkiṉāṉ.  appāl nūl nūṟkavum necavu neyyavum, vīṭu kaṭṭavum vaḻikaṇṭāṉ.
avaṉatu paṭṭaṟiviṉ payaṉāka toḻilkaḷ pala nāṭṭil urup peṟṟeḻuntaṉa.  oru toḻili uṇarntu ati niṟivāṉa toḻilāka viḷaṅkac ceyvataṟku maṉitaṉ paṉṉūṟu āṇṭukaḷik kaṭakka nērntatu ulakil maṉitaṉ pala toḻilkaḷip paṭittāṉ.  avaṉ toḻilkaḷip paṭippataṟku uyarnta karuvikaḷi uruvākkiṉāṉ.  avaṉ kaṇṭa toḻilukku iṉṟiyamiyāta uyarnta mūlapporuḷkaḷik kāṇa pala iṭaṅkaḷukkum ceṉṟu alintu tirintuḷḷāṉ.  appāl avaṉ aritiṟ kaṇṭa toḻilkaḷi eḷitāka muṭikkavum eḻil peṟac ceyyum muyaṟci ceytāṉ avaṉatu muyaṟciyil avaṉ periya veṟṟiyi īṭṭiṉāṉ.  avaṉatu kivaṇṇam meyvaṇṇattiyum veṉṟatu.  ciṟpat toḻilāḷi teyvam pōl uyarntāṉ.  avaṉ paṭitta ciṟpap poruḷkaḷ iyaṟkiyiyum veṉṟaṉa.  avaṉ teyvatti yum viñci viṭṭāṉ eṉṟu pulavarkaḷ pukaḻ māli cūṭṭiṉar.
maṉitaṉ ātiyil uṇavup poruḷic cuṭṭuttiṉṉat toṭaṅkiṉāṉ. appāl ati neyyiliṭṭu vatakkic cāppiṭavum, uppu, puḷi, miḷaku mutaliyavaṟṟic cērttu aṟucuviyuṭaṉ uṇṇavum terintāṉ.
avaṉ melliya nūli nūṟkavum, aḻakiya āṭikaḷi neyyavum, tuṇikaḷukku civappu, mañcaḷ, karuppu, nīlam, ūtā pōṉṟa eṇṇilā vaṇṇaṅkaḷi ūṭṭavum vaḻi kaṇṭāṉ.  āṭikaḷil paṟavi, vilaṅku, ceṭi, koṭi, ili, pū, kāy pōṉṟa uruvaṅkaḷit tīṭṭi eḻil mikum uṭikaḷi aṇiya muṉ vantāṉ.  paṭṭāṭikaḷiyum, kampaḷi āṭikaḷiyum ceytu aṇintu akamakiḻntāṉ.
avaṉ ātiyil ōlik kuṭicikaḷit tāṉ kaṇṭāṉ.  appāl maṇ cuvarkaḷi nāṟpuṟamum eḻuppi mēlē ōlikaḷāl kūri vēyntu atil uṟintāṉ.  piṉ maravīṭukaḷiyum, ceṅkallum cuṇṇāmpum kalantu cuvar eḻuppi mēlē  marattiṉāl caṭṭamum viṭṭamum, mallukaḷum, paṭṭiyalkaḷum amittu kūrikku ōṭu vēyntāṉ.  piṉṉar cuvarkaḷiṉ mītu uttaramum, kaṭṭikaḷum vittuk kaṭṭi ceṅkallum cuṇṇāmpum cērttu mēṟṟaḷam iṭṭu maṭṭap pāy vīṭukaḷik kaṭṭiṉāṉ.  piṟaku oṉṟiraṇṭu māṭikaḷiyum amittāṉ.  vīṭukaḷil tūṇkaḷum, palakaṇikaḷum, nilikaḷum, katavukaḷum, uttaramum, kaṭṭikaḷum, palakikaḷum, pōtikikaḷum iṭam peṟṟaṉa.  vīṭukaḷ muṟṟam, tāḻvāram paṭṭāli, iraṇṭām kaṭṭu, araṅku, tuyiliṭam, aṭukkaḷi, paṇṭaka cāli, nilā muṟṟam pōṉṟa uṟuppukaḷip peṟṟaṉa.  kaṭṭiṭam ciṟṟillam, māḷiki, araṇmaṉi, kōyil, kaḷañciyam, araṇ pōṉṟu palavakiyāy vaḷarcciyuṟṟatu.
maṉitaṉ tāṉ kaṇṭa ellāt toḻililum ellāt tuṟiyum nuṇṇuṇarvic celutti avikaḷi aḻaku peṟavum, cuviyuṟavum, uṟuti poliyavum, iṉimi ceṟiyavum ceytāṉ.  ivaṟṟi maṉitaṉ kali eṉṟu kūṟiṉāṉ.  makkaḷ kaṇṭa uṇavu, uṭi, uṟiyuḷ pōṉṟavikaḷil maṭṭumalla maruttuvam, ōviyam, nāṭakam, nāṭṭiyam, eḻuttu, moḻi, ici pōṉṟavi aṉit tilum kaliyip pukuttiṉāṉ. kali eṭṭāka eḻuntu eṭṭeṭṭāka aṟupattu nāṉkāka malarntu nūṟṟeṭṭāka uyarntu iṉṟu āyirat teṭṭāka vaḷarntu mēlum eṇṇaṟṟa tāka virintuḷḷatu.
makkaḷatu aka uṇarcciyiṉ teḷivāṉa niliyiṉiṉṟē perukkeṭuttu veḷit tōṉṟum cīriya kali uṇarcciyiṉ payaṉākattāṉ ulakam kaṇṭu viyantu pōṟṟum ulakil oppaṟṟa cintu veḷip paṇpāṭu aiyāyiram āṇṭukaṭku muṉ malarntatu.  aḻakuṇarcciyiṉ ariya nuṇukkamē avaṉi pōṟṟum ajantā ōviyamāka uruppeṟa muṭintatu.  kaliyiṉ nuṇṇiya eḻucciyē ellōrākkukic ciṟpamāka kāntārak kaviṉ ciṟpamākat tuḷirtteḻuntatu.  tamiḻ nāṭṭuc ciṟpikaḷil kivaṇṇac ciṟappē tilli āṭa vallaṉāy, nellik kūttaṉāy, kōṉērirācapuram ampalavāṇaṉāy eḻil peṟṟilaṅkumpaṭi ceytatu.  cōḻa nāṭṭu kaṭṭiṭak kali vallunarkaḷiṉ aḷappaṟiya ciṟpac ciṟappē tañcip peruvuṭiyār kōyilāka ulakil oppaṟṟa viṇmuṭṭum vimāṉamāy eḻuntōṅkumpaṭi ceytatu.
kaṭṭiṭak kali makkaḷ kaṇṭakaviṉ kali oṉṟu.  atu naṉṟāṉa nākarikak kali eṉṟum kūṟalām.  kaṭṭiṭak kali, makkaḷ vāḻviṟku iṉṟiyamiyāta ēṟṟamuṟṟa eḻiṟkali eṉṟum collalām.  kaṭṭiṭak kaliyil, toḻil nuṭpam, aḻaku, kaṟpaṉi ākiya mūṉṟu uyariya nilikaḷi oruṅkē peṟṟa oppaṟṟa kaliyāyiṟṟu.  kaṭṭiṭam kaṭṭuvataṟku ceṅkal ceyyum toḻil, kottu vēli, taccuvēli, irumpu vēli, kaṭṭiṭap paṭam variyum vēli mutaliya toḻilkaḷiṉ nuṭpam terintirukka vēṇṭiyatāyiṟṟu kaṭṭiṭam uṟutiyākavum uyaramākavum, vicālamākavum maṭṭum iruntāṟ pōtātu.  atil  vāḻpavarkaḷiṉ vacatikku uriyatākavum, cukātārattiṟku ēṟṟatākavum uḷḷattiṟku uvaki aḷippatākavum eḻil nalam vāyntatākavum irukka vēṇṭum.  uṟiyuḷ kaṭṭiṭac ciṟpamākac ciṟantirukka vēṇṭum eṉṟāl atu kāṇpavarkaḷiṉ kaṟpaṉiyit tūṇṭat takkatākat tulaṅka  vēṇṭum.  kaṟpaṉi palavakikaḷil tūṇṭap peṟalām.  cila kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ varalāṟṟut toṭarpāl kaṟpaṉiyik kavaralām.  cila kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ ataṉ puṉitat taṉmiyāl makkaḷ uḷḷattik kavarak kūṭum.  kaṟpaṉiyit tūṇṭak kūṭiya kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷiyellām kaṭṭiṭa ciṟpam eṉṟu kūṟa muṭiyātu.  kavarcci aḻakiṉ aṭippaṭiyil amintirukka vēṇṭum.  kaṭṭiṭam ciṟitākavō, peritākavō, putitākavō, paḻiyatākavō, kuḷḷamākavō, uyaramākavō-eppaṭiyum irukkalām.  āṉāl atu aḻaku amintatāy ciṟpa nuṭpam ceṟivatāy irukka vēṇṭum.  avvāṟu iruntāl atu kaṭṭiṭa ciṟpam eṉṟu aḻikkappaṭum.  aḻaku eṉpatu kaṟpaṉiyi tūṇṭum vēlippāṭṭik kuṟippatākum.
oru nāṭṭuk kaṭṭiṭac  ciṟpak kali vaḷarccikku mūlatāramāy amintuḷḷatu avarkaḷ camayaṅkaḷākum.  avi kaṭṭiṭak kali vaḷarccikku aṭi kōliyatu  poṉṉē pōl pōṟṟi vaḷarttatu.  mēlum atu ciṟappākak kōyil kaṭṭiṭak kaliyip pēṇivaḷarttatu.  camayam vaḷartta kōyilkaḷ, paṭimakkalikku uṟiviṭamāy iruntaṉa.  kōyilkaḷ, ici, nāṭakam, nāṭṭiyam, kaṇitam, uṇavu, aṇikalaṉ, tiruviḷakku, āṭikaḷ, kalveṭṭu, ceppēṭukaḷ, icik karuvikaḷ, veḷḷi, cempup pāttiraṅkaḷ, ōviyam iṉṉōraṉṉa eṇṇilāk kalikaḷiyum vaḷarttaṉa.  avaṟṟi kalip poruḷkaḷikkākkum kali araṇkaḷ eṉṟu kūṟiṉum cālap poruntum.  intiyak kaṭṭiṭak kali āyvut tuṟi vallunarāka matikkappaṭum aṟiñar tiru. perkūcaṉ avarkaḷ, kaṭavuḷ vaḻipāṭṭiṟkākak kōyil kaṭṭa vēṇṭum eṉṟa ārvamē ellōrum viyantu pōṟṟum kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ tōṉṟuvataṟku mūlātāramāy iruntatu eṉṟu kūṟiyatu āḻnta karuttuṭiyatākum.  iṟivaṉ uṟivataṟku ēṟṟa iṭatti uruvākka vēṇṭum eṉṟa ārvam kali vaḷarccikku iṉṟiyamiyāta karupporuḷi uṇṭākkiyatu.  anta māperum nōkkattiṉ tūṇṭutal eṇṇilāk kōyilkaḷi eḻuppiyatu.  maṉṉarkaḷum makkaḷum kaviṉ peṟum kalik kōyilkaḷi uruvākkiṉar.  eṉavē kōyil, ellāk kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷiyum viṭa kaviṉuṟum vaṉappuḷḷatāy, eṉṟum poṉṟāta uṟutiyuḷḷatāy ulakam viyakkum uyarnta niliyil ki.pi. aintām nuṟṟāṇṭil, cōḻap pēraracaṉ kōcceṅkaṇāṉ eḻupatu māṭak kōyilkaḷi eṭuppittāṉ.  irācarācaṉ ulakil uyarnta vimāṉattiyuṭiya tañcip peruvuṭiyar kōyili eṭuppittāṉ.  itu paktiyiṉ ciṉṉam.  mokalāya maṉṉaṉ  ṣājakāṉ taṉ maṉiviyiṉ niṉivāka ulakilē viliyuyarnta aḻakiya maṇi māḷikiyāka matikkap peṟum tājmakāli eḻuppiṉāṉ.  itu kātaliṉ ciṉṉam.  iraṇṭum intiyak kaṭṭiṭak kaliyiṉ kaṇ eṉak karutappaṭupavi.  ulakilē paktiyum kātalum ulakil uyarnta kaṭṭiṭak kalikaḷi eḻuppuvataṟku aṭippaṭiyāy iruntaṉa eṉpatu naṉku teriya varukiṟatu.   tamiḻ nāṭṭu maṉṉarkaḷ campantapaṭṭa maṭṭil avarkaḷiṉ araṇmaṉikaḷ eṉṟu kūṟattakkavikaḷ etuvum kāṇappaṭavilli.  āṉāl avarkaḷ eḻuppiya kōyilkaḷ āyiram āyiram āṇṭukaḷ ākiyum aḻiyātu nilittu niṟkiṉṟaṉa.  namatu māmaṉṉarkaḷ taṅkaḷukku uyarnta araṇmaṉiyi amittiruntaṉarkaḷā?  ciṉṉañ ciṟu kallil vāḻntiruntaṉarā eṉṟa aiyappāṭṭik kūṭa eḻuppuvatāka uḷḷatu.  atu evvāṟāyiṉum irukkaṭṭum, avarkaḷ taṅkaḷuk keṉṟu viliyuyarnta kōyilkaḷi (araṇmaṉikaḷi)  amippati viṭa iṟivaṉukkeṉṟu kōyil amippatilum, avi eṉṟum nilittu niṟpatilum atu ulakam uḷḷaḷavum iruntu eppoḻutum pūci, nivēttiyaṅkaḷ naṭipeṟuvatilum atika akkari koṇṭiruntārkaḷ eṉpati avarkaḷ kōyilkaḷukku aḷitta nipantaṅkaḷum, kalveṭṭukaḷum, ceppēṭukaḷum naṉku eṭuttukkāṭṭupaviyāka uḷḷaṉa.
ulakilē intiyāviltāṉ atikamāṉa kōyilkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  atilum eṉṟum aḻiyāta kaṟkōyilkaḷ uyariya ciṟpaṅkaḷi yuṭiya aḻakiya kōyilkaḷ uṇṭeṉṟu ellā nāṭṭaṟiñarkaḷ karutukiṉṟārkaḷ.
ulakilē uyarnta kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷiyum, tirukkōyilkaḷi yum, araṇkaḷiyum amikkum paṇpum marapum tiṟaṉum tirāviṭa iṉattiṟkē uṇṭu.  ulakilē enta nāṭṭilāyiṉum āyiram āṇṭiṟku muṉ uḷḷa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ irukkiṟatu eṉṟu kūṟappeṟṟāl atu niccayam tirāviṭarkaḷāl allatu avarkaḷatu iratta campantamāṉa uṟaviṉarkaḷāl eṭuppikkappaṭṭatāka irukkum eṉṟu aimpatu āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ  eṉatu tantiyār tiru.vaṭi. aruṇācalakkavirāyar avarkaḷ kūṟiṉārkaḷ.  aṉṟu avarkaḷ kūṟiya kūṟṟil eṉakku nampikki illi.  iṉṟu avarkaḷatu vārttiyil 100kku 100 catavikitam uṇmiyirukkiṟatu eṉṟu nampukiṟēṉ.
kaviṉ peṟum kaṭṭiṭam etu?  ciṟanta kali etu?  makkaḷukku iṉṟiyamiyāta paṇi etu?  eṉpatu kālattiṟkuk kālam māṟu paṭum.  nāṭṭiṟku nāṭu māṟupaṭum.  iṉattiṟku iṉam vēṟupaṭum.  makkaḷiṉ eṇṇam, nōkkam, aḻakuṇarcci avarkaḷiṉ aṟivu vaḷarcci, poruḷātāra nili, taṭpa veppa nili, kiṭikkak kūṭiya poruḷkaḷ nākarikam pōṉṟavi kaṭṭiṭac ciṟpattiṉ amippi, taratti nirṇayam ceyyat tuṇiyāy iruntu vantuḷḷaṉa.
paṇṭik kālattiya ekiptiya nāṭṭu makkaḷiṉ vāḻkki aṟivulakam eṉṟum āḻntu cintikkat takkatāy amintuḷḷatu.  oru puṟam koṭiya kōra niliyiyuṭiya pālivaṉam.  maṟṟoru pakkam eṅkum pacumiyi parappi eḻil tarum ceṭi koṭi kaḷiyum, kottuk kottākap pūttuk kuluṅkum vaṇṇa malarkaḷiyum, tiraṇṭa kāykaḷiyum, paḻuttut toṅkum iṉiya paḻak kulikaḷiyum, uyarnta uṇavup poruḷāṉa vāṟ kōtumi vayalkaḷi piṟa vāḻkkikku iṉṟiyamiyāta poruḷkaḷi ceḻittu vaḷaracceyyum Ús(Neela)  nīla āṟṟaṅkarikaḷil uḷḷa ūrkaḷilum ati aṭuttuḷḷa nakarkaḷilum ciṟṟūr kaḷilum vāḻntavarkaḷ. avarkaḷ tirāviṭa iṉattiṉ neruṅkiya  uṟaviṉarkaḷ.  ati avarkaḷ camayamum, teyvaṅkaḷum, moḻiyum paṇpāṭum varalāṟum kalikaḷum uṟutippaṭuttukiṉṟaṉa.  avarkaḷ cāviṟku añciyatilli.  maraṇam oru muṭivāṉa nili eṉṟu nampiyatilli.  uyir uṭali viṭṭup pirivatu uṇmi.  āṉāl atu uyiriṉ iṟutinili alla.  cāvu uyirkaḷukku eḻum oru māṟṟu nikaḻcciyit taviṟa vēṟalla.  oruvaṉuṭiya uyir uṭali viṭṭu nīṅkiya piṉ - atāvatu ivvulakit tuṟantapiṉ vēṟu ulakiṟ ceṉṟu ellā vāḻkki nalattiyum peṟṟu iṉpuṟṟu vāḻntu varum eṉpatu paṇṭiya ekiptiya makkaḷiṉ nampikki.  eṉavē avarkaḷ uyirtuṟanta piṉṉarum uṭali keṭātavāṟu maruntiṭṭu peṭṭikaḷil vittu avarkaḷ payaṉpaṭuttiya poruḷkaḷi yellām vittu putittu camāti eḻuppiṉar.  aṉṟu avarkaḷ eḻuppiya camātikaḷiṉ kōpuraṅkaḷē (piramiṭukaḷē) kōyilkaḷāka malarntaṉa.  niliyāṉa pēṟum uṟutiyum ekiptiya makkaḷiṉ kuṟikkōḷāka iruntaṉa.  avarkaḷ tirāviṭarkaḷip pōl periya kal tūṇkaḷ viṭṭu, kal uttaraṅ
kaḷi vittu periya kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷi eḻuppiṉar.  avarkaḷ nāṭṭil takutiyāṉa kaṟkaḷ kiṭikkavilli.  veḷināṭu
kaḷiṉiṉṟu mikunta ciramappaṭṭu kaṟkaḷik koṇṭu kallālāṉa camātik kōpuraṅkaḷi eṭuppittaṉar.  cāvaka nāṭṭiluḷḷa peruṅkōyilkaḷ aṉittum maṉṉarkaḷiṉ camātikaḷiṉ mītē eṭuppikkap peṟṟuḷḷatu;  tamiḻ nāṭṭiluḷḷa pala paḻiya kōyilkaḷ cittarkaḷ camātiyiṉ mītu eṭuppikkap peṟṟavi eṉṟu iṉṉiṉṉa cittarkaḷ camātiyiṉ iṉṉiṉṉa ūrk kōyil eḻuppap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa eṉṟum cila aṟiñarkaḷ viḷakkan tantuḷḷaṉar.  itaṉ mūlam ekiptiya nākarikam, tirāviṭa marapi aṭippaṭiyākak koṇṭatu eṉpati eṭuttuk kāṭṭuvatāka amintuḷḷatu eṉat teriyavarukiṟatu.
kirēkkarkaḷ iyaṟki eḻilum, eṇṇaṟṟa vaḷamum vāynta nāṭṭil vāḻnta makkaḷ. aḻakum, uṇmiyum kirēkkarkaḷiṉ paṇpāṭṭil irukaṇkaḷāka nilaviṉa.  avarkaḷ kalikaḷil aḻakum meyyum iṇintu ēṟṟamuṟṟu ilaṅkiṉa.  avarkaḷ nāṭṭiṟ kiṭitta calavik kaṟkaḷāl kōyilkaḷiyum, kaṭṭiṭaṅ
kaḷiyum amittu kaṭṭiṭak kalikku ciṟappūṭṭiṉar.   kirēkkar
kaḷiṉ kaṭṭiṭak kaliyilum, cilikkalikaḷilum meṉmiyum tiṇmiyum, nayamum polivuṟṟaṉa.
tirāviṭarkaḷ teyva nampikki vāyntavarkaḷ.  uṭali iṟivaṉ vāḻum kōyilāka eṇṇupavarkaḷ itaṉi naṭamāṭuṅ kōyil eṉṟu avarkaḷ maṟinūlkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟaṉa.  eṉṟum aḻiyātu nili peṟṟirukkum iṟivaṉukku eṉṟum aḻiyā uṟiviṭamāka kukik kōyiliyum kuṭi varik kōyiliyum kaṟṟaḷikaḷiyum amittavarkaḷ āṇṭavaṉ aḻivaṟṟavaṉ avaṉ uṟiyum kōyilum aḻivaṟṟatu eṉṟu ulakiṟku meyp pittavarkaḷ. kallāl aṭippaṭiyum, taḷamum, cuvarkaḷum, tūṇkaḷum, uttaramum, pāvu kallum koṇṭu kōyil amittavarkaḷ.  ulakam aḻiyiṉum tāṉ aḻiyātu niṟkum taṉit taṉmi peṟṟa taṅkaḷ iṟivaṉi vaḻipaṭa niliyāṉa kōyilkaḷi uruvākkiyavarkaḷ tirāviṭarkaḷ eṉṟu ulakak kōyil varalāṟṟil uyarnta iṭattip peṟṟavarkaḷ.  tirāviṭa makkaḷ paṭitta viṇmuṭṭum vimāṉaṅkaḷum, mukilaḷāvum kōpuraṅkaḷum tirāviṭarkaḷiṉ uyarnta koḷkikaḷukkum kuṟikkōḷkaḷukkum oru uyariya ciṉṉam pōl tikaḻkiṉṟaṉa.
ulakil, makkaḷ vāḻum palvēṟu pakutikaḷilum toṉmi yāṉa kālattilē taṉittaṉiyē kaṭṭiṭak kali eḻuntuḷḷatu.  atu aṉṟiyac cūḻnilikaḷukkēṟpavum, makkaḷiṉ tēvikaḷuk kēṟpavum vaḷarntuḷḷatu.  paḻaṅkāla kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ, avaṟṟi uruvākkap payaṉpaṭuttappaṭṭa poruḷkaḷ, avaṟṟiṉ aḻipāṭukaḷ ammakkaḷiṉ aṟivu, paṇpāṭu, nākarikam, kali, varalāṟu, camayam mutaliyavaṟṟi aṟintu koḷḷat tuṇiyāka irukkiṉṟaṉa.
ātikālak kaṭṭiṭak kaliyilum iṭikkālak kaṭṭiṭak kaliyum, kaṭṭiṭak kalic ciṟpamum aḻakum, uṟutiyum uḷḷavi kaḷāyt tikaḻkiṉṟaṉa.  aracarkaḷum, nilakkiḻārkaḷum, vaṇikar kaḷum āṭampara vāḻkki naṭatti vantaṉar.  eṉṟālum kali vaḷarppatilum kaṇṇōṭṭam celuttupavarkaḷāy iruntaṉar.  aracarkaḷiṉ ātaravip peṟṟu ciṟpikaḷ taṅkaḷ kalvi aṟivi yum kali aṟiviyum, kaṟpaṉit tiṟaṉiyum payaṉpaṭutti ciṟanta kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷiyum, oppaṟṟa ōviyaṅkaḷiyum, cīriya cilikaḷi yum, pāvaṅkaḷ oḷirum paṭimaṅkaḷiyum paṭittu teyvam uṟiyum tirukkōyilkaḷiyum aracaṉ vāḻum araṇmaṉi kaḷiyum aḻaku poliya amittuḷḷaṉar.  itu nilakkiḻārkaḷ taṅkaḷiṉ piraputtuva niliyi eṉṟum nili peṟṟu niṟkac ceyta tantiram eṉpar cilar muṟpōkku eḻuttāḷarkaḷ.
iṉṟu, ulakil uḷḷa ellā nāṭukaḷum aṇmiyil uḷḷa nāṭukaḷip pōl neruṅkit toṭarpu koḷḷat toṭaṅki yuḷḷaṉa.  oḷiyiyum oliyiyum viṭa vēkamākac cellum viṇṇūrti cilamaṇi nēraṅkaḷil ulakic cuṟṟi varukiṉṟatu.  oruvārattiṟkuḷ tiṅkaḷi aṭikiṉṟaṉa.  cila tiṅkaḷukkuḷ, cevvāy, putaṉ, viyāḻaṉ pōṉṟa kōḷkaḷi aṭikiṉṟaṉa.  aṅkuḷḷa nilikaḷip pūmiyil uḷḷa makkaḷukku uṇarttu kiṉṟaṉa.  ulakam aṉittiṟkum potuvāṉa kāṅkiriṭ pōṉṟa kaṭṭiṭap poruḷkaḷ payaṉpaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  ciṟpam, ōviyam pōṉṟa kaliyaṇikaḷ niṟinta kaviṉuṟum kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ eṅkum eḻuppap peṟukiṉṟaṉa.  makkaḷ vāḻkkiyil eḻuntuḷḷa kalvi, kuṭiyiruppu, aracāṭci mutaliyavikaḷukku ēṟpa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ uṟutiyākavum, vacatiyākavum, aḻakākavum kaṭṭappaṭṭu varukiṉṟaṉa.
tamiḻakattil ātiyil arumpiyatu teyva tiru uruvaṅkaḷ tāṉ.  teyvat tiru uruvaṅkaḷ tōṉṟip pallāyiram āṇṭu
kaḷukkup piṉṉar tiruk kōyilkaḷ eḻavilli.  āṉāl teyvat tiru uruvaṅkaḷi periya maraṅkaḷiṉ aṭiyil vittē vaḻipaṭṭu vantaṉar.  periyār ci. em. irāmaccantiraṉ ceṭṭiyār (muṉṉāḷ intu aṟaniliyap pātukāvaṟ kaḻakattiṉ āṇiyāḷar)  intiyāvō camayattik koṇṭatu āṉāl tamiḻnāṭō camayattilum, camaya niliyaṅkaḷic ciṟanta kuṟikkōḷākak koṇṭu viḷaṅkukiṟatu vēṟu nāṭṭu aṟiñarkaḷ evar inta nāṭṭiṟku vanta pōtilum iṅkuḷḷa camaya niliyaṅkaḷik kaṇṭu makiḻntu viyantu eḻutātār illi.  ākavē tamiḻ makkaḷ camaya niliyaṅkaḷukku vaḷarcci tantu avikaḷic cīriya muṟiyil vikkappaṭuvatiyē kuṟik kōḷākak koṇṭiruntārkaḷ eṉpatil aiyamilli camaya uṇarcci eppōtu ēṟpaṭṭatu eṉṟu colla iyalātu eṉṟu eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷār.
makkaḷ iṉattil camaya uṇarcci avarkaḷ kaṟkāla makkaḷāy irukkum kālattilē tuḷirttu viṭṭatu.  tāyē ātiyil taṉṉip peṟṟavaḷāy kāppavaḷāy araciyāy, maruttuvacciyāy, pātukākkum taṉṉalamaṟṟa kaṭavuḷāyk kāṇappaṭṭāḷ.  avaḷ iṟanta iṭattil naṭukal nāṭṭi avaḷi vaḻipaṭat toṭaṅkiṉāṉ appāl tantikkum, peruñcittarkaḷukkum, niṉivukal kaṭṭi vaḻipaṭat toṭaṅkiṉōm.  nīṇṭanāṭkaḷukkup piṟakē nammip pōla namatu camūkat talivarkaḷiṉ māḷikiyip pōl iṟutiyāy namatu aracaṉiṉ araṇmaṉiyip pōl nām vaḻipaṭum teyva uruvaṅkaḷukku kaṭṭiṭam eḻuppat toṭaṅki ṉōm.  nakaram, niyamam, kōṭṭam, paḷḷi, ālayam eṉṟa pataṅkaḷ kōyilukku vaḻaṅkappaṭṭaṉa.  kōyil eṉṉum patam kō + il eṉap pirittu aracaṉ vīṭu eṉṉum poruḷil payaṉpaṭutti appāl iṟivaṉ uṟiyum iṭattiṟkē niliyāṉa peyarāka nilittu niṟkac ceytu viṭṭōm.  oru kālattil maṉṉaṉik kaṭavuḷāka, allatu kaṭavuḷiṉ avatāramāka eṇṇiya kālattil avaṉ uṟiyum iṭattik kōyil eṉṟu payaṉpaṭuttiyatu tavaṟalla.  appāl makkaḷ aṟivu mutircciyiṉ payaṉāka maṉṉaṉ teyvamāka muṭiyātu avaṉ uṟiyum iṭam tēva kōṭṭamāka teyva uṟiyuḷḷākavō āka muṭiyātu eṉṟa eṇṇam piṟakkavē iṟivaṉ uṟiyum illam kōyilākavum aracaṉ uṟiyum maṉi araṇmaṉiyākavum nilipeṟṟu viṭṭatu.
iṟivaṉukku eḻilārnta illaṅkaḷi amittatu mikat toṉmiyāṉa ēṟpāṭu.  ātiyil makkaḷ aka nāḻikiyi maṭṭumē amittārkaḷ.  makkaḷ iṟi uruvattiṟkē illam kaṇṭārkaḷē yoḻiya makkaḷ veyilukkum, kāṟṟiṟkum, veppattiṟkum, maḻikkum kōyilōṭu cērttu iṭam amikka villi  - amippatu kūṭātu eṉṟum eṇṇiṉar.  namatu kōyilkaḷiṉ aṭippaṭiyilē cāñci, kāñci, cāranāt, pūri pōṉṟa iṭaṅkaḷil puttarkaḷ aka nāḻikiyi maṭṭum amittuḷḷārkaḷ.
mecapottāmiyā, ekiptu, kirīṭ kirīcu, urōm, pāracīkam, peru, mekcikkō, āppirikkā, cīṉam mutaliya nāṭukaḷil nilavi maṅki maṟintupōṉa mataṅkaḷ cumār irupatu irukkalām.  iṉṟu uyiruṭaṉ nilavum intu camayam, putta camayam, ilāmiya matam, kiṟittuva matam, yūta matam, corāṣṭaṭiriya matam, ciṇṭē camayam, kaṉpūciya matam ṭōvō matam, jiṉacamayam ākiya pattu mataṅkaḷic ciṟappākak kūṟalām.  ilāmiya camayam ki.pi 7-ām nūṟṟāṇṭil yūta kiṟittava camayattiṉ aṭippaṭiyil eḻunta vayatil kuṟinta camayam, ki.mu. 1980-āṇṭiṟku muṉ piṟanta kiṟittuviṉ vaḻiyi yoṭṭi eḻunta camayam ilāmiya neṟikku muṉ tōṉṟiya matam, maṟṟiya mataṅkaḷ etuvāy iruntālum iṉṟikku 2500 -m āṇṭiṟku muṟpaṭṭavikaḷē. iṟivaṉi vaḻipaṭum iṭaṅkaḷ eṉṉum poruḷil ellā mataṅkaḷukkum kōyilkaḷ eṭuppittu avaṟṟiṉ amippu kālattiṟkum iṭattiṟkum makkaḷiṉ nākarika vaḷarccikkum paṇpāṭṭiṟkum ēṟpa vaḷarntuḷḷatu.
paṇṭu toṭṭu iṉṟu vari ulakaṉittum kōyil eḻuntuḷḷataṟkuk kāraṇam camaya uṇarcci makkaḷiṭam eppoḻutum ētō ōraḷavil iruntu vantatē eṉpatil aiyamilli.  añciyāyiṉum, aṉpupaṭṭāyiṉum neñcam! vāḻi, niṉi niṉṟiyūri nī  eṉa namakku aṟivuṟuttiyuḷḷār āḷuṭiya piḷḷiyār.  mutalil ātikāla makkaḷ tāykkum, tāyt teyvattiṟkum ēṉ?  ammiyappaṉukkum añci vaḻipaṭṭa makkaḷēyāvar.  nam kaṇṇiṟkup pulappaṭātu aṇuviṉukkum aṇuvāy nilavum aṟivuṭiya peruñcaktiyeṉṟum perumpālum ataṟkaṭaṅki naṭantu tam muṭporutu koṇṭirukkum vēṟu ciṟu caktikaḷ tēvatikaḷ palavum uṇṭeṉṟum aviyellām makkaḷ vāḻkkiyil kalantu koṇṭu naṉmi tīmi mutaliyavaṟṟi nalkum taṉmi vāyntaṉa eṉṟum avaṟṟiyellām nām vaḻipaṭṭāl avi nammit tuṉpuṟuttātu eṉṟu makkaḷ nampi vāḻkkiyi naṭattiṉārkaḷ.  paṇṭik kāla makkaḷ vaḻipaṭṭa tāyt teyvaṅkaḷ tantit teyvaṅkaḷ, kaṇṇaṉ teyvam makaṉ teyvam pōṉṟavi paṭippaṭiyāy uyarntaṉa.  mēṭṭiṟkum malikkum, viṇṇiṟkumāka uyarntaṉa.  ñāyiṟu, tiṅkaḷ, cevvāy, putaṉ, mutaliya kōḷkaḷākavum, neruppu, nilam, nīr kāṟṟu, ākāyam maṭṭumiṉṟi iṭi, maḻi mutaliyavikaḷum teyvaṅkaḷāyiṉa.  ivaṟṟit teyvaṅkaḷākak koṇṭu ivaṟṟiṟku uyir pali iṭutal pipiḷil kūṟum ātām kālattil iruntu iṉṟu vari ellā mataṅkaḷum palvēṟu peyaril perum vaḻakkāy iruntu vantatu eṉpatu uṟutiyākum.  paḻaṅkālattil namatu camayaṅkaḷil irunta mūtātiyarkaḷ āṭumāṭu kutiri oṭṭakam kōḻi mutaliyavaṟṟi maṭṭumiṉṟi maṉita uyirkaḷiyum paliyiṭṭu vantārkaḷ.  anta vaḻakkam iṉṟu kūṭa muṟṟāka niṟuttappaṭavilli.  tām uṇṇum kāykaṟip poruḷiyum  tam kaṭavuḷukkup paṭittatuṇṭu.  ippaṭi pali, vēḷvi ceyyum poḻutu tām vaḻipaṭum teyvattip pōṟṟi pukaḻntu tam kuṟikaḷik kūṟuvatuṇṭu.
uṇmiyi urippatāṉāl iṉṟu kōyilil irukkum palipīṭam kēraḷattil palikkal eṉṟa peyaril iruppavikaḷ aṉittum ātikālattil uyirkaḷip paliyiṭṭa iṭamēyākum.  iṉṟu uyirppali civarkaḷ kōyilil maṭṭumalla kattōlikka kiṟittavarkaḷ kōyilkaḷilum palippīṭaṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  āṉāl uyirppali ceyvatilli.  āṉāl civa camaya aṟivarkaḷ palippīṭaṅkaḷ, maṉitaṉ iṟivaṉ cannitikkup pōkum muṉ taṉ uḷḷattil uḷḷa tīya eṇṇaṅkaḷi viṭṭuviṭṭu (akaṟṟi) puṉitamāṉa uḷḷattōṭu celka eṉpati niṉivūṭṭuvataṟku vittirukkiṟatu eṉṟu tattuvak karuttukkaḷ kūṟuvatu pōl kiṟitavarkaḷum kūṟukiṟārkaḷām.   āṉāl ātimaṉitaṉākiya ātām-ēvāḷ eṉpavarkaḷ makkaḷ iruvar iruntārkaḷ avarkaḷil oruvaṉ kāpayar kāyīṉ avaṉ vivacāyi, maṟṟavaṉ āṭumāṭukaḷi mēyppavaṉ.  ivviruvarkaḷil āṭumēyppavaṉ kaṭavuḷukku (karttarukku) āṭu māṭukaḷip paliyiṭṭu vantāṉ.  kaṭavuḷ avaṉ mītu piriyamāka iruntār.  avaṉukku vēṇṭiya naṉmikaḷic ceytu vantār.  mūttavaṉākiya kāyīṉ vēḷāṇmi ceypavaṉ avaṉ kaṭavuḷukku appam, paḻam, kāykaṉi kiḻaṅku mutaliyavikaḷip paṭittu vaḻi paṭṭu vantāṉ.  kaṭavuḷ (tēvaṉ) avaṉ mēl piriyamāka illi. eṉavē avaṉ kōpamum poṟāmiyum koṇṭavaṉāka āpēl eṉṉum tampiyi veṭṭik koṉṟu viṭṭāṉ.  itaṉip pipiḷ eṉṉum kiṟittavat tirumaṟi eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṟatu.  āpirakām taṉmakaṉip paliyiṭa aḻittuc ceṉṟatum kaṭavuḷ atit taṭuttatum piṉ avaṉ aṇmiyil niṉṟa āṭṭip paliyiṭṭatum teḷivāyk kuṟippiṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  kiṟitavarkaḷ iṉṟu palipīṭam vittirukkiṟārkaḷ.  pali iṭuvatilli eṉṟālum avarkaḷiṉ kaṭavuḷākiya ekōvā āṭu māṭu, mutaliya palikaḷi virumpi ēṟṟuk koṇṭatōṭu maṉitap paliyiyum ēṟṟuk koṇṭiruk kiṟār eṉṟu cāṉṟu kāṭṭa muṭiyum.
iṉṟu civaṉ kōyilkaḷilum pala tāyt teyvaṅkaḷiṉ palipīṭam uṇṭu pali iṭuvatilli.  appar cāmi kālattiṟku piṉ civaperumāṉukku āṭumāṭu, erumi kōḻi mutaliyavikaḷ paliyiṭṭatuṇṭu civaperumāṉ taṉ paktarkaḷiṭam piḷḷikkaṟi kēṭṭa katiyum uṇṭu.  pala kōyilkaḷilum tēr iḻukkum pōtu kōḻikkuñciyip paṭṭatuṇṭu.  vīṭukaṭṭi muṭintatum taccuk kaḻittal eṉṉum peyarāl āṭṭi paliyiṭṭu ataṉ utiratti vīṭṭil teḷippatum uṇṭu.  iṟanta uyirkaḷukku kōḻikkuñci capparattil (pāṭiyil) kaṭṭik koṇṭu pōy paliyiṭṭu ati vaṇṇārkaḷ eṭuttuk koḷvatum uṇṭu.  itaṉi maṟiyātu civap periyār caccitāṉantam piḷḷi yavarkaḷ B.A.B.T mutal mutal maṉitaṉ vaḻipaṭa kōvilā iruntatu.  ippaṇi mēṭiyē iruntatu.  ovvoru ūrilum iyaṟki vaḷam ceṟintatōr  pakkattil ceḻittut taḻittu vaḷarnta marattaṭiyil palippīṭam amikkappaṭṭiruntatu.1  kaṭavuḷ aṅkeḻuntaruḷi taṉṉi vaḻipaṭuvōr tarum palikaḷiyum ceyyum tōttiraṅkaḷiyum ēṟṟu koḷkiṉṟār eṉṉum  nampikki valuttatum appāṟi irunta iṭattiṟkē perum matippēṟpaṭṭu viṭṭatu.  kuṟitta nāṭkaḷil ammēṭikkum ceṉṟu paliyiṭṭup pōṟṟi varam vēṇṭum pōtu maṭṭumiṉṟi ammēṭiyik kāṇa nērnta pōtellām kaṭavuḷi niṉittu vaṇaṅki celvatum iyalpāyiṟṟu.
neṭuṅkālam variyil ippalimēṭiyit tavira vēṟu kōyilkaḷ eviyum ēṟpaṭṭatākat teriyavilli.  piṉpu maṉitaṉ taṉ karuttukaḷip parup poruḷāka veḷiyiṭuvataṟku muyaṉṟapōtu tāṉ kaṇṭa poruḷkaḷiṉ uruvaṅkaḷi variyat talippaṭṭāṉ cittiram ivvāṟu tōṉṟiyatu.  piṉpu puṟakkaṇṇāṟ kāṇap peṟāta maṉak kaṇṇāṟ kaṇṭa kāṭci kaḷiyum uruvaṅkaḷiyum cittarikkalāṉāṉ.  nāḷaṭivil ivvaṭivaṅkaḷi maṇṇilum marattilum kallilum paṉṉāṭ kaḷukkup piṉ ulōkaṅkaḷilum ceyyum tiṟamiyum vaḻakkum perukiṉa.
ippaṭik kaṭavuḷi vaḻipaṭuvataṟku ēṟpaṭṭa paruvuruvaṅ kaḷip paṇṭiya maṉitaṉ pali mēṭik ketiril eḻuntaruḷap paṇṇiṉāṉ.  ivaṟṟuḷ mikavum paḻiyatu aṉaṟ koḻuntu vaṭivāyuḷḷa civaliṅkamē eṉṟu karuta iṭamuṇṭu eṅṅaṉa meṉṟu ciṟitu kāṇpām.  ñāyiṟu, tiṅkaḷ tī mutaliya iyaṟkip perum poruḷkaḷit taṉittaṉi tēvatikaḷāyk koṇṭu vaṇaṅkiya makkaḷ nāḷaṭivil aṟivu peruka avaruṭ ciṟantōr avaṟṟiluḷḷa nalamum valiyumellām orē iṟivaṉuṭiya teṉṟu kaṇṭaṉar.  appōtu avaṟṟi iṟivaṉatu māperummēṉikaḷāka viḷakka niliyaṅkaḷākak karuti vaḻipaṭat talippaṭṭārkaḷ avaṟṟuḷ tīyāṉatu makkaḷ kikkeṭṭuvatāy avarkaḷāl vaḷarkkak kūṭiyatāṉa pōtu avvaṉaṟ piḻampi ciṟappu vakiyil āṇṭavaṉ tirumēṉiyākak koṇṭu pōṟṟum vaḻakkam perukiṟṟu.  koṟkit tīyāṉatu neyyum viṟakum koṇṭu ōmpappaṭṭa pōtaṉṟit tōṉṟātu.  aṉṟiyum maṉitaṉ taṉ aṉpiṉ aṟikuṟiyāka avvaṉaṟ koḻuntiṟku nīrāṭalum āṭi canta maṇimalar puṉitalum iyalāvaṉṟē?  ātaliṉ avvaṉaṟ piḻampuruvatti kallil amittu vaṇaṅkum vaḻakkam tōṉṟiyatu.  ivviliṅka vaḻipāṭu paṇṭiya  mekcikkō, ekiptu, arāpiyā mutaliya veḷināṭukaḷil iruntataṟkuc cāṉṟukaḷ kiṭikkiṉṟaṉa. namatu nāṭṭil ippaṇṭiya vaḻipāṭu imayam mutal kumari variyil iṉṟaḷavum kāṇak kiṭakkiṉṟatu aṟiñarkaḷ ivviliṅkattiṉ kaṇ tattuvam kaṭanta taṉi mutaṟ poruḷāṅ kantaḻiyi vaḻipaṭukiṉṟaṉar.  maṟṟiyōriṟ palar oru marattiṉ kīḻ kallilō maṇṇilō ivviliṅka vaṭivic camittu tam iṣṭa teyvatti ataṉil varuvittu vaṇaṅkutal iṉṟum kaṇ kūṭāyuḷḷatu.  mikavum paṇṭiyatāṉa civaliṅka vaḻipāṭṭuṭaṉ ki kāl mutaliya uṟuppukaḷ poruntiya palvēṟu uruvaṅkaḷi vittuc ceyyum vaḻipāṭukaḷ piṉṉāṟpalkiṉa ivaṟṟi virikkiṟ perukum.
ivvāṟellām uruva vaḻipāṭu peruki varukiyil aḷapparum perumiyuṭiya āṇṭavaṉ vatitaṟkuttakka ciṟappaminta kōyil vēṇṭum eṉṉum viruppamum muyaṟciyum tōṉṟiṉa.  aracaṉillattiṉum pārkka āṇṭavaṉ uṟiyuḷ cīriṉum ciṟappiṉum viñci viḷaṅka vēṇṭum eṉṉum ārvam perukiṟṟu.  ivvāṟu kōyilkaḷ ulakeṅkum tōṉṟip perum polivōṭu nilavalāyiṉa eṉṟu civa cittānta camayatti piracurikka eḻunta centamiḻc celvi eṉṉum tiṅkaḷ ēṭṭil uṇmiyi maṟikkātu veḷiyiṭṭuḷḷār.1
kōyilkaḷ eppaṭit tōṉṟiyatu.  uruva vaḻipāṭu eppaṭit tōṉṟiyatu.  ekkālat tōṉṟiyatu eṉṟa ārāycci tamiḻarkaḷukku eḻuntatē illi.  atōṭu tām aṟinta uṇmiyi ulakiṟku uṇartta vēṇṭum eṉṟa eṇṇamum eḻuntatē illi.  civa camayattip parappa eḻunta kaḻakaṅkaḷum nūṟpatippuk kaḻakaṅkaḷum, tiṅkaḷ itaḻkaḷum namatu kōyilkaḷip paṟṟi nūl eḻuta muṉ vantatē illi.  perci piravuṇ, cōviyat tuprayal, ṭellā kirāmriṣ pōṉṟa mēṉāṭṭaṟiñar nūlkaḷip parappavō allatu tamiḻākkam ceytu veḷiyiṭavō itu vari muṉ varavilli.  tēvāram, tiruvācakam, tirukkuṟaḷ, akanāṉūṟu, puṟanāṉūṟu pōṉṟa nūṟkaḷiyum veḷiyiṭṭu kācu campātippatilē kaṇṇum karuttāka ituvari iruntu vantuḷḷaṉar.  ulakameṅkaṇum tamiḻarkaḷ ceṉṟu āṅkāṅkē akaḻ āyvu ceytu tamiḻarkaḷum avarkaḷiṉ muṉṉōrkaḷāṉa tirāviṭarkaḷum upitiyā, ellam, aciriyā, akkēṭiyā, cumēriyā, ekiptu, kirīṭ mutaliya iṭaṅkaḷukkum malēciyā, tāylāntu, kampōṭiyā, cāvakam, pālittīvu pōṉṟa iṭaṅkaḷuk

kaḷiyum ceytu civaṉeṟiyip parappiya ceytikaḷi ayalnāṭṭu tolporuḷ āyvuttuṟiyiṉar veḷiyiṭṭuḷḷa ceyti
kaḷiyum, nūṟkaḷiyum tamiḻ makkaḷukkut terivikka vēṇṭum eṉṟu ciṟitum avarkaḷ eṇṇiyatilli.  cintu veḷiyil civa naṉmakkaḷ eḻuppiya ciṟanta nākarikattip paṟṟi ettaṉi nūṟkaḷ veḷivantuḷḷaṉa.  cintu veḷi makkaḷ eḻutiya eḻuttukkaḷip paṭikka kōpaṉ kēkaṉ aṟiñarkaḷum leṉiṉ kirāṭ palkalik kaḻakamum eṇṇaṟṟa aṟiñarkaḷik koṇṭu laṭcam laṭcamāka poṟkācukaḷic celaviṭṭu āyvu ceytu veḷiyiṭṭu varuvatil namatu tamiḻ nāṭṭu civacittāntak kaḻakamō camayap piracārak kaḻakamō, tirāviṭak kaḻakam, tirāviṭa muṉṉēṟṟak kaḻakamō, akila intiya aṇṇā ti.mu.ka niṟuvaṉamō kaṭukaḷavum kavalippaṭṭatuṇṭā?  itaṟku oru celavuk kācum celaviṭṭa tuṇṭā?  tamiḻ nāṭṭil tamiḻar peyarāl eḻuntuḷḷa araciyal niṟuvaṉaṅkaḷum, camaya niṟuvaṉaṅkaḷum tam vayiṟṟāttiṟattit tīrttuk koḷḷa vaḻi tēṭuvatil kaṇṇum karuttumāy irukkiṟatē oḻiya tamiḻ iṉattiṉ nalaṉi nāṭiyatē illi.  iṉṟallāviṭiṉum virivil tamiḻ makkaḷ uṇmiyi uṇarntu ivarkaḷiṭam kaṇakkuk kēṭka muṉ varuvārkaḷ eṉpatu uṟuti.  appoḻutu kā. cu. piḷḷikku kalleṭuttēṉ, aṇṇāviṟkuc camāti kaṭṭi malarmāli cūṭṭi tūpa tīpaṅkāṭṭiṉēṉ, aṇṇā peyari akila intiyā muḻuvatum parappi avar cilikku māli cūṭṭiṉēṉ eṉṟu kūṟit tappittuk koḷḷa muṭiyātu.
tamiḻakattilē civa camayattik kāppataṟku eḻunta maṭaṅkaḷō, allatu paktarkaḷō namatu tamiḻarkaḷukku kōyilip paṟṟiyō, cilikaḷip paṟṟiyō ceppu uruvaṅ kaḷip paṟṟiyō nalla nūṟkaḷ āṅkilattilō veḷiyiṭavilli.  namatu nāṭṭic cērnta kāṣmīrattil vaḷarntuḷḷa civa neṟiyip paṟṟiyō, cāvakam, pāli, kampōcakam mutaliya nāṭṭil civa camayikaḷ kaṭṭiya kōyilkaḷip paṟṟiyō oru nūlum eḻuta eṇṇiyatē illi.  cālṭiya nāṭṭil 5000-m āṇṭukaṭku muṉ oru peruṅkōyil eḻuntatu.  mecapottāmiyāvil mukō eṉṉum akaḻ āyvil naṉṉar eṉṟa civaṉ kōyil kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu. ikkōyil cuṭumaṇ ceṅkaṟkaḷālāṉatu kīḻ iruntu mēlē ovvoru pirakāramum parappiṟ kuṟintatāy oṉṟiṉ mēl oṉṟāka mūṉṟāvatu mēṭiyil ucciyil oru aka nāḻiki uḷḷatu ataṉ muṉ palimēṭiyāka oru kaṟpāṟi uḷḷatu.  kōyiliṉ cuvarkaḷil veḷippuṟam paḷapaḷappāṉa nīla vaṇṇattil eṉāmal ōṭukaḷ patippikkap peṟṟuḷḷatu uṭpuṟam marappalakikaḷ aṭikkap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  ivaṟṟiṉ iṭi iṭiyē paḷiṅkuk kaṟkaḷum poṉṉum maṇiyum koṇṭu ceyta ariya ciṟpaṅkaḷ pala uḷa.  itu tirāviṭarkaḷ kaṭṭiya peruṅkōyil eṉṟu mēṉāṭṭaṟiñarkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟārkaḷ. aṭiyiliruntu mēlēyuḷḷa aka nāḻiki vari paṭikaḷ uḷḷaṉa.
vaṭa amerikkāvil kolāṭō eṉṉum āṟṟaṅkariyil uḷḷa kuṉṟiṉ mītuḷḷa civaṉ kōyil 1937-ām āṇṭu amerikkat tol poruḷ āyviṉar kaṇṭupiṭittu intak kōyil 10-āyiram āṇṭukaṭku muṟpaṭṭatu eṉṟu muṭivu kaṭṭiṉar.  itu iṅkilāntil uḷḷa pattirikikaḷilellām veḷivantatu.  tamiḻaṉukku teriyātu.  tēvāram pāṭik koṇṭu irukkum civa paktaṉō, periya purāṇam paṭittāl civalōkam kiṭṭumeṉṟu nāṭōṟum civanēyac celvarkaḷukkē teriyātu terintālum aṅku pōy pārkkavō namatu makkaḷukku itip paṟṟi viḷakkik kūṟavō avaciyam illāmal pōkiṟatu.  amerikkāvil uḷḷa cevvintiyar civaperumāṉ eṅkaḷ teyvam. avaṉ cevvintiyaṉāka iruppatāl intiyarkaḷ kūṭa avaṉi iṉṟu vari mīṉāṭci, umā tēvi mutaliya civaṉ maṉiviyik karuppi eṉṟu kūṟuvatip pōl civaṉi karuppaṉ eṉṟu kūṟat tiriyam piṟakkavilli.  intiyarkaḷ civaṉi tī vaṇṇaṉ, cevvaṇṇaṉ, ceyyōṉ, ceñcaṭiyōṉ eṉṟellām kūṟi civaperumāṉ vaṭa amerikkāvil uḷḷa cevvintiyaṉ eṉṟum, avaṉ imayamali mītuḷḷa intiya aracaṉākiya takkaṉ makaḷākiya pārvatiyiyum, teṉ intiyāvil uḷḷa parattiyākiya mīṉāṭciyiyum maṇantu koṇṭāṉ eṉṟum civaṉ amerikka cevvintiyarkaḷiṭamiruntu iravalākap peṟṟa teyvam eṉṟu kūṟukiṉṟaṉar.1
ekiptu nāṭṭiṉ talinakarākiya keyrōviṟku aṇmiyil uḷḷa kījā eṉṉum iṭattil piṅk kōyil oṉṟuḷḷatu. itu 5000-m āṇṭukaṭku kuṟintataṉṟu. karuṅkal eḷitil akappaṭāta cālṭiyā nāṭṭuk kōyil pōlaṉṟi ekiptil eḷitil kiṭikkum ikkōyil karuṅkallāl kaṭṭap peṟṟatu.  iṅkuḷḷa maṇṭapam 55 aṭi nīḷamuḷḷatu.  ciṟpa vēlippāṭu ciṟitumaṟṟa caturat tūṇālāṉatu. tūṇkaḷ iraṇṭu variciyāka niṟuttappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  ki.mu.1600 āṇṭiliruntu tāṉ ekiptil peruṅkōyilkaḷ eḻuntaṉa.  appu cimapal eṉṉum iṭattil 150-aṭi nīḷamum 100 - aṭi uyaramum uḷḷa kōyil pāṟiyik kuṭintu ceyyappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  ekiptiya nāṭṭil muṟkālattil tamiḻarkaḷ kuṭiyēṟi aṅku kōyilkaḷi eḻuppiṉar.  aṅku teyva uruvatti palarum eḷitil kāṇa muṭiyāta vakiyil vaḻipaṭum muṟikaḷ amikkappaṭṭiruntaṉavām.  ekiptil civa vaḻipāṭum kāḷi vaḻipāṭum iruntatu.  iḵtaṉṟi kāḷi mukamum maṉita uṭalum uṭiya atikāra nanti (Apis)  vaḻipāṭum iruntatu .
kiṭṭi nāṭṭil uḷḷa kōyilil nantiyum ataṉ mītu civaperumāṉ niṉṟu koṇṭu kiyil maḻuvum cuttiyalum tiricūlamum tāṅki niṟpatu pōṉṟa uruvaṅkaḷ iruntaṉa eṉṟu pala āciriyarkaḷ tam  nūṟkaḷil kuṟippiṭṭuḷḷaṉar.  annāṭṭiṉ kōyilkaḷ namatu nāṭṭiṉ tirukkōyilōṭu oppuvamikāṭṭi oru āyvu nūli eḻuta civa cittāntikaḷō avarkaḷ camayamō, maṭamō nūl veḷiyīṭṭuk kaḻakamō eṇṇiyatē illi.  teruvil kiṭakkum  oru uṭinta kalli eṭuttu vittuk koṇṭu civa civa eṉṟu taliyil taṭṭuvatum kaṉṉattil pōṭṭuk koḷvatum kōyil kaṭṭuvataṟku taṉakku vēṇṭiyavar celvarkaḷ maṭātipatikaḷ kālil vīḻntu keñci poruḷ tiraṭṭuvatum periya tiruppaṇiyāka niṉikkiṟār.  irukkiṟa eṇṇaṟṟa kōyilkaḷ ceppaṉiṭa vaḻiyaṟṟu carintu vīḻntu koṇṭirukkum pōtu uṭintu teruvil kiṭakkum oru kalli civaliṅkam oṉṟu kūṟi kumpiṭuvatum kōyil kaṭṭa makkaḷiṭam paṇam kēṭpatum veṭkamāṉa ceyal. mutalil kumpiṭuvataṟku āṭkaḷit tiraṭṭu appāl oru ciṟu kōyilik kaṭṭu.  civa naṉmakkaḷ uṇṇa uṇaviṉṟi uṭukka uṭiyiṉṟi paṭikka vaḻiyiṉṟi, paṭittavarkaḷukku vēliyiṉṟit tiṇṭāṭum poḻutu teruvil kiṭanta kallukku civaliṅkam eṉṟu peyar colli āyirakkaṇakkāṉa poruḷip potu makkaḷiṭam tiraṭṭa muyaṟcippatā?  itu aṟamā?  intak kōyilikku civaṉ varuvāṉā?  kōyilkaḷ ellām kuccuk kārikaḷ vīṭṭiṟkuc camam eṉṟār kānti aṭikaḷ.  kōyilkaḷ kaḷḷarkaḷiṉ kukikaḷ eṉṟār ēcunātar.  eṉavē ikkāla makkaḷukku mutalil kōyil eṉṟāl eṉṉa?  camayam eṉṟāl eṉṉa?  nām ēṉ kōyilukkuc cella vēṇṭum eṉpavaṟṟiṉi viḷakki namatu iḷam vāliparkaḷi, uṉatu kippaṇatti vīṭṭu kōyilukku varac cey.  namatu camūka makkaḷ oṉṟu cēra, namatu camaya poruḷātāra muṉṉēṟṟam peṟa kāltuṭṭum celavaḻiyātu ēmāṟṟi vāḻum orucilar, kūriyēṟi kōḻi piṭikka iyalāta kurukkaḷ vāṉattik kīṟivikuntam kāṭṭap pōvatu pōl ippoḻutu taṉṉalattiṟkāka tiruppaṇi ceyya muṉ vantuḷḷārkaḷ.  ivarkaḷ tiruppaṇi oḻika! oḻika!  eṉṟu kūṟi viṭṭu nām ulakil uḷḷa namatu kōyilkaḷiyum, namatu nāṭṭu kōyilkaḷipaṟṟi ārāyvōm; aḻintu koṇṭirukkum kōyilkaḷip pātukāppōm kalik karuvūlamāka ciṟpa maṇikaḷāy mūli muṭukkukaḷilaḻintu vīḻntu koṇṭu irukkum tirukkōyilkaḷip paḻutu pārkkavum namatu kōyilkaḷiyum cilikaḷiyum cempuppaṭimaṅkaḷiyum pātukākka muṉ varavēṇṭum. tamiḻ makkaḷi vaṇaṅki maṉṟāṭik kēṭṭuk koḷkiṟēṉ itaṉ uṇmiyaṟiyāta makkaḷ ōyvu peṟṟa kālattil mōṭcam pōka eṇṇi piṟar poruḷip payaṉaṟṟa vaḻikaḷukkākap payaṉpaṭuttuvatil muṉiya vēṇṭām.  tāṉ mōṭcam pōka vēṇṭum eṉṟāl taṉ contap poruḷic celaviṭṭuk kōyil kaṭṭaṭṭum. allatu taṉatu vīṭṭiyē kōyilāka māṟṟaṭṭum.   ati varavēṟkiṉṟōm vāḻttukiṉṟōm.  kānti aṭikaḷ, oruvaṉukku 2 vēṭṭikaḷ tēvi 4,6,18 vēṭṭikaḷ vittuk koṇṭāl itu tiruṭṭuttaṉam. 4 vēṭṭikaḷ vittiruppavaṉ tiruṭaṉ 6 vēṭṭikaḷ vittiruppavaṉ koḷḷikkāraṉ 8 vēṭṭikaḷ vittiruppavaṉ tīvaṭṭik koḷḷikkāraṉ eṉṟār eṉpati eṉatu tamiḻc cakōtarar kaḷukkum cakōtarikaḷukkum aṉpuṭaṉ terivittuk koḷkiṟēṉ.
niṟka kirēṭṭā (Crete) eṉṉum ittāli nāṭṭiṟku aṇmiyil uḷḷa tīvu paṇṭiyat tamiḻarkaḷuṭiya kuṭiyēṟṟa nāṭu. heraṭṭōṭṭa eṉṉum paḻam perum varalāṟṟāciriyar kirēṭṭā makkaḷ tamiḻar (tamiḻ) eṉappaṭṭār  eṉṟu kūṟiyuḷḷār.  kirēṭṭā nākarikam cintu veḷi nākarikattōṭu mika neruṅkiya orumippāṭuṭiyatu.  kirēṭṭā makkaḷ mīṉavarkaḷ eṉap peṟṟaṉar.  cintu veḷi eḻuttum kirēṭṭā eḻuttum oṉṟu pōlak kāṇappaṭukiṟatu.  kirēṭṭā nakaril uḷḷa oru nakariṟku civaṉ eṉṟu peyar.  kirēṭṭāvil cintu veḷiyil kaṭṭeṭuttatip pōṉṟa pala paḻam poruḷum annāṭṭu miṉōṉ araṇmaṉi yum (Palace of Minon)  kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  iṅku civa vaḻipāṭum civaṉ kōyil kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.1
