eṉṟu kūṟum tamiḻaṉ kaṇṭa aṟavaḻi nilikkumāṟu ceyvatē innūliṉ muḻu nōkkamākum.  oṉṟē kulamum oruvaṉē tēvaṉum eṉṟa tirumantirattip paṟi cāṟṟuvōmāka.
intiyak kaṭṭiṭak kali
intiyak kaṭṭiṭak kali varalāṟṟup pukaḻ vāyntatu.  atu taṉakkē urittāṉa taṉit taṉmiyum, taṉi marapum, taṉip paṇpum vāyntatu.  atu piṟa nāṭṭuk kalit toṭarpāl urup peṟṟu vaḷarntatalla.  intiya kaṭṭiṭak kali, kalappuk kali alla.  puṉitamāṉa pukaḻ peṟṟa uyar taṉikkali.  tirāviṭa intiyā mikat toṉmiyāṉa kālattiliruntē kaṭṭiṭak kaliyat tōṟṟuvittu ati naṉku pēṇi vaḷarttu vaḷamuṟac ceytu vantuḷḷatu.  intiyāvil ātitta nallūriṉiṉṟu arappā vari kāṇappaṭum aḻipāṭukaḷ aṉittum paṇṭiyat tirāviṭa intiyāviṉ paṇpiṟkum nākarikattiṟkum uyarviṟkum eṭuttuk kāṭṭākak kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
paḻantirāviṭar kālam
cintu veḷiyil ki.mu. 3000 -m āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ tali tūkki niṉṟa makattāṉa kaṭṭiṭak kali ulakam ituvari ulakil uḷḷa oppaṟṟak kaṭṭiṭak kaliyāka eṇṇappaṭukiṟatu.  iṉṟikku aiyāyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ cintu veḷiyil akaḻntu kaṇṭa arappā mokañcātārō, rūpār nakaraṅkaḷip pōṉṟa makōṉṉatamāṉa nakaraṅkaḷ evarum eṅkum kaṇṭatilli.  arappā mokañcātārō, rūpār nakaraṅkaḷip pōṉṟa naṉi ciṟanta nakar amippi ulakil enta varalāṟṟilum ituvari evarum kaṇṭatilli.  cintu veḷi tirāviṭap peruṅkuṭimakkaḷ ñālam pōṟṟum nakar amippu muṟiyi naṉkaṟintu cuṭappaṭāta paccimaṇ ceṅkalliyum, cuṭumaṇ ceṅkalliyum payaṉpaṭutti aṇiyaṇiyākap pala vīṭukaḷiyum, māḷikikaḷiyum, araṇ
kaḷiyum, neṟkaḷañciyaṅkaḷiyum kaṭṭi iṉitu vāḻntu vantaṉar.  avarkaḷ amittirunta māḷikikaḷ pala nilā muṟṟaṅ
kaḷiyuṭiyaṉavāyt tikaḻntaṉa.  pala oṉṟu iraṇṭu māṭi
kaḷiyuṭiyatākat tikaḻntaṉa.  avarkaḷ amitta māḷikikaḷ cukātāra vacatiyuḷḷatāy nāṟpuṟamum nalla pala kaṇikaḷ uḷḷatāyt tikaḻntaṉa.  ciṟiya aṟikaḷilum kūṭa kāṟṟum, veyyilum tārāḷa
mākap pukuntu vantaṉa.
mokañcatārōvil iraṇṭiṟku mēṟpaṭṭa aṭukkukaḷik koṇṭa celvarkaḷiṉ māḷikikaḷ pala kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  ivi periya kūṭaṅkaḷ akaṉṟu nīṇṭa uyariya tāḻvāraṅkaḷ akaṉṟa periya muṟṟaṅkaḷ iṭikaḻikaḷ, ciṟiya periya vāyilkaḷ eṇṇaṟṟa aṟikaḷ palavum uḷvāyk kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  mēṉ māṭaṅkaḷil ceṅkal taḷavaricikaḷ cīr peṟa amintuḷḷaṉa.  cila mēṉ māṭaṅkaḷil paṭukki aṟikaḷ pāṅkuṟa amintuḷḷaṉa.  cila māṭaṅkaḷ uḷḷa māḷikikaḷil paḷḷi aṟikaḷ kuḷikkum aṟikaḷ, malaṅ kaḻikkum otukkiṭam mutaliyaṉa naṉku amintuḷḷaṉa.  māṭikkuc cellum paṭikkaṭṭukaḷ oḻuṅkuṭaṉ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  cila māḷikikaḷukku marattiṉālāṉa ēṇikaḷ vittu cellappaṭum māṭikikaḷ amikkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  pala māṭikaḷukkup paṭikkaṭṭukaḷ teruppuṟamē vittuk kaṭṭap paṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  cila vīṭukaḷil paṭikkaṭṭukaḷ uṭpuṟam vittuk kaṭṭap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
oru māḷikiyil muṉpuṟam 85 aṭi nīḷam viṭṭum piṉpuṟam 87-aṭi nīḷam iṭam viṭṭum kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  muṉpuṟamum piṉpuṟamum iṭam viṭṭu vīṭu kaṭṭum muṟi paṉṉeṭum kālamāka intiyāvil iruntu vantuḷḷatākat terikiṟatu.
oru māḷiki 242 - aṭi nīḷamum 112 aṭi akalamum uḷḷatu.  ataṟku aṇmiyil 177 aṭi nīḷamum 118 aṭi akalamum uḷḷa periya māḷiki oṉṟum uḷḷatu.  ikkaṭṭiṭattuḷ pala aṟikaḷum kiṇaṟukaḷum uḷḷaṉa.  iṅku 42 caturam aṭi uḷḷa tūṇkaḷ pala kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  tūṇkaḷ kaṭṭiṭa vāyiliṉ vaḷivukaḷit tāṅkupavikaḷākum.
 ciṟiya illaṅkaḷ 30 aṭi nīḷamum 27 aṭi akalamum nāṉku aintu aṟikaḷum uḷḷatāy amintuḷḷaṉa.  ivi ceṅkaṟ kaḷāl cemmiyuṟak kaṭṭappaṭṭu, tari cāṇattāl meḻukap paṭṭuḷḷatu.
cila vīṭukaḷukku mēlē taḷam iṭap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  cuṟṟilum kipiṭic cuvarkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  mēṟṟaḷattil peyyum maḻi nīr uṭaṉukkuṭaṉ kīḻē varuvataṟkēṟṟa kuḻāykaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  ik kuḻāykaḷ maṇṇālum marattālum āṉavi.  iṅku cila aṅkāṭi kaḷum uḷḷaṉa. cila tirukkōyilkaḷ pōṉṟa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.
mokañcatārōvil vīṭukaḷiṉ piṉpuṟam paṭukki aṟikaḷ, camiyal aṟikaḷ makaḷirkaḷ taṅkuvataṟku ēṟṟa taṉiyaṟikaḷum uḷḷaṉa.  ovvoru illattiṟkum vāyiṟ paṭikaḷ uṇṭu.  avaṟṟi aṭuttu tiṟanta ciṟṟari oṉṟu vāyiṟ kāvalaṉukkākak kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  ovvoru vīṭṭilum nīrāṭum aṟi uḷḷatu.  cila māḷikikaḷil oṉṟukku mēṟpaṭṭa kuḷippaṟikaḷum uḷḷaṉa.  ivi teruppakkam amintuḷḷaṉa.  ivaṟṟil uḷḷa kaḻivu nīr veḷiyē cella vaṭikālkaḷ naṉku amikkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  vaṭikālkaḷ terukkālvāyuṭaṉ amikkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  ittakiya nīrāṭum aṟi eṣṉaṉ ṉāvil irunta akkēṭiyar araṇmaṉiyil uḷḷatu.  akkēṭiyar kuḷippaṟi amikkum muṟiyi cintu veḷi makkaḷiṭamiruntu kaṟṟirukka vēṇṭum.1
iṅku pala aṅkāṭikaḷum, periya maṇṭapaṅkaḷum uḷḷaṉa.  85 aṭi catura aṭipparappuḷḷa oru maṇṭapamum uḷḷatu.  itaṉ mēṟ kūriyi irupatu ceṅkaṟ tūṇkaḷ tāṅki niṟkiṉṟaṉa.  ivi nāṉku nāṉkāy niṟkum caturat tūṇkaḷākak kāṇappaṭu kiṉṟaṉa.
potuvāka ellāk kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷum periya cuvarkaḷi yuṭiyaṉavākavē kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  cuvarkaḷ 3 ½ aṭi mutal 6 ½ vari akaṉṟa cuvarkaḷāka uḷḷaṉa.  periya kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷiṉ puṟac cuvar 5 aṭi 9- aṅkulam kaṉam uṭiyatu.  ēṉiya cuvarkaḷ 3 aṭi 6 aṅkulam 4 aṭi 10 aṅkulam kaṉam uṭiyatāy uḷḷaṉa.  periya kaṭṭiṭac cuvar 18 aṭi uyaram uḷḷatu. cila iṭaṅkaḷil 25 aṭi uyaramum uḷḷaṉa.  cuvarkaḷ ceṅkal muṟippaṭi kuṟukkum neṭukkumāka vittu iṭi iṭiyē maṇ cāntu vittuk kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  mēlē mēṟpūccāka maṇ cāntē pūcap peṟṟuḷḷatu aṭikkaṭi paḻutupārkkap peṟṟu vantuḷḷatu naṉku terikiṟatu.
kuḷam
mokañcatārōvil akaḻntu kaṇṭa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷil araṇmaṉi eṉṟu eṇṇattakka kaṭṭiṭam oṉṟum aḻakiya cey kuḷamum viyattaku peṟṟiyi vāyntaṉavākak karutappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  ceykuḷam mēli nāṭṭu poṟivallārum kaṇṭu tikikkumāṟu amikkap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  itil nīr niṟkum iṭam 40 aṭi nīḷamum 23 aṭi akalamum 8 aṭi āḻamum uḷḷatu.  ikkuḷattiṟku aṭi vari oḻuṅkāṉa paṭikkaṭṭukaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  kuḷattic cuṟṟi nāṉpuṟamum naṭi vaḻi viṭṭu 4 ½ aṭi akalamuḷḷa cuvar eḻuppap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  iccuvarukku appāl kuḷattiṟku nāṟpuṟamum 
7aṭi akalamuḷḷa peruñcuvar uḷḷatu.  itaṉ mītu naṭi vaḻi amikkap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  aṭippakuti naṉṟāka iḻittu vaḻavaḻappākkappaṭṭa ceṅkaṟ patittu oru vakittār pūcap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  mutalil cūḷiyiṭappaṭṭa vaḻavaḻappāṉa ceṅkaṟ kaḷi oruvaki veḷḷik kaḷimaṇ koṇṭuvantu oṭṭa vittuḷḷaṉar.  ivvāṟu nālu pakkamum nālu aṭik kaṉattil cuvar eḻuppap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  piṉ accuvar mītu oru aṅkulak kaṉattil nilak kīl pūcap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  iṅku payaṉpaṭuttappaṭṭa kīl intiyāvil illi.  cumēriyāvil iruntu koṇṭuvarap paṭṭirukka vēṇṭum eṉṟu karutappaṭukiṟatu. kuḷattiṟku aṇmiyil eṭṭu aṟikaḷ, kuḷittu viṭṭu āṭikaḷ māṟṟik koḷvataṟkāka amikkap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  ic cey kuḷattil aḻukku nīri aṭikkaṭi māṟṟik koḷvataṟku ēṟṟa muṟiyil kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu. ikkuḷam civa neṟiyic cārnta cāṉṟōrkaḷ, nāyaṉmārkaḷ, civāccāriyarkaḷ kuḷippataṟkeṉṟu kaṭṭappaṭṭa kuḷamākak karutappaṭukiṟatu.  kuḷattiṟku arukil kōyil pōṉṟa iṭamum uḷḷatu.
araṇkaḷ
arappā mokañcatārō, rūpār pōṉṟa iṭaṅkaḷil ceyta akaḻ āyvil araṇkaḷ etuvum kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭa villi.  tirāviṭarkaḷ toṉṟu toṭṭu taṅkaḷ nakarattic cuṟṟi araṇkaḷ amikkum vaḻakkattiṟku māṟāka cintu veḷiyil araṇ kāṇappaṭātatu oru kuṟiyāka eṇṇappaṭṭatu.  itu tirāviṭarkaḷ eḻuppiya nakaraṅkaḷ eṉpatil oru aiyappāṭum eḻuntatu.  appāl ṭākṭar ār.i. em. uyilar mēṟkoṇṭu ceyta akaḻ āyvil 1944 -il arappāvil 30  -aṭi akalattil kaṭṭappaṭṭa pēraraṇ oṉṟu akaḻntu kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu.  ivi ceṅkaṟkaḷik koṇṭu maṇ cāntiṉāl kaṭṭap paṭṭuḷḷatu.  cintu veḷiyil mūṉṟu periya kōṭṭikaḷ iruntaṉa.  oṉṟu ceṅkallāl kaṭṭappaṭṭatu.  maṟṟoṉṟu cuṭappaṭāta maṇ ceṅkallik koṇṭu kaṭṭappaṭṭatu.  maṟṟoṉṟu atikac cūṭṭāl maṇ ventu urukik karuttu irumpu pōl kāṇappaṭum urukkāṉ ceṅkaṟkaḷāl kaṭṭappaṭṭatu.  itaṉi āriyarkaḷ cempuk kōṭṭi veḷḷik kōṭṭi irumpuk kōṭṭi eṉṟum ati taṅkaḷ talivaṉākiya intiraṉ aḻittāṉ eṉṟu avarkaḷ vētamākiya irukkuvil kūṟappaṭṭiruppatiyum viḷakki ṭākṭar uyilar ulakiṟku uyarttiyuḷḷār (piṟkālattil civaperumāṉ acurarkaḷiṉ muppuram eritta purāṇak katiyi itu eṉa āriyar iṇit tuḷḷaṉar) 1
āriyariṉ vētakālam
cintu veḷi nākarikatti aṭuttu vaṭa intiyāvil arumpiyatu āriyāvarttam.  iṅku eḻuntatu vēta kāla nākarikam.  itu ki.mu.1500- mutal ki.mu.500 - variyuḷḷa kālam.  vēta kālat toṭakkattil ciṟappāka amikkappaṭṭa nakaraṅkaḷ etuvum eṅkum illi.  maṭcuvarkaḷum ōlik kūrikaḷum uḷḷa eḷiya kuṭicikaḷē iruntaṉa.  nāḷaṭivil kaṭṭiṭac ciṟpak kali vaḷarat toṭaṅkiyatu.
ki.mu. mutal āyiram āṇṭiṉ iṭippakutiyil āriyariṉ camūka amippu virivaṭintatiyoṭṭic cila iṭaṅkaḷil nakaraṅkaḷ tōṉṟiṉa.  maraṅkaḷip payaṉpaṭutti vīṭukaḷ kaṭṭiṉar.  ki.mu.5 ām nūṟṟāṇṭil vaṭa intiyāvil niṟuvap peṟṟa tali nakaraṅkaḷil amipput tiṭṭatti vakuttut tantavar makā kōvintar eṉṟa ciṟpi eṉkiṉṟaṉar.  eṉiṉum āriyarkaḷ aḻakuk kalikaḷil taṉippaṭṭa kavaṉam celuttāta kāraṇattāl vēta  kālattil kaṭṭiṭac ciṟpak kali cintu veḷi nākarika kālattil iruntatip pōl uyarnta niliyil illi. 1
eṉṟu tiru mo.ka. tēcāy avarkaḷ uḷḷati uḷḷavāṟē eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷār.  āriyarkaḷ innāṭṭiṟku varum poḻutu āṭumāṭu mēykkum nāṭōṭikaḷāy vantaṉar.  avarkaḷ aṟa vaḻiyil, taṟpātukāppiṟkāka cila ciṟupaṭikaḷi vittirāta cintu veḷi civa neṟiyāḷarkaḷāṉa civa antaṇarkaḷi maṟa vaḻiyil veṉṟaṉar.  avarkaḷ nāṭu nakaraṅkaḷi aḻittaṉar.  ataṉāl avarkaḷ periya kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ, māṭa māḷikikaḷ araṇkaḷ mutaliyavaṟṟi amittu viṭa muṭiyum eṉṟu eṇṇuvatu tavaṟu.  āriyarkaḷ cintu veḷi aḻiviṟkup piṉ nīṇṭa kālam ceṉṟu kaṭṭiṭak kali aṟivip peṟṟaṉar eṉṟu kūṟuvatu poruntum.  atu uṇmiyumākum.  āriyarkaḷ, irāmāyaṇa kālattil kūṭa kaṭṭiṭak kali aṟivi atikam peṟa villi.  vāṉmīki kūṟum irāmaṉuṭiya araṇmaṉi aḻakum irāvaṇaṉuṭiya araṇmaṉic ciṟappum paṭippōrkku naṉku pulaṉākum.  āriyarkaḷ kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷi aḻippatil akāyacurarkaḷ; kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷik kaṭṭuvataṟku pala kālam payila vēṇṭiyatā yiruntatu.
intiyāviṟkum, pāpilōṉukkum, pāracīkattiṟkum, acīriyāviṟkum, akkēṭiyāviṟkum, arēpiyāviṟkum, cālṭiyā viṟkum iṭiyē toṉmiyāṉa kālattiliruntu vaṇikat toṭarpu iruntatu vantatu.  ki.mu-6-ām nūṟṟāṇṭil vaṭa mēṟku intiyā pāracīkar paṭi yeḻuccikku āḷākiyatu.  cila kālam avarkaḷatu payaṅkara āṭci nilaviyatu.  appāl ki.mu.4-ām nūṟṟāṇṭiṉ muṟpakutiyil (ki.mu.327) kirēkka vīraṉ mā alekcāntariṉ paṭiyeṭuppālum, appāl eḻunta mokalāyarkaḷiṉ ātikkattālum ayal nāṭṭuk kali muṟikaḷ vaṭa intiyak kali muṟiyōṭu ciṟitu kalantaṉa.  ikkalappiṉ payaṉi kāntārac ciṟpa muṟiyilum, muriyac ciṟpa muṟiyilum, mokalāya ciṟpa muṟiyilum kāṇalām.  cantirakuptaṉ mecapottāmiyak kaliyit taḻuvi araṇmaṉiyi aḻakuṟa amittāṉ.  cājakāṉ arēpiyak kaṭṭiṭa muṟiyit taḻuvi tājmakāli amittāṉ.
putta ciṟpam
āriyarkaḷiṉ varuṇācirama muṟiyiyum, purōkita ātikkattiyum etirttu vaṭa intiyāvil putta neṟi eḻuntatu.  ataṉ payaṉāka putta ciṟpamum piṟantatu.  putta kaṭṭiṭaciṟpam (ki.mu.250- ki.pi.750) vaṭa intiyā, teṉ intiyā ilaṅki, cāvā, mutaliya nāṭukaḷilellām paraviyatu.  acōkaṉ eṉṉum māmaṉṉaṉ putta neṟiyit taḻuviyatiṉ payaṉāka putta kaṭṭiṭac ciṟpam peritum vaḷarcciyuṟṟatu.  kaṟkaḷāl kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ kaṭṭappaṭṭaṉa.  ciṟpa vēlikaḷ ciṟappuṟṟu eḻuntaṉa.  puttarkaḷ periya kōyilkaḷiyum maṭaṅkaḷiyum maṇṭapaṅkaḷiyum amittaṉar.  nālāntāvil uḷḷa nantāp perumi vāynta putta maṭam 10,000 tuṟavikaḷ taṅkuvataṟkēṟṟa periya maṭamāka iruntatu.  puttarkaḷ nāṭṭiṉ nāṉāpakutikaḷilum kuṭivarik kōyilkaḷiyum, tūpikaḷiyum, maṭaṅkaḷiyum, tūṇkaḷiyum kalveṭṭukaḷiyum amittup pukaḻ peṟṟaṉar.
cuṅka - āntira kālac ciṟpam
muriya āṭci acōkaṉukkup piṉ aṭiyuṭaṉ cāyntatu.  vaṭakku, mēṟkup pakutikaḷil cuṅkarkaḷiṉ āṭci arumpiyatu.  avarkaḷiṉ āṭci ki.mu.70 variyil tali tūkki niṉṟu appāl vīḻntatu.  ataṉ piṉṉar āntirar (cātavākaṉar) āṭci arumpi ki.pi.150-variyil nilavi maṟintatu.  ki.mu.185-il iruntu ki.pi.180-vari kiṭṭat taṭṭa 300-āṇṭukaḷ cuṅka - āntirar āṭciyil avarkaḷiṉ kaṭṭiṭa ciṟpamum vaḷarntaṉa.  avarkaḷ pala kukik kōyilkaḷiyum maṭaṅkaḷiyum niṟuviṉar. ivarkaḷiṉ kalikku ellōrā cittiyamum kilācak kōyilum ēṟṟa eṭuttuk kāṭṭukaḷāka uḷḷaṉa.
cāḷukkiyar kaṭṭiṭa ciṟpam
ki.pi.aintām āṇṭil teṉ intiyāvil cāḷukkiyar āṭci tali tūkkiyatu.  ataṉ payaṉāka cāḷukkiyar kaṭṭiṭa ciṟpam eḻuntatu.  mutaṉ mutaṉ kaṟkaḷāl kōyilkaḷ kaṭṭat toṭaṅkiṉar.  ki.pi. āṟām nūṟṟāṇṭil pāṟikaḷik kuṭintu pala kōyilkaḷi amikka muyaṉṟaṉar.  miya intiyāvil pala kaṟ kōyilkaḷ ivarkaḷiṉ pāṇiyil pala eṭuppikkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  ivarkaḷāl ātiyil eṭuppikkap peṟṟa kaṟ kōyilkaḷ pījāppūril uḷḷaṉa.  cāḷukkiyarkaḷiṉ kaṭṭiṭac ciṟpamum intiyāviṉ kaṭṭiṭak kaliyil oru ciṟanta ciṟpak kalik karuvūlamāy pōṟṟappaṭṭu varukiṟatu.
intiya iculāmiya kaṭṭiṭa ciṟpam
intiyāvil mokalāyar āṭci arumpiya piṉ iculāmiyak kaṭṭiṭa ciṟpa muṟi celvākkup peṟṟatu.  mokalāyarkaḷ peritum antanta iṭattuk kali muṟiyit taḻuvi paḷḷikaḷum, camātikkaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷum araṇmaṉikaḷum vīṭukaḷum amittaṉar.  paḻiya tilliyil uḷ iltutṉiṣ macūtiyum, pījappūr paḻiya paḷḷikaḷum nākūr tarkāvum piṟavum cāṉṟukaḷākum.
mokalāyar āṭciyiṉ toṭakka kālam iculāmiyar kaṭṭiṭak kaliyiṉ poṟkālam eṉṟu pukaḻappaṭum.  mokalāyar kaṭṭiṭak kaliyil intu, iculāmiya pāracīka marapukaḷ kalantu viḷaṅkiṉa.  mokalāyar paṇṭiya ekiptiya maṉṉarkaḷōṭu pōṭṭi pōṭṭu paḷḷikaḷum camātikaḷum kaṭṭiṉar.  akpariṉ paṭṭēppūr cikri nakaril eḻuppiya kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷiṉ ciṟpaṅkaḷum ṣājakāṉ kaṭṭiya tājmakālum, muttu macūtiyum, araṇmaṉiyum mikac ciṟantavi.  mokalāyar kālattil eḻucciyuṟṟa avarkaḷiṉ kaṭṭiṭak kali avarkaḷ āṭci aḻintatum avarkaḷiṉ kaṭṭiṭak kali peritum kuṉṟi viṭṭatu.
mēṉāṭṭu kaṭṭiṭak kali
intiyāvil pōrccukkīciyarum, ulāntākkārarum, pirañcukkārarum, āṅkilēyarum pukuntu āḷa muṟpaṭṭaṉar.  taṅkaḷiṉ kiṟittu camayattiyum kaṭṭiṭak kaliyiyum pukuttiṉar.  aracāṅkak kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷum kiṟittavak kōyilkaḷum kāttiya kali muṟippaṭi kaṭṭap peṟṟatu.  tamiḻ makkaḷukku cutantira uṇarcci eḻunta piṉ kiṟittavak kōyilkaḷ airōppiya pāṇiyil kaṭṭuvatu muṟi aṉṟu eṉṟa eṇṇam eḻuntatu.  āntira nāṭṭiluḷḷa tōrṇakkal pakutiyil mutal intiya nallāyarāyt tōṉṟiya picap avar āḷukikkuṭpaṭṭa iṭaṅkaḷil kiṟittavak kōyilkaḷ tirāviṭap pāṇiyil amikkappaṭṭaṉa.  cutantira intiyāvil intiyak kaṭṭiṭak kali maṟumalarcciyuṟṟu varukiṟatu. 


tamiḻnāṭṭut tirukkōyilkaḷ
tamiḻ makkaḷiṉ teyva vaḻipāṭu
tamiḻ makkaḷ mikat toṉmiyāṉavarkaḷ avarkaḷ varalāṟṟuk kālattiṟku muṟpaṭṭa nāḷiliruntē inta nāṭṭil vāḻntu varukiṉṟaṉar.  avarkaḷ ayal nāṭṭiṉiṉṟu innāṭṭil kuṭiyēṟiyavarkaḷ eṉṟu cila āciriyarkaḷ kūṟiṉar.  atu tavaṟu; ātāramaṟṟa kūṟṟu eṉṟu iṉṟu aṟiñarkaḷāl karutappaṭukiṟatu.
tamiḻakattiṉ nilamum, nīrum pāṟikaḷum makkaḷum, maram ceṭi koṭikaḷum vilaṅkukaḷum paṟavikaḷum innāṭu mikat toṉmiyāṉatu eṉpati uṇarttum.  maṉita kulattiṉ toṭṭil teṉintiyā eṉṟu cila nila nūlārum māṉiṭa iyal nūl vallārum karutukiṉṟaṉar.  teṉ intiyāviṉ pāṟikaḷ, atu mikat toṉmi mikka nāṭu eṉpataṟku eṉṟum poṉṟāc cāṉṟāka niṉṟoḷirkiṟatu.
paḻaṅkāla maṉitaṉ kāṭukaḷil tam vāḻkkiyit   toṭaṅka villi.  kuṉṟukaḷilē mutaṉ mutalāka vāḻkkiyit toṭaṅki yuḷḷāṉ eṉṟu aṟiñarkaḷāl karutappaṭukiṟatu.1
tamiḻarkaḷ 10,000-m āṇṭukaḷukku muṉṉiṉṟē -atāvatu varalāṟṟuk kālattiṟku muṉṉiruntē tamiḻakattil vāḻntu vantuḷḷārkaḷ.  tamiḻ makkaḷ paḻam kaṟkālattiliruntu putuk kaṟkālam vari, putuk kaṟkālattiliruntu peruṅkallaṟip paṇpāṭṭuk kālam vari, peruṅ kallaṟip paṇpāṭṭuk kālattiliruntu irumpuk kālam vari iṅku toṭarntu vāḻntu varukiṉṟaṉar.  ivarkaḷiṉ paḻam perum paṇpāṭṭi, innāṭṭi ākkiramitta tirāviṭarkaḷ kippaṟṟip putittu viṭṭārkaḷ eṉṟu cilar kūṟuvatu pōl nām eḷitil kūṟi viṭa muṭiyātu.  tirāviṭarkaḷiṉ ātimuṉṉōrkaḷic cārnta iṉattavarkaḷip paṟṟi muṉṉar koṇṭa tavaṟāṉa muṭipiṉiṉṟu tappuvippataṟkākat tamiḻarkaḷ veḷi nāṭṭiṉiṉṟu vantavarkaḷ eṉṟu cila āciriyarkaḷ kūṟiyuḷḷaṉar.  tirāviṭarkaḷiṉ, āti
muṉṉōric cārnta iṉattavarkaḷ ayalnāṭṭiṉiṉṟu vantavarkaḷ eṉṟa karuttu ciṟitum ātāramaṟṟa koḷkiyākum atu tirāviṭarkaḷ ayalnāṭṭiṉiṉṟu iṅkuvantu kuṭiyēṟiyavarkaḷ eṉṟa oru tavaṟāṉa koḷkiyi uruvākkak kāraṇamāka amintuḷḷatu.  tamiḻarkaḷ veḷi nāṭṭiṉiṉṟu iṅku pōnta ākkiramippāḷarkaḷ aṉṟu.  avarkaḷ teṉ intiyāviṉ kaṟkālap paṇpāṭṭiṉ marapuvaḻivantavarkaḷ.1
kumukāya amippu
paṇṭik kālattil irunta tamiḻar kumukāyantāṉ iṉṟum iruntu varukiṟatu eṉṟālum paṇṭiya niliyiṉiṉṟu mikavum māṟṟam aṭintuḷḷatu.  kumukāya amippu, moḻi, paṇpāṭu, paḻakka vaḻakkam mutaliya aṉittum māṟupaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  avarkaḷiṉ aṉṟāṭa tēvikaḷum uṇavup piracṉiyum avarkaḷiṭiyē periya māṟṟatti viḷivittuḷḷaṉa.  avarkaḷ vāḻkkiyil māṟṟam ceyyāviṭil aḻintu oḻintu pōkum niliyi aṭintaṉar.  māṟu allatu māṇṭupō eṉṟa poṉ moḻi avarkaḷ uḷḷattil aṭikkaṭi arumpiyatu.
makkaḷiṉ vāḻkki
tamiḻ makkaḷ ātiyil malikaḷilum kuṉṟukaḷilum vilaṅku
kaḷip pōl vilaṅkukaḷōṭu vilaṅkukaḷāy vāḻntu vantaṉar.  avarkaḷ āṭikaḷ aṇiya aṟiyārkaḷ.  vīṭukaḷ amikka eṇṇiyatē illi.  pāṉi caṭṭi kuṭam mutaliṉa etuvum avarkaḷukkuc ceyyat teriyātu.  avarkaḷ maliyil uḷḷa nīrūṟṟukaḷ varaṇṭaṉavāyiṉ kaṟpāṟi mītuḷḷa paḷḷaṅkaḷil tēṅki niṟkum nīri aruntuvar.  avarkaḷ kālaṭiyil kiṭanta kūḷāṅkaṟkaḷi āyutaṅkaḷāka payaṉpaṭutta mutalil payiṉṟaṉar.  avarkaḷ pallāṇṭukaḷ ceṉṟu kaṟkaḷi, katti, vāḷ, kōṭari, īṭṭi, uḷi pōṉṟa āyutaṅkaḷākap payaṉpaṭuttap payiṉṟaṉar.  akkāla makkaḷ payaṉpaṭuttiya kallāyutaṅkaḷ pala kaṭappā nellūr, ceṅkaṟpaṭṭu, meññāṉapuram, cāyarpuram tirumaṅkalam pōṉṟa viṭaṅkaḷil kaṇṭeṭukkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
malikaḷil vāḻkkiyit toṭaṅkiya makkaḷ aṅku kiṭitta kāy, kaṉi, kiḻaṅku, koṭṭi, kīri mutaliyavaṟṟi uṇṭu uyir vāḻntaṉar.  ivikaḷ kiṭikkāta kālaṅkaḷil vilaṅkukaḷik koṉṟu avaṟṟiṉ ūṉi uṇṭu uyir vāḻntu vantaṉar.  koṭiya vilaṅkukaḷiṉiṉṟu, taṉṉik kāppāṟṟik koḷḷa villiyum kaṇṭaṉar.  appāl maṉitaṉ uṇaviṉ poruṭṭu vēṭṭi āṭuvatil tiṟami peṟṟāṉ.  āṇ peṇ ākiya makkaḷ iṉattil, āṇ peritum vēṭṭiyāṭuvatiyē toḻilākak koṇṭāṉ.  vēṭṭiyāṭac ceṉṟa āṇ vēṭṭiyāṭik koṇṭē pala nāḷ allatu pala tiṅkaḷ ceṉṟu viṭuvāṉ avaṉ taṉ maṉivi eṉṟum, makkaḷ eṉṟum evariyum eṇṇiyatum illi.  avarkaḷ vāḻkkikkākak kavalip paṭṭatum illi.  kumukāyattil maṉivi, kaṇavaṉ makkaḷ eṉṟa uṟavu eḻavilli.  tāy karuvuṟavum, makkaḷip peṟavum pāl koṭukkavum vēṇṭiya iṉṟiyamiyāta nili eḻuntatāl makkaḷukkāka uṇavu tēṭavum, vilaṅkukaḷiṉiṉṟu makkaḷik kākkavum vēṇṭiya iṉṟiyamiyāta nilikku āṭpaṭṭāḷ.  tāy tāṉ  peṟṟa makkaḷōṭē eppoḻutum vāḻntu vantāḷ.   paḻaṅkaḷip poṟukkuvatilum, kiḻaṅkukaḷi akaḻvatilum, mūṅkil arici cāmi mali nel, tiṉi mutaliyavaṟṟic cēkarittu tāṉ uṇṭatōṭu makkaḷukkum ūṭṭivantāḷ.
aṭikkaṭi maliyil, uṇavu taṭṭuppāṭu eḻavē maliyi ṉiṉṟu kīḻē ōṭi varum āṟukaḷ mūlam avaṟṟiṉ karikaḷiṉ vaḻiyāka cilamakkaḷ kūṭṭam kūṭṭamākak kīḻiṟaṅki mali aṭivārattil mullic ceṭikaḷ aṭarntirunta pakutiyil vāḻat talippaṭṭaṉar.  ivarkaḷ muṉṉar maliyiṉ ucciyil kuṟiñci maraṅkaḷiṉ aṭiyil vāḻntaṉar.   eṉavē kuṟiñci nila mākkaḷ eṉa aḻikkappaṭṭaṉa. ivarkaḷ kuravar eṉavum kūṟappaṭuvar.  ivarkaḷ peritum vēṭṭiyāṭuvatiyē, toḻilākak koṇṭiruntaṉar.  tēṉ aṭikaḷic cēkarippatum vilaṅkukaḷiṉ tōlkaḷ, kompukaḷ mutaliyavaṟṟi cēkarippatum toḻilākak koṇṭiruntaṉar.
mali aṭivārattil kuṭiyēṟiya makkaḷ āṭumāṭukaḷip paḻakki pāl, tayir, mōr, veṇṇey ney mutaliyavikaḷic ceyyum kittoḻilkaḷi uruvākkiṉar.  tiṉi, cāmi pōṉṟa puñcey tāṉiyaṅkaḷi vitikkavum aṟukkavum vaḻi kaṇṭaṉar.  ivarkaḷ āyar eṉṟu aḻikkappaṭṭaṉar.  ivarkaḷ mulli nilamākkaḷ eṉṟum kūṟappaṭuvar.
cilar, aṅkiruntum puṟappaṭṭu āṟṟaṅkari vaḻiyāka vantu nīr nirampiya kuḷaṅkaḷum, kaḻaṉinilaṅkaḷum niṟinta iṭaṅkaḷil maruta nila maraṅkaḷiṉ aṭiyil taṅkiṉar.  ivarkaḷ kalliṉāl nilaṅkiḷḷi payirt toḻil puriyat toṭaṅkiṉar.  nilaṅkiḷḷum toḻiṉ mūlam pūmik kaṭiyiliruntu tātup poruḷkaḷik kaṇṭeṭuttaṉar.  kaḷimaṇ upayōkatti aṟintu, maṇpāṉi, maṇ caṭṭikaḷi vaḷiya muṟpaṭṭaṉar.
innilam atikamāṉa nañcey puñcey tāṉiyamaṇikaḷiṉ viḷivāl vaḷam peṟṟatu.  vāḻi karumpu mutaliya payirkaḷ eḻuntaṉa.  innilattil viḷinta poruḷkaḷukkāka piṟa nilattiluḷḷōr taṅkaḷ nilattil kiṭitta poruḷkaḷip paṇṭamāṟṟākak koṭuttu nel, pul, eḷ, koḷ mutaliya poruḷkaḷip peṟṟuc ceṉṟaṉar.
maruta nilattil makkaḷiṉ vāḻvu malarntatu.  nel,eḷ, pul, koḷ, uḷuntu payaṟu mutaliya viḷi poruḷkaḷiṉ viḷivāl vaḷam peṟṟatu.  iṅku vāḻnta makkaḷ maruta nilamakkaḷ.  ivarkaḷ vēḷāḷarkārāḷar eṉappaṭuvar.  iṅku kuyavarkaḷ tōṉṟi maṭpāṇṭaṅkaḷic ceytaṉar.  mēlum pañcu viḷintatāl nūṟṟal toḻilum neytal toḻilum innilattil vaḷarntatu, taccar, kollar, taṭṭārkaṉṉar, kottar mutaliya toḻilāḷarkaḷ perukiṉar. mēlum pāṇarkaḷ tōṉṟi āṭal pāṭal toḻilkaḷic ceytu vantaṉar.
innilattil celvap perukkāl, vīṭukaḷ eḻuntaṉa.  eṅkum nāṭu nakaram amikkappaṭṭaṉa.  maṉṉarkaḷ celvarkaḷ tōṉṟiṉar.  āṭal pāṭal arumpiṉa.  mattaḷattiṉ oliyum kiṇip paṟiyiṉ āravāramum mārccaṉiyuṭiya muḻaviṉ ārppum, yāḻiṉ iṉṉoliyum eḻuntaṉa.  innilattil vāḻntōr vēḷāḷar nākarikattiṉ aṭikōliyavarkaḷ āyiṉar.
oru cilar, āṟṟaṅkari vaḻiyāka kaṭal vari ceṉṟu kaṭaṟkariyil uḷḷa neytal ceṭiyiṉ pakkalil taṅkiṉar ivarkaḷ neytal nilamakkaḷ allatu paratavar eṉṟu aḻikkappaṭṭaṉar.  ivarkaḷ mīṉ piṭippatit toḻilākak koṇṭaṉar.  appāl paṭaku, ōṭam, tōṇi, kappal, nāvāy, vaṅkam, ampi mutaliyavi kaḷi ōṭṭavum uppi viḷivikkavum mīṉkaḷip piṭittu piṟa nilattavarkaḷukkup paṇṭamāṟṟāka viṟkavum ceytu vantaṉar.
ivarkaḷ, kaṭal vaṇikattiṟku ātaravāka piṟa  nāṭukaḷuṭaṉ vaṇikam naṭatta kappal ōṭṭa muṉ vantatāl, nāṭu celvam peṟavum nākarikam ciṟappu peṟavum tuṇiyāka iruntatu.
teyvaṅkaḷiṉ tōṟṟam
cila aṟiñarkaḷ ulakil purōkitar tōṉṟi taṅkaḷ nalaṉukkākak kaṭavuḷ nampikkiyi uruvākkiyuḷḷaṉar eṉṟu kūṟukiṉṟaṉar.  cilar makkaḷiṉ aṟiyāmiyāl kumukāyattil teyva uṇarcci eḻuntatu eṉpar. cilar payattāl teyva nampikki piṟantatu eṉpar.  cilar aṭimip puttiyāl makkaḷ tāmākavē teyva nampikkiyi uruvākki viṭṭaṉar eṉṟu kūṟukiṉṟaṉar.
āṉāl camūka nūl (Social science)  tāy ātikālattil makkaḷik kāppāṟṟi vantatōṭu makkaḷukkāka avaḷ vilaṅku
kaḷōṭu pōriṭṭum, veṟṟi peṟṟum, kāl, ki, kaṇ, kātukaḷi iḻantum, uyiri iḻantatum uṇṭu.  mikat toṉmiyāṉa kāla makkaḷukku, tāy kuṭumpat taliviyākiyum, kākkum teyvamākavum karuṇi kāṭṭum araciyākavum viḷaṅkiṉāḷ.  avaḷ iṟantatum avaḷip putittu anta iṭattil naṭukal nāṭṭi atil makkaḷ vaḻipaṭṭu vantaṉar.  itaṉāl nāṭṭil pala tāyt teyvaṅkaḷ tōṉṟiṉa.  eṉavē namatu nāṭṭil maṭṭumalla ekiptu, pāpilōṉ, aciriyā, akkēṭiyā, ellam, cīriyā, ciṉṉa āciyā, kākasa kirīṭa, kirīcu, urōm mutaliya ellā nāṭukaḷilum tāyt teyvaṅkaḷ tōṉṟiṉa.
nīṇṭa kālattiṟkup piṉ tāy āṭci maṟinta piṉ tāyt teyva vaḻipāṭum kuṉṟi kaṇavaṉ teyvam (civaṉ) aṇṇaṉ teyvam (māyōṉ) makaṉ teyvam (murukaṉ)  pōṉṟa pala teyvaṅkaḷ tōṉṟiṉa.  ātiyil tamiḻar vāḻnta nāṉilattum nālu teyvaṅkaḷ eḻuntaṉa.  tolkāppiyam akattiṇi iyal cūttirattil,
māyōṉ mēya kāṭuṟi ulakamum
cēyōṉ mēya mivari ulakamum
vēntaṉ mēya tīmpuṉal ulakamum
varuṇaṉ mēya perumaṇal ulakamum
mulli, kuṟiñci, marutam neytal eṉac
colliya muṟiyāl collavum paṭumē
eṉṟu kūṟappaṭukiṟatu.   itaṉāl paṇṭik kālat tamiḻar mullikku māyōṉum kuṟiñcikkuc cēyōṉum (murukaṉum) marutattiṟku vēntaṉum (aintiraṉum) neytalukku varuṇaṉum teyvam eṉṟu vaḻipaṭṭaṉar eṉṟu cātāraṇamāka ellāp pulavarkaḷum uri kūṟuvatu iyalpu.
āṉāl uyar tiru. kā. cuppiramaṇiya piḷḷi avarkaḷ, kāṭṭiṟkut teyvam māyōṉ eṉappiṟkālattavar karutiṉum māyōḷākiya karuniṟamuṭiya ammiyiyē ciṟappākak koḷḷa vēṇṭum.  māyōḷ mēya kāṭuṟi ulakamum  eṉṟa pāṭamē ciṟantatu.  kāṭukiḻāaḷ eṉṟatumatu.  nāṭṭuppuṟaṅkaḷilum kāṭukaḷilum peruvaḻakkāka vaḻipaṭappaṭṭut teyvacaktiyiṉ vēka vaṭivākiya tēviyi piṟkālattē marapoṟṟumi paṟṟik kōvalar, māyōṉ vaḻipāṭṭik koṇṭaṉar.  māyōḷum māyōṉum uṭaṉ piṟantār eṉṉum koḷkiyuṅ kāṇka.  māyōṉukku marukaṉākiya murukaṉ vaḻipāṭu kuṟiñci nilattiṟ ciṟappāka nikaḻntatu.  āṉimukak kaṭavuḷiṉ vaḻipāṭuṅ kuṟiñci nilattiṟkē uriyatāyiṉum aintiṇik kātal oḻukkattiṟkuc ciṟappāvatu muruka vaḻipāṭēyām eṉpatu paṟṟi murukaṉiyē kuṟiñcikkut teyvam eṉṟār pōlum
vēntaṉ mēya tīmpuṉal ulakamum eṉṟu āciriyar tolkāppiyar kūṟiṉamiyāl maruta nilattut teyvam vēntaṉ eṉpatu veḷippaṭi intiraṉi vēntaṉ eṉpataṟkuk kāraṇam avaṉ maḻit teyvam ātal paṟṟiyum vayalukku iṉṟiyami yātatu paṟṟiyumeṉka.  iṉṟiraṉ eṉṟa coṟṟoṭarē intiraṉ eṉa maruviṟṟeṉpa.  maṉṟiṟam mantiram eṉa maruviyatu pōla.  maruta nilattiṟkuriya nakaraṅkaḷil mutaṉmiyāka vaḻipaṭappaṭṭateyvam, civaṉ eṉpatu nutal viḻi nāṭṭat tiṟiyōṉ kōṭṭa mutalāka eṉṟa cilappatikāra aṭiyāṟ pulaṉātaliṉ vēntaṉ eṉpāṉic civaṉ eṉpārumuḷar eṉṟu eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷār.1
tolkāppiyap poruḷatikārap puṟattiṇi iyal cūttirattil
koṭi nili kantaḻi vaḷḷi eṉṟa
vaṭunīṅku ciṟappiṉ maṉṉiya mūṉṟum
kaṭavuḷ vāḻttoṭu kaṇṇiyē varumē                         
eṉṟu kūṟappaṭukiṟatu.  itaṟku ñāyiṟu, tiṅkaḷ tī pōṉṟa iyaṟkip poruḷkaḷ tolkāppiyar kālattil teyvamāka vaḻipaṭappaṭṭirukkiṟatu eṉṟu tiru. cāmi citamparaṉār poruḷ kūṟiyuḷḷār.2
civap perumpulavar tiru. kā. cuppiramaṇiya piḷḷi avarkaḷ, ittolkāppiyac cūttirattiṟku poruḷ kūṟum poḻutu, kālam pālvari teyvam, viṉit teyvam, coṟṟeyvam, pūtat teyvam ñāyiṟu tiṅkaḷ eṉpaṉa vitantōtap paṭṭaṉa.  kālak kaṭavuḷik kālam eṉṟār.  akkaṭavuḷi uruttiraṉ eṉpārumuḷar.  pālvarit teyvam eṉpatu ellārkkum iṉpa tuṉpattiṟkuk kāraṇamākiya iruviṉiyi vakukkuṅ kaṭavuḷ.  ikkaṭavuḷi ayaṉ eṉpārumuḷar.  viṉit teyvam eṉpatu aṟatteyvam eṉṟu cēṉāvariyar kūṟiyuḷḷār eṉṟu eṭuttuk
kāṭṭiyuḷḷār.1
cintuveḷit tirāviṭa nākarikattil eḻunta ōviya eḻuttuk
kaḷi āynta piṉlāntu pēraṟiñar ṭākṭar akō pārpōlāvum piṟarum cintuveḷi makkaḷ mutaṉmutalāka viṇṇiluḷḷa ñāyiṟu (cūriyaṉ) tiṅkaḷ (cantiraṉ) cevvāy, putaṉ, viyāḻaṉ, veḷḷi, caṉi mutaliya kōḷkaḷi vaḻipaṭṭuḷḷaṉar.  appāl avi
kaḷukkup patilāka ivvulakil ñāyiṟṟiṟkup patilākac civaṉiyum, tiṅkaḷukkup patilāka umā tēviyiyum cevvāykkup patilāka murukaṉiyum, putaṉukkup patilāka, nāṉmukaṉiyum viyāḻaṉukkup patilākat tirumāliyum, caṉikkup patilāka kiruṭṭiṉaṉiyum vaḻipaṭṭirukkavēṇṭum eṉṟu karutukiṟōm eṉṟu kūṟiyuḷḷaṉar.
atōṭu tamiḻar kaṇṭa aintu nilaṅkaḷil kuṟiñci nilattil ceyōṉ eṉṟu kūṟappaṭum cevviya niṟamuṭiya cevvaṇṇaṇ ākiya ceñcaṭiyōṉākiya civaperumāṉum, pāli nilattil ammiyākiya koṟṟaviyum, mulli nilattil māyōṉākiya tirumālum neytal nilattil varuṇaṉum maruta nilattil vēntaṉum (aracaṉum) vaḻipaṭappaṭṭirukka vēṇṭum.  appāl kuṟiñci nilattil murukaṉum, maruta nilattil civaṉum teyvamāka vaḻipaṭap paṭṭirukkavēṇṭum eṉṟu eṇṇappaṭukiṟatu.  cintuveḷiyil maṭṭumalla pāpilōṉilum, ekiptilum pālatīṉattilum, piṟanāṭukaḷilum uḻavarkaḷiṉ teyvamāka civaperumāṉē kaṭavuḷāka vaḻipaṭappaṭṭuḷḷār.  iṉṟu pāpilōṉ, ellam ekiptu aciriyā, akkēṭiyā, cālṭiyā, hiṭṭiṭ mutaliya uḻavarkaḷiṉ nākarikam eḻunta nāṭukaḷil ellām civaperumāṉ kāḷimītu niṟpatōṭu kiyil tiricūlam (mūvalivēl) tāṅki niṟpatu pōṉṟa uruvaṅkaḷ tīṭṭappaṭṭiruppatu pipiḷ akarāti pōṉṟa nūṟkaḷilum, paṇṭiya kiḻakku nāṭukaḷil putiya oḷi eṉṟa peyarkaḷil vantapala nūṟkaḷilum aḻakiya ōviyam tīṭṭi eṭuttukkāṭṭap paṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  atōṭu tamiḻnāṭṭut teyvaṅkaḷāṉa civaṉ koṟṟavi murukaṉ pōṉṟa teyvaṅ kaḷip paṟṟi tolkāppiyam eṉṉa kūṟukiṟatu eṉṟu aṟivatu mikavum cālpuṭittatākum eṉṟu eṇṇukiṟēṉ.
tirāviṭa nākarikam paraviyatāka iṉṟu mēṉāṭṭu āciriyarkaḷ karutum miya nilakkaṭaṟkarip pakutikaḷilellām ñāyiṟu, tiṅkaḷ, cevvāy vaḻipāṭē civa vaḻipāṭākavum, cakti vaḻipāṭākavum murukaṉ vaḻipāṭākavum malarntuḷḷaṉa eṉṟu teḷivāka eṭuttuk kāṭṭappeṟṟuḷḷatu.  mikat toṉmiyāṉa kālattil tamiḻnāṭu toṭṭu, cintuveḷi vari, tāyt teyva vaḻipāṭē naṭantirukka vēṇṭum eṉṟu terikiṟatu.  tāyt teyvam koṟṟavi, kāṭukiḻāaḷ, paḻiyōḷ mutiyōḷ kāḷi turkki eṉṟu pala peyarkaḷāl vaḻipaṭappaṭṭuḷḷāḷ.  avaḷē īṭum eṭuppu maṟṟa muḻumutaṟ kaṭavuḷākak karutappaṭṭāḷ eṉṟu terikiṟatu.
maṟaṅkaṭi kūṭṭiya tuṭinili ciṟanta
koṟṟavi niliyum attiṇip puṟaṉē                        
eṉṟa tol kāppiyap poruḷatikārap puṟattiṇi iyal cūttiram koṟṟavi vīrattiṉāl eyta veṟṟiyi koṇṭāṭuvataṟku tuṭinili eṉṟu eṭuttukkāṭṭukiṟatu.  ivveṟṟikkuttuṇi ceyta teyvam paḻiyōḷ.  antat tāyt teyvattip pukaḻntu pōṟṟi vaḻipaṭum viḻāviṟkuk koṟṟavi nili eṉṟu kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
tamiḻnāṭṭiṉ tamiḻar teyvamāka eḻunta civaperumāṉ aiyāyiram āṇṭiṟku muṉ cintuveḷiyil ciṟappuṟṟirukkum poḻutu mūvāyiram āṇṭiṟkumuṉ ilakkiyaṅkaḷil civaṉ eṉṟa peyar kāṇappaṭātatāl tamiḻnāṭṭil civaṉē illi eṉṟu kūṟutal, takumā? tamiḻnāṭṭil 2000, ām āṇṭiṟku muṉṉuḷḷa ettaṉiyō nūṟkaḷ aḻintupōyiṉa.  avikaḷil civaṉ eṉṟa peyar iṭam peṟṟirukkalām allavā?
tolkāppiyam oru ilakkaṇa nūl, atil tamiḻnāṭṭil uḷḷa ellāt teyvaṅkaḷiṉ ellāp peyarkaḷum irukka vēṇṭum eṉṟu etirpārppatu piḻiyākum.  nilaṅkaḷukkuriya teyvaṅkaḷik kuṟippiṭṭu nilaṅkaḷukku appāṟpaṭṭa pirapañcat tiṟkuriya perunteyvattiṉ peyarik kuṟippiṭātu viṭappaṭṭum irukkalām eṉṟu cilar kūṟukiṟārkaḷ. mēlum tol kāppiyatti viṭa paḻam nūl eṉṟu eṇṇappaṭum nūṟkaḷil piṟavāyākkip periyōṉ, kaṇṇutaṟ peruṅkaṭavuḷ, mukkaṇṇaṉ eṉṟu kuṟippiṭappaṭuvatē civaṉ tamiḻakattiṉ muḻumutaṟ kaṭavuḷ eṉpati nili nāṭṭap pōtiya cāṉṟākum.
civaperumāṉ uruviṉi viḷakka eḻunta civap perum pulavar kā. cu. piḷḷi avarkaḷ,
katiravaṉi iṭamākak koṇṭa civaperumāṉ, vemmi yiṉāl accam viḷikkum tantit teyvamākak karutappaṭṭa pōtu, taṇṇaḷiyuṭiyatāyt teyvattiṉ vaṭivam taṇṇīrākak karutappaṭṭatu.  āḻamuḷḷa nīriṉ niṟam nīlamātaliṉ tāyt teyvam niṟamum nīlamāyiṟṟu.  tiṅkaḷ kuḷircci taruvatākat tōṉṟuvatāy, cantiraṉ tāyiṉ aruvuru vaṭivamākak karutappaṭuvataṟku ētuvāyiṟṟu.  ñāyiṟṟiṉ oḷiyil tōṉṟum ēḻu niṟaṅkaḷil mutalil uḷḷatu civappum, iṟutiyil uḷḷatu nīlamum ām.  pāti āṇum pātip peṇṇum ākiya civa vaṭivattil āṇpakuti cenniṟamākavum, peṇpakuti nīlaniṟamākavum koḷḷappaṭṭatu.  civam eṉṟa col muḻumutaṟkaṭavuḷik kuṟikkap payaṉpaṭṭa pōtu eṅkum niṟintilaṅkum kaṭavuḷiṉ āṟṟal cakti eṉap paṭṭatu.  kaṭavuḷ taṉ āṟṟaliṉāl ellām ceyvatu uyirkaḷ mēl vitta aruḷkāraṇamām eṉṟa koḷki eḻunta pōtu civacakti aruḷ eṉavum tāyeṉavum vaḻaṅkappaṭṭatu.
katiravaṉi civattiṟku uvamiyākavum avaṉ oḷiyic caktikku uvamiyākavum vaḻaṅkiya pōtu avvoḷi paraviya iṭamākiyaviṇṇum caktikkup pērāyiṟṟu.  viṇṇu eṉṟa peyarē viṇṭu eṉavum viṣṇu eṉavum māṟiṟṟu.
tirumāl kōyilil uḷḷa perumāḷ kaṇṇaṉ, irāmaṉ aṉumāṉ karuṭaṉ mutaliya teyvaṅkaḷ tirāviṭat teyvaṅkaḷē yākum.  kaṭavuḷ caktiyit tāyāka vaḻipaṭum tamiḻar vaḻakkaṅkāraṇa māka civa viṇavak kōyilkaḷil teyvaṅkaḷiṉ āṟṟal peṇ vaṭivil vaḻipaṭap paṭuvatāyiṟṟu.  atuvum tamiḻar karuttiṉ viḷivēyākum.  āḻvārkaḷ aṭiyārkaḷākat tirumāl kōyil kaḷil iṭam peṟṟaṉar.  ātiyil oru teyvak kōyilkaḷē ēṟpaṭṭiruntaṉa.  piṟkālattil teyvaṅkaḷiṉ parivāraṅkaḷum avikaḷil iṭam peṟalāyiṉa.  eṉiṉum ikkōyilkaḷil mukkiya teyvam oṉṟē vaḻipaṭappaṭukiṟatu.  vaṭamoḻi vētattil pēcappaṭum palvēṟu teyvaṅkaḷ tamiḻar kōyilkaḷil iṭam peṟavilli eṉpatu teḷivu.  ikkaruttiṉi ṭākṭar kilparṭ kilēṭṭar pōṉṟavarkaḷ viḷakkiyuḷḷaṉar.1
 tamiḻp perumpulavarāṉa pērāciriyar ñā. tēvanēyaṉ  avarkaḷ, paṇṭit tamiḻ nākarikamum paṇpāṭum - eṉṟa nūlil kuṟiñci nilattiṉ teyvam civaṉāka iruntār eṉpati ātarittu eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷār.  atu aṭiyil varumāṟu! cēyōṉ civantavaṉ cēntaṉ eṉṉum peyarum apporuḷatē.  murukaṉ vēlaṉ kumaraṉ eṉṉum peyarkaḷum ivaṉukkuṇṭu - civaṉ eṉpatu cēyōṉ eṉpataṉ ulaka vaḻakku vaṭivam.1  ippeyar vaṭivu vēṟupāṭṭik koṇṭu piṟkālattil āriyar orē teyvatti iraṇṭākki tantiyum makaṉumākak kūṟiviṭṭaṉar.  kumaraṉ eṉpataṟkum cēy eṉṉum kuṟukkattiṟkum makaṉ eṉṟu tavaṟākap poruḷ koṇṭatē itaṟku aṭippaṭi.
civaṉ eṉṉum āriyat teyvam oṉṟum illi.  civa eṉṉum col nalla allatu maṅkala eṉṉum poruḷil uruttiraṉukkum intiraṉukkum akkiṉikkum potuvāṉa aṭi moḻiyākavē āriyavētattil vaḻaṅkiṟṟu.
puṟakkaṇ kāṇa muṭiyātavaṟṟiyum neṭuntolivil uḷḷavaṟṟiyum kaṇṭaṟiyum ōr aṟivuk kaṇpōṉṟa uṟuppu, kumari nāṭṭu makaḷ neṟṟiyil iruntatu eṉṟum ataṉālēyē avar tam iṟivaṉukkum (civaṉukkum) oru neṟṟik kaṇṇip paṭittuk kūṟiṉar eṉṟum ārāycciyāḷar kūṟukiṉṟaṉar.  veḷḷi mali (kili) irukkiyum, kāḷiyūrtiyum civaṉik kuṟiñci nilat teyvamākak kāṭṭuvatu kavaṉikkat takkatu.
atōṭu civaperumāṉiṉ tōṟṟam, puli āṭi, yāṉit tōl pōrvi mutaliyavikaḷum cintuveḷiyil uḷḷa muttiri kaḷil civaperumāṉ arukil yāṉi, puli, kāṇṭāmirukam, māṉ mutaliyavikaḷ cūḻa niṟpatum, avar tamiḻnāṭṭil makēntira kiriyi uṟiviṭamāyk koṇṭatum vaṭintiyāvil imaya maliyil vīṟṟiruntatum mēlum avar malimakaḷi maṇan tiruppatum, avaratu mittuṉaṉākiya māyōṉum, makaṉākiya murukaṉum malit teyvam āka iruppatum civaṉ malit teyvam eṉpati uṟutippaṭuttum.
ulakam muḻutum oppuk koḷḷum oru uṇmi, civaperumāṉ uḻutu payir ceyyum maruta nilamakkaḷiṉ teyvam eṉpatākum civaperumāṉ uḻavarkaḷākiya vēḷāḷariṉ teyvamākiya paṭiyāl vēḷāḷarkaḷukku uṟutuṇiyākiya kāḷiyi vākaṉamāka avar koṇṭār.  kāḷi, nilatti uḻavum, uḻutapiṉ cēṟu nirampiya nilatti maṭṭam aṭikkavum appāl nel viḷintu aṟuvaṭiyāṉapiṉ cūṭu aṭikkaṭavum, piṉṉar nelmaṇikaḷi cākkil kaṭṭi mutukil cumantu cellum potimāṭākavum, vaṇṭikaḷil, neṟcākki ēṟṟi mikat tolivil uḷḷa nāṭukaḷukkellām cellum vaṇṭi māṭākavum payaṉpaṭṭuvantatāl tamiḻarkaḷiṉ talivaṉāṉatu civaṉ kāḷimāṭṭik kāppōṉākavum kāḷi māṭukaḷiyum nañcey puñcey payirkaḷi aḻikkum pulikaḷiyum yāṉi kaḷiyum etirttu kāḷikaḷik kāppōṉāy, eppoḻutum kiyil tiricūlam (mūvilivēl) tāṅkiyavaṉākavum, paracu eṉṉum kik kōṭariyit tāṅkiyavaṉākavum, iṭiyēṟṟi (vaccirāyutatti)t tāṅkiyōṉākavum, viḷinta payirkaḷiṉ maṇikaḷip paṟavikaḷ tiṉṉa voṭṭātu viraṭṭum tamarumakam eṉṉum tāṉiyaṅkip paṟiyi valatu kiyil tāṅkiyōṉākavum, iravil vayalkaḷil uḷḷa payirkaḷi aḻikka varavoṭṭātu kiyil neruppit tāṅkiyavaṉākavum, uḻavarkaḷiṉ pakivar kaḷākiya yāṉiyiyum puliyiyum aḻippavaṉ eṉpatik kāṭṭuvataṟku ariyil pulittōli aṇintum, mēlē yāṉit tōlip pōrttum uḷḷāṉ.
tāmari maruta nila malarāka civaperumāṉ virumpum malarāka, tamiḻ aṟiñarkaḷ pōṟṟuvar. kampaṉ maruta nilattiṉ māṇpi eṭuttukkāṭṭa eṇṇiyapoḻutu avaṉ uḷḷatti ṉiṉṟu taṇ poruni āṟṟil taṇṇīr poṅki eḻuntu varuvatu pōl, kaviti poṅkat toṭaṅkiyatu,
taṇṭali mayilkaḷāṭat tāmari viḷakkantāṅkak
koṇṭalkaḷ muḻaliṉ ēṅkak kuvaḷikaḷ viḻittu nōkkat
teṇṭiri eḻiṉikāṭṭat tēmpiḻi  makarayāḻiṉ

maruta nilam, māṟṟuyarnta poṉṉilam eṉṟu pulavarkaḷ pukaḻvar.  ēṉiya mūṉṟu nilamakkaḷum taṅkaḷ nilattiṟkiṭitta ceyporuḷkaḷiyum, viḷiporuḷiyum maruta nilamakkaḷiṭam paṇṭamāṟṟāka aḷittu nel pul, eḷ, koḷ, payaṟu mutaliya poruḷkaḷip peṟṟuc ceṉṟaṉar.  poruḷ vaḷattāl aṅku iyal ici nāṭakam pōṉṟa nuṇkalikaḷ vaḷarntiruppati makkaḷ kaṇṭukaḷittuc ceṉṟaṉar.  aṅku, eṅkum kāyum kaṉiyum niṟintiruntaṉa.  malarkaḷ kottuk kottāy malarntu toṅkiṉa.  kampaṉ ivaṟṟiyellām kūṟātu mayilkaḷ tāmari malarkaḷ, kuvaḷip pūkkaḷ vaṇṭukaḷ ākiyavikaḷiṉ āṭṭattiyum aḻakiyum maṇattiyum, rīṅkārattiyum vittu maruta nilattiṉ māṇpi eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṟāṉ.  āṭaka araṅkil āy mayilkaḷ āṭavum anta āṭṭattiṟku ēṟṟavāṟu tāmari taṉatu pūvākiya viḷakkik kāṭṭutākavum, kuvaḷi malarkaḷi nāṭakam pārppavar kaḷākavum nīril eḻum alikaḷit tiric cīlikaḷākavum vaṇṭukaḷiṉ iṉiya ōciyi yāḻākavum maruta nilam kaliyiṉṟu vīṟṟirukkum oru perum nilappirapuvākavum oru putiya nāṭaka araṅki namakkuk kaṟpaṉi ceytu kampaṉ kāṭṭiyuḷḷāṉ.  nāṭakam, ici, viḷakku, tiriccīli ākiyavikaḷ nāṭṭiyattiṟku iṉṟiyamiyāta pāttiraṅkaḷ.  itaṉik kampaṉ kaviṉuṟa eṭuttuk kāṭṭuvatu cuvittu iṉpuṟattakkatākum.
iḵtaṉṟi, maruta nilattil poruḷātāra vaḷattālum, aṟiviṉ āṟṟalālum, kaṟpaṉit tiṟattālum makkaḷ civaṉi maruta nilat teyvamāka uyarttiṉar.  avaṉi viṇṇil kōṭāṉu kōṭi kal tolivil cuḻaṉṟōṭum ceññāṉṟiṉukkum mēlum uyarttiṉar. pattari māṟṟup pacumpoṉṉilum māṟṟuyarnta pacumpoṉṉākap pukaḻntaṉar.  avaṉ ēḻulakiṟkum ataṟku appāl eṇṇilāt toliviṟkum ellāp pirapañcattiṟkum mutalvaṉākak koṇṭaṉar ulakil civaṉit tavira vēṟu teyvamē illi.  ulakilē aiyāyiram āṇṭukaṭku muṉpē tamiḻarkaḷ kumari toṭṭu imayam vari maṭṭumalla īḻam, malayam, ciṅkapuram, cāvakam, cumattirā pōrṉiyō, tāylāntu, kampōṭiyā, antamāṉ pōṉṟa kiḻakkāciya nāṭukaḷil maṭṭumalla āppirikkā mecapottāmiyā, pāpilōṉ, cumēriyā, ellam, cīriyā, acīriyā akkēṭiyā cālṭiyā, pālatīṉam, ciṉṉa āciyā kākaca ittāli, kirīpāku turuyitiyar (Druids) amerikkā pōṉṟa nāṭukaḷukkellām ceṉṟu civaṉ eṉṉum nāmattip parappi, kōyilkaḷ kaṭṭi, kalivaḷarttu ici payiṉṟu paṇpāṭu parappi oḻukkam ōmpi vantaṉar.  ulakil mutaṉ mutalāka camayatti aṉṉiya nāṭṭārkkup parappa 1600- āṇṭukaṭku muṉ vantavarkaḷ kiṟittavarkaḷ eṉṟu 20  -āṇṭukaṭku muṉ cila veḷḷiyarkaḷ kūṟivantaṉar.  50 - āṇṭukaṭku muṉ intiyā, ilaṅki, malēciyā, ciṅkapuram, cāvakam, kampōṭiyā, tāylāntu, intōcīṉam, campāṉ, cīṉā, raciyā, koriyā mutaliya nāṭukaḷukkellām putta canniyācikaḷ ceṉṟu putta neṟiyip parappi vantaṉar eṉṟu cila vaṭa intiyarkaḷ kūṟivantaṉar.  iṉṟu, cumār aiyāyiram āṇṭukaṭku muṉ, civarkaḷ civa neṟiyi kumari toṭṭu nēppāḷam vari, parmātoṭṭu paluccitāṉ vari maṭṭumalla ekiptu, amerikkā, pāpilōṉ, pālatīṉam mutaliya ulaka nāṭukaḷ aṉittiṟkum civa muṉivarkaḷ ceṉṟu civaneṟiyip parappi, tirukkōyilkaḷi eḻuppi, civap paṇpāṭṭiyum civakkalikaḷiyum parappi vantuḷḷaṉar eṉṟum uṇmi uṇarap peṟṟuḷḷatu. 1922- ām āṇṭu cintuveḷi akaḻ āyviṟkup piṉ 5000-m āṇṭukaṭkumuṉ cintu veḷiyil civaṉ, umi, civaliṅkam murukaṉ, piḷḷiyār, nilatteyvam, nīrtteyvam marat teyvam pōṉṟa teyvaṅkaḷ vaḻipaṭappaṭṭu vantaṉar eṉṟum āriyar varumuṉ intiyā muḻuvatum civaṉeṟi paraviyiruntatu eṉṟum intiya miya araciṉ akaḻ ārāyccit tuṟiyiṉar kaṇṭu ulakiṟku inta uṇmiyi uṇarttiyuḷḷaṉar.  itaṉi viḷakki i.pi. hēval eṉṉum aṟiñarum, pēṭrik kērlṭṭaṉ pōṉṟa aṟiñarum ulakiṟku mutaṉ mutalāka uṇarttiyuḷḷaṉar atōṭu tamiḻ moḻikku ēṟṟam aḷittatil ciṟanta paṅku nallāyar kālṭuvel avarkaḷukku uṇṭu.1
oru kālattil intiyā muḻuvatum tirāviṭarkaḷum civacamayamum niṟivuṟṟiruntatu.  intiyāvil cumār 4000-m āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ nilaviya tirāviṭarkaḷ camayam civam eṉappaṭum.  itu intiyāviṉ tēciya matam. civam  ulakaḷāviya paḻamperum camayam.  itu āriyam, puttam, kiṟittavam ekōvā neṟi (yūtar neṟi), epirēyarkaḷiṉ el neṟi ākiya ellāc camayattiṟkum muntiya neṟi; nīṇṭa vāṇāḷip peṟṟa palam vāynta paḻamperum camayam; iṉṟum iḷami kuṉṟātu eḻil māṟātu iḷamip polivuṭaṉ ēṟṟamuṭaṉ tikaḻum naṉṉeṟi eṉṟu poruḷ tarum muṟiyil cintuveḷi akaḻ āyvi naṭattiya iyakkunarkaḷiṉ talivarum, intiya miya araciṉ tol poruḷ āyvuttuṟi iyakkunarkaḷiṉ taḷapatiyumāṉa cāṇmārcal ulakiṟku eṭuttukkāṭṭiṉār.2
civam paḻamperum camayantāṉ; ulakaḷāviya uyarnta neṟitāṉ; eṉṟālum atu cumār ki.mu. 7500-kku muṉṉar āriyarkaḷāl peruntākkutalukku āṭpaṭṭu cintu āṟṟaṅkariyi ṉiṉṟu taṇporuni āṟṟaṅkari vari piṉ taḷḷappaṭṭatu.  ataṉāl civam aḻiyavilli; citiyavilli. āriyam, civac caṭaṅkukaḷ palavaṟṟi taḻuviyatu; āriyarkaḷiṟ palar civarāyiṉar. āriyap pārppaṉar āriya neṟiyit tuṟantu, āriyaneṟiyit tākki ataṉ akattiyum mukattiyum māṟṟiviṭṭaṉar.  pala āriyap pārppaṉar civantaḻuvi pulāl uṇavit tuṟantu, yākatti maṟantu, uṭalil tirunīṟu aṇintu kaḻuttil uruttirākkam pūṇṭu ciciṉatēvar eṉṟu oru kālattil tam muṉṉōr iḻittuk kūṟiya civaliṅkatti vaḻipaṭa muṉvantaṉar.  cilar aṟupattu mūṉṟu nāyaṉmārkaḷiṉ iṭaṅkaḷik kūṭa kippaṟṟiṉar.  campantar, cuntarar, māṇikkavācakar pōṉṟōr civa camaya kuravarkaḷāy āriya (camayattiyum) putta camaṇa
camayaṅkaḷiyellām etirttu veṟṟiyīṭṭiṉar.  intiyāviṟkuḷ āriyarkaḷ intiraṉ talimiyil pukuntu tirāviṭarkaḷik koñcam koñcamākat teṉ intiyāvarip piṉ taḷḷiṉar.  itaṉāl āriyarkaḷ intiyāvil pukuntu innāṭṭil taṅkum iṭattip peṟṟaṉar.  eṉṟālum avarkaḷ veṟṟi veṟum pōli veṟṟi eṉpati oru āṅkilap pēraṟiñar, intiraṉ ciṟu pūcalil tirāviṭari veṉṟāṉ; āṉāl civaṉ pōril āriyari veṉṟāṉ eṉṟu āṇittaramāka eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷār.1  civantaḻuvāta āriyarkaḷ civam oru camayam alla eṉṟu ulakam muḻuvatum paṟi aṭittu vantaṉar.  civattiṟku oru tattuvacātiram (Philosophy) kūṭa uṇṭu eṉṟu airōppiya tattuva ñāṉikaḷ palar aṟintu koḷḷā vaṇṇam iruṭṭaṭippuc ceytuḷḷaṉar.  puttar kaḷum, camaṇarkaḷum muculimkaḷum, kiṟittavarkaḷum civaneṟiyit tākkit tamiḻakattil taṅkaḷ camayattiṟku āḷcērkkum paṇiyil tamiḻarkaḷukkum, tamiḻp paṇpāṭṭiṟkum, tamiḻ neṟikkum iṭarviḷittuḷḷaṉar.  āṉāl tamiḻnāṭṭiṉ varalāṟu, tamiḻakattil nāṭṭiṟku putitāka vanta intiya tēcīyamatamallāta enta camayamum nilittu niṟka
villi eṉṟu kūṟukiṟatu.  intiyāviyum, tamiḻ nāṭṭiyum putta camaṇa neṟikaḷ āṭci celuttiya kālattil civacamaya kuravarkaḷ tōṉṟi avviru camayarkaḷiyum tamiḻakattiṉiṉṟu atu irunta taṭam kūṭa aṟiya muṭiyā vaṇṇam avaṟṟit tuṭittu aḻittuviṭṭaṉar.  putta, camaṇa camayaṅkaḷi nāṭṭiviṭṭu viraṭṭiyaṭitta varalāṟu, tēvāra tiruvācakaṅkaḷil iṉṟum poṉṟātu poli vuṟṟut tikaḻkiṉṟatu.
aṉittintiya neṟiyākiya camaṇattiyum aṉittulaka neṟiyāka niṉṟa putta camayattiyum mika eḷitil etirttu oru coṭṭu utiramum cintātu  intiya tēcīya neṟiyāṉa civam veṟṟiyīṭṭiyuḷḷatu.  ayal neṟiyāḷarkaḷi veṉṟa civacamayat talivarkaḷil appar cariyi vaḻi niṉṟavar eṉṟum campantar kiriyi vaḻi niṉṟavar eṉṟum, cuntarar yōkaneṟi niṉṟavar eṉṟum māṇikkavācakar ñāṉaneṟi niṉṟavar eṉṟum, tamiḻ neṟiyāka eḻunta cariyi, kiriyi, yōkam, ñāṉam (aṟivu) eṉṉum pēroḷiyiṉ muṉ camaṇa putta anniya nāṭṭu neṟikaḷ eḷitil maṟintaṉa eṉṟum tamiḻaka varalāṟu kūṟukiṟatu.  ēḻām nūṟṟāṇṭil cēra, cōḻa, pāṇṭiya, toṇṭi nāṭṭu aracar
kaḷiṉ pērātaravi camaṇa putta camayaṅkaḷ muṟṟākap peṟṟiruntum avikaḷi tamiḻppaṇ iyinta oru cila tēvarāp pāṭalkaḷiṉ mūlam aṭiyaṟṟa marampōl viḻuntu maṟintu oḻiyumāṟu ceytuviṭṭatu civanaṉṉeṟi. maṉṉarkaḷ aṉivarum tam tavaṟukku maṉṉippukkōri civaṉ aṭiyārkaḷ kālil vīḻntu vaṇaṅki civaṉukku āṭpaṭṭuviṭṭaṉar.
appar aṭikaḷ talimiyil campantar, cuntarar, māṇikka vācakar mutaliyōr āṟṟiya civat toṇṭiṉ mūlam intiya nāṭṭiṉ tēcīya neṟiyākiya civaneṟi veṟṟiyīṭṭiyatu. camaṇa putta neṟikaḷi etirppatil civaneṟiyāḷarkaḷukku āriyarkaḷ palar tuṇi niṉṟaṉar.  ataṉ mūlam āriyarkaḷ tamiḻnāṭṭil taṅkaḷukkum taṅkaḷ moḻikkum ōraḷavu iṭam tēṭik koṇṭaṉar eṉpatu maṟukka muṭiyāta uṇmitāṉ eṉṟālum maṉōṉmaṇiyam āciriyar cuntaram piḷḷi, nelli kā. cu. piḷḷi, nāki maṟimali aṭikaḷ muyaṟciyāl civamum, tamiḻum puṉitamuṟivum āriya māyiviṭṭu akalavum orupēr iyakkattiṟku aṭi kōlap peṟṟuḷḷatu.
civaṉi vaḻipaṭum kūṭṭattār civar eṉṟu tēvāra āciriyar kālattiṟkuc ciṟitumuṟpaṭṭup peyar vittirukkalām  eṉṟālum ki.mu. 3000 - āṇṭaḷavil arappaṉ paṇpāṭu arumpiya kālattilē cintuveḷiyil civaṉ, āṭavallāṉ, pacupati, umātēvi pōṉṟa civat teyvaṅkaḷ tōṉṟat toṭaṅkiyuḷḷaṉa.  iṉṟu antat teyva uruvaṅkaḷ poṟitta muttirikaḷum, tāyattukaḷum ērāḷamākak kiṭittuḷḷaṉa.
ātikālat tamiḻar vaḻipaṭṭa cemporuḷākiya civattiṟku caṅka kālattilum ataṟku muṉṉarum iṟiyōṉ, kaṭavuḷ, periyōṉ eṉṟa peyarkaḷ kūṟap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  nutal vaḻi nāṭṭat tiṟivaṉ, eṉa maṇimēkaliyilum kaṭavuḷ eṉa puṟanāṉūṟṟilum piṟavā yākkip periyōṉ eṉac cilappatikārattilum cemporuḷ eṉṟu tirukkuṟaḷilum kūṟap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa. pala aṟiñarkaḷ īcaṉ, kaṇṇutaṟ peruṅkaṭavuḷ, mukkaṇṇaṉ, vēlaṉ, cūlaṉ, caṭiyaṉ, mukkaṭ kaṭavuḷ, maṅkipaṅkaṉ, muḻumutaṟkaṭavuḷ eṉṟellām kūṟivantuḷḷaṉar.
mēlum civaṉ, ciyaṉ, cipā, ciyōṉ, el, elcaṭi, viricaṭi, al, il, ol pāl, (pakal) āṇpil acur, attāt, ṭayōṉica, martūk naṉṉar, taṅkaḷ eṉṟa peyarkaḷil palvēṟu nāṭukaḷil civaperumāṉ vaḻipaṭappaṭṭuḷḷār.  avar kāḷi mītu niṟpatum, avar kiyil tiricūlam tāṅki niṟpatum avar civaṉ eṉpati uṟutippaṭuttum civa vaḻipāṭṭit toṭarntu umātēvi vaḻipāṭum nanti vaḻipāṭum civaliṅka vaḻipāṭum pala nāṭukaḷil paravi uḷḷaṉa.
niṟka, makkaḷ tamiḻakattil mikat toṉmiyāṉa kālattilē teyva vaḻipāṭṭit toṭaṅkiviṭṭaṉar.  paḻaṅkaṟkālattilē āla marattiṉ aṭiyil oru ciṟiya kuraṭu eḻuppi atil oru kalli nāṭṭi vaḻipaṭat toṭaṅkiviṭṭaṉar.  oru ciṟiya kaṭuku pōṉṟa vittiṉiṉṟu muḷittuk kiḷittu paṉṉūṟu pēr taṅkak kūṭiya periya marattiṉ kīḻ taṅkaḷ teyva uruvaṅkaḷi vittu vaḻipaṭum iṭamākak koṇṭaṉar.
tamiḻarkaḷiṉ muṉṉōrkaḷ ātiyil iṟivaṉik kallāla marattiṉ kīḻ kaṇṭaṉar eṉpatu tamiḻarkaḷiṉ aitīkam; nampikki; uṟuti. tamiḻarkaḷiṉ teyva vaḻipāṭu mutaṉ mutalāka ālamarattiṉ aṭiyiṉiṉṟu arumpiyatu eṉṟu aṉumāṉikkappaṭukiṟatu.  makēntiramaliyil civaperumāṉ taṭcaṇāmūrttiyāy atāvatu teṉmukak kaṭavuḷāy, kurumūrttamāy  kal ālamarattiṉ aṭiyil amarntu caṉakar, caṉāntarar, caṉaṟkumārar, ākiya nāṉku tamiḻ muṉivarkaḷukku nāṉmaṟikaḷi aruḷiṉār eṉṟu tamiḻarkaḷiṉ camayanūṟkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟaṉa.  ataṉāl civaperumāṉi ālamar kaṭavuḷ eṉṟu iṉṟum pōṟṟi varukiṉṟārkaḷ.

coṉṉa ākamam tōṟṟuvit taruḷiyum - 
eṉṟa tiruvākku ati uṟutippaṭuttukiṟatu.
ālamaram, tamiḻarkaḷiṉ uḷḷattiṟku ukantatāyum karuttik kavarntatāyum iruntatu.  aṇup pōṉṟa oru ciṟiya kaṭukupōṉṟa vitiyiṉiṉṟu eḻunta oru nīṇṭa paranta periya maram taṉ nīṇṭa kiḷikaḷit tāṅka iṭi iṭiyē viḻutu viṭṭu nilattit toṭṭu, vērviṭṭuḷḷatu.  periya pantalit tāṅka iṭi iṭiyē tūṇkaḷ naṭṭiyatu pōl viḻutukaḷ vērviṭṭu maram evvaḷavu peritākap paṭarntālum kiḷikaḷ noṭintu viḻāmal tāṅki niṟpatiyum paṉṉūṟu makkaḷ ataṉ aṭiyil taṅki ataṉ niḻali nukarntum paḻattit tiṉṟu makiḻvatiyum tamiḻarkaḷ kaṇṭu viyantaṉar.  ālamarattiyum ataṉ payaṉiyum aṟintu ataṉip puṉita maramāka eṇṇip pōṟṟiṉar.
āla marattiṉ aṭiyil maṇṇik kuvittu mēṭākki atic camataḷamākac ceytu, antac camataḷamāka uḷḷa kuraṭṭiṉ naṭuvil oru mukkōṇa vaṭivilāṉa kalliyō, allatu nīṇṭa marakkaṭṭiyiyō, naṭṭu vaḻipaṭṭu vantaṉar.  mukkōṇa vaṭivamāṉa kal tāyiṉ ciṉṉamākavum, nīṇṭa marak kompu tantiyiṉ ciṉṉamākavum karutappaṭṭatu.  ulakil mutalil tāy āṭciyum tāy vaḻipāṭum nilaviyatu.  appāl tanti āṭciyum tantit teyva vaḻipāṭum nilaviyatu eṉṟu pala camūka iyal nūli uṇarnta aṟiñarkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟārkaḷ.
ūr tōṟum ālamarattiṉ aṭiyil tiruuruvam amittu vaḻipaṭum oru marapu tamiḻakattil eḻuntatu.  inta vaḻipaṭum iṭam potu il eṉappaṭṭatu.  appāl atu ampalamāka māṟiyatu.  ampalattil teyvat tiruuruvam iṭampeṟṟatu. ampalattil teyvam uṟiyum  taṟiyākiya tūṇ oṉṟu naṭappaṭṭatu.  nīrāṭit tūymi yuṭiyōrāy makaḷir ampalatti aṭintu meḻuki, kōlamiṭṭu, nantā viḷakkēṟṟi malar tūvi pōṟṟi vaḻipaṭṭu vantaṉar.  piṉṉar pakivarkaḷ ūriṉiṉṟu ciṟipiṭittu vanta makaḷiriyum inta vaḻipāṭṭil īṭupaṭac ceytaṉar.  ūrukkup putiyavarkaḷ vantāl ampalattil taṅkuvatum uṇṭu.  paṭṭiṉappāli eṉṉum paḻam perum caṅka nūl aṭiyil varumāṟu kūṟukiṟatu.
koṇṭi makaḷir uṇṭuṟi mūḻki
anti māṭṭiya nantā viḷakkiṉ
malaraṇi meḻukkam ēṟippalar toḻa
vampalar cērkkum kantuṭip potiyil -
ippāṭṭiṟku nacciṉārk kiṉiyar, pakivar maṉiyōrāyp piṭittu vanta makaḷir palarum, nīruṇṇun tuṟiyilē ceṉṟu muḻuki, meḻukum vaḻakkattiṉiyum avarkaḷ anti kālattē koḻuttiṉa aviyāta viḷakkattiṉiyum naṟumaṇam nāṟum nalla pūkkaḷiyum cūṭṭiya taṟiyiṉiyuṭiya ampalam eṉṟu kūṟukiṟār.  kantu teyvam uṟiyum taṟiyākum.  vampalar cērkkum potiyil putiyavarkaḷ palarum ēṟit toḻuvataṟkum taṅkuvataṟkum uriya iṭamāyiṟṟu potiyili meḻuki viḷakkum iṭṭirukka vampa makaḷiri vittār.  ataṉāl tamakkup pukaḻ uḷatām eṉṟu karutiṉar eṉṟu virivuri tarappaṭṭatu.
ivvāṟu tamiḻarkaḷ ūr tōṟum ālamarattiṉ aṭiyil kantiṉi vittu vaḻipaṭṭu vantaṉar.  ālamarattiṉ aṭiyil kantu vittu vaḻipaṭum iṭam ālamuṟṟam eṉappēr peṟṟatu.
ñālam nāṟum nalaṅkeḻu nallici
nāṉmaṟi mutunūl mukkaṇ celvam
ālamuṟṟam kaviṉ peṟat ti iya
poyki cūḻnta poḻiṉmaṉi makaḷir -  
eṉap puṟanāṉūṟṟuc ceyyuḷ pukaḻkiṟatu.
ālamar kaṭavuḷ aṉṉa niṉ celvam 
vēlkeḻu kuricilkaṇ ṭēṉākaliṉ
eṉṟa puṟanāṉūṟṟuc ceyyuḷum ālamarattiṉ aṭiyil araṉāriṉ tiru uruvi vittu vaḻipaṭuvatu paṇṭik kālat tamiḻar marapu eṉpati naṉku pulappaṭukiṟatu.
ātikālattil tamiḻarkaḷ ālamarattiṉ aṭiyil kantuvi vittu vaḻipaṭṭa vaḻakkam nīṇṭa kālamāka avarkaḷ kumukāyatti viṭṭu akalavilli.  ālamaraṅkaḷ illāta ūril taṅkaḷ ūril uḷḷa vēṟu maraṅkaḷiṉ aṭiyil teyva uruvaṅ kaḷi vittu vaḻipaṭṭu vantaṉar.
tamiḻar kumukāyam vaḷarcci peṟṟu kōyilkaḷ kaṭṭi ataṉ uḷḷē teyva uruvaṅkaḷi vittu vaḻipaṭum nākarikam eḻunta kālattum avarkaḷ ātikālattil teyva uruvaṅkaḷi vittu vaḻipaṭṭa maratti maṟakkavilli.  ati tala viruṭcamākak koṇṭu kōyiluḷ ataṟku oru ciṟappāṉa iṭam aḷittuḷḷaṉar.  tirupputtūril talaviruṭcam koṉṟi, akattiyāṉ paḷḷiyil tala viruṭcam vaṉṉimaram,  tiruvāṭāṉiyil  tala viruṭcam vilvamaram,  tiruāmarttūril tala viruṭcam vaṉṉi maram,  tiruāṉikkāvil tala viruṭcam veṇṇāval, tirukaḷ eṉṟum ūriṉ tala viruṭcam pāricātam, cikkal eṉṉum ūriṉ talaviruṭcam malliki; tirunelvēli nelliyappar kōyil talaviruṭcam mūṅkil, tirukkuṟṟālattil talaviruṭcam palāmaram;  tiruvīḻimiḻaliyil tala viruṭcam vīḻic ceṭi;  maturiyil tala viruṭcam kaṭappamaram; tiruppātirip puliyūril tala viruṭcam pātiri maram, tiruppukalūril tala viruṭcam puṉṉimaram;  tirumaḻapāṭiyil talaviruṭcam paṉimaram;  tirunellikkāvil talaviruṭcam nellimaram; ivvāṟu ovvoru ūrilum ovvoru maram tala viruṭcamāka uḷḷatu.  itu tirukkōyil eḻumuṉ ātiyil marattiṉ kīḻ teyva uruvam vittu vaḻipaṭappaṭṭatu eṉpati naṉku eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṟatu.
ālamum kaṭampum, nalyāṟṟu naṭuvum
kāl vaḻak kaṟunilik kuṉṟamum
eṉṟa paripāṭal ceyyuḷum,
kāṭum kāvum kaviṉ peṟu turuttiyum 
yāṟum kuḷaṉum vēṟupal vippum
catukkamum cantiyum putuppūṅkaṭampum
maṉṟamum potiyilum kantuṭi niliyum
eṉṟa tirumurukāṟṟup pāṭalum muṟkālattil maraṅkaḷiṉ aṭiyil kāṭukaḷilum mēṭukaḷilum, āṟṟaṅkarikaḷilum,  kuḷakkari kaḷilum, kaṭaṟkarikaḷilum kuṉṟukaḷilum, maṉṟukaḷilum teyva uruvaṅkaḷ vittu vaḻipaṭappaṭṭu vantaṉa eṉpati eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṉṟaṉa.
periya nākarikam eḻunta ikkālattum perumpālāṉa teyvattiru uruvaṅkaḷ maraṅkaḷiṉ aṭiyilē iruntu varukiṉṟaṉa.  perumpālum oru ūrukku iraṇṭu mūṉṟu piḷḷiyār uruvaṅkaḷ irukkum.  avikaḷ perumpālum vēmpu, aracu maraṅkaḷ aṭiyilē iruntu varukiṉṟaṉa.  cila ūrkaḷiltāṉ piḷḷiyār kōyilil iṭam peṟṟuḷḷār.
iḵtaṉṟi tamiḻ nāṭṭil pala tāyt teyvaṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  avikaḷ perumpālum nāṉku puṟamum cuvar eḻuppap peṟṟu mēlē caṭṭamum viṭṭamum vittu malluk kikaḷ vittu ōṭukaḷ vēynta kūrik kōyilkaḷil iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
iṉṟum ciṟṟūrkaḷilum, ēṉ? pērūrkaḷilum cila tāyt teyvaṅkaḷukku aṭi peruttum nuṉi ciṟuttum caturat tūṇ vaṭivil 4, 5 aṭimutal 8 vari maṇṇāl kaṭṭap peṟṟō, allatu ceṅkaṟkaḷāl kaṭṭappeṟṟō mēlē cuṇṇaccāntu pūcappeṟṟa pīṭaṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa. cila pīṭaṅkaḷil teyva uruvaṅkaḷum palavita vaṇṇattil tīṭṭap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
ātikālattil oṉṟu allatu nāṉku aintu āka irunta teyvaṅkaḷ palavāki āyirakkaṇakkāṉa kōyilkaḷip peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
