kaṭṭiṭak kali 
kaviṉ kalikaḷil kaṭṭiṭak kali oṉṟu.  kaṭṭiṭak kaliyiviṭa, makkaḷukku iṉṟiyamiyāta kali etuvum illi.  makkaḷiṉ uṭal nalattiṟku ūṟu viḷivikkum veyyil maḻi, kāṟṟu iṉṉōraṉṉa iyaṟkiyiṉ kōpattiṟkut tappuvikka  maṉitaṉ uṟiyuḷi uruvākkiṉāṉ.  muṟkālattil illaṅkaḷ makkaḷik koṭiya vilaṅkukaḷiṉ pacikku tappum araṇkaḷāvum viḷaṅkiṉa.
ātikālattil maṉitaṉ kāṭukaḷil vilaṅkukaḷiṉ naṭuvē, vilaṅkukaḷ pōl vāḻntu vantāṉ.  avaṉukku akkālattil uṭukka uṭiyum, paṭukkap pāyum uṇṇa uṇavum, oṇṭak kuṭiciyum iṉṟi aṅkum iṅkum alintu tirintāṉ.  avaṉ uyiri ōmpa uṭalip pātukākkat talippaṭṭāṉ.  uṇavup poruḷkaḷic cēkarikka muṟpaṭṭāṉ.  vilaṅkukaḷi etirttu veṭṭavum, marañceṭi koṭikaḷit tuṇṭikkavum, maraṅkaḷi luḷḷa paḻaṅkaḷi kīḻē vīḻttavum kaṟkaḷip payaṉpaṭuttavum muṉ vantāṉ.  kal avaṉatu vāḻkkiyiṉ muṉṉēṟṟattiṟkum, ciṟappiṟkum nākarikattiṟkum tuṇiyāka iruntatu.
makkaḷ nāḷaṭivil paṭippaṭiyāka nākarikam aṭintaṉar.  aṟivu vaḷarcci peṟṟaṉar.  vacikka vīṭum pucikka uṇavum uṇṭākkik koḷḷa uṇarntaṉar.  vilaṅkiṉ oru pirivāka vāḻnta maṉitaṉ aṟivāṟṟal peṟṟu nākarika vāḻkkiyi eytiṉāṉ.  avaṉ nākarika vāḻkkiyi aṭivataṟkup pallāyiram āṇṭukaḷ kaḻintaṉa.
maṉita vāḻkkikku iṉṟiyamiyāta uṇavu, uṭi uṟiyuḷ ākiyavaṟṟip peṟa  iṭiviṭātu muyaṉṟāṉ avaṉatu ariya muyaṟciyiṉ payaṉāy palavitat toḻilkaḷi uṇarntāṉ.  mutalil avaṉ payirt toḻilit toṭaṅkiṉāṉ.  appāl nūl nūṟkavum necavu neyyavum, vīṭu kaṭṭavum vaḻikaṇṭāṉ.
avaṉatu paṭṭaṟiviṉ payaṉāka toḻilkaḷ pala nāṭṭil urup peṟṟeḻuntaṉa.  oru toḻili uṇarntu ati niṟivāṉa toḻilāka viḷaṅkac ceyvataṟku maṉitaṉ paṉṉūṟu āṇṭukaḷik kaṭakka nērntatu ulakil maṉitaṉ pala toḻilkaḷip paṭittāṉ.  avaṉ toḻilkaḷip paṭippataṟku uyarnta karuvikaḷi uruvākkiṉāṉ.  avaṉ kaṇṭa toḻilukku iṉṟiyamiyāta uyarnta mūlapporuḷkaḷik kāṇa pala iṭaṅkaḷukkum ceṉṟu alintu tirintuḷḷāṉ.  appāl avaṉ aritiṟ kaṇṭa toḻilkaḷi eḷitāka muṭikkavum eḻil peṟac ceyyum muyaṟci ceytāṉ avaṉatu muyaṟciyil avaṉ periya veṟṟiyi īṭṭiṉāṉ.  avaṉatu kivaṇṇam meyvaṇṇattiyum veṉṟatu.  ciṟpat toḻilāḷi teyvam pōl uyarntāṉ.  avaṉ paṭitta ciṟpap poruḷkaḷ iyaṟkiyiyum veṉṟaṉa.  avaṉ teyvatti yum viñci viṭṭāṉ eṉṟu pulavarkaḷ pukaḻ māli cūṭṭiṉar.
maṉitaṉ ātiyil uṇavup poruḷic cuṭṭuttiṉṉat toṭaṅkiṉāṉ. appāl ati neyyiliṭṭu vatakkic cāppiṭavum, uppu, puḷi, miḷaku mutaliyavaṟṟic cērttu aṟucuviyuṭaṉ uṇṇavum terintāṉ.
avaṉ melliya nūli nūṟkavum, aḻakiya āṭikaḷi neyyavum, tuṇikaḷukku civappu, mañcaḷ, karuppu, nīlam, ūtā pōṉṟa eṇṇilā vaṇṇaṅkaḷi ūṭṭavum vaḻi kaṇṭāṉ.  āṭikaḷil paṟavi, vilaṅku, ceṭi, koṭi, ili, pū, kāy pōṉṟa uruvaṅkaḷit tīṭṭi eḻil mikum uṭikaḷi aṇiya muṉ vantāṉ.  paṭṭāṭikaḷiyum, kampaḷi āṭikaḷiyum ceytu aṇintu akamakiḻntāṉ.
avaṉ ātiyil ōlik kuṭicikaḷit tāṉ kaṇṭāṉ.  appāl maṇ cuvarkaḷi nāṟpuṟamum eḻuppi mēlē ōlikaḷāl kūri vēyntu atil uṟintāṉ.  piṉ maravīṭukaḷiyum, ceṅkallum cuṇṇāmpum kalantu cuvar eḻuppi mēlē  marattiṉāl caṭṭamum viṭṭamum, mallukaḷum, paṭṭiyalkaḷum amittu kūrikku ōṭu vēyntāṉ.  piṉṉar cuvarkaḷiṉ mītu uttaramum, kaṭṭikaḷum vittuk kaṭṭi ceṅkallum cuṇṇāmpum cērttu mēṟṟaḷam iṭṭu maṭṭap pāy vīṭukaḷik kaṭṭiṉāṉ.  piṟaku oṉṟiraṇṭu māṭikaḷiyum amittāṉ.  vīṭukaḷil tūṇkaḷum, palakaṇikaḷum, nilikaḷum, katavukaḷum, uttaramum, kaṭṭikaḷum, palakikaḷum, pōtikikaḷum iṭam peṟṟaṉa.  vīṭukaḷ muṟṟam, tāḻvāram paṭṭāli, iraṇṭām kaṭṭu, araṅku, tuyiliṭam, aṭukkaḷi, paṇṭaka cāli, nilā muṟṟam pōṉṟa uṟuppukaḷip peṟṟaṉa.  kaṭṭiṭam ciṟṟillam, māḷiki, araṇmaṉi, kōyil, kaḷañciyam, araṇ pōṉṟu palavakiyāy vaḷarcciyuṟṟatu.
maṉitaṉ tāṉ kaṇṭa ellāt toḻililum ellāt tuṟiyum nuṇṇuṇarvic celutti avikaḷi aḻaku peṟavum, cuviyuṟavum, uṟuti poliyavum, iṉimi ceṟiyavum ceytāṉ.  ivaṟṟi maṉitaṉ kali eṉṟu kūṟiṉāṉ.  makkaḷ kaṇṭa uṇavu, uṭi, uṟiyuḷ pōṉṟavikaḷil maṭṭumalla maruttuvam, ōviyam, nāṭakam, nāṭṭiyam, eḻuttu, moḻi, ici pōṉṟavi aṉit tilum kaliyip pukuttiṉāṉ. kali eṭṭāka eḻuntu eṭṭeṭṭāka aṟupattu nāṉkāka malarntu nūṟṟeṭṭāka uyarntu iṉṟu āyirat teṭṭāka vaḷarntu mēlum eṇṇaṟṟa tāka virintuḷḷatu.
makkaḷatu aka uṇarcciyiṉ teḷivāṉa niliyiṉiṉṟē perukkeṭuttu veḷit tōṉṟum cīriya kali uṇarcciyiṉ payaṉākattāṉ ulakam kaṇṭu viyantu pōṟṟum ulakil oppaṟṟa cintu veḷip paṇpāṭu aiyāyiram āṇṭukaṭku muṉ malarntatu.  aḻakuṇarcciyiṉ ariya nuṇukkamē avaṉi pōṟṟum ajantā ōviyamāka uruppeṟa muṭintatu.  kaliyiṉ nuṇṇiya eḻucciyē ellōrākkukic ciṟpamāka kāntārak kaviṉ ciṟpamākat tuḷirtteḻuntatu.  tamiḻ nāṭṭuc ciṟpikaḷil kivaṇṇac ciṟappē tilli āṭa vallaṉāy, nellik kūttaṉāy, kōṉērirācapuram ampalavāṇaṉāy eḻil peṟṟilaṅkumpaṭi ceytatu.  cōḻa nāṭṭu kaṭṭiṭak kali vallunarkaḷiṉ aḷappaṟiya ciṟpac ciṟappē tañcip peruvuṭiyār kōyilāka ulakil oppaṟṟa viṇmuṭṭum vimāṉamāy eḻuntōṅkumpaṭi ceytatu.
kaṭṭiṭak kali makkaḷ kaṇṭakaviṉ kali oṉṟu.  atu naṉṟāṉa nākarikak kali eṉṟum kūṟalām.  kaṭṭiṭak kali, makkaḷ vāḻviṟku iṉṟiyamiyāta ēṟṟamuṟṟa eḻiṟkali eṉṟum collalām.  kaṭṭiṭak kaliyil, toḻil nuṭpam, aḻaku, kaṟpaṉi ākiya mūṉṟu uyariya nilikaḷi oruṅkē peṟṟa oppaṟṟa kaliyāyiṟṟu.  kaṭṭiṭam kaṭṭuvataṟku ceṅkal ceyyum toḻil, kottu vēli, taccuvēli, irumpu vēli, kaṭṭiṭap paṭam variyum vēli mutaliya toḻilkaḷiṉ nuṭpam terintirukka vēṇṭiyatāyiṟṟu kaṭṭiṭam uṟutiyākavum uyaramākavum, vicālamākavum maṭṭum iruntāṟ pōtātu.  atil  vāḻpavarkaḷiṉ vacatikku uriyatākavum, cukātārattiṟku ēṟṟatākavum uḷḷattiṟku uvaki aḷippatākavum eḻil nalam vāyntatākavum irukka vēṇṭum.  uṟiyuḷ kaṭṭiṭac ciṟpamākac ciṟantirukka vēṇṭum eṉṟāl atu kāṇpavarkaḷiṉ kaṟpaṉiyit tūṇṭat takkatākat tulaṅka  vēṇṭum.  kaṟpaṉi palavakikaḷil tūṇṭap peṟalām.  cila kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ varalāṟṟut toṭarpāl kaṟpaṉiyik kavaralām.  cila kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ ataṉ puṉitat taṉmiyāl makkaḷ uḷḷattik kavarak kūṭum.  kaṟpaṉiyit tūṇṭak kūṭiya kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷiyellām kaṭṭiṭa ciṟpam eṉṟu kūṟa muṭiyātu.  kavarcci aḻakiṉ aṭippaṭiyil amintirukka vēṇṭum.  kaṭṭiṭam ciṟitākavō, peritākavō, putitākavō, paḻiyatākavō, kuḷḷamākavō, uyaramākavō-eppaṭiyum irukkalām.  āṉāl atu aḻaku amintatāy ciṟpa nuṭpam ceṟivatāy irukka vēṇṭum.  avvāṟu iruntāl atu kaṭṭiṭa ciṟpam eṉṟu aḻikkappaṭum.  aḻaku eṉpatu kaṟpaṉiyi tūṇṭum vēlippāṭṭik kuṟippatākum.
oru nāṭṭuk kaṭṭiṭac  ciṟpak kali vaḷarccikku mūlatāramāy amintuḷḷatu avarkaḷ camayaṅkaḷākum.  avi kaṭṭiṭak kali vaḷarccikku aṭi kōliyatu  poṉṉē pōl pōṟṟi vaḷarttatu.  mēlum atu ciṟappākak kōyil kaṭṭiṭak kaliyip pēṇivaḷarttatu.  camayam vaḷartta kōyilkaḷ, paṭimakkalikku uṟiviṭamāy iruntaṉa.  kōyilkaḷ, ici, nāṭakam, nāṭṭiyam, kaṇitam, uṇavu, aṇikalaṉ, tiruviḷakku, āṭikaḷ, kalveṭṭu, ceppēṭukaḷ, icik karuvikaḷ, veḷḷi, cempup pāttiraṅkaḷ, ōviyam iṉṉōraṉṉa eṇṇilāk kalikaḷiyum vaḷarttaṉa.  avaṟṟi kalip poruḷkaḷikkākkum kali araṇkaḷ eṉṟu kūṟiṉum cālap poruntum.  intiyak kaṭṭiṭak kali āyvut tuṟi vallunarāka matikkappaṭum aṟiñar tiru. perkūcaṉ avarkaḷ, kaṭavuḷ vaḻipāṭṭiṟkākak kōyil kaṭṭa vēṇṭum eṉṟa ārvamē ellōrum viyantu pōṟṟum kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ tōṉṟuvataṟku mūlātāramāy iruntatu eṉṟu kūṟiyatu āḻnta karuttuṭiyatākum.  iṟivaṉ uṟivataṟku ēṟṟa iṭatti uruvākka vēṇṭum eṉṟa ārvam kali vaḷarccikku iṉṟiyamiyāta karupporuḷi uṇṭākkiyatu.  anta māperum nōkkattiṉ tūṇṭutal eṇṇilāk kōyilkaḷi eḻuppiyatu.  maṉṉarkaḷum makkaḷum kaviṉ peṟum kalik kōyilkaḷi uruvākkiṉar.  eṉavē kōyil, ellāk kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷiyum viṭa kaviṉuṟum vaṉappuḷḷatāy, eṉṟum poṉṟāta uṟutiyuḷḷatāy ulakam viyakkum uyarnta niliyil ki.pi. aintām nuṟṟāṇṭil, cōḻap pēraracaṉ kōcceṅkaṇāṉ eḻupatu māṭak kōyilkaḷi eṭuppittāṉ.  irācarācaṉ ulakil uyarnta vimāṉattiyuṭiya tañcip peruvuṭiyar kōyili eṭuppittāṉ.  itu paktiyiṉ ciṉṉam.  mokalāya maṉṉaṉ  ṣājakāṉ taṉ maṉiviyiṉ niṉivāka ulakilē viliyuyarnta aḻakiya maṇi māḷikiyāka matikkap peṟum tājmakāli eḻuppiṉāṉ.  itu kātaliṉ ciṉṉam.  iraṇṭum intiyak kaṭṭiṭak kaliyiṉ kaṇ eṉak karutappaṭupavi.  ulakilē paktiyum kātalum ulakil uyarnta kaṭṭiṭak kalikaḷi eḻuppuvataṟku aṭippaṭiyāy iruntaṉa eṉpatu naṉku teriya varukiṟatu.   tamiḻ nāṭṭu maṉṉarkaḷ campantapaṭṭa maṭṭil avarkaḷiṉ araṇmaṉikaḷ eṉṟu kūṟattakkavikaḷ etuvum kāṇappaṭavilli.  āṉāl avarkaḷ eḻuppiya kōyilkaḷ āyiram āyiram āṇṭukaḷ ākiyum aḻiyātu nilittu niṟkiṉṟaṉa.  namatu māmaṉṉarkaḷ taṅkaḷukku uyarnta araṇmaṉiyi amittiruntaṉarkaḷā?  ciṉṉañ ciṟu kallil vāḻntiruntaṉarā eṉṟa aiyappāṭṭik kūṭa eḻuppuvatāka uḷḷatu.  atu evvāṟāyiṉum irukkaṭṭum, avarkaḷ taṅkaḷuk keṉṟu viliyuyarnta kōyilkaḷi (araṇmaṉikaḷi)  amippati viṭa iṟivaṉukkeṉṟu kōyil amippatilum, avi eṉṟum nilittu niṟpatilum atu ulakam uḷḷaḷavum iruntu eppoḻutum pūci, nivēttiyaṅkaḷ naṭipeṟuvatilum atika akkari koṇṭiruntārkaḷ eṉpati avarkaḷ kōyilkaḷukku aḷitta nipantaṅkaḷum, kalveṭṭukaḷum, ceppēṭukaḷum naṉku eṭuttukkāṭṭupaviyāka uḷḷaṉa.
ulakilē intiyāviltāṉ atikamāṉa kōyilkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  atilum eṉṟum aḻiyāta kaṟkōyilkaḷ uyariya ciṟpaṅkaḷi yuṭiya aḻakiya kōyilkaḷ uṇṭeṉṟu ellā nāṭṭaṟiñarkaḷ karutukiṉṟārkaḷ.
ulakilē uyarnta kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷiyum, tirukkōyilkaḷi yum, araṇkaḷiyum amikkum paṇpum marapum tiṟaṉum tirāviṭa iṉattiṟkē uṇṭu.  ulakilē enta nāṭṭilāyiṉum āyiram āṇṭiṟku muṉ uḷḷa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ irukkiṟatu eṉṟu kūṟappeṟṟāl atu niccayam tirāviṭarkaḷāl allatu avarkaḷatu iratta campantamāṉa uṟaviṉarkaḷāl eṭuppikkappaṭṭatāka irukkum eṉṟu aimpatu āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ  eṉatu tantiyār tiru.vaṭi. aruṇācalakkavirāyar avarkaḷ kūṟiṉārkaḷ.  aṉṟu avarkaḷ kūṟiya kūṟṟil eṉakku nampikki illi.  iṉṟu avarkaḷatu vārttiyil 100kku 100 catavikitam uṇmiyirukkiṟatu eṉṟu nampukiṟēṉ.
kaviṉ peṟum kaṭṭiṭam etu?  ciṟanta kali etu?  makkaḷukku iṉṟiyamiyāta paṇi etu?  eṉpatu kālattiṟkuk kālam māṟu paṭum.  nāṭṭiṟku nāṭu māṟupaṭum.  iṉattiṟku iṉam vēṟupaṭum.  makkaḷiṉ eṇṇam, nōkkam, aḻakuṇarcci avarkaḷiṉ aṟivu vaḷarcci, poruḷātāra nili, taṭpa veppa nili, kiṭikkak kūṭiya poruḷkaḷ nākarikam pōṉṟavi kaṭṭiṭac ciṟpattiṉ amippi, taratti nirṇayam ceyyat tuṇiyāy iruntu vantuḷḷaṉa.
paṇṭik kālattiya ekiptiya nāṭṭu makkaḷiṉ vāḻkki aṟivulakam eṉṟum āḻntu cintikkat takkatāy amintuḷḷatu.  oru puṟam koṭiya kōra niliyiyuṭiya pālivaṉam.  maṟṟoru pakkam eṅkum pacumiyi parappi eḻil tarum ceṭi koṭi kaḷiyum, kottuk kottākap pūttuk kuluṅkum vaṇṇa malarkaḷiyum, tiraṇṭa kāykaḷiyum, paḻuttut toṅkum iṉiya paḻak kulikaḷiyum, uyarnta uṇavup poruḷāṉa vāṟ kōtumi vayalkaḷi piṟa vāḻkkikku iṉṟiyamiyāta poruḷkaḷi ceḻittu vaḷaracceyyum Ús(Neela)  nīla āṟṟaṅkarikaḷil uḷḷa ūrkaḷilum ati aṭuttuḷḷa nakarkaḷilum ciṟṟūr kaḷilum vāḻntavarkaḷ. avarkaḷ tirāviṭa iṉattiṉ neruṅkiya  uṟaviṉarkaḷ.  ati avarkaḷ camayamum, teyvaṅkaḷum, moḻiyum paṇpāṭum varalāṟum kalikaḷum uṟutippaṭuttukiṉṟaṉa.  avarkaḷ cāviṟku añciyatilli.  maraṇam oru muṭivāṉa nili eṉṟu nampiyatilli.  uyir uṭali viṭṭup pirivatu uṇmi.  āṉāl atu uyiriṉ iṟutinili alla.  cāvu uyirkaḷukku eḻum oru māṟṟu nikaḻcciyit taviṟa vēṟalla.  oruvaṉuṭiya uyir uṭali viṭṭu nīṅkiya piṉ - atāvatu ivvulakit tuṟantapiṉ vēṟu ulakiṟ ceṉṟu ellā vāḻkki nalattiyum peṟṟu iṉpuṟṟu vāḻntu varum eṉpatu paṇṭiya ekiptiya makkaḷiṉ nampikki.  eṉavē avarkaḷ uyirtuṟanta piṉṉarum uṭali keṭātavāṟu maruntiṭṭu peṭṭikaḷil vittu avarkaḷ payaṉpaṭuttiya poruḷkaḷi yellām vittu putittu camāti eḻuppiṉar.  aṉṟu avarkaḷ eḻuppiya camātikaḷiṉ kōpuraṅkaḷē (piramiṭukaḷē) kōyilkaḷāka malarntaṉa.  niliyāṉa pēṟum uṟutiyum ekiptiya makkaḷiṉ kuṟikkōḷāka iruntaṉa.  avarkaḷ tirāviṭarkaḷip pōl periya kal tūṇkaḷ viṭṭu, kal uttaraṅ
kaḷi vittu periya kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷi eḻuppiṉar.  avarkaḷ nāṭṭil takutiyāṉa kaṟkaḷ kiṭikkavilli.  veḷināṭu
kaḷiṉiṉṟu mikunta ciramappaṭṭu kaṟkaḷik koṇṭu kallālāṉa camātik kōpuraṅkaḷi eṭuppittaṉar.  cāvaka nāṭṭiluḷḷa peruṅkōyilkaḷ aṉittum maṉṉarkaḷiṉ camātikaḷiṉ mītē eṭuppikkap peṟṟuḷḷatu;  tamiḻ nāṭṭiluḷḷa pala paḻiya kōyilkaḷ cittarkaḷ camātiyiṉ mītu eṭuppikkap peṟṟavi eṉṟu iṉṉiṉṉa cittarkaḷ camātiyiṉ iṉṉiṉṉa ūrk kōyil eḻuppap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa eṉṟum cila aṟiñarkaḷ viḷakkan tantuḷḷaṉar.  itaṉ mūlam ekiptiya nākarikam, tirāviṭa marapi aṭippaṭiyākak koṇṭatu eṉpati eṭuttuk kāṭṭuvatāka amintuḷḷatu eṉat teriyavarukiṟatu.
kirēkkarkaḷ iyaṟki eḻilum, eṇṇaṟṟa vaḷamum vāynta nāṭṭil vāḻnta makkaḷ. aḻakum, uṇmiyum kirēkkarkaḷiṉ paṇpāṭṭil irukaṇkaḷāka nilaviṉa.  avarkaḷ kalikaḷil aḻakum meyyum iṇintu ēṟṟamuṟṟu ilaṅkiṉa.  avarkaḷ nāṭṭiṟ kiṭitta calavik kaṟkaḷāl kōyilkaḷiyum, kaṭṭiṭaṅ
kaḷiyum amittu kaṭṭiṭak kalikku ciṟappūṭṭiṉar.   kirēkkar
kaḷiṉ kaṭṭiṭak kaliyilum, cilikkalikaḷilum meṉmiyum tiṇmiyum, nayamum polivuṟṟaṉa.
tirāviṭarkaḷ teyva nampikki vāyntavarkaḷ.  uṭali iṟivaṉ vāḻum kōyilāka eṇṇupavarkaḷ itaṉi naṭamāṭuṅ kōyil eṉṟu avarkaḷ maṟinūlkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟaṉa.  eṉṟum aḻiyātu nili peṟṟirukkum iṟivaṉukku eṉṟum aḻiyā uṟiviṭamāka kukik kōyiliyum kuṭi varik kōyiliyum kaṟṟaḷikaḷiyum amittavarkaḷ āṇṭavaṉ aḻivaṟṟavaṉ avaṉ uṟiyum kōyilum aḻivaṟṟatu eṉṟu ulakiṟku meyp pittavarkaḷ. kallāl aṭippaṭiyum, taḷamum, cuvarkaḷum, tūṇkaḷum, uttaramum, pāvu kallum koṇṭu kōyil amittavarkaḷ.  ulakam aḻiyiṉum tāṉ aḻiyātu niṟkum taṉit taṉmi peṟṟa taṅkaḷ iṟivaṉi vaḻipaṭa niliyāṉa kōyilkaḷi uruvākkiyavarkaḷ tirāviṭarkaḷ eṉṟu ulakak kōyil varalāṟṟil uyarnta iṭattip peṟṟavarkaḷ.  tirāviṭa makkaḷ paṭitta viṇmuṭṭum vimāṉaṅkaḷum, mukilaḷāvum kōpuraṅkaḷum tirāviṭarkaḷiṉ uyarnta koḷkikaḷukkum kuṟikkōḷkaḷukkum oru uyariya ciṉṉam pōl tikaḻkiṉṟaṉa.
ulakil, makkaḷ vāḻum palvēṟu pakutikaḷilum toṉmi yāṉa kālattilē taṉittaṉiyē kaṭṭiṭak kali eḻuntuḷḷatu.  atu aṉṟiyac cūḻnilikaḷukkēṟpavum, makkaḷiṉ tēvikaḷuk kēṟpavum vaḷarntuḷḷatu.  paḻaṅkāla kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ, avaṟṟi uruvākkap payaṉpaṭuttappaṭṭa poruḷkaḷ, avaṟṟiṉ aḻipāṭukaḷ ammakkaḷiṉ aṟivu, paṇpāṭu, nākarikam, kali, varalāṟu, camayam mutaliyavaṟṟi aṟintu koḷḷat tuṇiyāka irukkiṉṟaṉa.
ātikālak kaṭṭiṭak kaliyilum iṭikkālak kaṭṭiṭak kaliyum, kaṭṭiṭak kalic ciṟpamum aḻakum, uṟutiyum uḷḷavi kaḷāyt tikaḻkiṉṟaṉa.  aracarkaḷum, nilakkiḻārkaḷum, vaṇikar kaḷum āṭampara vāḻkki naṭatti vantaṉar.  eṉṟālum kali vaḷarppatilum kaṇṇōṭṭam celuttupavarkaḷāy iruntaṉar.  aracarkaḷiṉ ātaravip peṟṟu ciṟpikaḷ taṅkaḷ kalvi aṟivi yum kali aṟiviyum, kaṟpaṉit tiṟaṉiyum payaṉpaṭutti ciṟanta kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷiyum, oppaṟṟa ōviyaṅkaḷiyum, cīriya cilikaḷi yum, pāvaṅkaḷ oḷirum paṭimaṅkaḷiyum paṭittu teyvam uṟiyum tirukkōyilkaḷiyum aracaṉ vāḻum araṇmaṉi kaḷiyum aḻaku poliya amittuḷḷaṉar.  itu nilakkiḻārkaḷ taṅkaḷiṉ piraputtuva niliyi eṉṟum nili peṟṟu niṟkac ceyta tantiram eṉpar cilar muṟpōkku eḻuttāḷarkaḷ.
iṉṟu, ulakil uḷḷa ellā nāṭukaḷum aṇmiyil uḷḷa nāṭukaḷip pōl neruṅkit toṭarpu koḷḷat toṭaṅki yuḷḷaṉa.  oḷiyiyum oliyiyum viṭa vēkamākac cellum viṇṇūrti cilamaṇi nēraṅkaḷil ulakic cuṟṟi varukiṉṟatu.  oruvārattiṟkuḷ tiṅkaḷi aṭikiṉṟaṉa.  cila tiṅkaḷukkuḷ, cevvāy, putaṉ, viyāḻaṉ pōṉṟa kōḷkaḷi aṭikiṉṟaṉa.  aṅkuḷḷa nilikaḷip pūmiyil uḷḷa makkaḷukku uṇarttu kiṉṟaṉa.  ulakam aṉittiṟkum potuvāṉa kāṅkiriṭ pōṉṟa kaṭṭiṭap poruḷkaḷ payaṉpaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  ciṟpam, ōviyam pōṉṟa kaliyaṇikaḷ niṟinta kaviṉuṟum kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ eṅkum eḻuppap peṟukiṉṟaṉa.  makkaḷ vāḻkkiyil eḻuntuḷḷa kalvi, kuṭiyiruppu, aracāṭci mutaliyavikaḷukku ēṟpa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ uṟutiyākavum, vacatiyākavum, aḻakākavum kaṭṭappaṭṭu varukiṉṟaṉa.
tamiḻakattil ātiyil arumpiyatu teyva tiru uruvaṅkaḷ tāṉ.  teyvat tiru uruvaṅkaḷ tōṉṟip pallāyiram āṇṭu
kaḷukkup piṉṉar tiruk kōyilkaḷ eḻavilli.  āṉāl teyvat tiru uruvaṅkaḷi periya maraṅkaḷiṉ aṭiyil vittē vaḻipaṭṭu vantaṉar.  periyār ci. em. irāmaccantiraṉ ceṭṭiyār (muṉṉāḷ intu aṟaniliyap pātukāvaṟ kaḻakattiṉ āṇiyāḷar)  intiyāvō camayattik koṇṭatu āṉāl tamiḻnāṭō camayattilum, camaya niliyaṅkaḷic ciṟanta kuṟikkōḷākak koṇṭu viḷaṅkukiṟatu vēṟu nāṭṭu aṟiñarkaḷ evar inta nāṭṭiṟku vanta pōtilum iṅkuḷḷa camaya niliyaṅkaḷik kaṇṭu makiḻntu viyantu eḻutātār illi.  ākavē tamiḻ makkaḷ camaya niliyaṅkaḷukku vaḷarcci tantu avikaḷic cīriya muṟiyil vikkappaṭuvatiyē kuṟik kōḷākak koṇṭiruntārkaḷ eṉpatil aiyamilli camaya uṇarcci eppōtu ēṟpaṭṭatu eṉṟu colla iyalātu eṉṟu eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷār.
makkaḷ iṉattil camaya uṇarcci avarkaḷ kaṟkāla makkaḷāy irukkum kālattilē tuḷirttu viṭṭatu.  tāyē ātiyil taṉṉip peṟṟavaḷāy kāppavaḷāy araciyāy, maruttuvacciyāy, pātukākkum taṉṉalamaṟṟa kaṭavuḷāyk kāṇappaṭṭāḷ.  avaḷ iṟanta iṭattil naṭukal nāṭṭi avaḷi vaḻipaṭat toṭaṅkiṉāṉ appāl tantikkum, peruñcittarkaḷukkum, niṉivukal kaṭṭi vaḻipaṭat toṭaṅkiṉōm.  nīṇṭanāṭkaḷukkup piṟakē nammip pōla namatu camūkat talivarkaḷiṉ māḷikiyip pōl iṟutiyāy namatu aracaṉiṉ araṇmaṉiyip pōl nām vaḻipaṭum teyva uruvaṅkaḷukku kaṭṭiṭam eḻuppat toṭaṅki ṉōm.  nakaram, niyamam, kōṭṭam, paḷḷi, ālayam eṉṟa pataṅkaḷ kōyilukku vaḻaṅkappaṭṭaṉa.  kōyil eṉṉum patam kō + il eṉap pirittu aracaṉ vīṭu eṉṉum poruḷil payaṉpaṭutti appāl iṟivaṉ uṟiyum iṭattiṟkē niliyāṉa peyarāka nilittu niṟkac ceytu viṭṭōm.  oru kālattil maṉṉaṉik kaṭavuḷāka, allatu kaṭavuḷiṉ avatāramāka eṇṇiya kālattil avaṉ uṟiyum iṭattik kōyil eṉṟu payaṉpaṭuttiyatu tavaṟalla.  appāl makkaḷ aṟivu mutircciyiṉ payaṉāka maṉṉaṉ teyvamāka muṭiyātu avaṉ uṟiyum iṭam tēva kōṭṭamāka teyva uṟiyuḷḷākavō āka muṭiyātu eṉṟa eṇṇam piṟakkavē iṟivaṉ uṟiyum illam kōyilākavum aracaṉ uṟiyum maṉi araṇmaṉiyākavum nilipeṟṟu viṭṭatu.
iṟivaṉukku eḻilārnta illaṅkaḷi amittatu mikat toṉmiyāṉa ēṟpāṭu.  ātiyil makkaḷ aka nāḻikiyi maṭṭumē amittārkaḷ.  makkaḷ iṟi uruvattiṟkē illam kaṇṭārkaḷē yoḻiya makkaḷ veyilukkum, kāṟṟiṟkum, veppattiṟkum, maḻikkum kōyilōṭu cērttu iṭam amikka villi  - amippatu kūṭātu eṉṟum eṇṇiṉar.  namatu kōyilkaḷiṉ aṭippaṭiyilē cāñci, kāñci, cāranāt, pūri pōṉṟa iṭaṅkaḷil puttarkaḷ aka nāḻikiyi maṭṭum amittuḷḷārkaḷ.
mecapottāmiyā, ekiptu, kirīṭ kirīcu, urōm, pāracīkam, peru, mekcikkō, āppirikkā, cīṉam mutaliya nāṭukaḷil nilavi maṅki maṟintupōṉa mataṅkaḷ cumār irupatu irukkalām.  iṉṟu uyiruṭaṉ nilavum intu camayam, putta camayam, ilāmiya matam, kiṟittuva matam, yūta matam, corāṣṭaṭiriya matam, ciṇṭē camayam, kaṉpūciya matam ṭōvō matam, jiṉacamayam ākiya pattu mataṅkaḷic ciṟappākak kūṟalām.  ilāmiya camayam ki.pi 7-ām nūṟṟāṇṭil yūta kiṟittava camayattiṉ aṭippaṭiyil eḻunta vayatil kuṟinta camayam, ki.mu. 1980-āṇṭiṟku muṉ piṟanta kiṟittuviṉ vaḻiyi yoṭṭi eḻunta camayam ilāmiya neṟikku muṉ tōṉṟiya matam, maṟṟiya mataṅkaḷ etuvāy iruntālum iṉṟikku 2500 -m āṇṭiṟku muṟpaṭṭavikaḷē. iṟivaṉi vaḻipaṭum iṭaṅkaḷ eṉṉum poruḷil ellā mataṅkaḷukkum kōyilkaḷ eṭuppittu avaṟṟiṉ amippu kālattiṟkum iṭattiṟkum makkaḷiṉ nākarika vaḷarccikkum paṇpāṭṭiṟkum ēṟpa vaḷarntuḷḷatu.
paṇṭu toṭṭu iṉṟu vari ulakaṉittum kōyil eḻuntuḷḷataṟkuk kāraṇam camaya uṇarcci makkaḷiṭam eppoḻutum ētō ōraḷavil iruntu vantatē eṉpatil aiyamilli.  añciyāyiṉum, aṉpupaṭṭāyiṉum neñcam! vāḻi, niṉi niṉṟiyūri nī  eṉa namakku aṟivuṟuttiyuḷḷār āḷuṭiya piḷḷiyār.  mutalil ātikāla makkaḷ tāykkum, tāyt teyvattiṟkum ēṉ?  ammiyappaṉukkum añci vaḻipaṭṭa makkaḷēyāvar.  nam kaṇṇiṟkup pulappaṭātu aṇuviṉukkum aṇuvāy nilavum aṟivuṭiya peruñcaktiyeṉṟum perumpālum ataṟkaṭaṅki naṭantu tam muṭporutu koṇṭirukkum vēṟu ciṟu caktikaḷ tēvatikaḷ palavum uṇṭeṉṟum aviyellām makkaḷ vāḻkkiyil kalantu koṇṭu naṉmi tīmi mutaliyavaṟṟi nalkum taṉmi vāyntaṉa eṉṟum avaṟṟiyellām nām vaḻipaṭṭāl avi nammit tuṉpuṟuttātu eṉṟu makkaḷ nampi vāḻkkiyi naṭattiṉārkaḷ.  paṇṭik kāla makkaḷ vaḻipaṭṭa tāyt teyvaṅkaḷ tantit teyvaṅkaḷ, kaṇṇaṉ teyvam makaṉ teyvam pōṉṟavi paṭippaṭiyāy uyarntaṉa.  mēṭṭiṟkum malikkum, viṇṇiṟkumāka uyarntaṉa.  ñāyiṟu, tiṅkaḷ, cevvāy, putaṉ, mutaliya kōḷkaḷākavum, neruppu, nilam, nīr kāṟṟu, ākāyam maṭṭumiṉṟi iṭi, maḻi mutaliyavikaḷum teyvaṅkaḷāyiṉa.  ivaṟṟit teyvaṅkaḷākak koṇṭu ivaṟṟiṟku uyir pali iṭutal pipiḷil kūṟum ātām kālattil iruntu iṉṟu vari ellā mataṅkaḷum palvēṟu peyaril perum vaḻakkāy iruntu vantatu eṉpatu uṟutiyākum.  paḻaṅkālattil namatu camayaṅkaḷil irunta mūtātiyarkaḷ āṭumāṭu kutiri oṭṭakam kōḻi mutaliyavaṟṟi maṭṭumiṉṟi maṉita uyirkaḷiyum paliyiṭṭu vantārkaḷ.  anta vaḻakkam iṉṟu kūṭa muṟṟāka niṟuttappaṭavilli.  tām uṇṇum kāykaṟip poruḷiyum  tam kaṭavuḷukkup paṭittatuṇṭu.  ippaṭi pali, vēḷvi ceyyum poḻutu tām vaḻipaṭum teyvattip pōṟṟi pukaḻntu tam kuṟikaḷik kūṟuvatuṇṭu.
uṇmiyi urippatāṉāl iṉṟu kōyilil irukkum palipīṭam kēraḷattil palikkal eṉṟa peyaril iruppavikaḷ aṉittum ātikālattil uyirkaḷip paliyiṭṭa iṭamēyākum.  iṉṟu uyirppali civarkaḷ kōyilil maṭṭumalla kattōlikka kiṟittavarkaḷ kōyilkaḷilum palippīṭaṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  āṉāl uyirppali ceyvatilli.  āṉāl civa camaya aṟivarkaḷ palippīṭaṅkaḷ, maṉitaṉ iṟivaṉ cannitikkup pōkum muṉ taṉ uḷḷattil uḷḷa tīya eṇṇaṅkaḷi viṭṭuviṭṭu (akaṟṟi) puṉitamāṉa uḷḷattōṭu celka eṉpati niṉivūṭṭuvataṟku vittirukkiṟatu eṉṟu tattuvak karuttukkaḷ kūṟuvatu pōl kiṟitavarkaḷum kūṟukiṟārkaḷām.   āṉāl ātimaṉitaṉākiya ātām-ēvāḷ eṉpavarkaḷ makkaḷ iruvar iruntārkaḷ avarkaḷil oruvaṉ kāpayar kāyīṉ avaṉ vivacāyi, maṟṟavaṉ āṭumāṭukaḷi mēyppavaṉ.  ivviruvarkaḷil āṭumēyppavaṉ kaṭavuḷukku (karttarukku) āṭu māṭukaḷip paliyiṭṭu vantāṉ.  kaṭavuḷ avaṉ mītu piriyamāka iruntār.  avaṉukku vēṇṭiya naṉmikaḷic ceytu vantār.  mūttavaṉākiya kāyīṉ vēḷāṇmi ceypavaṉ avaṉ kaṭavuḷukku appam, paḻam, kāykaṉi kiḻaṅku mutaliyavikaḷip paṭittu vaḻi paṭṭu vantāṉ.  kaṭavuḷ (tēvaṉ) avaṉ mēl piriyamāka illi. eṉavē avaṉ kōpamum poṟāmiyum koṇṭavaṉāka āpēl eṉṉum tampiyi veṭṭik koṉṟu viṭṭāṉ.  itaṉip pipiḷ eṉṉum kiṟittavat tirumaṟi eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṟatu.  āpirakām taṉmakaṉip paliyiṭa aḻittuc ceṉṟatum kaṭavuḷ atit taṭuttatum piṉ avaṉ aṇmiyil niṉṟa āṭṭip paliyiṭṭatum teḷivāyk kuṟippiṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  kiṟitavarkaḷ iṉṟu palipīṭam vittirukkiṟārkaḷ.  pali iṭuvatilli eṉṟālum avarkaḷiṉ kaṭavuḷākiya ekōvā āṭu māṭu, mutaliya palikaḷi virumpi ēṟṟuk koṇṭatōṭu maṉitap paliyiyum ēṟṟuk koṇṭiruk kiṟār eṉṟu cāṉṟu kāṭṭa muṭiyum.
iṉṟu civaṉ kōyilkaḷilum pala tāyt teyvaṅkaḷiṉ palipīṭam uṇṭu pali iṭuvatilli.  appar cāmi kālattiṟku piṉ civaperumāṉukku āṭumāṭu, erumi kōḻi mutaliyavikaḷ paliyiṭṭatuṇṭu civaperumāṉ taṉ paktarkaḷiṭam piḷḷikkaṟi kēṭṭa katiyum uṇṭu.  pala kōyilkaḷilum tēr iḻukkum pōtu kōḻikkuñciyip paṭṭatuṇṭu.  vīṭukaṭṭi muṭintatum taccuk kaḻittal eṉṉum peyarāl āṭṭi paliyiṭṭu ataṉ utiratti vīṭṭil teḷippatum uṇṭu.  iṟanta uyirkaḷukku kōḻikkuñci capparattil (pāṭiyil) kaṭṭik koṇṭu pōy paliyiṭṭu ati vaṇṇārkaḷ eṭuttuk koḷvatum uṇṭu.  itaṉi maṟiyātu civap periyār caccitāṉantam piḷḷi yavarkaḷ B.A.B.T mutal mutal maṉitaṉ vaḻipaṭa kōvilā iruntatu.  ippaṇi mēṭiyē iruntatu.  ovvoru ūrilum iyaṟki vaḷam ceṟintatōr  pakkattil ceḻittut taḻittu vaḷarnta marattaṭiyil palippīṭam amikkappaṭṭiruntatu.1  kaṭavuḷ aṅkeḻuntaruḷi taṉṉi vaḻipaṭuvōr tarum palikaḷiyum ceyyum tōttiraṅkaḷiyum ēṟṟu koḷkiṉṟār eṉṉum  nampikki valuttatum appāṟi irunta iṭattiṟkē perum matippēṟpaṭṭu viṭṭatu.  kuṟitta nāṭkaḷil ammēṭikkum ceṉṟu paliyiṭṭup pōṟṟi varam vēṇṭum pōtu maṭṭumiṉṟi ammēṭiyik kāṇa nērnta pōtellām kaṭavuḷi niṉittu vaṇaṅki celvatum iyalpāyiṟṟu.
neṭuṅkālam variyil ippalimēṭiyit tavira vēṟu kōyilkaḷ eviyum ēṟpaṭṭatākat teriyavilli.  piṉpu maṉitaṉ taṉ karuttukaḷip parup poruḷāka veḷiyiṭuvataṟku muyaṉṟapōtu tāṉ kaṇṭa poruḷkaḷiṉ uruvaṅkaḷi variyat talippaṭṭāṉ cittiram ivvāṟu tōṉṟiyatu.  piṉpu puṟakkaṇṇāṟ kāṇap peṟāta maṉak kaṇṇāṟ kaṇṭa kāṭci kaḷiyum uruvaṅkaḷiyum cittarikkalāṉāṉ.  nāḷaṭivil ivvaṭivaṅkaḷi maṇṇilum marattilum kallilum paṉṉāṭ kaḷukkup piṉ ulōkaṅkaḷilum ceyyum tiṟamiyum vaḻakkum perukiṉa.
ippaṭik kaṭavuḷi vaḻipaṭuvataṟku ēṟpaṭṭa paruvuruvaṅ kaḷip paṇṭiya maṉitaṉ pali mēṭik ketiril eḻuntaruḷap paṇṇiṉāṉ.  ivaṟṟuḷ mikavum paḻiyatu aṉaṟ koḻuntu vaṭivāyuḷḷa civaliṅkamē eṉṟu karuta iṭamuṇṭu eṅṅaṉa meṉṟu ciṟitu kāṇpām.  ñāyiṟu, tiṅkaḷ tī mutaliya iyaṟkip perum poruḷkaḷit taṉittaṉi tēvatikaḷāyk koṇṭu vaṇaṅkiya makkaḷ nāḷaṭivil aṟivu peruka avaruṭ ciṟantōr avaṟṟiluḷḷa nalamum valiyumellām orē iṟivaṉuṭiya teṉṟu kaṇṭaṉar.  appōtu avaṟṟi iṟivaṉatu māperummēṉikaḷāka viḷakka niliyaṅkaḷākak karuti vaḻipaṭat talippaṭṭārkaḷ avaṟṟuḷ tīyāṉatu makkaḷ kikkeṭṭuvatāy avarkaḷāl vaḷarkkak kūṭiyatāṉa pōtu avvaṉaṟ piḻampi ciṟappu vakiyil āṇṭavaṉ tirumēṉiyākak koṇṭu pōṟṟum vaḻakkam perukiṟṟu.  koṟkit tīyāṉatu neyyum viṟakum koṇṭu ōmpappaṭṭa pōtaṉṟit tōṉṟātu.  aṉṟiyum maṉitaṉ taṉ aṉpiṉ aṟikuṟiyāka avvaṉaṟ koḻuntiṟku nīrāṭalum āṭi canta maṇimalar puṉitalum iyalāvaṉṟē?  ātaliṉ avvaṉaṟ piḻampuruvatti kallil amittu vaṇaṅkum vaḻakkam tōṉṟiyatu.  ivviliṅka vaḻipāṭu paṇṭiya  mekcikkō, ekiptu, arāpiyā mutaliya veḷināṭukaḷil iruntataṟkuc cāṉṟukaḷ kiṭikkiṉṟaṉa. namatu nāṭṭil ippaṇṭiya vaḻipāṭu imayam mutal kumari variyil iṉṟaḷavum kāṇak kiṭakkiṉṟatu aṟiñarkaḷ ivviliṅkattiṉ kaṇ tattuvam kaṭanta taṉi mutaṟ poruḷāṅ kantaḻiyi vaḻipaṭukiṉṟaṉar.  maṟṟiyōriṟ palar oru marattiṉ kīḻ kallilō maṇṇilō ivviliṅka vaṭivic camittu tam iṣṭa teyvatti ataṉil varuvittu vaṇaṅkutal iṉṟum kaṇ kūṭāyuḷḷatu.  mikavum paṇṭiyatāṉa civaliṅka vaḻipāṭṭuṭaṉ ki kāl mutaliya uṟuppukaḷ poruntiya palvēṟu uruvaṅkaḷi vittuc ceyyum vaḻipāṭukaḷ piṉṉāṟpalkiṉa ivaṟṟi virikkiṟ perukum.
ivvāṟellām uruva vaḻipāṭu peruki varukiyil aḷapparum perumiyuṭiya āṇṭavaṉ vatitaṟkuttakka ciṟappaminta kōyil vēṇṭum eṉṉum viruppamum muyaṟciyum tōṉṟiṉa.  aracaṉillattiṉum pārkka āṇṭavaṉ uṟiyuḷ cīriṉum ciṟappiṉum viñci viḷaṅka vēṇṭum eṉṉum ārvam perukiṟṟu.  ivvāṟu kōyilkaḷ ulakeṅkum tōṉṟip perum polivōṭu nilavalāyiṉa eṉṟu civa cittānta camayatti piracurikka eḻunta centamiḻc celvi eṉṉum tiṅkaḷ ēṭṭil uṇmiyi maṟikkātu veḷiyiṭṭuḷḷār.1
kōyilkaḷ eppaṭit tōṉṟiyatu.  uruva vaḻipāṭu eppaṭit tōṉṟiyatu.  ekkālat tōṉṟiyatu eṉṟa ārāycci tamiḻarkaḷukku eḻuntatē illi.  atōṭu tām aṟinta uṇmiyi ulakiṟku uṇartta vēṇṭum eṉṟa eṇṇamum eḻuntatē illi.  civa camayattip parappa eḻunta kaḻakaṅkaḷum nūṟpatippuk kaḻakaṅkaḷum, tiṅkaḷ itaḻkaḷum namatu kōyilkaḷip paṟṟi nūl eḻuta muṉ vantatē illi.  perci piravuṇ, cōviyat tuprayal, ṭellā kirāmriṣ pōṉṟa mēṉāṭṭaṟiñar nūlkaḷip parappavō allatu tamiḻākkam ceytu veḷiyiṭavō itu vari muṉ varavilli.  tēvāram, tiruvācakam, tirukkuṟaḷ, akanāṉūṟu, puṟanāṉūṟu pōṉṟa nūṟkaḷiyum veḷiyiṭṭu kācu campātippatilē kaṇṇum karuttāka ituvari iruntu vantuḷḷaṉar.  ulakameṅkaṇum tamiḻarkaḷ ceṉṟu āṅkāṅkē akaḻ āyvu ceytu tamiḻarkaḷum avarkaḷiṉ muṉṉōrkaḷāṉa tirāviṭarkaḷum upitiyā, ellam, aciriyā, akkēṭiyā, cumēriyā, ekiptu, kirīṭ mutaliya iṭaṅkaḷukkum malēciyā, tāylāntu, kampōṭiyā, cāvakam, pālittīvu pōṉṟa iṭaṅkaḷuk
kellām ceṉṟu palappala periya kōyilkaḷiyum tiru uruvaṅ
kaḷiyum ceytu civaṉeṟiyip parappiya ceytikaḷi ayalnāṭṭu tolporuḷ āyvuttuṟiyiṉar veḷiyiṭṭuḷḷa ceyti
kaḷiyum, nūṟkaḷiyum tamiḻ makkaḷukkut terivikka vēṇṭum eṉṟu ciṟitum avarkaḷ eṇṇiyatilli.  cintu veḷiyil civa naṉmakkaḷ eḻuppiya ciṟanta nākarikattip paṟṟi ettaṉi nūṟkaḷ veḷivantuḷḷaṉa.  cintu veḷi makkaḷ eḻutiya eḻuttukkaḷip paṭikka kōpaṉ kēkaṉ aṟiñarkaḷum leṉiṉ kirāṭ palkalik kaḻakamum eṇṇaṟṟa aṟiñarkaḷik koṇṭu laṭcam laṭcamāka poṟkācukaḷic celaviṭṭu āyvu ceytu veḷiyiṭṭu varuvatil namatu tamiḻ nāṭṭu civacittāntak kaḻakamō camayap piracārak kaḻakamō, tirāviṭak kaḻakam, tirāviṭa muṉṉēṟṟak kaḻakamō, akila intiya aṇṇā ti.mu.ka niṟuvaṉamō kaṭukaḷavum kavalippaṭṭatuṇṭā?  itaṟku oru celavuk kācum celaviṭṭa tuṇṭā?  tamiḻ nāṭṭil tamiḻar peyarāl eḻuntuḷḷa araciyal niṟuvaṉaṅkaḷum, camaya niṟuvaṉaṅkaḷum tam vayiṟṟāttiṟattit tīrttuk koḷḷa vaḻi tēṭuvatil kaṇṇum karuttumāy irukkiṟatē oḻiya tamiḻ iṉattiṉ nalaṉi nāṭiyatē illi.  iṉṟallāviṭiṉum virivil tamiḻ makkaḷ uṇmiyi uṇarntu ivarkaḷiṭam kaṇakkuk kēṭka muṉ varuvārkaḷ eṉpatu uṟuti.  appoḻutu kā. cu. piḷḷikku kalleṭuttēṉ, aṇṇāviṟkuc camāti kaṭṭi malarmāli cūṭṭi tūpa tīpaṅkāṭṭiṉēṉ, aṇṇā peyari akila intiyā muḻuvatum parappi avar cilikku māli cūṭṭiṉēṉ eṉṟu kūṟit tappittuk koḷḷa muṭiyātu.
tamiḻakattilē civa camayattik kāppataṟku eḻunta maṭaṅkaḷō, allatu paktarkaḷō namatu tamiḻarkaḷukku kōyilip paṟṟiyō, cilikaḷip paṟṟiyō ceppu uruvaṅ kaḷip paṟṟiyō nalla nūṟkaḷ āṅkilattilō veḷiyiṭavilli.  namatu nāṭṭic cērnta kāṣmīrattil vaḷarntuḷḷa civa neṟiyip paṟṟiyō, cāvakam, pāli, kampōcakam mutaliya nāṭṭil civa camayikaḷ kaṭṭiya kōyilkaḷip paṟṟiyō oru nūlum eḻuta eṇṇiyatē illi.  cālṭiya nāṭṭil 5000-m āṇṭukaṭku muṉ oru peruṅkōyil eḻuntatu.  mecapottāmiyāvil mukō eṉṉum akaḻ āyvil naṉṉar eṉṟa civaṉ kōyil kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu. ikkōyil cuṭumaṇ ceṅkaṟkaḷālāṉatu kīḻ iruntu mēlē ovvoru pirakāramum parappiṟ kuṟintatāy oṉṟiṉ mēl oṉṟāka mūṉṟāvatu mēṭiyil ucciyil oru aka nāḻiki uḷḷatu ataṉ muṉ palimēṭiyāka oru kaṟpāṟi uḷḷatu.  kōyiliṉ cuvarkaḷil veḷippuṟam paḷapaḷappāṉa nīla vaṇṇattil eṉāmal ōṭukaḷ patippikkap peṟṟuḷḷatu uṭpuṟam marappalakikaḷ aṭikkap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  ivaṟṟiṉ iṭi iṭiyē paḷiṅkuk kaṟkaḷum poṉṉum maṇiyum koṇṭu ceyta ariya ciṟpaṅkaḷ pala uḷa.  itu tirāviṭarkaḷ kaṭṭiya peruṅkōyil eṉṟu mēṉāṭṭaṟiñarkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟārkaḷ. aṭiyiliruntu mēlēyuḷḷa aka nāḻiki vari paṭikaḷ uḷḷaṉa.
vaṭa amerikkāvil kolāṭō eṉṉum āṟṟaṅkariyil uḷḷa kuṉṟiṉ mītuḷḷa civaṉ kōyil 1937-ām āṇṭu amerikkat tol poruḷ āyviṉar kaṇṭupiṭittu intak kōyil 10-āyiram āṇṭukaṭku muṟpaṭṭatu eṉṟu muṭivu kaṭṭiṉar.  itu iṅkilāntil uḷḷa pattirikikaḷilellām veḷivantatu.  tamiḻaṉukku teriyātu.  tēvāram pāṭik koṇṭu irukkum civa paktaṉō, periya purāṇam paṭittāl civalōkam kiṭṭumeṉṟu nāṭōṟum civanēyac celvarkaḷukkē teriyātu terintālum aṅku pōy pārkkavō namatu makkaḷukku itip paṟṟi viḷakkik kūṟavō avaciyam illāmal pōkiṟatu.  amerikkāvil uḷḷa cevvintiyar civaperumāṉ eṅkaḷ teyvam. avaṉ cevvintiyaṉāka iruppatāl intiyarkaḷ kūṭa avaṉi iṉṟu vari mīṉāṭci, umā tēvi mutaliya civaṉ maṉiviyik karuppi eṉṟu kūṟuvatip pōl civaṉi karuppaṉ eṉṟu kūṟat tiriyam piṟakkavilli.  intiyarkaḷ civaṉi tī vaṇṇaṉ, cevvaṇṇaṉ, ceyyōṉ, ceñcaṭiyōṉ eṉṟellām kūṟi civaperumāṉ vaṭa amerikkāvil uḷḷa cevvintiyaṉ eṉṟum, avaṉ imayamali mītuḷḷa intiya aracaṉākiya takkaṉ makaḷākiya pārvatiyiyum, teṉ intiyāvil uḷḷa parattiyākiya mīṉāṭciyiyum maṇantu koṇṭāṉ eṉṟum civaṉ amerikka cevvintiyarkaḷiṭamiruntu iravalākap peṟṟa teyvam eṉṟu kūṟukiṉṟaṉar.1
ekiptu nāṭṭiṉ talinakarākiya keyrōviṟku aṇmiyil uḷḷa kījā eṉṉum iṭattil piṅk kōyil oṉṟuḷḷatu. itu 5000-m āṇṭukaṭku kuṟintataṉṟu. karuṅkal eḷitil akappaṭāta cālṭiyā nāṭṭuk kōyil pōlaṉṟi ekiptil eḷitil kiṭikkum ikkōyil karuṅkallāl kaṭṭap peṟṟatu.  iṅkuḷḷa maṇṭapam 55 aṭi nīḷamuḷḷatu.  ciṟpa vēlippāṭu ciṟitumaṟṟa caturat tūṇālāṉatu. tūṇkaḷ iraṇṭu variciyāka niṟuttappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  ki.mu.1600 āṇṭiliruntu tāṉ ekiptil peruṅkōyilkaḷ eḻuntaṉa.  appu cimapal eṉṉum iṭattil 150-aṭi nīḷamum 100 - aṭi uyaramum uḷḷa kōyil pāṟiyik kuṭintu ceyyappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  ekiptiya nāṭṭil muṟkālattil tamiḻarkaḷ kuṭiyēṟi aṅku kōyilkaḷi eḻuppiṉar.  aṅku teyva uruvatti palarum eḷitil kāṇa muṭiyāta vakiyil vaḻipaṭum muṟikaḷ amikkappaṭṭiruntaṉavām.  ekiptil civa vaḻipāṭum kāḷi vaḻipāṭum iruntatu.  iḵtaṉṟi kāḷi mukamum maṉita uṭalum uṭiya atikāra nanti (Apis)  vaḻipāṭum iruntatu .
kiṭṭi nāṭṭil uḷḷa kōyilil nantiyum ataṉ mītu civaperumāṉ niṉṟu koṇṭu kiyil maḻuvum cuttiyalum tiricūlamum tāṅki niṟpatu pōṉṟa uruvaṅkaḷ iruntaṉa eṉṟu pala āciriyarkaḷ tam  nūṟkaḷil kuṟippiṭṭuḷḷaṉar.  annāṭṭiṉ kōyilkaḷ namatu nāṭṭiṉ tirukkōyilōṭu oppuvamikāṭṭi oru āyvu nūli eḻuta civa cittāntikaḷō avarkaḷ camayamō, maṭamō nūl veḷiyīṭṭuk kaḻakamō eṇṇiyatē illi.  teruvil kiṭakkum  oru uṭinta kalli eṭuttu vittuk koṇṭu civa civa eṉṟu taliyil taṭṭuvatum kaṉṉattil pōṭṭuk koḷvatum kōyil kaṭṭuvataṟku taṉakku vēṇṭiyavar celvarkaḷ maṭātipatikaḷ kālil vīḻntu keñci poruḷ tiraṭṭuvatum periya tiruppaṇiyāka niṉikkiṟār.  irukkiṟa eṇṇaṟṟa kōyilkaḷ ceppaṉiṭa vaḻiyaṟṟu carintu vīḻntu koṇṭirukkum pōtu uṭintu teruvil kiṭakkum oru kalli civaliṅkam oṉṟu kūṟi kumpiṭuvatum kōyil kaṭṭa makkaḷiṭam paṇam kēṭpatum veṭkamāṉa ceyal. mutalil kumpiṭuvataṟku āṭkaḷit tiraṭṭu appāl oru ciṟu kōyilik kaṭṭu.  civa naṉmakkaḷ uṇṇa uṇaviṉṟi uṭukka uṭiyiṉṟi paṭikka vaḻiyiṉṟi, paṭittavarkaḷukku vēliyiṉṟit tiṇṭāṭum poḻutu teruvil kiṭanta kallukku civaliṅkam eṉṟu peyar colli āyirakkaṇakkāṉa poruḷip potu makkaḷiṭam tiraṭṭa muyaṟcippatā?  itu aṟamā?  intak kōyilikku civaṉ varuvāṉā?  kōyilkaḷ ellām kuccuk kārikaḷ vīṭṭiṟkuc camam eṉṟār kānti aṭikaḷ.  kōyilkaḷ kaḷḷarkaḷiṉ kukikaḷ eṉṟār ēcunātar.  eṉavē ikkāla makkaḷukku mutalil kōyil eṉṟāl eṉṉa?  camayam eṉṟāl eṉṉa?  nām ēṉ kōyilukkuc cella vēṇṭum eṉpavaṟṟiṉi viḷakki namatu iḷam vāliparkaḷi, uṉatu kippaṇatti vīṭṭu kōyilukku varac cey.  namatu camūka makkaḷ oṉṟu cēra, namatu camaya poruḷātāra muṉṉēṟṟam peṟa kāltuṭṭum celavaḻiyātu ēmāṟṟi vāḻum orucilar, kūriyēṟi kōḻi piṭikka iyalāta kurukkaḷ vāṉattik kīṟivikuntam kāṭṭap pōvatu pōl ippoḻutu taṉṉalattiṟkāka tiruppaṇi ceyya muṉ vantuḷḷārkaḷ.  ivarkaḷ tiruppaṇi oḻika! oḻika!  eṉṟu kūṟi viṭṭu nām ulakil uḷḷa namatu kōyilkaḷiyum, namatu nāṭṭu kōyilkaḷipaṟṟi ārāyvōm; aḻintu koṇṭirukkum kōyilkaḷip pātukāppōm kalik karuvūlamāka ciṟpa maṇikaḷāy mūli muṭukkukaḷilaḻintu vīḻntu koṇṭu irukkum tirukkōyilkaḷip paḻutu pārkkavum namatu kōyilkaḷiyum cilikaḷiyum cempuppaṭimaṅkaḷiyum pātukākka muṉ varavēṇṭum. tamiḻ makkaḷi vaṇaṅki maṉṟāṭik kēṭṭuk koḷkiṟēṉ itaṉ uṇmiyaṟiyāta makkaḷ ōyvu peṟṟa kālattil mōṭcam pōka eṇṇi piṟar poruḷip payaṉaṟṟa vaḻikaḷukkākap payaṉpaṭuttuvatil muṉiya vēṇṭām.  tāṉ mōṭcam pōka vēṇṭum eṉṟāl taṉ contap poruḷic celaviṭṭuk kōyil kaṭṭaṭṭum. allatu taṉatu vīṭṭiyē kōyilāka māṟṟaṭṭum.   ati varavēṟkiṉṟōm vāḻttukiṉṟōm.  kānti aṭikaḷ, oruvaṉukku 2 vēṭṭikaḷ tēvi 4,6,18 vēṭṭikaḷ vittuk koṇṭāl itu tiruṭṭuttaṉam. 4 vēṭṭikaḷ vittiruppavaṉ tiruṭaṉ 6 vēṭṭikaḷ vittiruppavaṉ koḷḷikkāraṉ 8 vēṭṭikaḷ vittiruppavaṉ tīvaṭṭik koḷḷikkāraṉ eṉṟār eṉpati eṉatu tamiḻc cakōtarar kaḷukkum cakōtarikaḷukkum aṉpuṭaṉ terivittuk koḷkiṟēṉ.
niṟka kirēṭṭā (Crete) eṉṉum ittāli nāṭṭiṟku aṇmiyil uḷḷa tīvu paṇṭiyat tamiḻarkaḷuṭiya kuṭiyēṟṟa nāṭu. heraṭṭōṭṭa eṉṉum paḻam perum varalāṟṟāciriyar kirēṭṭā makkaḷ tamiḻar (tamiḻ) eṉappaṭṭār  eṉṟu kūṟiyuḷḷār.  kirēṭṭā nākarikam cintu veḷi nākarikattōṭu mika neruṅkiya orumippāṭuṭiyatu.  kirēṭṭā makkaḷ mīṉavarkaḷ eṉap peṟṟaṉar.  cintu veḷi eḻuttum kirēṭṭā eḻuttum oṉṟu pōlak kāṇappaṭukiṟatu.  kirēṭṭā nakaril uḷḷa oru nakariṟku civaṉ eṉṟu peyar.  kirēṭṭāvil cintu veḷiyil kaṭṭeṭuttatip pōṉṟa pala paḻam poruḷum annāṭṭu miṉōṉ araṇmaṉi yum (Palace of Minon)  kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  iṅku civa vaḻipāṭum civaṉ kōyil kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.1

cintu veḷi akaḻ āyvu
aimpatu āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ intiya aṟiñarkaḷiṟ cilar intiyāvil tēvarkaḷum arakkarkaḷumē uṇṭeṉṟu kūṟi vantaṉar.  appāl anāti kālam toṭṭu intiyāvil pirāmaṇar kaḷum cūttirarkaḷumē vāḻntu varukiṉṟaṉar.  appāl āṅkilēya varalāṟṟāciriyar intiyāvil āriyarkaḷum, tirāviṭarkaḷum uṇṭu.  āriyarkaḷ aḻakuvāyntavarkaḷ.  jermaṉ makkaḷum avarkaḷ moḻiyum āriyarkaḷuṭaṉ neruṅkiya toṭarpu koṇṭiruppatāyum viḷamparappaṭuttappaṭṭatu. piṉṉar āriyarkaḷ kāṇṭinēviyaṉ nāṭṭiliruntu vanta nākari makkaḷ.  avarkaḷ karuppu niṟamum cappi mūkkiyumuṭiya intiya nāṭṭiṉ paḻaṅkuṭimakkaḷi veṉṟu avarkaḷi nākarikap paṭuttiyuḷḷaṉar.  avarkaḷiṉ moḻi camakirutam, avarkaḷiṉ vētam irukku, yacur, cāmam atarvaṇam ākiyavikaḷākum.  camakirutattiṉiṉṟē tamiḻ, teluṅku, kaṉṉaṭam, maliyāḷam tuḷu, vaṅkāḷam, marāṭṭiram asām, pañcāpi mutaliya moḻikaḷ aṉittum piṟantaṉa.  intiyāvil uḷḷa ellāt teyvaṅkaḷiyum kalikaḷiyum intiyamakkaḷukku vaṭa moḻi vētamē vaḻaṅkiṉa eṉṟellām kūṟappaṭṭu vantaṉa.
vētakālap paṇpāṭṭiṟku muṉpu intiyāvil camayamō, tiruntiya moḻiyō, eḻuttō, perun teyvaṅkaḷō, kaṭṭiṭak kaliyō, ciliyō, veṇkalappaṭimaṅkaḷō, iciyō, icikkaruvikaḷō, kōyilō, aṇikalaṉkaḷō, ilakkaṇaṅkaḷō, ilakkiyaṅkaḷō, ōviyaṅkaḷō, piṟa kalikaḷō, paṇpāṭō etuvum kiṭiyātu.  civaṉ, pirammā, viṣṇu cuppiramaṇiyaṉ, umātēvi, caravati, laṭcumi mutaliya teyvaṅkaḷ ellām āriyarkaḷiṭamiruntu tirāviṭarkaḷ iravalākap peṟṟavikaḷē eṉṟu kūṟi vantaṉar.
intiyāviṉ varalāṟu ki.mu. 1500-kku muṟpaṭṭataṉṟu (atāvatu āriyarkaḷ varukikku muṟpaṭṭataṉṟu)  cila mēṉāṭṭāciriyarkaḷ kūṭa eḻuti vantaṉar.   1922-mutal 1931-ām āṇṭuvari cintu veḷiyil naṭipeṟṟa tol poruḷ āyvu intiya varalāṟṟiṉ toṭakkamum, toṉmiyum, taṉmiyum oppuvamiyaṟṟatu eṉṟu ulakiṟku uṇarttiyatu. cintu veḷiyil eḻunta āyvu intiya varalāṟṟil kavvik kiṭanta iruḷi akaṟṟum pēroḷiyāy eḻuntatu.
nantāp perumi vāynta cintu veḷip paṇpāṭu ulaka varalāṟṟiṟkē oru tiruppu muṉiyāka māṟiyatu.  intiya varalāṟṟiṉ iruṇṭakālatti ēṟṟa miku poṟkālamāka oḷipeṟac ceytuḷḷatu.  pāratap paṇpāṭṭiṉ aṭippaṭiyāka aminta paṇpukaḷ aṉittum cintu veḷi nākarikattiṉ ciṟappiyalpukaḷē eṉṟum varalāṟu kūṟum ceyti kēṭṭu ulakam viyappuṟṟuḷḷatu.
cintu veḷi varalāṟu intiyāviṉ toṉmikku ōr aḷavukōl.  intiyap paṇpāṭṭiṉ taṉmiyi (māṟṟi) uṇarttum urikal.  tici tavaṟic cellum mālumiyi nērvaḻic cellat tūṇṭum kalaṅkari viḷakkiṉip pōl tavaṟāṉa pātiyil ceṉṟa varalāṟṟāciriyarkaḷ paḻiya intiyāviṉ mītu vīcum putiya oḷi eṉṟu nēr vaḻi cellac ceytuḷḷatu.
iṉṟu intiyap paḷḷic ciṟārkaḷellām, cintu veḷi nākarikam ulakil oppaṟṟa nākarikam.  5000 -m āṇṭiṟku muṉ cintu veḷi nākarikatti ciṟanta nākarikam eṅkum arumpavilli.  cintuveḷi nākarikattiṉip paṭittamakkaḷ teṉṉintiyāvil vāḻum tirāviṭarkaḷē.  intiyāviṉ eḻuttum, camayamum, moḻiyum, kalikaḷum, paṇpāṭum, nākarikamum cintu veḷip paṇpāṭṭiṉiṉṟu kiḷittavikaḷē eṉṟu teḷivāka uṇarntuḷḷārkaḷ.
ippoḻutu intiyāvil nūl eḻutupavarkaḷ evarāka iruppiṉum cintuveḷip paṇpāṭṭi mutal attiyāyamāka vittē nūl eḻutat toṭaṅkiyuḷḷārkaḷ.  camīpattil veḷivarum pala nūlkaḷi uṉṉippākak kavaṉittu varukiṟēṉ.  varalāṟu, moḻi, eḻuttu, camayam, nāṭṭiyam, ici, icik karuvi, āṭi, aṇikalaṉkaḷ, nakar amippu, maruttuvam, mutaliya pala tuṟikaḷip paṟṟi veḷivanta nūṟkaḷilum cintu veḷi mutal iṭam peṟṟuḷḷatu.  eṉavē tirukkōyilip paṟṟi eḻutap peṟṟa innūlilum ulakak kaṭṭiṭak kaliyil toṉmiyāṉa uyarniliyip peṟṟirukkum cintu veḷik kaṭṭiṭak kaliyum iṅku iṭam peṟutal ciṟappuṭittākumaṉṟō?
arappāviṉ kaṭṭiṭakkali
arappāviṉ kaṭṭiṭak kali ciṟappu mikkatu.  cintu veḷi nakaraṅkaḷil mikat toṉmivāynta nakar arappāvākum.  arappāvil ciṟappāṉa āṭci ki.mu.3000  -m āṇṭiṟku muṉ eḻuntatu.  atu civaperumāṉi muḻumutaṟ kaṭavuḷākak koṇṭa vēḷāṇ kuṭimakkaḷ āṭciyākum.  aṅku aracarkaḷ iruntaṉar.  avarkaḷ vēḷāḷar marapil vantavarkaḷ.  anta aracaṉ koṭi ērk koṭiyākum.  kōyilkaḷil uḷḷa koṭikaḷil erutu poṟikkap
paṭṭiruntatu.
cintu veḷiyil vēḷāḷar (kārāḷar) āṭci nilaviyatu.  aṅku āṭci purinta vēḷāḷar civaperumāṉi (kayili maliyil vīṟṟiruppavari)  pacupati vaṭivilum, iliṅka vaṭivilum vaḻipaṭṭu vantaṉar.  avarkaḷ civaṉ kōyilukkut teṉ intiyāvip pōla (tamiḻakattip pōla)k kōyilukku ērāḷamāṉa varuvāyuḷḷa nilaṅkaḷi māṉiyamāka viṭṭiruntārkaḷ. avarkaḷil pakal veḷḷāḷar (cūriya kula vēḷāḷar, tiṅkaḷ (cantira) kula vēḷāḷar eṉṟum iru piriviṉar iruntaṉar.  vēḷāḷar kula muṭi maṉṉarkaḷ muṭi koṭi, kuṭi, iṇik kayal, kaṭṭil, viḷakku, muracu mutaliya araca ciṉṉaṅkaḷiyuṭiyavarkaḷāka iruntaṉar.  avarkaḷ naṭumaliyil (imayamaliyil) uḷḷa puṉita mīṉi-atāvatu eṇ kuṇattāṉi (civaperumāṉiyum) veḷḷimaliyil uṟinta murukaṉiyum vaḻipaṭṭu vantaṉar.  aṅku iliṅkatti vaḻipaṭum villavarkaḷum, (kuṟiñci nila makkaḷum mīṉāṭṭi āṇṭa mīṉavarkaḷum neytal nila makkaḷum) iruntārkaḷ eṉṟum mīṉavarkaḷ (paratavarkaḷ) vēḷāḷar araciṟkut tuṇiyāka iruntārkaḷ eṉṟum aṟikiṉṟōm.  itaṉi hirā aṭikaḷ tam kaṭṭurikaḷil viḷakki eḻutiyuḷḷār.1
nakaraṅkaḷ
1920-ām āṇṭu pañcāp mānilattil iravi caṭlec āṟukaḷukku iṭiyil tōṇṭiya poḻutu arappā eṉṉum iṭam akaḻntu kāṇappaṭṭatu.  inta nakaram cintu veḷiyil akaḻntu kaṇṭa nakaraṅkaḷil mikat toṉmiyāṉatu.  itu cintu veḷiyil nilaviya āṭciyiṉ talinakarāka iruntirukkalām eṉṟu eṇṇappaṭukiṟatu. inta nakaram akaḻnteṭutta poḻutu mikavum citintu pōṉa niliyil iruntatu.  1922-ām āṇṭil cintu mānilattil larkkāṉā māvaṭṭattil uḷḷa mokañca-tārō eṉṉum nakar ākum.  inta nakar 70-aṭi uyaramuḷḷa maṇmēṭṭiṉ aṭiyil putintiruntatu.   itu arappāvi viṭa citivuṟātu nalla niliyilē uḷḷatu.  itu cintuveḷi āṭciyil arappāviṟkup piṉ tali nakarāka iruntirukkalām eṉṟu eṇṇappaṭukiṟatu iḵtaṉṟi cintu mānilattilum, paluccitāṉ mānilattilum pala ūrkaḷ akaḻntu kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  avikaḷ kuvēṭṭā, amari, nal kuḷḷimeki, cōpu veḷi, cāṉku tārō, lokuñco, tārō, rūpār, kāḷipaṅkaṉ, cakpūrpāṉiciyāl, alimurāt pāṇṭivāki, kōṭcā nikāṅ kāṉ, cukār, kāccicā pōṉṟa nūṟṟukku mēṟpaṭṭa nakaraṅkaḷum ciṟṟūrkaḷum akaḻntu kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  iṅku akaḻntu kaṇṭeṭutta vīṭukaḷum poruḷkaḷum arappā mokañcatārō  ākiya iṭaṅkaḷil kiṭitta poruḷkaḷukkum iṭiyē ciṟu vēṟupāṭukaḷum illi.  ivi aṉittum cintu veḷip paṇpāṭṭuṭaṉ iṇinta nakar amippukaḷuṭaṉ iṇintu kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.1
nakar amippu
cintu veḷiyil akaḻntu kaṇṭa nakaraṅkaḷil ciṟappākak kuṟippiṭattakkaṉa arappā, mokañcatārō nakaraṅkaḷ eṉalām.  itu paṇṭiyat tirāviṭa makkaḷ peṟṟirunta nakar amipput tiṟaṉi eṭuttuk kāṭṭuvatākum.  arappā iravi āṟṟaṅkariyil iruntatu.  mokañcatārō cintu āṟṟaṅkariyil iruntatu.  marakkalaṅkaḷil viḷi poruṭkaḷi ōriṭattiliruntu maṟṟōr iṭattiṟku eṭuttuc cellavum, makkaḷiṉ pōkkuvarattu vacatikkumāka āṟṟaṅkariyil nakaraṅkaḷi amittuḷḷaṉar.  iṅku vāḻnta uḻavarkaḷ, cempuk kālattil amitta intap paṇpāṭṭi āṟṟaṅkarip paṇpāṭu eṉṟu kūṟukiṉṟaṉar.  inta mānakarkaḷ pala pirivukaḷākap pirikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  ellāp pakutikaḷum orē mātiriyāka irukkiṉṟaṉa.  oṉṟiṟkoṉṟu vēṟṟumi kāṇamuṭiyātavāṟu oḻuṅkākap pirikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. oru cemmiyāṉa aṭippaṭiyil cīrāka amikkappaṭṭuḷḷa immānakar nērāṉa terukkaḷiyum vacatiyāṉa illaṅkaḷiyum periya māḷikikaḷiyum, uṟutiyāṉa potuk kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷiyum uṭiyaṉavāy eḻil peṟṟu viḷaṅkukiṉṟaṉa.  arappā mokañcatārō urūpār mutaliya nakaraṅkaḷ muṉ kūṭṭiyē naṉku tiṭṭamiṭappaṭṭu uṟutiyāṉa aṭippaṭiyil amikkappaṭṭa nakarkaḷākak kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  arappā nalla araṇiyuṭiya perum nakarākak kāṇappaṭukiṉṟatu.  mokañcatārō atiṉum ciṟappuṭiya mānakarākat tōṉṟukiṉṟatu.  mokañcatārō iṉṟiya laṅkāciyar vaṭṭattil uḷḷa pāṭṭāḷi makkaḷiṉ nakarappakutiyiṉip pōla kāṇappaṭukiṟatu eṉṟu kūṟukiṟār oru āṅkila nāṭṭu eḻuttāḷar.
vīṭukaḷ amippu
arappāvil potuk kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ oruvitamākavum celvarkaḷ kuṭiyirukkum kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ oruvitamākavum ēḻi makkaḷum, naṭuttara makkaḷ vāḻum maṉikaḷ oruvitamākavum uḷḷaṉa.  celvarkaḷ vāḻum māḷiki māṭikaḷiyuṭiyaṉavāyum pala aṟikaḷ uḷḷaṉavāyum vicālamāṉatāyum uḷḷaṉa.  māḷikiyil viruntiṉarkaḷ vantāl taṅkuvataṟkut taṉi aṟi uḷḷatu.  tiyalarkaḷ iruppataṟku ovvoru vīṭṭilum taṉi iṭaṅkaḷ iruntaṉa.  potuk kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷil vaṭṭa vaṭivamāṉa mēṭikaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  ēḻikaḷum, toḻilāḷarkaḷum taṅkum ciṟu vīṭukaḷ ēḻu vīṭukaḷ iraṇṭu varicikaḷil oṉṟāka amikkap paṭṭiruntaṉa.  iraṇṭu varicikaṭṭum iṭiyē kuṟukiya pāti iruntatu.  iru pātikaḷiṉ irupakkaṅkaḷum potut teruk kaḷil vantu kalantuḷḷaṉa.  toḻilāḷar illaṅkaḷil periya muṟṟaṅkaḷum ciṟiya aṟikaḷum iruntaṉa.  arappāvil amikkappaṭṭa illaṅkaḷ ki.mu.3000-kkum muṟpaṭṭaṉa.  ekiptil kaṭṭappaṭṭa illaṅkaḷ ki.mu.2000-kkup piṟpaṭṭaṉa vākum.  arappāvil kaṭṭappaṭṭa ciṟu illaṅkaḷ kūṭa nalla kāṟṟōṭṭamum veḷiccamum uḷḷatāy cukātāra nalatti eṇṇi amikkappaṭṭaṉa.  cumēriyar, ekiptiyar illaṅkaḷ cukātāra nalaṉkaḷ kavaṉikkappaṭāviṭiṉum aḻakuṭiyatāy iruntaṉa.  iṟantavarkaḷukkāka aṅku piramiṭ kōpuram cittira vēlippāṭukaḷ niṟinta illaṅkaḷum iruntaṉa.  arappāvil cittira vēlippāṭukaḷil atikac cirattik kāṭṭappaṭavilli. iṟantavarkaḷukkākap periya camātikaḷ kaṭṭappaṭavilli.  uyarnta kōyilkaḷ kūṭa kaṭṭap paṭa villi.  āṉāl makkaḷ vāḻvataṟkēṟṟa cukātāramuḷḷa vacatiyāṉa vīṭukaḷ palakaṇikaḷ uḷḷatāy amikkappaṭṭiruntatu kavaṉikkattakkatu.
ciṟiya illaṅkaḷ
arappāvil ēḻikaḷ vāḻum ciṟu illaṅkaḷum cemmi yāka cuṭumaṇ ceṅkaṟkaḷik koṇṭu oḻuṅkākak kaṭṭap paṭṭuḷḷatu.  avikaḷ naṉṟākac cūḷiyiliṭappaṭṭa cuṭumaṇ ceṅkaṟkaḷāl civappu niṟamuṭiyatāka neṭukkum kuṟukkumāy aṭukki uṟutiyākavum aḻakākavum irukkumāṟu kavarcciyāka irukkumāṟu kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  perumpālum celvarkaḷ vīṭṭil maṭṭumiṉṟi ēḻikaḷ vīṭukaḷilum taṉikkiṇaṟukaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  potuk kiṇaṟukaḷ teruvilum uḷḷaṉa.  kiṇaṟukaḷ vaṭṭamāka amikkappaṭṭatāl kiṇaṟukaḷ kaṭṭuvataṟkeṉṟu taṉiyāka vaḷinta ceṅkalkaḷ cūḷiyil iṭappaṭṭu ventatākap pārttuk kaṭṭappaṭṭatu.  cila iṭaṅkaḷil cuṇṇāmpuc cāntiṉālum ceṅkalkaḷ vittuk kaṭṭappaṭṭa cuvarkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  āṉāl perumpālāṉa vīṭṭuc cuvarkaḷ kaḷimaṇ cāntu koṇṭē kaṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa.  akkālattil cintu veḷiyil irunta kuḷirnta taṭpa nilikku cuṭu maṇ cuvarkaḷāl kaṭṭappaṭṭa vīṭukaḷ takka veppantaruvaṉavāy iruntirukkalām eṉṟu karutappaṭukiṟatu.  arappāvil uḷḷa enta vīṭukaḷilum māṭimuṉ mukappu (Balcony)  eṅkum kāṇavilli.  aṅku vāḻnta celvarkaḷum vayalkaḷukkup pōy ēr eṭuttu uḻutu vantirukka vēṇṭum  eṉṟu eṇṇuvataṟ kēṟpa celvarkaḷ vīṭukaḷil tavaṟātu oru kalappiyuḷḷatu.  makaḷirkaḷ kōcā peṇkaḷāka illi.  vaṭa intiya intup peṇkaḷ pōl vīṭṭiṟkuḷ aṭittu vikkappaṭavilli.  camūka vāḻvil ellāt tuṟi kaḷilum pukuntu āṇkaḷōṭu ottuḻittu camūkam uyarap pāṭupaṭṭu vantaṉar eṉṟu terikiṟatu-ovvoru vīṭṭilum malaṅkaḻikkat taṉiyiṭam iruntatu.
māṭa māḷikikaḷ 
arappā periya parappāṉa cama nilattil amikkappaṭṭa paḻam perum kōnakar.  celvarkaḷum, vaṇikarkaḷum, nilak kiḻārkaḷum maṉṉarkaḷum periya māṭa māḷikikaḷ kaṭṭi ciṟappuṭaṉ vāḻntu vantuḷḷaṉar. māḷikikaḷiṉ aṭippaṭikaḷ akaṉṟatāy āḻam uḷḷaṉavāy naṉku cūḷiyiṭappaṭṭa cuṭumaṇ ceṅkaṟkaḷi maṇ cāntu kalantu naṉṟāka moṅkāḷ pōṭṭu uṟutiyāṉa aṭiyiṭṭu akalamāṉa cuvarkaḷ eḻuppi iraṇṭukku mēṟpaṭṭa māṭa māḷikikaḷ uḷḷa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ arappāvil pala kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  āṉāl ciṟiya illaṅkaḷil aṭippaṭi iṭappaṭṭiruppatākat teriyavilli.  avikaḷ uṭinta ōṭukaḷ ceṅkaṟtuṇṭukaḷ mutaliyavaṟṟi maṇ cāntu koṇṭu kalantu pōṭṭa aṭippaṭi mītu kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. māḷikikaḷiṉ cuvarkaḷum, taḷaṅkaḷum, mūṭucākkaṭikaḷum oruvitakkal koṇṭu naṉṟāka vaḻavaḻappākat tēyttu nīr aṭiyil kaciyāvaṇṇam uṟutiyāka amikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa.  taḷavariciyil iṭappaṭṭa kaṟkaḷ taḷataḷappākavum uṟutiyākavum iruntaṉa.  māṭip paṭik kaṭṭukaḷ uṟutiyāka amikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa.  kuppit toṭṭikaḷ kaḻivu nīrt tēkkaṅkaḷ vāykkālkaḷ vaṭikālkaḷ nalla niliyil kaṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa.  illaṅkaḷ tōṟum vaṭṭavaṭivilāṉa kiṇaṟukaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  kiṇaṟukaḷukku nāṟpuṟamum kipiṭic cuvarum kiṇaṟṟiṉiṉṟu kaḻivu nīr veḷiyē celvataṟku  caṟṟuc cāyvāṉa taḷamiṭappaṭṭa aṅkaṇamum uṭiyatāy iruntaṉa.  ovvoru vīṭṭic cuṟṟiyum maḻinīr veḷiyē ceṉṟu teruvil uḷḷa mūṭucākkaṭikku cellattakkatāy ciṟu kālvāy kaṭṭappaṭṭiruntatu.
kūlak kaḷañciyam 
mokañcatārōvi viṭa arappāvil atikamāṉa kūlak kaḷañciyaṅkaḷ cālac ciṟappuṟṟiruntaṉa.  ivikaḷ aṇi aṇiyāy aṭuttaṭuttu akalamum nīḷamum uyaramum uḷḷatāy amin tiruntaṉa.  oru kūlakkaḷañciyam 168 aṭi nīḷamum 13 aṭi akalamum 58 aṭi uyaramum uṭiyatu.  ivaṟṟiṉ cuvar 9 aṭi kaṉam uḷḷatu.  ivi iraṇṭu variciyāyk kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  ivviru variciyil oṉṟuk koṉṟuḷḷa tolivu 23-aṭiyākum itaṉ mēlē uṟutiyāṉa taḷam - atāvatu maṭṭappāy pōṭap paṭṭirukkiṉṟatu.  ikkūlak kaḷañciyattiṉ iraṇṭu variciyāka eṭuppikkap peṟṟirukkum neṭiya cuvarkaḷuḷ ovvoru variciyilum āṟumaṇṭapaṅkaḷ amikkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  ovvoru maṇṭapattiyum cīrāka amikkum vakiyil aintu iṭikaḷikaḷ amikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  ovvoru maṇṭapaṅ kaḷilum mūṉṟu neṭuñ cuvarkaḷ eḻuppap peṟṟu nāṉku aṟi kaḷākak pirikkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  aṭiyil marappalakikaḷ patikkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  ivikaḷ kūlap poruḷkaḷi (tāṉiya maṇi kaḷi)k  koṭṭi vippataṟkeṉṟē kaṭṭi vikkap peṟṟatāyk kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  ivikaḷ aracāṅkap paṇṭaka cālikaḷ pōlak kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  itaṉāl ovvoru nilaccuvāṉtār kaḷum ērāḷamāṉa nilaṅkaḷi uṭiyavarkaḷāy ciṟṟaracarkaḷ pōl vāḻntirukka vēṇṭum eṉṟu eṇṇappaṭukiṟatu.  aracukku variyāka inta nilac cuvāṉtārkaḷ paṇam koṭātu kūlap poruḷkaḷiyē aḷantu koṭuttirukka vēṇṭum eṉṟu aṟiñarkaḷāl karutappaṭukiṟatu.1
ivaṟṟiṟku īṭāṉa kaḷañciyam ulakil eṅkum evarum kaṇṭatilli eṉṟu karutappaṭukiṟatu.
mokañcatārō 
mokañcatārō eṉṟa peyar ātikālattil  cintu veḷiyil vāḻnta makkaḷ iṭṭa peyar alla, intap pakutiyil uḷḷa makkaḷ, ippoḻutu immāvaṭṭa moḻiyil mokañcatārō (mohenjo-daro) - maṟintōr maṇmēṭu eṉṉum poruḷpaṭum muṟiyil peyariṭṭu aḻittaṉar.  innakar 5000- m  āṇṭu muṉ aṭippaṭi iṭṭu kaṭṭappaṭṭa kō nakar ākum.  mutal kō nakar arappā.  arappā talinakarāka iruppatil pala iṭiyūṟu irukkiṟatu eṉṟō allatu atu aḻipāṭuṟṟa teṉṟō mokañcatārōvi talinakarāka eḻuppi  irukkalām eṉṟu eṇṇappaṭukiṟatu.
mokañcatārō nakar kaṭṭappaṭṭa iṭam mikap paranta camaveḷi ākum.  innakar ātiyilē naṉku tiṭṭamiṭṭuk kaṭṭap
paṭṭa mānakar ākum.  itu iraṇṭāvatu kōnakar āka irukkalām eṉṟum eṇṇappaṭukiṟatu.  itu mutalil oru caturak kal parappuṭiyatu.  itil pattil oru pakutiyē akaḻntu āyvu ceyyap peṟṟatu.  innakar oru kālattil cīrum ciṟappumāy vāḻnta talinakarāka tikaḻntatu.  iṅkuḷḷa maṇmēṭṭiṉi akaḻntu kaṇṭeṭuttatiṉ payaṉāka ēḻaṭukkukaḷik koṇṭa aḻinta nakarik kaṇṭuḷḷaṉar.  1950-il innakariṉ ēḻāvatu aṭukki iṉṟi (pākkitāṉ) araciṉ tol āyvuttuṟi akaḻ āyvuttuṟi iyakkunar taḷapati car mārṭṭi mar uyilar tōṇṭip pārttu mokañcatārō nākarikattil ettakiya vēṟupāṭum kāṇappaṭavilli eṉṟu kūṟiṉār.
teru amippu
mokañcatārōviṉ terukkaḷ kiḻakku mēṟkākavum teṟku vaṭakkākavum amikkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  teṉ kiḻakku, vaṭakiḻakkup paruvak kāṟṟiṉi uḷattiṟ koṇṭu nalla iḷaṅkāṟṟi etirpārttē terukkaḷ nīḷamākavum, akalamākavum amikkap paṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  periya terukkaḷ 6-parlāṅku (mukkāl kal) nīḷam uṭiyaṉa.  9-mutal 34-aṭi vari akalam uṭiyaṉa.  periya terukkaḷil mūṉṟu vaṇṭikaḷ orē kālattil cellalām.  periya terukkaḷi pala kuṟunterukkaḷ nērāka veṭṭic celkiṉṟaṉa.  nāṉkaṭi akalamuḷḷa ciṟu cantukaḷum uḷḷaṉa.  periya teruk
kaḷiṉiṉṟu kuṟunterukkaḷukku vaṇṭikaḷ cellum poḻutu teruviṉkaṭi kōṭiyil uḷḷa vīṭṭiṉ nērāṉa mūliyi cētappaṭuttāmal vīṭṭiṉ muṉi vaḷivākak kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  ellāt terukkaḻivukaḷilum nīrppāti (mūṭu cākkaṭikaḷ) uḷḷaṉa.  cantu muṉiyil uḷḷa vaḷivāṉa mūlikaḷiyuṭiya vīṭukaḷiṉ arukil cellum mūṭu cākkaṭiyum vaḷivākavē amikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  ovvoru kuṟunteruvilum kūṭa kiṇaṟukaḷ uḷḷatu.  terukkaḷ nalla kāṟṟōṭṭam uḷḷaṉavāy irukkiṉṟaṉa.  cukātāratti naṉku kavaṉittu terukkaḷum vīṭukaḷum amikkap
paṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  vīṭukaḷ variciyāka tam ellikkuḷḷāka oḻuṅkāka amikkap paṭṭuḷḷaṉa innakara makkaḷiṉ kuṭimip paṇpu pōṟṟaṟkuriya tākum periya terukkaḷiṉ kōṭiyil kāvaṟ
kūṭaṅkaḷum ciṟṟuṇṭic cāliyum uḷḷaṉa.
kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ amippu muṟi
cintu veḷi makkaḷiṉ paṇpāṭum aṟivum nākarikamum avarkaḷiṉ kaṭṭiṭa amippu muṟiyil naṉku amintu viḷaṅkukiṟatu.  ivarkaḷ eḻuppiya kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷukku cuṭṭa ceṅkaṟkaḷiyum, ularnta maṇ ceṅkaṟkaḷiyum payaṉpaṭutti yuḷḷaṉar.  ceṅkaṟkaḷ ellām orē aḷavil ceyyappaṭṭaṉa vākum.  atāvatu nīḷattiṟpāti akalam akalattiṟpātikaṉam.  ivikaḷ tēvikkēṟṟavāṟu palavaṭivil ceyyappaṭṭiruntaṉa.  cila caturamākavum cila vaḷivākavum, cila mūlikku ēṟṟavāṟu mukkōṇa vaṭivilum ceyyappaṭṭiruntaṉa.  ularnta maṇ ceṅkaṟkaḷic cuṭuvataṟku kālvāykaḷ pala vaṭṭa vaṭivil iruntaṉa.  potuvākac ceṅkaṟkaḷ oṉpatu aṅkula nīḷamum 4 ½  aṅkula akalamum     2 ¼ aṅkulap parumaṉum uṭiyaṉavāy uḷḷaṉa.  ceṅkaṟkaḷ mēṭupaḷḷaṅkaḷiṉṟi naṉṟāka aṟukkap paṭṭuc camaṉ ceyyap paṭṭiruntaṉa.  kiṇaṟu kaṭṭa taṉiyāṉa āppuc ceṅkal ceyyap paṭṭup payaṉpaṭuttappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  kaḻivunīrkkāl vāykaḷ periya ceṅkaṟkaḷik koṇṭu kaṭṭappaṭṭu mēlē mūṭap
paṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  periya matilum araṇum amippataṟku 29 aṅkula nīḷamum 14 ½ aṅkula akalamum 7 aṅkulap parumaṉum uṭiya ceṅkaṟkaḷ payaṉpaṭuttappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
mokañcatārōvil iraṇṭu, nāṉku, ēḻaṭukku variyuḷḷa uyarnta vīṭukaḷ kaṭṭap peṟṟiruntaṉa.  māṭikaḷ uyaramiṉṟi iruntaṉa.  mūṉṟaṭukku vīṭukaḷē atikam uḷḷaṉa.  iṅkuḷḷa makkaḷ taṅkaḷ nāṭṭiṉ taṭpa veppa nilikaḷukkēṟpa kaṭṭiṭaṅ
kaḷik kaṭṭiyuḷḷaṉar.
kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷiṉ puṟac cuvarkaḷi taṭpa veppa nilikaḷ tākkuvatāl avikaḷic cuṭumaṇ ceṅkaṟkaḷāl amittuḷḷaṉar.  taṭpa veppa niliyiṉ tākkutalkaḷukku uṭpaṭāta uṭpuṟac cuvarkaḷi ularnta-cūḷiyiṭap peṟāta ceṅkaṟkaḷāl kaṭṭiyuḷḷār.  cuvarkaḷi, ceṅkaṟkaḷi vittu maṇ cāntāṟ kaṭṭi, mēṟpūccākak kaḷimaṇ cāntiyē pūci irukkiṉṟaṉar.  cila iṭaṅkaḷil kaḷimaṇṇuṭaṉ taviṭukalantu naṉṟākak kuḻittu cāntākac ceytu meḻukiyuḷḷaṉar.  cuvarkaḷum, tariyum kūriyum kaḷimaṇṇāl pūcap peṟṟiruntatu.  cuvar mītu marattiṉālāṉa periya uttiraṅkaḷi vittu avaṟṟiṉ mītu kūṭikaḷip parappi avaṟṟiṉ mītu nāṇaṟpāykaḷip parappi appāykaḷ mītu kaḷimaṇ cāntik kaṉamākap pūcik kūrimītu amittu illam amittu vāḻntaṉar kaṭṭiṭam kaṭṭum kottarkaḷ cuvarkaḷi oḻuṅkākavum nērākavum kaṭṭuvataṟku maṭṭap palakikaḷip payaṉpaṭuttiyuḷḷaṉar.  uttiraṅkaḷi vippataṟkeṉṟē cuvarkaḷil periya caturamāka tuḷikaḷi viṭṭiruntaṉar.  avikaḷ iṉṟum naṉṟākak kāṇappaṭukiṟatu.  kottarkaḷ cuvarkaḷiyum tariyiyum mēṟkūriyiyum ciṟitum peritumāṉa maṭṭap palakikaḷ, kippāṇikaḷ, karaṇṭikaḷ mutaliyavikaḷip payaṉpaṭutti yuḷḷaṉar.  vīṭṭuc cuvarkaḷ cāḷaraṅkaḷ, vāyiṟpaṭikaḷ oḻuṅkāka vum peritākavum amittu kaṭṭiṭam uṟutiyākavum vacatiyākavum amittiruppatu akkālak kottarkaḷ kaṭṭiṭa amippil niṟinta paṭṭaṟivuṭiyavarkaḷ eṉpatip pulappaṭuttukiṟatu.
cuvarkaḷ ceṅkaṟkaḷi vittu maṇ cāntu koṇṭu kaṭṭi eḻuppap peṟṟatāl uṟutiyāka irukka cuvarkaḷ akalamāka amikkappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  vīṭṭuc cuvarkaḷ mūṉṟari aṭimutal āṟu aṭi vari akalam uḷḷatāy mikapparumaṉāka irukkiṉṟaṉa.  cintu āṟṟiṉ veḷḷatti eṇṇiyē cuvarkaḷ parumaṉāka amikkap paṭṭirukkalām eṉṟu eṇṇappaṭukiṟatu.  oṉṟiṟku mēṟpaṭṭa māṭikaḷiyuṭiya māḷikikaḷ amikkumpōtu mēl uḷḷa pārattit tāṅkuvataṟkāka cuvarkaḷiṉ akalam nīṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  oru periya kaṭṭiṭattiṉ oru cuvar akalam 5 aṭi 9 aṅkula kaṉamuṭiyatāyum piṟa cuvarkaḷ 3 aṭi 6 aṅkulam, 4 aṭi 10- aṅkulam, 4 aṭi 5 aṅkulam uḷḷatāy amikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  25 aṭi akalattil oru cuṭumaṇ ceṅkallāl kaṭṭappaṭṭa araṇum uḷḷatu.
mokañcatārōvil pala tiṟappaṭṭa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  iraṇṭu, mūṉṟu, nāṉku nilikaḷiyuṭiya vīṭukaḷ ērāḷamāka uḷḷaṉa.  akaṉṟa muṟṟaṅkaḷiyuṭiya orē aṭukkuṭiya māṭamuṭiya vīṭukaḷum uḷḷaṉa.  ellā illaṅkaḷum mēṟṟaḷam uṭiyavikaḷākavē irukkiṉṟaṉa.  nālu puṟamum mēṟṟaḷattil kipiṭiccuvarkaḷ uḷḷaṉa. mēṟṟaḷattil viḻum maḻi nīr mēṟṟaḷattil ciṟitu nēramum taṅka vaḻiyiṉṟi kīḻē iṟaṅka mēṟṟaḷattil vāṭṭam vittuk kaṭṭappaṭṭiruppatōṭu kīḻē nīr vantu cēra kuḻāykaḷum vikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  kuḻāykaḷ maṇṇālum marattālum āṉavi.
ciṟiya illam
ciṟiya illaṅkaḷum pala uḷḷaṉa.  avi pāṭṭāḷi makkaḷiṉ illam eṉa eṇṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  ciṟiya illam 4-aṟikaḷ uḷḷatāy 30 aṭi nīḷamum 27 aṭi akalamum uṭiyatu.  ivikaḷ ellām ceṅkaṟkaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷēyākum.  ivaṟṟiṉ taḷam cāṇattiṉāl meḻukappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  iḵtaṉṟi kuṭilkaḷ amittu vāḻum ēḻikaḷ iruntiruppārō eṉṟa aiyamum uṇṭākiṟatu.  cintuveḷip paṇpāṭṭil piccikkārarkaḷum illātavarkaḷum iruntiruppārkaḷā eṉṟu aiyam eḻukiṟatu.
cila periya māḷikikaḷiṉ naṭuvil akaṉṟa muttaṅkaḷ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  ataṉic cuṟṟip pala aṟikaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  aṟikaḷ ciṟitāka nalla kāṟṟōṭṭam uḷḷatāyk kāṇappaṭu kiṉṟaṉa.  vāyiṟpaṭiyum kūriyum uyarntatāy irukkiṉṟaṉa.  āṉāl itaṉ upayōkam namakkup pulappaṭavilli.  ittakiya illaṅkaḷ pala tamiḻ nāṭṭil iṉṟum uḷḷaṉa.
pērillam
akkālattu vēḷāṇmiyāl uyarnta vāḻvip peṟṟa peruṅkuṭimakkaḷ kūṭṭukkuṭumpa vāḻkkiyip peritum nāṭi vāḻntaṉar.  tāy tantiyuṭaṉ āṇmakkaḷ taṅkaḷ tuṇiviyarōṭum, peṇmakkaḷ taṅkaḷ kaṇavarōṭum oru illattil oṟṟumiyuṭa ṉum aṉpuṭaṉum vāḻntu vantuḷḷaṉar.  itaṉi avarkaḷuṭiya periya illamum avaṟṟiluḷḷa pala aṟikaḷum naṉku eṭuttukkāṭṭukiṉṟaṉa.  periya vīṭukaḷil cakōtararkaḷ vāḻvataṟku vīṭṭiṉiṭiyē neṭuñcuvarkaḷ vittu vīṭu pirikkappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
akkālattil kūlap poruḷkaḷi cēkarittuvikkum kutirkaḷ pōṉṟavikaḷ tariyil patippittu vikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  cila illaṅkaḷil māṭaṅkaḷum cuvar aṟikaḷum amintu uḷḷaṉa.  cila vīṭukaḷil camiyaṟ pāṇṭaṅkaḷi vittaṟkuriya marap peṭṭakaṅkaḷ cuvarkaḷil patippikkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
māḷikikaḷ
celvarkaḷ vāḻum māṭaṅkaḷ uḷḷa māḷikikaḷ pala uḷḷaṉa.  avi iraṇṭiṟku mēṟpaṭṭa aṭukkukaḷiyuṭiya māḷikikaḷ ākum.  ivi akaṉṟa kūṭaṅkaḷ, nīṇṭa tāḻ
vāraṅkaḷ periya muṟṟaṅkaḷ iṭi kaḻikaḷ ciṟiya vāyilkaḷ ciṟitum peritumāṉa pala aṟikaḷiyum uṭiyaṉa.  ivaṟṟil uḷḷa mēṉili māṭaṅkaḷ ceṅkal taḷavaricikaḷi uṭiyaṉa.  cila mēṉmāṭaṅkaḷ paṭukki aṟikaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  cila māṭaṅkaḷil payilum iṭam,nīrāṭum aṟikaḷ, malaṅkaḻikkum ciṟṟaṟikaḷ pōṉṟavikaḷum uḷḷaṉa.  māṭaṅkaḷukkuc cella ceṅkaṟ
kaḷāl kaṭṭappaṭṭa paṭikkaṭṭukaḷum, marattiṉāl ceyyappaṭṭa paṭikkaṭṭukaḷum uḷḷaṉa.  cila māṭaṅkaḷukku ēṇikaḷ mūlam celvatum uṇṭeṉṟu terikiṉṟatu.  paṭikkaṭṭukaḷ perumpālāṉa māḷikikaḷil veḷippuṟamē amintuḷḷatu.  cila vīṭukaḷil paṭikkaṭṭukaḷ uṭpuṟam uḷḷaṉa.  oru māḷikiyil iraṇṭu paṭikkaṭṭukaḷ oṉṟiṟ koṉṟu aṇmiyilē irukkumpaṭi kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  itu periya talivaṉuṭiya illam pōl kāṇappaṭukiṟatu.  oru māḷikiyiṉ muṉpuṟam cumār 100 aṭi muṉpuṟam akaṉṟa muṟṟam uḷḷatu.  piṉpuṟam 100 aṭi akaṉṟa tōṭṭam uḷḷatu. 
māperum māḷiki
iṅkuḷḷa māḷikikaḷ aṉittiṉum periya māḷiki oṉṟu mikavum uyaramākavum akaṉṟu nīṇṭatāyum aḻaku niṟintatāyum uḷḷatu.  inta māḷiki 242 aṭi nīḷamum 112 aṭi akalamum uḷḷatu.  itaṉ aṇmiyil iti viṭac caṟṟuk kuṟinta aḷavil 177-aṭi nīḷamum 117aṭi akalamum uṭiya māḷiki oṉṟum kāṇappaṭukiṟatu.  itaṟku aṭuttāṟ pōṟ maṟṟoru ciṟiya māḷiki oṉṟu uḷḷatu.  ataṉ vaṭapuṟam 87aṭi nīḷamum teṉpuṟam 83 aṭi nīḷamum uḷḷa cuvarkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  mēṟkup puṟac cuvar 38 aṭi nīḷamum kiḻakkup puṟaccuvar 48 aṭi nīḷamum uḷḷatu.  iṅku pala aṟikaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  vīṭṭiṉ piṉpuṟam vaṭṭavaṭivāṉa kiṇaṟum uḷḷatu.  iṅku 4 aṭi akalamuḷḷa caturamāṉa tūṇkaḷ pala kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  it tūṇkaḷ inta māḷikiyiṉ vaḷivukaḷit tāṅkupavi.
inta māḷikikaḷiṉ aṇmiyil 56-aṭi nīḷamāṉa ciṟu viṭuti uḷḷatu.  itil nīṇṭa tūṇkaḷik koṇṭa maṇṭapam, pala kūṭaṅkaḷum uḷḷa vaḻikaḷuṭaṉ kūṭiya pala aṟikaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  inta aṟikaḷ paṇṭaṅkaḷi vippataṟkum camiyal ceyvataṟkum, tuyilvataṟkum uṇavu uṇpataṟkum ēṟpaṭṭaṉa.  itu aracaṉatu araṇmaṉiyāka irukkalām eṉṟu eṇṇappaṭukiṟatu. aṭutta māḷikikaḷ amiccar iḷavaracar pōṉṟavarkaḷiṉ māḷikikaḷum ēvalāḷarkaḷiṉ illaṅkaḷumāka irukka vēṇṭum eṉṟu eṇṇap
paṭukiṟatu.
iṅkuḷḷa illaṅkaḷil makaḷirkaḷ vacippataṟkut taṉiyiṭamum, māḷiki vāyiṟpuṟatti aṭuttu kāvalarkku oru ciṟṟam iruntatu.  vīṭṭiṉ piṉpuṟam vīṭṭukkārarkaḷ amarntu pēcuvataṟkēṟṟa kūṭaṅkaḷum uṇṭu.  ovvoru vīṭṭilum camiyal aṟikaḷum, paṭukki aṟikaḷum tavaṟātu uḷḷaṉa.  taṉiyē kuḷikkum aṟikaḷum uḷḷaṉa.  kuḷippaṟikaḷ teruppakkam uḷḷaṉa.  ceṅkaṟkaḷāl taḷavarici iṭappaṭṭu aṟikaḷ cuttamāka uḷḷaṉa.  kaḻivu nīr ōṭa vaṭikālkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  vaṭikāl teruvil uḷḷa mūṭu cākkaṭiyuṭaṉ poruntiyuḷḷatu.  nīrāṭumaṟiyiṉ tarimaṭṭam caṟṟu carintu veḷiyē nīr celvataṟku ēṟṟavāṟu amintuḷḷatu.
camiyal aṟi
ovvoru vīṭṭilum taṉiyē camiyal aṟi iruntatu.  aṅku viṟaku vikkavum piṟa, camiyaṟ paṇṭaṅkaḷi vikkavum taṉi iṭam iruntatu eṉṟālum camiyal muṟṟattiṉ aṇmiyil ceyvatum uṇṭu.  camiyal aṟiyil periyatāḻikaḷ patippikkap paṭṭiruntaṉa.  camiyal aṟiyil tāḻikaḷ patippikkappaṭṭa aṭiyāḷaṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  ivi nīric cēmittu vippataṟkāka iruntirukkalām eṉṟu eṇṇappaṭukiṟatu. camiyalukkuriya cāmāṉkaḷ vikkap palamaṇ cāṭikaḷ payaṉpaṭuttappaṭṭaṉa.  inta vaḻakkam iṉṟum mokañcatārōvic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa kirāmattā riṭam nilavukiṉṟatu.  ovvoru vīṭṭilum camiyal aṟiyil aṭuppukaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  cila vīṭukaḷil aṭuppukaḷ kāṇappaṭāviṭi ṉum aṭuppukaḷ iruntataṟkuriya aṭiyāḷaṅkaḷ terikiṉṟaṉa.  inta aṭuppukaḷ mecapottāmiyāvil uḷḷa aṭuppukaḷip pōṉṟavikaḷāka irukkiṉṟaṉa.
kōyil
mokañcatārō cintu veḷi akaḻ āyvil arappāviṟku aṭutta toṉmiyāṉa nakaram.  āṉāl arappāvi viṭa nalla niliyil aḻivuṟāta niliyil irukkiṟatu eṉṟu akaḻ āyvil īṭupaṭṭa ār.ṭi. pāṉarcci avarkaḷ eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷār. mokañcatārōvil maṭṭumalla cintu veḷiyilē eṇṇaṟṟa civa liṅkaṅkaḷum, tāyt teyva uruvaṅkaḷum, civaperumāṉ tiru uruvam tīṭṭap peṟṟa muttirikaḷum, nanti(kāḷi) uruvam tīṭṭappaṭṭa muttirikaḷum, tāyattukaḷum kiṭittuḷḷaṉa.  oru naṭarācar uruvam kūṭa kiṭittuḷḷaṉa.   iḵtaṉṟi pala nīrt teyvam, nilat teyvam, marat teyvam, mīṉ teyvam pōṉṟa eṇṇaṟṟa teyva uruvaṅkaḷ kiṭittaṉa. civaliṅkaṅkaḷum, civaṉār uruvam, avaratu kāḷi vākaṉamākiya nanti uruvamum cintu veḷip paṇpāṭu tirāviṭa moḻipayiṉṟa, civa neṟiyit  taḻuviya vēḷāḷar paṇpāṭu eṉpati uṟutippaṭutta oppaṟṟa mutal tarac cāṉṟāka iruntaṉa.  cintu veḷi nākarikam āriya nākarikam eṉṟu varalāṟṟip poyp paṭutta muṉvanta cila cātiveṟiyum, camaya veṟiyum koṇṭa aṟiñarkaḷ muyaṟci muṟiyaṭikkappaṭṭaṉa.  avarkaḷ iṟutiyāka cintu veḷi muttiri
kaḷil poṟikkappaṭṭa ōviya eḻuttukkaḷi vaṭa moḻic cārpāṉatu eṉṟu nili nāṭṭa muyaṉṟaṉar.  anta iṟuti muyaṟciyum ulāntāviṉ talinakarāṉa kōpaṉ hēkaṉ, kāṇṭi nēviyaṉ, āciyar ārāycci niliyam, mākō, leṉiṉ kirāṭ palkalik kaḻakaṅkaḷiṉ palvēṟu tuṟikaḷilumuḷḷa aṟiñarkaḷiṉ kuḻuvum cērntu cintu veḷi muttirikaḷilum, tāyattukaḷilum kāṇappaṭum ōviya eḻuttu kaḷukku maṟikuṟi eḻuttup poruḷ viḷakkam (Deceipherment)  ceyya muyaṉṟu, tamiḻ aṟiñar, tirāviṭa moḻikaḷiṉ ārāycci vallunar tuṇi koṇṭum mika nuṇṇiya kaṇita miṉ aṇuk karuviyiṉ (Computer)  tuṇi koṇṭum uṟutiyāka cintu veḷi ōviya eḻuttukkaḷ tirāviṭa moḻi eḻuttukkaḷē eṉṟu ulakiṟku uṇarttiyuḷḷaṉar.
cintu veḷiyiṉ akaḻ āyvil kōyilkaḷē kāṇappaṭa villi eṉṟu cilar karutukiṉṟaṉar.  atu tavaṟu cintu veḷiyil kōyilkaḷ uḷḷaṉa eṉṟu ṭākṭar mekkē avarkaḷ tiṭṭa
vaṭṭamāka eṭuttukkāṭṭiyuḷḷār.  ataṉi car cāṇmārcal, car mārṭṭimar uyilar pōṉṟavarkaḷ ātarittuḷḷaṉar.  cintu veḷiyil ki.mu. 3000 -m āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ eḻunta paṇpāṭu, oru perum nākarikattip paṭitta makkaḷuṭiyatu eṉpatu pulaṉāyiṟṟu.  ataṉi tāmira nākarikak kālam eṉṟu varalāṟṟu āciriyarkaḷ kūṟukiṟārkaḷ.  iṅku āḻamāka akaḻntu pārtta poḻutu  cevviyāka amikkappeṟṟa kōyilkaḷum vīṭukaḷum kāṇappeṟṟaṉa. kōyilkaḷil    ciṟu aṟikaḷ kaṉamāṉa cuvarkaḷi uṭiyaṉavāy iruntaṉa.  ataṉāl aṟikaḷukku mēl vimāṉam pōṉṟa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ iruntirukka vēṇṭum eṉṟu terikiṟatu.  anta aṟikaḷic cuṟṟi vicālamāṉa muṟṟamum ammuṟṟattiṉ nāṉku puṟaṅkaḷilum ciṟu māṭaṅkaḷum kāṇap
paṭṭaṉa.  naṭuvil uḷḷa aṟi tiru uṇṇāḻikiyāka (mūlatāṉamāka) irukkalām.  maliyāḷattuk kōyil amippu ataṉi yottatu pōlum.  caṅkut taṭṭukaḷ, nīla vaḷiyalkaḷ, tōṇṭi yeṭukkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  cila muttirikaḷil aracamaram, māṉ kompu, puli, yāṉi, kāṇṭāmirukam mutaliyavaṟṟiṉ vaṭivaṅkaḷ kāṇappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  kutirivaṭivam kāṇappaṭa villi eṉṟu tiru.kā.cuppiramaṇiya piḷḷi avarkaḷ mika viḷakkamākat tam nūlil eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷār.   iṅku kōyilkaḷ iruntaṉa.  kōyilkaḷiṉ tiru uṇṇāḻikiyiṉ tamiḻakattip pōla iliṅkaṅkaḷ iruntaṉa eṉpati mutalil kaṇṭavar car.cāṇmārcal avarkaḷēyākum.  avartam nūlil itip paṟṟi virivāka eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷār.
aṅku kaṇṭa inta vicālamāṉatum, nuṭpamāṉa periya kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ cila taṉippaṭṭa celvarkaḷiṉ conta māḷikiyāka yirukkalām.  allatu avikaḷiṟ cila tirukkōyilkaḷāka irukkalām eṉṟu teḷivāka āyntu muṭivu ceyya muṭiya villi.  mecapottāmiyāvil teyvam uṟiyum tiruk kōyilkaḷ vaḻipāṭṭu nērvuk kuṟikkōḷ uḷḷatāyum, viḷakkamāṉa kuṟikkōḷik koṇṭatāyumuḷḷa maṉṉarkaḷiṉ māḷikiyākavum irukkum-atāvatu uṇavi uṇṭu nīri aruntum kaṭavuḷiṉ kuṭiyiruppu iṭaṅkaḷākavum, maraṇam aṭiyak kūṭiya ētāvatu ōr iḷavaracaṉ kaḷikoḷḷac cey
vikkappaṭṭatākavum irukkum.  taṉṉuṭiya camayac caṭaṅkaḷ ceyyum peṇ pūcāriyiṉ tirumaṇa vipavaṅkaḷukkākavum irukkalām.  atē nōkkattōṭu mokañcatārōvil amikkap paṭṭa pērillamākavum irukkalām eṉṟu eṇṇalām.  ivi
kaḷil cila vitivilakkāka periya vicālamāṉa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ cila kaṭavuḷkaḷukkāka kaṭṭappaṭṭa illaṅkaḷāka irukkalām.  mutalāvatu, iraṇṭāvatu aintāvatu āṟāvatu eṇṇuḷḷa mēlē kaṇṭa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ ciṟappāka vaḻipāṭṭiṟkuriya tirukkōyilukku eṉṟu otukkivikkappaṭṭa iṭamāka irukkum eṉṟu karutalām.  iṉṉum pala iṭaṅkaḷil kiṭittuḷḷa taṉicciṟappumikka āvuṭiyār vaṭivaṅkaḷ (ringstones)  pōṉṟa poruḷ camayak kōṭpāṭṭu muṟiyil vaḻipaṭupavikaḷāka irukkalām eṉṟu nampuvataṟkup pōtiya kāraṇaṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  ivikaḷi yellām āyntu pārkkum poḻutu cintu veḷimakkaḷ kirīṭtīviluḷḷa miṉōvarkaḷ pōṉṟu potuvāṉa vaḻipaṭu iṭaṅkaḷ amikkāmal iruntirukkalām eṉṟum karuta iṭamuṇṭu.  appaṭiyē avarkaḷ kōyil amittiruntālum iṉṟiya intiyak kōyil pōlaṉṟi cātāraṇamāka makkaḷ vāḻum illaṅkaḷ pōṉṟu kōyilkaḷ amittirukkalām eṉṟu karuta muṭiyum.1
ēṉiya kōyil amippukaḷ
mokañcatārōvil uḷḷa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ palavaṟṟil pala vaṟṟiṉ upayōkam nammāl tiṭṭa vaṭṭamāka nirṇayikkap paṭavilli.  avikaḷil cila tirukkōyilkaḷāka irukkalām; allatu vēṟākavum irukkalām. cila pakutikaḷil uḷḷa ciṟiya kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ cila iraṇṭu aṟi vīṭukaḷil oṉṟu peritākavum maṟṟoṉṟu pakkattē pirakāram pōl ciṟitākavum uḷḷaṉa.  atē iṭattil 5-āvatu piḷāk oru periya amippu periya miya ariyi uḷ kūṟākak koṇṭirukkiṟatu.  iraṇṭu aṟi
kaḷukkum iṭiyēyuḷḷa naṭik kūṭam ataṉ mēṟkup puṟattilum teṟkup puṟattilum oru cuvarum iraṇṭu ciṟu aṟikaḷum ataṉ teṟkup pakutiyil cila periya aṟikaḷum uḷḷaṉa.  ataṉ vaṭakku puṟattil kaṭṭiṭattiṉ mūlappakuti teḷivaṟṟatāy aṭippakuti piṉṉar eḻuntatākak kāṇappaṭukiṟatu.  iṭatu pakuti aḻivuṟṟuḷḷatu; aṭippaṭi maṭṭum uḷḷatu.  itu vaḻakkattiṟku māṟākat tiṇmiyāka 10-aṭi āḻattil karaṭumuraṭāṉa ceṅkallāl aṭippaṭiyiṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu itu aḻakāka mēlkaṭṭumāṉam uḷḷatāy mikunta akkaṟiyōṭu  miyappakutiyil mēlē oru cikara amippi uṇṭupaṇṇi irukkiṟatu.
atē pōṉṟu maṟṟoru  kaṭṭiṭam nīṇṭa caturam uḷḷatāka irukkiṟatu.  teṉpuṟam oru ciṟiya oṭukkamāṉa aṟiyum mēṟkuppuṟam iraṇṭu vēṟu ciṟu aṟikaḷum uḷḷaṉa.  ivi eṇ 1-il piḷāk 4, cekcaṉ vi.e parappil uḷḷatu.  itil uḷḷa mūṉṟāvatu aṟi oṉṟil kaṇicamāṉa aḷavu maṉita elumpukaḷum, cāmpalum, maṭpāṇṭaṅkaḷum pāttiraṅkaḷum ēṉiya poruḷkaḷum iruntatu kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu.  intak kaṭṭiṭam oru taṉip
paṭṭa maṉitaṉuṭiya kuṭi iruppu iṭamāka eṇṇuvataṟkilli.  itu oru potu iṭamākavō, puṉita illamākavō, vaḻipaṭum iṭamākavō karutattakkatākum.  iṟutiyāy oru kuṉṟup pakutiyiṉ oru ciṟiya aḻipāṭu kāṇappaṭṭatu.  atu ṭikē parappil 2-vatu piḷākkil ē.cekcaṉil kāṇappaṭum inta aḻipāṭukaḷ tiru tīkcitar avarkaḷāl akaḻ āyvu ceytu ōr uṟutiyāṉa oru puṉita kōyilāka irukkiṟatu eṉṟu muṭiviṟku vantār.
iṅku kōyilkaḷ pōl pala kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ akaḻ āyvil kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭaṉa.  āṉāl avikaḷil teyva uruvaṅkaḷō pūcikkuriya  poruḷkaḷō kiṭikkavilli.  āṉāl uṟutiyāka cintu veḷi makkaḷ civaṉ, cakti mutaliya teyva vaḻipāṭṭuk kārarkaḷ.  uruvaṅkaḷi vittu vaḻipaṭṭuvantaṉar eṉpataṟkum aiyam illi.  iṉṟiya teṉ intiyat tirāviṭarkaḷip pōl tirukkōyil kaṭṭi cilikaḷ amittu vaḻipaṭavilli.  Ändht®(Minoar)  pōṉṟu makkaḷ vāḻum illattilum araṇmaṉiyilum teyva uruvaṅkaḷi vittu vaḻipaṭ ṭirukkalām eṉṟē cilar karutukiṟārkaḷ.  kālkaḷik kuṟukkāka vittuk koṇṭirukkum (āṭavallāṉ) teyva vaṭivam, pāmpu, tēvi, liṅkam mutaliyaṉa kōyilkaḷil kāṇappaṭṭaṉa.  civaliṅkaṅkaḷ ērāḷamākak kaṇṭeṭukkappaṭṭaṉa. kālattāṟ piṟpaṭṭa iṭaṅkaḷil pirētaṅkaḷip putippatu māttira mallāmal avaṟṟic cuṭṭeritta cāmpaliyum elumpiyum periya maṇpāṇṭattil vittu putippatum avaṟṟiṉ mēl ceṅkalliṉāl camāti pōṉṟa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ amippatum pulaṉāyiṉa.  putiyal, nilaṅkaḷil kāṇappaṭṭa muttiriyil uḷḷa eḻuttukkaḷ mutalil paṭa eḻuttāyiruntu piṉ olikaḷik kuṟippaṉalāyiṉa avaṟṟi āynta hīrā aṭikaḷ avi tamiḻ eḻuttukkaḷiṉ mūlavaṭivukaḷāy iruttal kūṭum eṉṟār. cintu nākarikam ekiptiya nākarikattiṉiṉṟum, cumēriyā nākarikatti ṉiṉṟum vantatu eṉṟu cilar kūṟiṉar.  āṉāl karṉal ālkāṭ ekiptiya nākarikamē pāṇṭiya nāṭṭiṉiṉṟu (paṇṭu nāṭṭi ṉiṉṟu) vantatu eṉṟum intiya nākarikattōṭu oppuvami kāṭṭi yuḷḷār.1
ciṟappu vāynta ceykuḷam
cintu veḷiyiṉ kaṭṭiṭak kaliyip paṟṟi nūl eḻutum evarum mokañcatārōvil uḷḷa ciṟappumikka ceykuḷam (Great Bath)  paṟṟi eḻutāmal viṭṭuviṭuvārāyiṉ atu oru niṟivāṉa nulāka eṇṇappaṭattakka taṉṟu.  annūl  aṟiñarkaḷāl ciṟappāṉatu eṉṟu aṟiñarkaḷ matikka māṭṭārkaḷ.  kuḷattil nīr niṟkum iṭam 39 aṭi nīḷamum 23 aṭi akalamum 8 aṭi āḻamum uḷḷatu.  itaṉ veḷippuṟaccuvar 7 allatu 8 aṭi akalamuḷḷatu.  iṉṟiyap perum nakaril uḷḷa nīccal kuḷaṅkaḷip pōl vacatiyum, cokucum eḻilum ēṟṟamum uṭiyatu.  kuḷattil aṇmiyil kaṭṭappaṭṭu uḷḷa kaṭṭiṭaṅ kaḷiyellām cērttuk kaṇakkiṭṭāl 180-aṭi nīḷamum 108-aṭiyum uḷḷa oru pōtiya nilap parappil ikkuḷam kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.1  ikkuḷattiṉ nīr niṟkum pakutiyic cuṟṟi nāṟpuṟamum naṭipātikaḷ uḷḷaṉa. naṭipāti uṭpuṟam uyarntu veḷippuṟam cāyntu maṭṭam vittuk kaṭṭap paṭṭuḷḷatu.  maḻi peytāl naṭiyil viḻum nīr oru coṭṭum uḷḷēyuḷḷa kuḷattu nīril kalakkātu veḷiyē ceṉṟu viṭum kuḷattiṟku aṭutta naṭi pātiyiṉ viḷimpil nāṟpuṟamum kipiṭiccuvarkaḷ eḻuppap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  naṭipātiyiṉ ovvoru muṉiyilum uyaramāṉa mēṭi oṉṟu uḷḷatu.  ammēṭikkuc cella pala paṭikkaṭṭukaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  ippātiyi aṭuttup periya cuvar uḷḷatu.  ataṉ mītum naṭipāti uṇṭu.
ipperuṅkuḷattiṉ aṭippakuti-nīr niṟkum iṭam nalla vaḻavaḻappāṉa ceṅkaṟkaḷāl maṇṇum cuṇṇamum kalanta cāntum koṇṭu kaṭṭappaṭṭatu.  ataṉ mītu oru vitat tār (kīl) pūcappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  kuḷattiṉ aṭippākam vari celvataṟku vaṭapuṟamum teṉpuṟamum variciyākap paṭikkaṭṭukaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  
6 ½ aṭi uyarattil kaḻivu nīri veḷiyē akaṟṟi viṭṭu putiya nīri uḷḷē koṇṭuvara nalla matakum uṇṭu.  
ikkuḷattil mūṉṟu puṟaṅkaḷilum tāḻvāraṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  tāḻvāraṅkaḷil curaṅkap pātiyum muṭiyil eṭṭu māṭiyuḷḷa aṟikaḷum uḷḷaṉa.  aṟikaḷ ikkuḷattil kuḷikkum camaya kurukkaḷ evarum aṟiyāvaṇṇam vantu kuḷittu viṭṭu aṟikaḷukkuc ceṉṟu uṭimāṟṟam ceyvataṟkāka amikkap paṭṭirukkalām eṉṟu karutappaṭukiṟatu.  civaṉ kōyilil pūci ceyyum camaya kurumārkaḷ āṟukālap pūcikkum āṟumuṟi kuḷikka vēṇṭum eṉṟu tamiḻ nāṭṭup pūcārikaḷiṉ vaḻiyil  ivarkaḷum āṟukāl kuḷippi (nāṉatti) viṭātu piṉpaṟṟi irukkalām eṉṟu karutappaṭukiṟatu.
intak kuḷattiṟku nīri nirappuvataṟkuk kuḷattiṉ ciṟitu tolivil mūṉṟu periya kiṇaṟukaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  avikaḷiṉiṉṟē nīri iṟittu ciṟu kālvāy mūlam nīri vārttu nirappukiṟārkaḷ.
ikkuḷattiṉ aṭippakutiyil uḷḷa taḷattil pūcappaṭṭiruk kum nilakkīl intiyāvil kiṭippatilli.  itu ayal nāṭṭiliruntē koṇṭuvarappaṭṭirukka vēṇṭum.  inta nilakkīl cumēriyāvil uṇṭu.  cumēriyar tam kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷi   inta nilakkīl mūlamē aḻakum uṟutiyum ceytu vantaṉar.  eṉavē cintu veḷi vaṇikarkaḷ intak kīli cumēriyariṭamiruntu peṟṟiruttal vēṇṭum.
cintu veḷi nākarikamum tamiḻakamum
1922-il cintu veḷi akaḻ āyvu ceyyappaṭṭu, akaḻ āyvuttuṟiyiṉ talivarum intiya miya araciṉ tolporuḷ āyvut tuṟiyiṉ iyakkunar talivar car cāṇ mārcal cintu veḷip paṇpāṭṭiṉ mūlakarttarkaḷ tirāviṭarkaḷ eṉṟu uṟutiyāka 1931-il ulakiṟku uṇarttiyuḷḷār.  avarukkup piṉṉar intiya miya araciṉ tol poruḷ āyvu iyakkunar kaḷiṉ taḷapatiyāka vanta car mārṭṭimar uyilarum mokañcatārō akaḻ āyvi poruppuṭaṉ naṭattiya pērāciriyar ār.ṭi. pāṉarcciyum, pērāciriyar ṭākṭar kōrṭaṉ cilṭu ṭākṭar ji.ār.haṇṭar, ṭākṭar eyc.ār. hāl - pērāciriyar lāṅṭaṉ, e-ē-vāṭal aṟiñar eyc.hirā aṭikaḷ, ṭākṭar akōpārpōlā, ṭākṭar koṉaracōv pōṉṟa eṇṇaṟṟa aṟiñarkaḷ cintu veḷippaṇpāṭu tirāviṭap paṇpāṭu eṉṟu eṇṇaṟṟa nūṟkaḷ mūlam uṟutippaṭuttiyuḷḷār.
eṉṟālum āriyap paṇṭitarkaḷ cilarum āccārikaḷum pirākikaḷum, paṇṭāraṅkaḷum lampāṭikaḷum cintu veḷip paṇpāṭu āriyappaṇpāṭu eṉṟu ataṟṟippitaṟṟit tirivati iṉṉum niṟuttavilli. cintuveḷip paṇpāṭu āriyappaṇpāṭu eṉṟāl cintu veḷiyiṉ vīḻccikkup piṉ āriyarkaḷ cintu veḷi nakaraṅkaḷip pōṉṟa nakaraṅkaḷi kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷi niṟuviṉar eṉṟu oru ciṟu cāṉṟu kāṭṭa muṭiyumā?  muṭiyātu.  āṉāl cintu veḷip paṇpāṭṭi viṭa cīriya paṇpāṭu ilaṅkiyil iruntatāka vāṉmīki kūṟiyuḷḷār.  cintu veḷip paṇpāṭṭi viṭa cīriya paṇpāṭṭi ciṟanta nakari, vāṉ aḷāviya māṭa māḷikikaḷi, tirukkōyilkaḷi eṭuppittaṉar eṉṟutamiḻ ilakkiyaṅkaḷ cāṉṟu pakarkiṉṟaṉa iṉṟu kūṭa tamiḻnāṭṭut tirukkōyilkaḷi vaṭa nāṭṭil kāṇa muṭiyavilli eṉpatu maṟukka muṭiyāta uṇmi.

tamiḻ nāṭṭuk kaṭṭiṭakkali - 
ilakkiyac cāṉṟukaḷ
tamiḻ nāṭṭil cumār pattāyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṉpē makkaḷ naṉku vāḻa muṟpaṭṭuviṭṭaṉar.  nāṭum nakarum pēr ūrum ciṟṟūrum eḻat toṭaṅkiviṭṭaṉa.  aracum muracum, paṭiyum kuṭiyum, araṇum, tiṟaṉum, akamum, pukaḻum, kōyilum, kōṭṭamum, māḷikikaḷum, maṉikaḷum, māṭaṅkaḷum kūṭaṅkaḷum, maṇṭapaṅkaḷum eḻuntu viṭṭaṉa.
aṉṟu, iṉṟu pōl kaṟṟaḷikaḷō, ceṅkaṟkaḷum, cuṇṇaccāntum vittuk kaṭṭappaṭṭa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷō kaṭṭap peṟātatāl avi nīṇṭa nāḷ aḻiyātu nilittu niṟka muṭiyavilli.  mēlum aṭuttaṭuttut tamiḻakattil eḻunta pala kaṭaṟ kōḷkaḷ, aṉittiyum koḷḷi koṇṭu pōy viṭṭaṉa. perumpālāṉa ēṭukaḷ kūṭa aḻintu pōy viṭṭaṉa.  eṉṟālum eñciya oru cila ēṭukaḷ iṉṟum pīṭutarum cāṉṟukaḷāka uḷḷaṉa.  atōṭu iṉṟu eḻuntuḷḷa aṟiviyal āyvu muṟikaḷum ariya tuṟikaḷum ki.mu 1000 -m āṇṭukaḷukku muṉṉiruntu 10,000 -m āṇṭukaḷ vari teṉṉintiyāvippaṟṟiyum aṅku vāḻnta makkaḷiṉ moḻi, vāḻkki, kali, paṇpāṭu, nākarikam, vīṭu, māḷiki, kōyil mutaliyavaṟṟi aṟiyattuṇi ceykiṉṟaṉa.
ki.mu. 3000 -m āṇṭiṟku muṉ cintu veḷiyil eḻunta tirāviṭa nākarikattiṉ ciṟappi M§»nya®-r®.jah‹ mārcal avarkaḷ talimiyil niṟuvap peṟṟa intiyat tol poruḷ āyvut tuṟi, cintu veḷiyil 5000 -m āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ putiyuṇṭa paṇpāṭum, nakaraṅkaḷum tirāviṭa makkaḷukku uriyatu eṉṟu ulakiṟku urittār.
paṇṭikkāla makkaḷiṉ varalāṟṟiyum moḻikaḷiyum, ōviya eḻuttukkaḷiyum aṟiviyal muṟiyil āyvataṟkup payiṉṟa paṇpāḷarum kattōlikka camayakuruvum peyiṉ tēca nāṭṭiṟ piṟantavarum mētaku pulavarum pampāy cavēriyār kallūri varalāṟṟāciriyarum putiya aṟiviyal pāṅkil paṇṭik kāla makkaḷ eḻutiya ōviya eḻuttuk kalikaḷukku maṟikuṟiyeḻuttu mūlattiṉ poruḷ viḷakkam (Decpher) kāṇum tuṟiyiṉip paḻutaṟap payiṉṟa pāvāṇarumāṉa heṇṭiri hirā aṭikaḷ cintu veḷi muttirikaḷilum, tāyattukaḷilum kāṇappeṟṟa eḻuttukkaḷip paṭittu atu tirāviṭarkaḷiṉ muṉṉōrkaḷāl eḻutappaṭṭa eḻuttu eṉṟum cintu veḷi nākarikam tamiḻarkaḷiṉ muṉṉōrkaḷ uruvākkiya nākarikam eṉpati ulakiṟku meyppittār.  ulāntā nāṭṭiṉ talinakarāṉa kōpaṉ hēkaṉiluḷḷa āciya ārāycciyiṉ kāṇṭi nēviyaṉ niliyam eṉṉum aṟiviyal kaḻakattiṉ kuḻuoṉṟu ṭākṭar akōpārpōlā avarkaḷ talimiyil āyntu aṟiñar hirā aṭikaḷ vaḻiyil āyntu vaṭamoḻi, tamiḻ moḻip pulavar ottuḻippōṭum kaṇita nuṇ poṟi (computer)Æ‹ tuṇiyōṭum mīṇṭum mīṇṭum naṉku āyntu cintu veḷi eḻuttu tirāviṭap paṇpāṭṭiṉiṉṟu eḻunta eḻuttē eṉpati āmōtittaṉar.  iṟutiyāka cōviyat raciyāvil uḷḷa leṉiṉ kirāṭ palkalik kaḻakattilum mākō palkalik kaḻakattilumuḷḷa maṉita iṉapparappup paṟṟiya aṟiviyal viḷakka āyviyal aṟiñarkaḷ paṉ moḻippulavar tōḻar yū.koṉaracōv avarkaḷ talimiyil kālañceṉṟa ematu aṉpiṟkuriya tōḻar tamiḻaṟiñar cimaṉ ruṭiṉ tuṇi koṇṭum uyarnta kaṇita nuṇ poṟi iyantirat tuṇi koṇṭum āyntu cintu veḷi nākarikam tirāviṭa nākarikam eṉpati eḵkup pōṉṟa acikka muṭiyāta cāṉṟukaḷiṉ tuṇi koṇṭu araṇ ceytuḷḷaṉar.  atōṭu cintu veḷip paṇpāṭum tirāviṭa makkaḷum ayal nāṭṭiliruntu varappaṭṭaṉa eṉpati maṟuttu teṉ intiyāvil-ciṟappāka maṟintu pōṉa oḷi (kumari) nāṭṭiliruntu (lemūriyāviliruntu)  cumēriyā, ekiptu, kākasa, cintu veḷi mutaliya nāṭukaḷukkup paraviṉa eṉṟa uṇmi āyvu ceyyappaṭṭu varukiṟatu.  ataṉi uṟutippaṭutta intu mākkaṭaliṉ aṭittaḷam ellām aṟiviyal muṟiyil ārāyappaṭṭu varukiṉṟaṉa.
sōviyat uruciyap pēraṟiñarum tirāviṭa iṉa makkaḷiṉ, varalāṟṟuk kālattiṟku muntiya vāḻkkiyip paṟṟiyum teṉ intiyāviṉiṉṟu tirāviṭa makkaḷ ekiptu, ellam  upitiyā, cumēriyā, kākasa pakutikaḷil ellām kuṭiyēṟiyavarkaḷ eṉpatip paṟṟiyum aṟiya avarkaḷ moḻi iṉam paṇpāṭu mutaliyavikaḷip paṟṟiyellām naṉkāynta aṟiñar ē.konrāt tōv avarkaḷ,
toṉmi mikunta paṇpāṭṭik koṇṭa tamiḻ makkaḷ pēcum moḻi  orē tirāviṭa moḻikkuṭumpattic cērnta ēṉiya cakōtara moḻikaḷuṭaṉ toṭarpuṭiya moḻiyākum.  tirāviṭarkaḷ, intiyāviṉ toṉmimikka maṉita iṉap pirivic cērntavarkaḷ.  avarkaḷ irukku vētattil kūṟappeṟṟuḷḷa pōr veṟikoṇṭa āriyarkaḷ inta viyattakum ariya nāṭṭiṟku varuvataṟku veku kālattiṟku muṉpē iṅku vāḻntu varupavarkaḷ āvar.  ippoḻutu tirāviṭa moḻi teṉ intiyāvil paravi yuḷḷaṉa.  āṉāl oru kālattil miya intiyāvilum-ēṉ?  vaṭa intiyāvilum kūṭap paravi iruntatu.  mēlum āyirakkaṇakkāṉa āṇṭukaḷukku muṉṉar, paluccitāṉattilum, īrāṉiṉ teṉ pakutiyilum kūṭa tirāviṭa moḻikaḷip pēci varum makkaḷ vāḻntu vantaṉar.  mecapottāmiyāvil mutaṉ mutalāka niliyāṉa vāḻkkiyip peṟṟu taliyāka vāḻnta makkaḷ avarkaḷākavē irukkak kūṭum.  avarkaḷē namatu ulakil mikat toṉmiyāṉa nākarikattip peṟṟirunta cumēriyarkaḷiṉ (Sumerians)  muṉṉōrkaḷākavum irukkalām eṉpataṟkāṉa cāṉṟukaḷ pala uḷḷaṉa.1  eṉṟu cōviyat nāṭu eṉṟu cōviyat araciṉ intiyat tūtariṉ niliyattiṉiṉṟu veḷivarum tiṅkaḷukku irumuṟi varum veḷiyīṭṭil eḻutiyuḷḷār.  mēlum tirāviṭarkaḷ, upitiyā, ellam (kujitāṉ- teṟku īrāṉ), cumēriyā, mecapottāmiya nākarikatti tōṟṟuvittavarkaḷ tirāviṭarkaḷē eṉṟu teḷivāka veḷippaṭuttiyuḷḷār.  tirāviṭarkaḷ ellam nāṭṭiṉ tantiyarkaḷ eṉṟu eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷār.  ellam nāṭṭiṉ tali nakar ūr. iṅkutāṉ kiṟitunātar kuṭumpattiṉ āti pitā īcākkum, ilāmiya camaya tūtar mukammat napiyiṉ muṉṉōṉumāṉa imāyilum piṟantaṉar.
iṟṟikku 5000-m āṇṭukaṭku muṉ ellam ekiptu, mecapottāmiyā, kirīṭ, teṉ amerikkāvil uḷḷa peru, mekcikkō, īṭā tīvu acīriyā, cālṭiyā pōṉṟa palvēṟu nāṭukaḷil teṉ intiyāviliruntu ceṉṟa tirāviṭa makkaḷ tuḷirkkac ceyta cīriya paṇpāṭēyākum eṉṟu aṟiñar makkaḷiṉ, car tāma hōlṭic, pērāciriyar lāṅṭaṉ, ṭākṭar ci.ār.haṇṭar ṭākṭar eyc.ār. hāl pōṉṟa aṟiñarkaḷ karutukiṉṟaṉar.
teṉ intiyak kōyilkaḷiṉ amippum acīriyariṉ kaṭṭiṭa amippum orē vakiyāka uḷḷaṉa eṉṟu kalōṉiyal tāma hōlṭic kūṟiyuḷḷār.  heraṭṭōṭṭa eṉṉum varalāṟṟāciriyar tam nūlil ki.mu.4000 - āṇṭiṟku muṉ teṉ intiyarkaḷ ekiptil intu matatti nili nāṭṭiṉar eṉṟu eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷār.  pāpilōṉ nāṭṭilum, ati aṭutta akkēṭiyā, ciriyā mutaliya nāṭukaḷil eḻunta cikkurāt eṉṉum kōyilkaḷum teyvaṅkaḷum teṉ intiyāvil uḷḷa kōyil aṭippaṭiyiliruntu arumpiyavikaḷēyākum.1
ulakil ki.mu.3000 āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ ulakam muḻuvatum uḷḷa kaṭṭiṭak kalikku vittiṭṭa tirāviṭa nāṭṭil iṉṟu kiṟittava ūḻikku muṉpuḷḷa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ kāṇappaṭavilli eṉpatālē akaḻ āyvil ituvari kiṟittuva ūḻikku muṉ kaṭṭappaṭṭa kaṭṭiṭattiṉ aṭippaṭi etuvum kaṇṭupiṭikkap paṭātatāl tamiḻarkaḷukku kiṟittuva  ūḻikkumuṉ kaṭṭiṭak kali teriyātu eṉṟu kūṟuvatu piḻiyākum.  varalāṟṟup pukaḻpeṟṟa pāṇṭiyarkaḷiṉ tuṟimukap paṭṭiṉamum talinakarum, caṅkam maruviya mūtūrum yavaṉa nāṭukaḷuṭaṉum, kiḻakkāciya nāṭukaḷuṭa ṉum, miyak kaṭaṟkari nāṭukaḷōṭum  kaṭal vaṇikam vaḷartta koṟkiyil ki.mu785-ām āṇṭil ceyyappaṭṭa maṭpāṇṭaṅ kaḷi tamiḻaka araciṉ tol poruḷ āyvut tuṟiyiṉar  1970-ām āṇṭu akaḻntu kaṇṭaṉar.  āṉāl koṟki eṉum kō-nakar itu tāṉ eṉṟu kūṟa oru kaṭṭiṭam kūṭa akaḻntu kāṇappaṭavilli.   koṟkiyiṉ araṇum ataṉ poṟkatavu kaḷum vāṉmīki irāmāyaṇattil irāmaṉ aṉumāṉiṭam kuṟippiṭṭup pēciyatākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  atē pōl vāṉmīki irāmāyaṇam ki.mu.1000 -m āṇṭiṟku muṉ irāvaṇaṉ vāṉ aḷāviya araṇmaṉiyil pavaḷattūṇkaḷum, poṟkaṭṭilum iruntatākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  āṉāl ilaṅkiyil kiṟittuva ūḻikku muṉ uḷḷa oru ciṟu vīṭṭiyum, kōṭṭiyum akaḻntu kāṇamuṭiyavilli.  ātitta nallūr akaḻ āyvil pāṉi caṭṭikaḷum eḵku  āytaṅkaḷum maṇṭi ōṭukaḷum kiṭittaṉa.  kaṭṭiṭam oṉṟiyum akaḻ āyvut tuṟiyiṉar kaṇṭupiṭittaṉar.
tamiḻakattil iraṇṭāyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ periya nakarkaḷum paṭṭiṉaṅkaḷum araṇmaṉikaḷum 8 māṭaṅkaḷum māḷikikaḷum iruntaṉa eṉpataṟku eṇṇaṟṟa ilakkiyac cāṉṟukaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  avi aṭiyil varumāṟākum.
maturiyum māṭaṅkaḷum
iraṇṭāyiram āṇṭukaṭku muṉ tamiḻarkaḷ kaṭṭiya nakaram maturi.  ammaturi ulakilē ōr oppaṟṟa nakar amippāka iṉṟum matikkappaṭukiṟatu.  nakar naṭuvē, tirukkōyilum kōyiliṉ nāṟpuṟamum māṭavītiyum ati aṭuttu caturam caturamāka amikkappaṭṭa maturi mānakar, tāmari malariṉ naṭuvē pokuṭṭum ati aṭuttu varici variciyāka pū itaḻkaḷum iruppatu pōṉṟu kāṇappaṭukiṟatu eṉṟu tamiḻp pulavarkaḷ viyantu pāṭiyuḷḷaṉar.  appāṭal aṭiyil varumāṟākum:
māyōṉ koppūḻ malarnta tāmarip
pūvoṭu puriyuñ cīrūr pūviṉ
itaḻakat taṉiya teruvam itaḻakattu
arum per kuṭṭaṉittē aṇṇal kōyil
tātiṉ aṉiyar taṇṭamiḻk kuṭikaḷ
tātuṇ paṟavi aṉiyar paricil vāḻnar
pūviṉuṭ piṟantōṉ nāviṉuṭ piṟanta
nāṉ maṟik kēḷvi navil kural eṭuppa
ēma viṉṟuyil eḻutal allati
vāḻiya vañciyum kōḻiyum pōlak
kōḻiyiṉ eḻātem pērūr tuyilē		- paripāṭal
itaṉ poruḷ, maturi mānakariṉ tōṟṟam oru tāmari malarip pōṉṟiruntatu.  tāmari malariṉ aka itaḻkaḷip pōṉṟu terukkaḷ aṭukkaṭukkāy aḻakuṟa amintiruntaṉa.  avvitaḻkaḷiṉ naṭuvē  uḷḷa pokuṭṭip pōṉṟu maturi naṭuvil aṇṇal akanāḻiki amintuḷḷatu malariṉkaṇ uḷḷa makarantat tūḷip pōlat taṇṭamiḻk kuṭikaḷ vāḻkiṉṟaṉar.  antat tātuṇṇum vaṇṭu kūṭṭattip pōṉṟu iravalar kūṭṭam nāṭi varukiṉṟatu.  cērar kōnakarāṉa vañciyil vāḻvōrum cōḻar talinakarāṉa uṟantiyil vāḻvōrum kāliyil kōḻiyiṉ kūkkural kēṭṭē tuyil eḻuvar. āṉāl maturiyil vāḻum makkaḷ kōḻikūvi eḻuntilar.   nāḷtōṟum atikāliyil maṟikaḷi muḻakkuvōriṉ iṉiya oli kēṭṭut tuyil eḻuvar eṉpatākum.
inta mānakar maturiyil uḷḷa maṉikaḷum, māḷikikaḷum, araṇmaṉikaḷum pala māṭaṅkaḷiyuṭiyatāy viḷaṅkiṉa.  atikamāka nāṉku māṭaṅkaḷiyuṭiya māḷikikaḷ iruntatāl inta nakar māṭak kūṭal eṉṟum nāṉmāṭakkūṭam eṉṟum peyar peṟṟatu.
māṭamali maṟukiṟ kūṭal 	    - (tirumurukāṟṟup paṭi) 
eṉpatu nakkīrar tiruvākku.
nāṉmāṭak kūṭal makaḷirum mintarum - (kalittoki) eṉṟu kalittoki nāṉku māṭiyuḷḷa māḷikiyil vāḻum maturi makaḷiriyum makkaḷiyum pōṟṟukiṉṟatu.
teṉṉavaṉ nāṉmāṭak kūṭal nakar - (paripāṭal) eṉṟu paripāṭal pāṇṭiyaṉiṉ nāṉkumāṭamuḷḷa perunakar eṉṟu pukaḻkiṟatu. iṅku eḻunilimāṭaṅkaḷuṭiya araṇmaṉikaḷum iruntaṉa eṉṟu tiruviḷiyāṭaṟpurāṇam kūṟukiṟatu.
terukkaḷ
ciṟṟūrkaḷum, pērūrkaḷum, paṭṭiṉaṅkaḷum kōnakarkaḷum paṭippaṭiyāy vaḷarntaṉa. ciṟṟūrkaḷil maṉimuṉṟil, maṉip puḻakkaṭi ivaṟṟi uḷḷaṭakki vēlikaḷiṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa.  pērūril makkaḷ toki perukikkoṇṭē iruntamiyāl iṭanerukkaṭi eḻuntatu.  eṉavē makkaḷ tam maṉiyil, māṭaṅkaḷ amittu kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷi eḻuppiṉar.  māṭaṅkaḷ oṉṟu iraṇṭu, mūṉṟu, nāṉku, ēḻu eṉa uyarntu koṇṭē ceṉṟaṉa.  pērūrkaḷil neṭunili māṭaṅkaḷ niṟintu uyarntu niṉṟaṉa.  nakaraṅkaḷum paṭṭiṉaṅkaḷum nīṇṭu akaṉṟa terukkaḷiyum, kuṟunterukkaḷiyum uṭiyaṉavāy iruntaṉa.  aṉṟu nīṇṭa terukkaḷiṉ irumaruṅkiṉum vāṉṟōy māṭaṅkaḷ aṇi aṇiyāy aḻakuṟa amintiruntaṉa.  cal cal eṉṟu oli eḻuppi akaṉṟu ōṭum āṟṟu veḷḷam veḷiyē cellavoṭṭātu niṟkum karikaḷ pōṉṟu mānakariṉ terukkaḷiṉ irupuṟaṅkaḷilum māṭaṅkaḷ uyarntu kāṭci aḷittatu itaṉic caṅka ilakkiyaṅkaḷ naṉku eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṉṟaṉa;
māṭamōṅkiya mallaṉ mūtūr
āṟu kiṭantaṉṉa vakal neṭun teruvil   - neṭunal 29-30
eṉṟu aḻakuṟa eṭuttukkāṭṭuvatu ārāyattakkatākum.

vāṉtōy māṭattu varippantu acii  -  perum 330-335
vāṉam kīḻē viḻātapaṭi muṭṭuk kālāka ūṉṟivitta oru paṟṟuk kōl pōla viṇṇit tīṇṭumpaṭi uyarntatum ēṇi cāttiyum ēṟaṟkariya taliyiṉiyuṭiyatum, kaṟṟi mutaliya vaṟṟāl vēyāṟu cāntiṭṭa aramiyattiyuṭiyatumākiya māṭattu ucciyilē iraviṉkaṇ ēṟṟiya viḷakku nivantu tici tappip peruṅkaṭal parappilē ōṭāniṉṟa marakkalaṅkaḷi aḻiyā niṉṟa nīrppāyttuṟimukam piṉṉē irukkiṟatu vā eṉṟu kalaṅkariviḷakku kalaṅkaḷi aḻippatu pōl niṉṟatu eṉṟu perumpāṇāṟṟup paṭi kūṟiyuḷḷatu.
