cittiramāṭam
muṟkālattil palavita māṭaṅkaḷiyuṭiya māḷikikaḷi maṉṉarkaḷum celvarkaḷum peṟṟiruntaṉar maṉṉarkaḷ cittira
māṭam eṉṉum māḷikiyittaṉiyē amittiruntaṉar.  pāṇṭiyaṉ naṉmāṟaṉ, avaṉatu cittiramāṭattil uyir tuṟantāṉ.  eṉavē, avaṉ, cittiramāṭattut tuñciya naṉmāṟaṉ eṉṟu kūṟappaṭṭāṉ.  pāṇṭiyaṉuṭiya cittiramāṭam veṇmiyāṉa cuvarkaḷiyuṭiyatāy iruntatu.  atil pala vaṇṇa ōviyaṅkaḷ tīṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa.  tūṇkaḷ karumiyāy paḷiṅkupōl viḷaṅkiṉa.  cila cuvarkaḷ cempupōl vaṇṇantīṭṭap paṭṭiruntaṉa.  cila araṇmaṉic cuvarkaḷiṉ āṟṟalic cīvakacintāmaṇi eṉṉum kāppiyam aṭiyil varumāṟu aḻakuṟa eṭuttukāṭṭukiṟatu1 peruṅkati māḷikiyiṉ cuvarkaḷil kaṇṭamāṉmaṟi ceṭi koṭikaḷip pāṅkuṟac cittarittuḷḷatu.2
maturip pāṇṭiyarkaḷiṉ kōnakar.  atupāṇṭiya maṉṉar kaḷiṉ iṟutik kālam vari talinakarāy viḷaṅkiyatu.  iṉṟum annakar māṇpuṭaṉ talinimirntu niṟkiṟatu.  anta nakariṉ amippum, māḷikikaḷiṉ uyaramum aḻakum uṟutiyum tamiḻarkaḷiṉ nakar amipputtiṟaṉukkum kaṭṭiṭak kaliyiṉ ciṟappiṟkum ēṟṟa eṭuttukkāṭṭāka ilaṅkukiṟatu.  ammā nakariṉ māḷikiyiṉ māṭaṅkaḷ viṇmuṭṭa eḻuntu niṉṟaṉa.  māḷikiyiṉ mēṟṟaḷattil mēkaṅkaḷ tavaḻntaṉa; māṭaṅkaḷ maliyeṉa uyarntu niṉṟaṉa eṉṟellām tamiḻ ilakkiyaṅkaḷil eṭuttukkāṭṭap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  mēṉmāṭikaḷ, āyirampēr amintu virun
tuṇṇak kūṭiyatāka iruntatu.  ivikaḷi yellām eṭuttuk kūṟum tamiḻ ilakkiyaṅkaḷi naṉku payiṉṟa yāḻppāṇattic cērnta tamiḻ aṟiñar, paḻaṅkāla yāḻppāṇam eṉṉum nūlil aṭiyil varumāṟu eṭuttukkāṭṭi yuḷḷār.1
cāḷaraṅkaḷ (caṉṉalkaḷ)
mānakaraṅkaḷil māḷikikaḷum, araṇmaṉikaḷum, illaṅkaḷum nallakāṟṟum oḷiyum pukumāṟu periya aḻakiya cāḷaraṅkaḷ (palakaṇikaḷ) amikkap peṟṟiruntaṉa.  itaṉi, maturik kāñci, 
vakipeṟu eḻuntu vāṉam mūḻki
cil kāṟṟu icikkum palpuḻi nalil    - maturi 357-358 
eṉṟu eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṟatu.
cōḻa nāṭṭu iḷavaracaṉ utayakumāraṉiṉ naṇpaṉ eṭṭiyiṉ makaṉ pukār paṭṭiṉattiluḷḷa parattiyar teruvil, poṟṟakaṭu pōrttiya māḷikiyiṉ uyarnta māṭattil, kaṭṭilil paṭuttuk koṇṭu cāḷaraṅkaḷiṉ vaḻiyāka varum teṉṟaṟ kāṟṟiṉ poṉṟā iṉpatti naṉṟāka nukarntavāṟē teruvil nikaḻum kāṭciyik kaṇṭukaḷittāṉ eṉṟu tamiḻ ilakkiyaṅkaḷ eṭuttuk kāṭṭu kiṉṟaṉa.

māṉkaṇ pōṉṟa cāḷaram
māṉ kaṇkaḷ pōṉṟa cāḷaraṅkaḷ māḷikiyil aḻakuṟap polintaṉa.  avaṟṟil kāṟṟu varum puḻikaḷ māṉkaḷiṉ kaṇkaḷ pōṉṟu kaviṉ peṟat tikaḻntaṉa.  vaṇṭukaḷ nuḻiyum aḷavu ciṟiya puḻikaḷiyuṭiya aḻakiya cāḷaraṅkaḷil aḻakiya mālikaḷ toṅkaviṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa.

kōlac cāḷarak kuṟuṅkaṇ nuḻintu

maliyeṉa uyarnta māḷiki
tamiḻ vēntarkaḷāṉa cērar, cōḻar, pāṇṭiyarkaḷiṉ talinakarkaḷāṉa, vañci, pukār, koṟki maturi, uṟiyūr mutaliya nakaraṅkaḷil māḷikikaḷ maliyeṉa uyarntu niṉṟaṉa.  makkaḷ māṭattil mēṉiliyil kūtir kālattē ciṟitu poḻutu celaviṭuvar.  perum poḻuti iṭinilikaḷil kaḻippar.  iravu kālaṅkaḷil tuyila māṭaṅkaḷ ēṟṟa iṭamāka iruntatu.  pakaṟpoḻutil māṭaṅkaḷil neruppuc caṭṭiyivittu atil neruppiyiṭṭu atil kaṭṭikaḷi ataṉ mēliṭṭu naṟumaṇap puki eḻuppi ati nukarntu makiḻvar; kūtir kāyvar

araṇmaṉikaḷ
makkaḷ vāḻum iṭam illam, vīṭu akam eṉappaṭṭatu. aracar vāḻum aḻakiya maṉi araṇmaṉi eṉa aḻikkappaṭṭatu.  aracaṉ vāḻum iṭam kōyil eṉṟum aḻikkappaṭum.  maṉṉarkaḷ vāḻnta māḷikikaḷ cuṟṟu matilkaḷiyuṭiyatāyum, uyarnta vāyiliyum, vāyilil uyarnta kōpuram vāyntatāyum, vaṇṇaṅkaḷ tīṭṭappaṭṭa cuvar ōviyaṅkaḷ niṟintatāyum tikaḻntatu.  maṉṉaṉ māḷikikaḷ pala māṭaṅkaḷiyuṭiyatāyum aḻaku niṟintatāyum amintiruntaṉa.  itaṉi aṭiyil varum pintamiḻ nūṟkaḷ pāṅkuṟa eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṉṟaṉa:
nalvaḻi yeḻutiya nalaṅkiḷar vāyilum
veḷḷi veṇcuti yiḻukiya māṭat
tuḷḷuru veḻutā veḷḷiṭi vāyilum
maṭitta cevvāyk kaṭutta nōkkiṟ
ṟoṭutta pācattup piṭitta cūlattu
neṭunili maṇṇīṭu niṉṟa vāyilu

irumpuk katavukaḷ
vāṉ aḷāviya vaṇṇa māṭaṅkaḷic cuṟṟi amikkap peṟṟa matilkaḷum, vāyilkaḷ mītuḷḷa kōpuraṅkaḷum, vāyiṟ katavukaḷum pāṅkuṟat tikaḻntaṉa.  avvāyil katavuḷ irumput takaṭukaḷ poruttap peṟṟatāy eḵku āṇikaḷāl tariyap paṭṭatāyk kāṇap peṟṟatu.  irumpuk katavukaḷum eḵku āṇikaḷum turu ēṟā vaṇṇam civanta ney vaṇṇam tīṭṭap peṟṟiruntatu. itaṉic caṅkamaruviya taṅka ēṭāṉa neṭunal vāṭi,
oruṅkuṭaṉ vaḷii yōṅkunili varippiṟ
paruvirumpu piṇittuc celvarak kurīit
tuṇi māṇ katavam porunti yiṇimāṇṭu
nāḷoṭu peyariya kōḷami viḻumarattup
pōtaviḻ kuvaḷip putuppiṭi kālamittut
tāḷoṭu kuyiṉṟa pōrami puṇarppiṟ
kival kammiyaṉ muṭukkaliṟ puritīrn
tiyavi yappiya neyyaṇi neṭunili
veṉṟeḻu koṭiyoṭu vēḻañ ceṉṟu pukak
kuṉṟu kuyiṉ ṟaṉṉa vōṅkunili vāyil
						     -neṭunal 79-88
māḷikiyiṉ māṇpu
aracaṉ vāḻum araṇmaṉi talinakariṉ naṭuvē tali nimirntu niṉṟatu.  atu, makkaḷ vāḻum maṉikaḷum, vaṇikar vāḻum māḷikikaḷum, nilakkiḻārkaḷ vāḻum neṭiya māṭat terukkaḷum, amiccarkaḷ, paṭit talivarkaḷ vāḻum araṇpōṉṟa terukkaḷum nāṟpuṟamum nilava naṭuvē uyarntu niṉṟatu.
paṭutiri cūḻnta payaṅkeḻu mānilattu
iṭiniṉṟu ōṅkiya neṭunili mēruviṉ
koṭi matil mūtūr naṭu niṉṟu ōṅkiya
tamaṉiya māḷiki		           - cilap  naṭunaṟ 47-50
araṇmaṉikaḷ, makkaḷ uṟiyum maṉikaḷip pōl aṭuttu vīṭukaḷ kaṭṭi vāḻvatu kāṇappaṭuvatilli.
nakariṉ naṭuvē nāṟpuṟamum uyarnta matil cūḻa aminta akaṉṟa nilattil naṟumaṇam vīcum poḻilukku naṭuvē pala mēṉilikaḷiyuṭiya pāṅkāṉa vaṇṇa māḷikiyāy eḻil peṟṟilaṅkum.  araṇmaṉiyic cuṟṟi aḻakuṟa amikkap peṟṟa iṉiya poḻilil, vēṇṭum poḻutu vēṇṭum aḷavu nīri iṟikkavum, nīrip pōkkavum valla, iyantirap poṟikaḷ aminta poykik kariyil amikkap peṟṟiruntatu.  
itaṉāl aracaṉ vāḻum araṇmaṉi ilavantiki māṭam eṉṟu aḻikkappaṭṭatu.  intak kuḷirtaru māṭattiṉ maruṅkē kāṟṟu vacatiyum nīrvacatiyum poruntumāṟu amikkappaṭṭuḷḷa maṇṭapam oṉṟu iruntatu.  atu nīrāḷi maṇṭapam eṉa aḻikkappaṭṭatu.  araṇmaṉiyil makaḷir taṅkum antappuram taṉiyē amikkappaṭṭiruntatu.  aṅku āṇkaḷ uṭ cella muṭiyātu.  maṉṉar vāḻum iṭam akaṉṟu nīṇṭa aḻakiya aṟikaḷ pala uḷḷatāy amikkappaṭṭirukkum.  araṇmaṉi yil aracaṉ tuyilumiṭam taṉiyē amikka peṟṟirukkum.  avaṟṟil aḻakiya kaṭṭilum, ciṟṟuṇṭikaḷum, nalla naṟumaṇap poruḷkaḷum niṟintirukkum.
mānīr vēlik kaṭam peṟantu imayattu
vāṉavar maruḷa maliviṟ pūṭṭiya
vāṉavar tōṉṟal vāyvāṭ kōti
viḷaṅku ila vanti veḷḷi māṭattu
iḷaṅkō vēṇmā ḷuṭaṉiruntaruḷi -cilap kāṭci  - 25:1-5
cōḻa aracaṉukku kāmaṉa aḻakiya vēṉiloṭu potiyiṟ teṉṟaliyum tiyiṭukiṉṟa pala malarkaḷi niritta nalla mara niḻaliyuṭiya ilavantiki eṉṉum maṉṉaṉ māḷikiyiṉiṉṟu matiṟ puṟattē celavar eṉpatic cilappatikāram
kaliyilāṉ kāmar veṉiloṭu
malayamārutam maṉṉavaṟkirukkum
paṉmalaraṭukkiya naṉmarap pantar
ilavantikiyiṉ eyiṟpuṟam pōki - cilap 10 nāṭukaḷ 28-31
nīrāḻi maṇṭapam
nīrāḻi maṇṭapam nīrāvi maṇṭapam eṉṟum kūṟappaṭum.  kuḷaṅkaḷiṉ naṭuvē amintuḷḷa maṇṭapam nīrāḻi maṇṭapam eṉappaṭum tāmari cūḻnta nīrāvi maṇṭapam eṉṟu cīvaka cintāmaṇi 2800-ṉ uriyil kuṟippiṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
araṇmaṉiyiṉ amippu
araṇmaṉi, uṟutiyāy, uyaramāy upparikkikaḷi yuṭiyatāy oḷirntatu.  araṇmaṉi cuṭumaṇ ceṅkallāl kaṭṭap peṟṟu mēlē kal cuṇṇac cāntum, cippic cuṇṇac cāntum pūcappeṟṟu naṉṟākap paḷapaḷappāṉa kallāl tēykkap peṟṟup paḷiṅkuc cuvar pōl viḷaṅka mēlē ōṭukaḷ vēyap peṟṟiruntaṉa.  pala māḷikikaḷil veḷḷit takaṭukaḷ potiyap peṟṟiruntaṉa.  cila māḷikikaḷ cempoṉṉāṟ ceyta ōṭukaḷ vēyap peṟṟiruntatu.  pavaḷat tūṇkaḷum, pimpoṉ tūṇkaḷum araṇmaṉiyi aḻaku peṟac ceytatu.  araṇmaṉi tamiḻ nāṭṭuc ciṟpikaḷāl maṭṭum kaṭṭap paṭuvatilli.  yavaṉa nāṭṭut taccarum; avanti nāṭṭuk kollarum; marāṭṭira nāṭṭuk kammiyar; makata nāṭṭu kottarkaḷum, kūṭik kaṭṭappaṭṭatu.  palvēṟu nāṭṭiluḷḷa poṉ, maṇi, pavaḷam, muttu, paṭṭu, tantam mutaliya poruḷkaḷāl araṇmaṉi aṇi ceyyap peṟṟiruntatu.  mukkālikaḷ nāṟkālikaḷ, kaṭṭilkaḷ, vicuppalakikaḷ niṟin tirukkum.
makata viṉiñarum marāṭṭak kammarum
avantik kollarum yavaṉat taccarum
taṇṭamiḻ viṉiñar-tammoṭu kūṭik
koṇṭiṉi  tiyaṟṟi kaṇkavar ceyviṉip
pavaḷat tiraḷkāl paṉmaṇip pōtikit
tavaḷa nittilat tāmam tāḻnta
kōṇac canti māṇviṉi vitāṉattut
tamaṉiyam vēynta vaki peṟu vaṉappiṉ
piñ cēṟu meḻukāp pacum poṉ maṇṭapam 
						     -maṇi. 19:107-115
māṭattil pantāṭṭam
maṉṉarkaḷum, nilakkiḻārkaḷum, vaṇikarkaḷum pala nilikaḷiyuṭiya māṭa māḷikikaḷik kaṭṭiyiruntaṉar.  maṉṉarkaḷiṉ peṇmakkaḷum nilakkiḻārkaḷiṉ iḷam peṇkaḷum vaṇikarkaḷiṉ peṇmakkaḷum māli vēḷikaḷil tattam māṭattiṉ mēṟṟaḷattil, kāṟcilampukaḷ kaṇīr kaṇīr eṉṟu olikkak kaḷikoṇṭu pantāṭiṉar.  itu māmaliyil mayilkaḷ tam aḻakiya tōkikaḷi virittu āṭi makiḻvatu pōl māṭaṅkaḷ mītu mati muka maṅkiyarkaḷ pantāṭiya kāṭci iruntatu.  itaṉi caṅka maruviya taṅka ēṭukaḷil pīṭuṟa eṅkaḷ perum pulavarkaḷ eḻil tikaḻa eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷaṉar.
mālvari cilampiṉ makiḻ ciṟantu ālum
pīli maññiyiṉ iyalik kāla 
tamaṉiyap poṟ cilampu olippa uyarnili
vāṉtōy māṭattu varippantu acii    perum 330-333
maturi, pukār nakarkaḷil, paṇṭikkāla māḷikikaḷilum, māṭaṅkaḷilum nila muṟṟamamittiruntaṉar. nilā muṟṟam vēṉiṟkālattum kuḷirkālattum iravu nilāk kālattum, kāliyilum makaḷirum mintarkaḷum oruṅkukūṭi,  āṭippāṭip poḻutu pōkkum iṭamāka iruntatu. itaṉic cilappatikāram,  eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṟatu.
nilā muṟṟam
māḷikikaḷil vāḻnta makkaḷ iravil-nilāk kālattil tiṅkaḷiṉ payaṉi naṉku payaṉpaṭutti vantaṉar.  māḷikikaḷil taṇṇoḷi tarum veṇmatiyiṉ payaṉi nukarvataṟ keṉṟē neṭu nilā muṟṟam amikkappaṭṭatupōl karutappaṭṭatu.  nilavu tarum iṉṉoḷi iṉpam eḻuppum; teṉṟaliṉ iṉimi kaḷiyūṭṭum; kātal vaḷarkkum.  iṉpam eḻuppum vēṉiṟ paḷḷiyum kūtir kālattu vāṭi pukāta kūtir paḷḷiyum naṉku amittu paruva nilikaḷukkēṟṟa uṟiyuḷum uṇavum uṭiyum piṟavum amittu illatti iṉpalōkamākki vāḻntu vantaṉar.
veppam mikutiyāka irukkum vēṉiṟkālattil nilā muṟṟatti aṭuttuk kīḻē irukkum maṉiyil pavaḻa  illattil katiravaṉiṉ veppam pukātu iṉitu vāḻntaṉar avarkaḷ veḷiyē pukātu vīṭṭiṉuḷḷē iruppar.  avviṭam mēṉ māṭiyip pōliṉṟi nāṟpuṟamum cuṟṟuc cuvarkaḷum mēṟṟaḷamum peṟṟiruppatāl aṅku veppam tākkātu; veppak kāṟṟup pukātu.  vēṉiṟ kālattu vīcum teṉṟal tavaḻntu varum vaṇṇam cuvaril palakaṇikaḷ amintiruntaṉa.
vāṉuṟa nivanta mēṉili maruṅkiṉ
vēṉiṟ paḷḷit teṉvaḷi tarūum
nērvāyk kaṭṭaḷit tiriyātu tiṇṇili -neṭunal 62-64

araṇmaṉiyil pāvi viḷakku
tamiḻ nāṭṭu maṉṉarkaḷiṉ araṇmaṉiyil makaḷir vāḻum antappuram taṉiyē iruntatu.  aṅku aracaṉuṭiya maṉiviyum-atāvatu paṭṭattaraciyum maṟumaṉiyāṭṭikaḷum avarkaḷiṉ paṇip peṇkaḷum iruppar.  aṅku aracaṉ allatu ayalār evarum aṇuka muṭiyātu.  palamāṉa kāval uṇṭu.  pāṇṭiya maṉṉarkaḷum cōḻar, ciṅkaḷavar, cērar, kaṉṉaṭar, āntirar mutaliya nāṭṭu maṉṉarkaḷōṭu peṇ eṭuttum koṭuttum uḷḷaṉar.  urōm nāṭṭup peṇkaḷ meykkāvalarkaḷip pāṇṭiyarkaḷ antappurattil iṭam peṟṟiruntaṉar. cōḻar pāṇṭiyar, cāḷukkiyar, āntirar, kaliṅkar, kaṭāra nāṭṭiṉar, (malēciyar) mutaliya nāṭṭiluḷḷa araciḷaṅkumarikaḷi maṇantum peṇ koṭuttum uḷḷaṉar.  araṇmaṉi ayalnāṭṭu poruḷkaḷāl alaṅkarikkap peṟṟiruntatu.  pāṇṭiyar araṇmaṉiyil yavaṉanāṭṭup pāvi viḷakku aṇipeṟat tikaḻntatu.  itaṉi neṭunalvāṭi
yavaṉar iyaṟṟiya viṉimāṇ pāvi
kiyēntu akala niṟi ney corintu
parūuttiri koḷīiya kurūuttali nimir eri 
						    -neṭunal 101-104   
kūṟuvataṉ mūlam naṉkaṟiyalām. 
aṉṉam vitta viḷakku
 iḵtaṉṟi aṉṉam pōṉṟa pāvikaḷ uruvil ceyyappaṭṭu vanta viḷakkum pāṇṭiyarkaḷ araṇmaṉiyil payaṉpaṭuttappaṭṭu vantaṉaveṉṟu perumpāṇāṟṟup paṭi eṉṉum paḻiya tamiḻ ilakkiyaṅkaḷ mūlam aṟikiṉṟōm:
----------------------  yavaṉar
ōtima viḷakkiṉ uyarmici koṇṭa
vikuṟu maṉīṟ piyakat tōṉṟu
nīrp peyaṟ ṟelli 		      -perumpāṇ 11:316-19
tamiḻakam pōnta yavaṉarkaḷiṉ marakkalaṅkaḷil uḷḷa kūmpukaḷil aṉṉam uruvamuḷḷa ciṟpavēlippāṭaminta aḻakiya viḷakkukaḷ iruntaṉa.  avikaḷ tamiḻaka aracarkaḷiṉ kōyilkaḷilum civaṉār, tirumāl kōyilkaḷilum nantā viḷakku eṉṉum peyaril iṭam peṟṟaṉa eṉṟu terikiṟatu.  aṉṉam tamiḻ nāṭṭup paṟaviyalla.  anta aṉṉa viḷakkukaḷi ātiyil urōmarkaḷ tamiḻ nāṭṭiṟku aḷittaṉar eṉpatu varalāṟṟup pāṅkāṉa uṇmi.
araṇmaṉiyil eḻiṟ pūṅkā
iyaṟki iṉpatti iṉituṇarnta tamiḻ nāṭṭu maṉṉarkaḷ tam araṇmaṉiyil ceyaṟkik kuṉṟukaḷ, iyantira  vāvikaḷ kālvāy amittu uyarnta maraṅkaḷiyum, pūñceṭikaḷiyum, pūmaraṅkaḷiyum, paḻa maraṅkaḷiyum amittu eḻil peṟac ceytiruntaṉar.  aṅku mayilkaḷ āṭiṉa.  kuyilkaḷ pāṭiṉa.  kiḷḷikaḷum pūviyum maḻali miḻaṟṟiṉa.  māṉkaḷ tuḷḷik kutittu viḷiyāṭiṉa.  iṅku araciḷaṅ kāḷikaḷum, araciḷaṅ kumarikaḷum āṭippāṭi iṉpuṟṟu vantaṉar.  itaṉi neṭunal
vāṭi, naṉku eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṟatu.
nerumayir ekiṉat tūniṟa ēṟṟi
kuṟuṅkāl aṉṉamoṭu ukaḷum muṉkaṭi
						        neṭunal 91-92
aracaṉ vāḻum kōyilil nilā muṟṟattil orupakutiyil mīṉ vaṭivam pōṟ ceyyappaṭṭa akaṉṟi vāyiyuṭiya nīrt tūmpiṉiṉṟu eppoḻutum nīr poṅki eḻuntu koṇṭē iruntatu.  maṟṟoru pakkam anta aruvi nīr kaṇṭum ataṉ oli kēṭkum māmayil makiḻntu tōkiyi virittu āṭi akavum. mayilum aruviyum amintayiṭam malik kāṭciyik kāṭṭilum iṉitē tikaḻntatu.  itaṉi neṭunalvāṭiyil mika aḻakāṉa ōviyamākat tīṭṭap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  atu aṭiyil varumāṟākum:
nilavum payaṉ koḷḷum neṭuveṇ muṟṟattu
kimpurip pakuvāy ampaṇam niṟiyak
kaluḻntu vīḻ aruvip pāṭuviṟan tayala
oli neṭum pīli olka mel liyal
kaḷimayal akavum vayir maruḷ iṉṉici
naḷimalic cilamayil cilampuṅ kōyil  -neṭunal 95-100
vīṭukaḷ
muṟkālattil tamiḻakattil vīṭukaḷiṉ amippukaḷ paranta tāyum nāṉku puṟamum kāliyāṉa nilapparappukaḷ uḷḷatāyum vīṭṭiṉ piṉpuṟattil kiṇaṟum pūmaraṅkaḷum kāykaṉikaḷ tarum maraṅkaḷ uḷḷatāyum iruntaṉa.  vīṭukaḷ pala aṟikaḷuḷḷatāyum aḻakuḷḷatāyum amintiruntatu.  iṟiyaṉār akapporuḷ eṉṉum nūliṉ uri paṇṭik kālat tamiḻmakkaḷiṉ maṉi amippu evvāṟu iruntatu eṉpati naṉku eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṟatu.1 atu aṭiyil varumāṟu:
aṭṭil (aṭukkaḷi), koṭṭakāram(paṇṭaṅkaḷ vikkumiṭam), paṇṭa cāli (aṇikaḷ mutaliyaṉa vikkum iṭam) kūṭa kāraṅkaḷ (mēṉmāṭam) paḷḷiyampalam (tuyilum iṭam) kūttap paḷḷi (nāṭaka maṉṟam) eṉa ivaṟṟuḷ nīkki  ceykuṉṟum iḷamarakkāvum, pūmpantarum viḷiyāṭum iṭamum ivaṟṟic cārntaṉavaṟṟuḷḷum piṟavaṟṟuḷḷumāka eṉṟavāṟu.  eṉak kuṟippiṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  itu maṉṉaṉ maṉiyā, periya nilak kiḻār maṉiyā eṉṟu aiyappaṭum aḷavil amintuḷḷatu.
itukāṟu eṭuttuk kāṭṭiya cāṉṟukaḷ caṅka kālattilum-kiṟittava ūḻikku muṉṉar tamiḻnāṭṭil eḻuntuḷḷa kaṭṭiṭak kaliyiṉ ēṟṟatti oruvāṟu uṇara muṭiyum.  ataṟku muṉṉuḷḷa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷip paṟṟi nām aṟivataṟku tamiḻ ilakkiyaṅkaḷ oṉṟum kiṭṭavilli.  kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ etuvum ituvarik kaṇṭu piṭikkappaṭavilli.
akaḻ āyvil cintu veḷiyil kiṭittatu pōl nakaraṅkaḷō, kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷō kiṭikkavilli, atōṭu tamiḻ nāṭṭil akkariyōṭu akaḻ āyvil iṟaṅkac ceyya aracu muyaṟci etuvum ceyyavilli.
ciṟitu kālattiṟku muṉ intiya miya araciṉ tol poruḷ āyvut tuṟiyiṉar ceyta akaḻ āyvil paḻaṅkaṟkāla makkaḷ payaṉpaṭuttiya karuvikaḷ ceṅkaṟpaṭṭu māvaṭṭattil uḷḷa kōttaliyāṟṟup pakutikaḷil kaṇṭeṭukkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  iḵtaṉṟi atirām pākkam pūṇṭi mutaliya iṭaṅkaḷilum cila paḻaṅkaṟkāla makkaḷiṉ kaṟkālak karuvikaḷ kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭaṉa.  tirunelvēli māvaṭṭattil naṭattiya akaḻ āyvil pala putiya kaṟkālak karuvikaḷ kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
1867-lum 1904-lum tirunelvēli māvaṭṭattil uḷḷa akaḻ āyvil palavitamāṉa maṇcaṭṭikaḷ pāṉikaḷ kalayaṅkaḷōṭu, irumpiṉāl ceyta īṭṭittali, uḷi, mūvili vēl, īṭṭi, irupuṟamum kūrāṉavāḷ, kuttuvāḷ, vēl, vācci katti, maṇ veṭṭi, kōṭari, eṟi vēl pōṉṟa āyutaṅkaḷ pala kaṇṭeṭukkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  pala veṇkala pāttiraṅkaḷum ciṟuvarkaḷiṉ viḷiyāṭṭup poruḷkaḷum poṉ aṇikalaṉ kaḷum kiṭittuḷḷaṉa.
1970-ām āṇṭiyoṭṭi ceṉṉit tol poruḷ āyvut tuṟiyiṉar koṟkiyil naṭattiya akaḻ āyvil pala ariya pāṉi caṭṭikaḷum piṟa poruḷkaḷum kiṭittuḷḷaṉa.  ivikaḷ ki.mu.785 āṇṭil uḷḷavi eṉṟu kūṟappeṟṟuḷḷatu.
1965-ām āṇṭiyoṭṭi intiya miya araciṉ tol poruḷ āyvut tuṟiyiṉar naṭattiya akaḻ āyvil pala pāṉi caṭṭikaḷ, āyutaṅkaḷ uṭinta cilikaḷ pōṉṟa pala ariya poruḷkaḷum vīṭukaḷiṉ aṭippaṭikaḷum kaṇṭupiṭikkap paṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  aṅku pala paḻiya kōyilkaḷiṉ aḻipāṭukaḷum kiṭittaṉa.
ivaṟṟiṟku muṉ 1945-ām āṇṭil putuc cēriyic cērnta arikkaṉ mēṭu eṉṉum pakutiyi piriṭṭiṣ āṭciyāḷarkaḷ muyaṟciyāl intiyat tol poruḷ āyvut tuṟiyiṉ muyaṟciyāl aṟiñar mārṭṭimārṭṭimā uyilar (Director general) talimiyil āyntu aṅku ki.mu200-ām āṇṭil nilaviya tuṟimukam, yavaṉac cēri, cuṭumaṇ ceṅkallāl kaṭṭappaṭṭa paṇṭakac cālikaḷum akaḻntu kaṇṭupiṭikkap paṭṭaṉa.  kaṇṇāṭi, paḷiṅku, NJgts«(Carnelian) mutaliyavi kaḷil kaṭinta maṇikaḷum, pala patakkaṅkaḷum poṉmaṇikaḷum kiṭittuḷḷaṉa.  iṅku tāṉ yavaṉar virumpiya mika melliya maliṉ tuṇikaḷukkuc cāyam ēṟṟappaṭṭatu.  iṅku urōmar ittāliyar nakarattuk kuyavarkaḷ ceyta pala aḻakiya uyarntavaki ariṭṭikaḷum (Arretine)  maṭkalaṉkaḷum kaṇṭeṭukkap paṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  mēlum pala kaṇṇāṭik kōppikaḷum, matuccāṭikaḷum, kiṟittuva ūḻikku muṉ nām yavaṉa nāṭukaḷuṭaṉ ceyta kaṭal vaṇikatti uṟutippaṭuttuvatāy uḷḷaṉa.  ki.mu.1400-ām āṇṭil naṭipeṟṟatākak karutappaṭum irāmaṉ varalāṟṟil (vāṉmīki irāmāyaṇattil) kūṟum irāvaṇaṉuṭiya pala māṭikaḷiyuṭiya  uparikkikaḷiyuṭiya araṇ maṉiyum, pāṇṭiyaṉiṉ talinakarāṉa kapāṭa purattil pāṇṭiyap pēraraciṉ kōṭṭi vāyiliṉ poṟṟakaṭu pōrtta katavukaḷiṉ ciṟappiyum inta akaḻ āyvu meyppikkiṟatu.
inta akaḻ āyviṟ kaṇṭa poruḷkaḷum, tamiḻ ilakkiyaṅkaḷ kūṟum araṇmaṉikaḷum, māḷikikaḷum, kōyil kaḷum caṅka kālattil tiṭīreṉṟu muḷittu viṭṭatu eṉṟu evarum kūṟa muṭiyātu.  tamiḻ ilakkiyaṅkaḷ kūṟum kaṭṭiṭak kaliyiṉ ēṟṟatti eytuvataṟku tamiḻ makkaḷum tamiḻ nāṭṭuc ciṟpikaḷum, kottarkaḷum 5000 - āṇṭukaḷākap paṇpaṭṭirukka vēṇṭum eṉpatu aṟivuṭiyār evarum maṟukka muṭiyāta uṇmiyākum.
eṉavē cintu veḷi nākarikam eḻuvataṟku pallāyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṉpē tamiḻnāṭu cintu veḷi nākarikatti viṭac ciṟappuṟṟu  viḷaṅkiyatu eṉṟa uṇmi uṇarappaṭukiṟatu.  tamiḻ nāṭṭil 8000 -māṇṭukaḷukku muṉ uyarnta kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷi eḻuppip paṇpaṭṭa karaṅkaḷē upitiyā, ellam, cumēriyā, kirīṭ cintu veḷip paṇpāṭṭi eḻuppi ulakilē oppaṟṟa nākarikam eṉṟu ulakam viyakkumāṟu ceytaṉa.
cintu veḷi nākarikam makkaḷiṉ varalāṟṟiṟkum puttoḷi tantu putiyatoru poliviṉi aḷittirukkiṟatu intiya varalāṟṟiṉ iruṇṭa kālatti eḻil mikka poṟkālameṉa iyampukiṟatu.  intiya nākarikattiṉ aṭip paṇpukaḷāka viḷaṅkuvaṉa yāvum cintu veḷi nākarikattiṉ ciṟappiyalpukaḷē eṉṉum varalāṟṟiṉ kuralik kēṭṭu ulakam viyakkum vaṇṇam ceytuḷḷatu.  cintu veḷi nākarikam intiyāviṉ oru aḷavu kōl; intiyap paṇpāṭṭiṟkuḷ ciṟappiṟku ōr urikal eṉṉum ariya uṇmiyi uṇarttukiṟatu  eṉṟu pēraṟiñar pērāciriyar ka.ta.tirunāvukkaracu avarkaḷ kūṟiyatu mikap poruḷ ceṟinta poṉ moḻiyākum.1

kaṭṭiṭak kaliyiṉ 
tōṟṟamum vaḷarcciyum

ki.mu.4000-āṇṭukaḷukku muṉpē tamiḻakattilum vicuvakarmā mayaṉ pōṉṟa teyva kammiyarkaḷ vāḻntu vantaṉar.  viṇmuṭṭum vīṭukaḷiyum mukil tavaḻum māṭaṅkaḷiyum eḵkuk kōṭṭi kaḷiyum eṭuppittu tamiḻakattiṟkup pērum perumiyum aḷittaṉar.
iṟivaṉi imippoḻutum maṟavāta irāvaṇaṉ, mātēvar malaraṭiyit toḻum maṇṭōtari ulakil tirunīṟu aṇintavarkaḷukku ilakkaṇamākat tikaḻntavarākiya irāvaṇaṉ maṉiviyum pārulakil uḷḷa pattuk kaṟparacikaḷil oru ciṟu mācum kūṟa muṭiyāta irāvaṇaṉ maṉivi maṇṭōtariyiṉ tanti vicuvakarmāvāka iruntāṉ
eṉavē taṉ marumakaṉ irāvaṇaṉukku eḻunili māṭaṅ kaḷiyum eḵku pōṉṟa araṇkaḷiyum ciṟanta āyutaṅkaḷiyum ceytu koṭuttāṉ. irāvaṇaṉ araṇmaṉi oru yōcaṉi nīḷam uḷḷatāy mukiḻ tavaḻum māṭam uḷḷatāy uyarntu viḷaṅkiyatu.  pavaḷat tuṇkaḷum paḷiṅkup paṭikaḷum, poṟkaṭṭilum maṇikaḷ iḻitta araca kaṭṭilum aṅku iruntaṉa.  navamaṇikaḷ iḻitta poṉ aṇikalaṉkaḷ eṇṇilātu kāṇappaṭṭaṉa.  tari cantaṉak kuḻampāl meḻukappaṭṭu aḻakuṟap polintaṉa.  eṅkum viliyuyarnta virippukaḷ kāṇappaṭṭaṉa.  naṟumaṇa vācaṉi iṉpamūṭṭiṉa.  iravil eṇṇilā viḷakkukaḷ araṇmaṉiyil paṭṭap pakaleṉa oḷivīcac ceytaṉa. aṅkuḷḷa   pūṅkākkaḷum, aṅku vāḻum mayilum,  kuyilum, kiḷiyum, kiṉṉarappaṟavikaḷum, paratīcup paṟavikaḷum, māṉkaḷ, kutirikaḷ, āṭu māṭukaḷ mutaliyavikaḷellām araṇmaṉiyi aḻaku ceyvatu pōl polivuṟṟiruntaṉa eṉṟu eḻil peṟa eṭuttukkāṭṭap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  itu aiyāyiram āṇṭukaṭku muṉ teṉ intiyāvil irunta kaṭṭiṭak kaliyiṉ ciṟappi eṭuttuk kāṭṭuvatāy uḷḷatu.
ki.mu. mutal nūṟṟāṇṭiṉiṉṟu irupatām nuṟṟāṇṭu vari nilaviyatākak karutappaṭum ātitta nallūr nākarikattil irunta irumpu āyutaṅkaḷum veṅkala pāttiraṅkaḷum maṭpāṇṭaṅ kaḷum, viḷiyāṭṭup poruḷkaḷum tamiḻakattil uyarnta kaṭṭiṭak kali nilavi iruntatu eṉpati ūkikka iṭam tarukiṟatu.  āṉāl ātitta nallūr nākarikam paraviya nakaram itu vari namakkuk kiṭikkavilli.  ātitta nallūr nākarikam arappā nākari kattōṭu caṅkilit toṭar pōla piṇintuḷḷatu.  eṉṟār ār.ṭi.pāṉarji.
ki.mu. mūvāyiram āṇṭaḷavil pāṇṭiyarkaḷiṉ tali
nakarāyum, tuṟimukap paṭṭiṉamāyum viḷaṅkiya koṟki camīpattil akaḻ āyvu ceyyappaṭṭatu.  āṉāl nakaramō, vīṭukaḷiyō akaḻntu kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭavilli.  āṉāl 
ki.mu.800 āṇṭil pala uṭintu pōṉa pāṉi caṭṭikaḷum uṭinta cāṭikaḷum piṟavum kaṇṭeṭukkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  iṉṉum koṟkiyil niṟivāṉa akaḻ āyvu ceyyap peṟṟāl ki.mu.2000 -m āṇṭaḷavil tamiḻakam peṟṟirunta kaṭṭiṭakkaliyiṉ ciṟappi meyppikka mutal taramāṉa cāṉṟukaḷ kiṭikkak kūṭum.
ki.mu. iraṇṭāyiram āṇṭiṟku muṉṉuḷḷa tamiḻ nāṭṭu maṉṉarkaḷiṉ tali nakaraṅkaḷum, araṇkaḷum araṇmaṉikaḷum aḻintu paṭṭaṉa.  piṟkālat tamiḻ aracarkaḷ vāḻnta koṟkiyum, vañciyum, pūmpukārum kūṭa niṟivāṉa akaḻ āyvu ceyyappaṭavilli.  āyvu ceyyap peṟṟāl namatu paḻamperum kaṭṭiṭak kaliyiṉ cīrum ciṟappum veḷivarum.
piṟkālap pāṇṭiyarkaḷiṉ talinakarāka viḷaṅkiyatu iṉṟiya maturi.  itu ālavāy eṉṟum nāṉmāṭakkūṭal eṉṟum kūṟappaṭum.  kiṟittuva ūḻi kiḷarnteḻuvataṟku muṉ maturi nāṉku māṭi
kaḷiyuṭiya pala araṇmaṉikaḷiyum, araṇkaḷiyum, māḷikikaḷiyum vīṭukaḷiyum kōyilkaḷi yum peṟṟiruntaṉa.  intak kaṭṭiṭak kaliyiṉ ciṟappi āyntōr tamiḻarkaḷ, aiyāyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṉpē cīrāṉa kaṭṭiṭakkaliyiṉ aṟiviyum, nakar amippiṉ tiṟaṉiyum peṟṟiruntāltāṉ inta maturiyi nirmāṇittirukka muṭiyum eṉṟu navilkiṉṟaṉar.  tamiḻar kaṭṭiṭak kali taṉic ciṟappu vāyntavi.  piṟa iṉattavariṉiṉṟu kaṭaṉ vāṅkiyavi allatu-maturi mānakariṉ nakar amippu tiṟaṉ pāṇṭiya nāṭṭu ciṟpikaḷiṉ paṭṭaṟiviṟkum, kivaṇṇattiṟkum ciṟpa aṟiviṟkum nalla eṭuttuk kāṭṭākum. maturi nakar amipput tiṟaṉ ulakiṟkōr putumi.  viyattaku peṟṟi vāyntatu.
makāpāratattilum irāmāyaṇattilum piṉ ki.mu.4-ām nūṟṟāṇṭil muṟpakutiyil vāḻnta cantira kuptariṉ aracaviyil kirēkka tūtaṉāka irunta mekataṉi kūṟṟilum ki.mu.300 -m āṇṭiṉ acōkaṉ kalveṭṭilum ki.pi.77-ām āṇṭil intiyā pōnta piḷiṉi eṉṉum ayal nāṭṭaṟiñarum ki.pi.77-il maturi mānakar ulakiṟperiya paṇṭaka cāli eṉṟu kūṟip pōntār.  varalāṟṟup pukaḻ peṟṟa tālami eṉṟa aṟiñar ki.pi.140-ām āṇṭil maturip pāṇṭiyariṉ māṇpi eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyatiliruntum pāṇṭiyap pēraracarkaḷ urōma cakkaravartti akaṭar aracavikku amiccarkaḷi aṉuppi araca tūtuvar
kaḷip parimāṟṟam ceytu koṇṭatum, piṉṉar pāracīkap payaṇiyum, cīṉavaḻip pōkkaṉum, mārkkō pōlō eṉṉum ittāliya vaṇikaṉ eḻuti vitta kuṟippukaḷum maturi nakariṉ paṇpāṭṭiyum kaṭṭiṭak kaliyiṉ ciṟappiyum naṉku pulap paṭuttukiṉṟaṉa.
mikat toṉmiyāṉa kālattilēyē namatu tamiḻnāṭṭil kaṭṭiṭak kali eḻuntuḷḷatu.  āṉāl aṉṟu maṇṇālum marattālum amikkappaṭṭaṉa.  appāl ceṅkalliṉālum cuṇṇāmpiṉālum cuvarkaḷ eḻuppiyum kūrikaḷ vēyntum kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. vīṭukaḷ, araṇmaṉikaḷ, araṇkaḷ maṇṭapaṅkaḷ aṉittum ivvāṟē amikkappaṭṭaṉa.  tamiḻ nāṭṭil maṇṇālē amikkappaṭṭa araṇkaḷum vīṭukaḷum iṉṟum uḷḷaṉa.  ciṟṟūrkaḷil kāḷi,kūḷi,māri, māṭatti, icakki piṭāri vaṇṭi malicci pōṉṟa tāyt teyvaṅkaḷiṉ kōyilkaḷ nāṟpuṟamum maṇcuvar eḻuppi mēlē paṉi ōli vēyntum marakkatavukaḷ pōṭṭum iruntu varukiṉṟaṉa.  kōyiliṉṟi kāṟṟiyum, veyyiliyum, maḻiyiyum poruṭpaṭuttātu veṟum pīṭattiṉ mītu niṟkum maṇṇālāṉa teyva uruvaṅkaḷum uḷḷaṉa. iṉṟu perumpālāṉa tāyt teyvaṅkaḷil nāṟpuṟam ceṅkallum cuṇṇāmpum vittuk kaṭṭi mēlē maṭṭappāy iṭṭu cuṇṇāmpu allatu cimiṇṭāl mēṟpūccup pūcap peṟṟu irumpuk kampikaḷālāṉa kataviṭṭu pūṭṭap peṟṟirukkum kōyilkaḷē atikam uḷḷaṉa.  makkaḷiṉ poruḷātāra nili uyara uyara kōyilkaḷum ciṟappuṟṟu eḻuntuḷḷaṉa.  ki.pi.āṟām nuṟṟāṇṭiṟkup piṉ tamiḻakattil kukik kōyilkaḷum, kuṭi varik kōyilum kaṟṟaḷikaḷumākap palakōyilkaḷ eḻuntaṉa.  kallum cuṇṇāmpum kalantu aṭippaṭiyiṭṭu karuṅkaṟ pāḷaṅkaḷi oṉṟiṉ mītu oṉṟāka variciyāka aṭukki vittu kaṭṭum kōyilē kaṟṟaḷikaḷ eṉappaṭum.
caṅka kālak kōyilkaḷ
caṅka kālattilē-atāvatu iraṇṭām caṅkam nilaviya kālattilē atāvatu ki.mu.300-mutal ki.mu.100-variyuḷḷa kālattilē tamiḻakattil kaṭṭiṭak kali ciṟappuṟṟiruntatu.  kōyilkaḷ pala kaṭṭap peṟṟaṉa.  āṉāl avikaḷ maṇṇālum ceṅkallālum marattālum kaṭṭap peṟṟiruntatāl nāṭṭil eḻunta koṭiya taṭpa veppa nilikaḷit tāṅka muṭiyāmal aḻintu viṭṭaṉa.  paḻaṅkaṟkālan toṭṭu, putiya kaṟkālam-ulōka
kālam varalāṟṟuk kālam vari tamiḻ makkaḷ iṅku vāḻntu varukiṟārkaḷ. 1 caṅkam niṟuviyuḷḷārkaḷ.  ilakkiyaṅkaḷ iyaṟṟiyuḷḷaṉar.  eṇṇaṟ kariya kalikaḷip paṭittuḷḷaṉar. āḻkaṭal kaṭakkum kalaṅkaḷik kaṭṭi ilaṅki, ciṅkappūr, kaṭāram, maliyam cāvakam mutaliya nāṭukaḷukkuc ceṉṟuḷḷaṉarkaḷ.  aṅku taṅkaḷ camayatti nili nāṭṭiyuḷḷārkaḷ.  ekiptu, ellam, cumēriyā, kirīṭ mutaliya nāṭukaḷukkum pōyk kuṭiyēṟi aṅku taṅkaḷ camayattiyum paṇpāṭṭiyum nili nāṭṭiyuḷḷārkaḷ.  cintu veḷiyiṟ kuṭiyēṟi ki.mu.3000 ām āṇṭiṟku muṉpu oppaṟṟa uyariya kalikaḷi uruvākkiyuḷḷārkaḷ.  iṉṟikku aiyāyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ ulakil enta iṉamum kaṇṭum kēṭṭum irāta cātaṉikaḷic cātittuḷḷārkaḷ.  arappā mokañcatārō, caṅkutārō nakar amippum uyariya kaṭṭiṭa amippum ulakam kaṇṭum  viyakkum peṟṟiyi uṭiyaṉa allavā?  ittakiya naṉiciṟanta nākarika makkaḷ caṅka kālattil kaṭṭiṭak kaliyil ciṟantu viḷaṅki iruntaṉarā eṉpatil ciṟitum aiyappaṭa vēṇṭiya
tilli.  cilar ki.mu.3000 āmāṇṭil cintu veḷiyil ciṟanta nākarikattip paṭitta makkaḷ cumēriya nāṭṭiṉiṉṟu kuṭiyēṟiyavarkaḷ.  avarkaḷ āriyarkaḷāl  teṉ intiyāviṟkut taḷḷappaṭṭu kiṟittava ūḻiyi oṭṭi aṅku kuṭiyēṟi irukkalām. eṉavē aṅku avarkaḷāl periya kaṭṭiṭakkaliyi uruvākki irukka muṭiyātu eṉṟu eṇṇukiṟārkaḷ.  itu tavaṟāṉa muṭipākum.  ki.mu.10000 ām āṇṭiṟku muṉpē tamiḻarkaḷ teṉ intiyāvil vāḻntu varukiṉṟārkaḷ.  avarkaḷ paḻaṅkaṟkālam putuk kaṟkālam, ulōka kālam aṉittiyum paṭittavarkaḷ.  avarkaḷiṟ cilar cumēriyāviṟkuṭiyēṟi, appāl cintu veḷikku vantu āriyarkaḷāl veruṭṭappaṭṭup piṉ teṟku nōkki vantu taṅkaḷ tāy iṉattōṭu vantu kalantu irukkalām eṉṟu karutukiṟēṉ.  teṉ intiyat tirāviṭa makkaḷ vaṭa intiyāvil kuṭiyēṟi irukkalām.  itu varalāṟṟu āciriyar vi.ār irāmac cantira aiyar pērāciriyar lāṅṭaṉ, ṭākṭar haṇṭar ṭākṭar eyc.ār.hāl pōṉṟavarkaḷ karuttumākum.
caṅka kālattilē tamiḻar kaṭṭiya kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷik kāṭṭa muṭiyāviṭṭālum eṇṇaṟṟa ilakkiyac cāṉṟukaḷik kāṭṭa muṭiyum.
kiṟittava ūḻikku muṉpē mutaṟcaṅkamum, tamiḻarum, tamiḻ moḻiyum tamiḻnāṭum, tamiḻ nākarikamum nilavi irunta pakuti kaṭaṟkōḷāl maṟintu pōṉati innāṭṭil vāḻum cila pulluruvi varkkam pōtiya cāṉṟu illi eṉṟu otukkit taḷḷi viṭukiṉṟaṉar.  mūvāyiram āṇṭukaṭku ivarkaḷ vētaṅkaḷum teyvaṅkaḷum, tēvarkaḷiṉ caṇṭiyum kiḷiyum, kaḻutiyum, kutiriyum, ciṅkamum, puliyum, yāṉiyum makkaḷip peṟṟa mākkatikaḷum purāṇap poymūṭṭikaṭkum cāṉṟu kāṭṭa muṭikiṟatu eṉṟu varuttattuṭaṉ kūṟa vēṇṭiyavaṉāka iruk
kiṉṟēṉ.
kumari muṉikku teṟkē, tamiḻnāṭu, kumari nāṭu, oḷi nāṭu eṉṉum peyarāl oru perum nilapparappu iruntatu eṉṟum aṅku pāṇṭiya maṉṉar āṭcipurintaṉar eṉṟum avarkaḷ niṟuviya mutaṟcaṅkamum caṅkattil uṟup peṟṟa uṟuppiṉarkaḷ peyarkaḷum aṅku araṅkēṟṟiya nūṟkaḷum akkālattil uḷḷa nāṭukaḷiṉ peyarkaḷum avarkaḷāl tōṟṟuvikkappaṭṭa vīṭukaḷum, araṇmaṉikaḷum, araṇkaḷum kōyilkaḷum uḷḷaṉa eṉpatu maṟukkaṟ pālataṉṟu.
naṭukalliṉ tōṟṟam
ātikālattil tamiḻ nāṭṭil tāy iṟantatum avaḷiṉ niṉivākavum, avaḷatu vaḻipāṭṭiṟkākavum naṭukal naṭappaṭṭatu.  appāl ciṟanta vīrarkaḷukkum naṭukal nāṭṭuvatum avarkaḷukku vaḻipāṭu ceyvatum eḻuntatu.  kaṟpuṭiya makaḷirkkum catikkal naṭuvatum pattiṉip paṭimam nāṭṭuvatum vaḻipaṭuvatum uṇṭu
kāṭci kālkōḷ nīrppaṭi naṭukal
cīrtta marapiṟ perumpaṭi vāḻtal
ṟirumūṉṟu vakiyiṟ kalloṭu puṇara -(tol.poruḷ 60)
eṉpatākum.
kōyilum vāḻkiyum
tamiḻarkaḷ kōyilit tam uyirāka eṇṇupavarkaḷ.  kōyili uṭal amippilē uruvākkiyuḷḷaṉar.  uṭampil uyirum, kōyilil iṟivaṉum iruppatāka makkaḷ eṇṇuvar.  makkaḷ eṅku kuṭiyēṟiṉum aṅku mutalil amippatu kōyilāka iruntatu.  kōyil illā ūril kuṭiyirukka vēṇṭām eṉpatu avarkaḷ kaṇṭa mutumoḻi.  itu avarkaḷ kaṇṭa mantiramum ākum.  tamiḻ makkaḷ kōyil illāta ūr tiruvuṭiya ūr ākā eṉṟu eṇṇiṉar.  oru ūr amippiṟkuk kōyili miyamāka (kēntiramāka)t tamiḻar koṇṭaṉar.  kōyili ūr naṭuvil amittu  ataṉ nāṉku puṟamum caturamāka nāṉku terukkaḷi amittu avikaḷi māṭa vīti eṉṟu aḻittaṉar.  ataṟku appāl nāṉku periya terukkaḷi amittu tērōṭum teru (ētavīti) eṉṟu aḻittaṉar.  ivvāṟu kōyili miyamāka amittu caturam caturamāka terukkaḷi amippatu paṇṭik
kāla makkaḷiṉ nalla nakariṉ amippu muṟiyāka iruntatu.  maturi mānakar inta amippu muṟiyi aṭuttē amikkappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
kōyil illāta ūrkaḷ nalla nakar ākā.  atu koṭiya vilaṅkukaḷ vāḻum kāṭṭiṟkuc camam ākum.  kōyil illā ūrkaḷil vāḻum makkaḷ naṟpaṇpukaḷiyum nalla paḻakka vaḻakkaṅkaḷiyum peṟa muṭiyātu eṉṟu nampiṉar.
tiruk kōyil illāta tiruvilūrum
    tiruveṇṇī raṇiyāta tiruvilūrum
paruk kōṭip pattimiyāṟ pāṭā vūrum
    pāṅkiṉoṭu palatuḷikaḷ illāvūrum
virup pōṭu veṇ caṅkam ūtā vūrum
    vimāṉamum veṇkoṭiyum illā vūrum
aruppōṭu malarpaṟit tiṭṭuṇṇā vūrum
    avi yellām ūralla aṭavi kāṭē
eṉṟu kūṟum tiruttāṇṭakam namatu karutti valiyuṟuttuvatāka miḷirkiṉṟatu.
tamiḻ makkaḷ
tirukkōyilkaḷi, mikat toṉmiyāṉa kālattilē iyaṟki eḻil iyinta kuṉṟukaḷilum kuṉṟiṉ aṭi vārattilum, kuḷakkariyilum, āṟṟaṅkariyilum kaṭaṟkariyilum, cōli kaḷiṉ naṭuvilum, amittaṉar.  kōyil makkaḷ aṉivarum  oṉṟu kūṭum iṭamāka amikkappaṭṭatu.  kōyilkaḷil āṟukālap pūci naṭipeṟṟatu.  makkaḷ tavaṟātu pūcikkuc celvar.
makkaḷ kāli māli uṭaṟṟūymi ceyyavum kōyilkaḷiṉ uṭpukum poḻutu kikāl, mukam mutaliya uṟuppukaḷi kaḻuvic cellavum  kōyilkaḷōṭu kuḷamum amittiruntaṉar.
 kōyilkaḷil makkaḷukkup piracātam eṉṉum peyarāl uṇavu vaḻaṅkappaṭṭatu.  kuṟinta celavil atika aḷavu cōṟum viṟkappaṭṭatu.  carkkarip poṅkal, puḷiyōtari, tayirc cātam, tōci, vaṭi, atiracam pōṉṟavikaḷ aṉivarukkum vaḻaṅkappaṭṭatu.  iṉṟum viṟkappaṭṭu varukiṟatu.  cukku vennīr, pāṉakkāram pōṉṟa kuṭinīrkaḷum pālum vaḻaṅkappaṭṭaṉa.  tīrttam eṉṉum peyarāl taṇṇīrum aḷikkappaṭṭatu.  cantaṉam, paṉṉīr vaḻaṅkappaṭṭaṉa.  cāmpirāṇi, kaṟpūram mutaliya naṟumaṇap pukikaḷum kāṭṭappaṭṭaṉa. 
kōyilkaḷ kaṭṭiṭak kalikkum, cili, paṭimam, ōviyam ākiya kalikaḷukkum nalla ūṟṟāka iruntatu.  āṭikaḷ aṇikaḷ, maṇikaḷ mutaliyavikaḷip pēṇip pātukākkum tāyakamāy amintaṉa.  iciyum nāṭṭiyamum vaḷarkkum māmaṉṟamākak kāṭci nalkiyatu.  aṅku yāḻ, vīṇi, muḻavu, nātacuram, vīṇi, tavil, uṭukki pāṇi, takki mutaliya karuvikaḷ mīṭṭappaṭṭu vantaṉa.  potumakkaḷukku kōyilkaḷ kalik karuvūlamāka eḻuntaṉa.  araṇmaṉiyi viṭa kōyilkaḷ uḷḷattil aṉpum, aruḷum, amitiyum, iṉpamum, eḻucciyum aḷikkum iṉpa puriyāy viḷaṅkiṉa.
tamiḻakattilē kaṟkālattiṟku muṉpē teyva vaḻipāṭu tuḷirttuḷḷatu.  ātiyil makkaḷ tāyi vaḻipaṭat toṭaṅkiṉar.  tāy iṟanta piṉ avaḷ putikkappaṭṭa iṭattil oru marattuṇṭiyō kalliyō naṭṭu vaḻipaṭat toṭaṅkiṉar.
kaṟkālam toṭaṅku muṉpē, makkaḷ mutirāp paṇpuṭiya mutumakkaḷāy vāḻum poḻutē iṭi,miṉṉal, kāṟṟu, neruppu mutaliyavaṟṟik kaṇṭañciṉar.  avaṟṟit toḻutaṉar.  appāl ñāyiṟu, tiṅkaḷ, cevvāy mutaliya kōḷkaḷi vaḻipaṭṭaṉar.  piṉ iravilum, iruṭṭilum, kārkālaṅkaḷilum tī, viḷakku ñāyiṟu pōṉṟa muccuṭar vaḻipāṭṭit toṭaṅkiṉar.  muttī vaḻipāṭṭiliruntutāṉ kantu vaḻipāṭum iliṅka vaḻipāṭum tōṟṟam peṟṟaṉa.
makkaḷ nākarika vaḷarcciyil vīṭukaḷum araṇmaṉikaḷum amitta kālattil iṟivaṉ uṟiviṭam eṉṟu kōyilkaḷ amikka muṟpaṭṭaṉar 
	(māṇikka vācakar kālamum varalāṟum-maṟimali aṭikaḷ)
viṇṇil uḷḷa kōḷkaḷi maṇṇil vaḻipaṭa makkaḷ mutalil neruppu, viḷakku mutaliyavikaḷip payaṉpaṭuttiṉar.  appāl avaṟṟiṟku tiruuruvam amittu vaḻipaṭalāyiṉar.
tamiḻar kaṇṭa oḷi vaḻipāṭu ulaka meṅkum paraviyatu.  ellā camayattiṟkum oḷi vaḻipāṭu mūlavaḻipāṭāy uyarntatu.  makkaḷiṉ aṟivu vaḷarcciyil ataṟkup periya tattuvap poruḷkaḷ kūṟappaṭṭaṉa.  makkaḷiṉ aṟivu vaḷara vaḷara teyvaṅkaḷiṉ taṉmiyum ciṟappum uyarntaṉa.
caṅka kālattilē tamiḻakattil kaṟkōyilkaḷē illi.  ceṅkaṟkaḷālum cuṇṇāmpiṉālum kaṭṭappaṭṭa kūrik kōyilkaḷē iruntaṉa.  antac ceṅkaṟ kaṭṭiṭak kōyilkaḷ kūṭi appoḻutu eḻunta taṭpa veppa nilikaḷit tāṅka muṭiyātu carintaṉa.  makkaḷāl ceppaṉiṭa muṭiyavilli.  avikaḷik kaṇṇuṟṟa caṅka kālap pulavar uruttiraṅ kaṇṇār iṭintu citintu vīḻntu kiṭakkum tirukkōyilik kaṇṭu maṉam poṟātu,
iṭṭiki neṭuñcuvar viṭṭam vīḻnteṉa
maṇippuṟāt tuṟanta marañcēr māṭattu,
eḻutaṇi kaṭavuḷ pōka viṟ pulleṉṟu
oḻuku pali maṟanta meḻukāp puṉṟiṇi
eṉṟu pāṭip pulampiyuḷḷār.
itaṟkappālum ki.pi.6 ām nūṟṟāṇṭu vari kōc ceṅkeṭ cōḻaṉ pōṉṟa paktarkaḷ civa perumāṉukkum tirumālukkum eḻupatu kōyilkaḷik kaṭṭiyuḷḷāṉ.  appāl cilar civaperumāṉukkuc cila vaki kōyilkaḷik kaṭṭi
uḷḷaṉar.
ivikaḷ ellām ceṅkaṟkaḷāl cuṇṇac cāntu koṇṭu pūcik kaṭṭappaṭṭa kōyilkaḷēyākum.  tamiḻ nāṭṭil iṉṟu peritum kaṟ kōyilkaḷākavē māṟi varukiṉṟaṉa.  āṉāl kalkaḷ ērāḷamāka kiṭikkum kēraḷattil, annāṭṭu makkaḷ iti marapu vaḻakkākak koṇṭu kūrik kōyilkaḷiyum kaṟkaḷāl maṭṭap
pāy pōṭṭa caturam,vaṭṭam, arivaṭṭam pōṉṟa vaṭivil kaṭṭiyuḷḷaṉar. 
kūrik kōyilkaḷ
caṅka kālattil tamiḻakattil kaṭṭap peṟṟa kōyilkaḷ oṉṟik kūṭap pārppatu aritāy viṭṭatu.  āṉāl kēraḷattil caṅka kālakkōyilkaḷ cilavaṟṟik kāṇa muṭiyum eṉṟu cilar kūṟukiṉṟaṉar.  kēraḷattila pala kūrik kōyilkaḷ iṉṟum uḷḷaṉa.  avikaḷi caṅka kālak kōyil eṉṟu nīṅkaḷ ēṟkāviṭiṉum caṅka kālattil nilaviya kōyilkaḷiṉ mātirik kōyilkaḷ eṉpati uṟutiyāka ēṟṟuk koḷḷalām.
caṅka kālattil tamiḻ nāṭṭil kaṟkōyilkaḷē kiṭiyātu.  perumpālum kūrik kōyilkaḷē uḷḷaṉa.  caṅka kālattil kōyilkaḷ nāṟ puṟamum maṇcuvar eḻuppi, mēlē marak kaṭṭikaḷum caṭṭaṅkaḷum vittuk  kaṭṭi maṭṭikaḷāl kaṭṭikaḷ mītu paṭṭiyal pōl paṉi nārkaḷāl kaṭṭappaṭṭu mēlē paṉi
yōli, teṉṉi ōli, taṭṭi cukku nāri pul mutaliyavikaḷ vēyap peṟṟa kūrik kōyilē eṅkum iṭam peṟṟiruntaṉa.
appāl nāṟpuṟamum marakkālkaḷi nāṭṭi, mēlē palakikaḷ vittu āṇi aṭittuṭṭu mēlē palakikaḷik koṇṭu kūriyāka vēynta kōyilkaḷ eṭuppikkappaṭṭaṉa.
caṅka kālattilē nalla nākarikam eḻunta piṉ nāṟpuṟamum ceṅkaṟkaḷ vittu cuṇṇac cāntu iṭi iṭiyē vittuk kaṭṭi mēlē marac caṭṭaṅkaḷum, viṭṭaṅkaḷum, malkikaḷum paṭṭiyalkaḷum, palakikaḷum aṭikkappaṭṭa kōyilkaḷ eḻuntaṉa.  cuvarkaḷ mītu cuṇṇac cāntu pūcap paṭṭatu.  mēlē pala kōyilkaḷil palakikaḷ mītu ceṅkaṟtuṇṭukaḷum cuṇṇac cāntukaḷum viravi virikkappaṭṭu mēlē kaṉamāṉa cuṇṇac cāntu koṇṭu meḻuki veyyilukkum maḻikkum tāṅkumvaṇṇam ceyyappaṭṭatu.
iṟutiyāka, caṭṭamum, viṭṭamum pala kikaḷum vittu irumpu āṇi aṭittu paṭṭiyalkaḷ iṇittu mēlē ōṭu pōṭum nili eḻuntatu.  iṉṟum pala kukkirāmaṅkaḷil ōṭu pōṭappaṭṭa kōyilkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  keṭṭup pōṉālum aṭikkaṭi paḻutu pārkkappaṭṭu varukiṉṟaṉa.
tamiḻakattil caṅkakālattil nilaviya kōyilkaḷip pōṉṟa kūrik kōyilkaḷ iṉṟum kēraḷa nāṭṭil pala uḷḷaṉa.  ciṟcila amippukaḷ vēṟupaṭṭatāka iruntālum potuvāka oru amippuṭiyatāka iruntirukka vēṇṭum eṉṟu eṇṇap
paṭukiṟatu.  iṉṟu tamiḻ nāṭṭuk kōyilkaḷi itu pāṇṭiya nāṭṭup pāṇi, itu cōḻa nāṭṭup pāṇi, itu pallavar nāṭṭup pāṇi, itu nāyakkar nāṭṭup pāṇi, eṉṟu kūṟuvatu pōl paṇṭik kālattil cērar nāṭṭup pāṇi eṉṟu cila putiya amippukaḷiyum alaṅkāraṅkaḷiyum cēra nāṭṭuk kōyilkaḷ peṟṟirukkalām.
mēlum, makkaḷiṉ perukkamum, cūḻnilikaḷum poruḷātārac 
ceḻippum cōḻa, pāṇṭiya, toṇṭi nāṭṭuk kōyilkaḷil cēra nāṭṭuk kōyilkaḷi viṭa pala putiya amippukaḷi eḻuppiyuḷḷaṉa. uyarnta matilkaḷ, vāṉ aḷāviya kōpuraṅkaḷ, kār mukilkaḷ tavaḻum uyariya vimāṉaṅkaḷ maṇi maṇṭapam, makā maṇṭapam, maṇa maṇṭapam, vacanta maṇṭapam, 108 kāl maṇṭapam, 1008 kāl maṇṭapaṅkaḷ, teppak kuḷaṅkaḷ, pōṉṟa pala māṟṟaṅ
kaḷi eḻuppiyuḷḷaṉa.
iṅku kāṭṭappaṭṭa tiruccūr kōyil pōṉṟa oṉṟiraṇṭu kōyilkaḷ tāṉ paṇṭiyac caṅka kālak kōyilkaḷōṭu oppiṭṭu nōkkalām.  iḵtaṉṟi viḻiñam eṉṉum iṭattiluḷḷa 9-ām nūṟṟāṇṭil kaṭṭap paṭṭa kōyil cōḻar pāṇiyil tiru uṇṇāḻikiyum muka maṇṭapamum uṭiyatāy uḷḷatu.  10-ām nuṟṟāṇṭil kaṉṉiyākumariyil eṭuppikkappaṭṭa kukanāta cuvāmi kōyilum 9-ām nūṟṟāṇṭil eḻuppap peṟṟa pārttiva cēkarapuram kōyilum, 16 -ām nūṟṟāṇṭil uruppaṭuttappaṭṭa cucīntiram kōyilum 13 -ām nūṟṟāṇṭil kaṭṭappaṭṭa tiruvallam ari vaṭṭak kōyilākiya paracurāmar kōyilum, 14-ām nūṟṟāṇṭil kaṭṭappaṭṭa nirmaṅkarāvil uḷḷa vaṭṭa vaṭivilāṉa kōyilum 16- ām nūṟṟāṇṭil valiya utiyāticca puram kōyilum ivikaḷ pōṉṟu cilavum tamiḻ nāṭṭilum, micūr mānilattilum uḷḷa iṉṟiyak kōyilkaḷiṉ pāṇiyil uḷḷaṉa.
kēraḷāvil kaṭṭappaṭṭa kōyilkaḷ ellām tirāviṭap pāṇiyil kaṭṭappaṭṭa kōyilkaḷēyākum.  aṅku tiru uṇṇāḻiki (karuvaṟi) cirikōyil eṉṟu kūṟappaṭum.  aṅkuḷḷa kōyilkaḷiṉ karuvaṟi perumpālum catura vaṭivilē uḷḷaṉa.  ari vaṭṭam, vaṭṭam, caturam nīṇṭa catura vaṭivil iruntālum marakkaṭṭikaḷāl kaṭṭappaṭṭu irumal kaṭṭikaḷ kūmpiya vaṭivil aṭukkaṭukkāy vittu paṭṭiyalkaḷ vittu aṭittu mēlē ōṭukaḷ vēyap peṟṟirukkum kūrikaḷ mukkōṇa vaṭivil irukkum.  cirikōyiliṉ (tiru uṇṇāḻikiyiṉ)  mēṟ kūriyiṉ tōṟṟam akaṉṟa kūmpiya vaṭivil irukkum.  ataṉ aṇmiyil uḷḷa iṭaṅkaḷiṉ (Halls) kūrikaḷ mukkōṇa vaṭivil nīḷ catura vaṭivil irukkum.  maḻit taṇṇīr uṭpukātu eḷitil veḷiyē celvataṟku ēṟṟatāka amikkappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  
kēraḷāvil uḷḷa kūrikkōyil cila tamiḻ nāṭṭil uḷḷa cātāraṇa vīṭukaḷ pōl uḷḷaṉa.  cila-atāvatu eṭṭamaṉūr kōyil muṉpuṟam ōṭu pōṭṭa tāḻvāramum appāl uyaramāṉa oru taṭṭuḷḷa kūriyum uḷḷaṉa.  iti vimāṉam eṉṟu kūṟukiṟārkaḷ.  oṉṟiṉ mēl oṉṟāka iraṇṭu kōppuḷḷa kōyili iraṇṭu vimāṉam allatu iraṇṭu māṭik kōyil eṉkiṉṟaṉar.  tiru uṇṇāḻikiyiṉ muṉ uḷḷa paṭik kaṭṭukaḷ cōpāṉam eṉappaṭum.  kēraḷak kōyiliṉ muṉ, namakāra maṇṭapamum ati aṭuttu nālampalam eṉṉum uṟuppum ataṉi aṭuttu palikkal (palipīṭam) koṭi maram ākiya pākaṅkaḷ amintirukkum.  koṭi marattiṉ arukē yāṉik koṭṭilkaḷ iṭam peṟṟirukkum.  kōyilkaḷ aṉittum tirāviṭa ciṟpa muṟiyil kaṭṭap
paṭṭatēyākum.1
marakkōyilkaḷ
muṟkālattil tamiḻ nāṭṭil eṅkum marattiṉāl kōyilkaḷ kaṭṭappaṭṭaṉa.  maṇkōyili viṭa marakkōyil ciṟappuṭiyatāy iruntaṉa.  maṇṇi viṭa ōliyi viṭa maram uṟuti vāyntatāyum maḻi veyyil kāṟṟu mutaliyavikaḷi nīṇṭakālam tāṅkum cakti vāyntatāyum iruntatu.  atōṭu maṇṇi viṭa atika uṟutiyāṉa aḻakiya nuṇṇiya ciṟpa  vaṭivaṅkaḷi marattiṉāl ceyvatu eḷitāka iruntatu.  kallip pōṉṟa karuṅkāli marattiṉāl ceyyappaṭṭa tiru uruvaṅkaḷum tēkkiṉāl ceyyap
paṭṭa tiru uruvaṅkaḷum  nīṇṭa nāḷ keṭātiruntu vantaṉa.  5000 ām āṇṭiṟku muṉ maṇṇil putintuḷḷa intiya tēkku marattuṇṭu cumēriya nāṭṭil kaṇṭeṭukkappaṭṭu iṉṟum poṉṟātu iruntu varuvatu kaṇṭu ulakam viyappil āḻntuḷḷatu.  iṉṟiyak kēraḷa nāṭṭil muṟkālattil marattāl kaṭṭap peṟṟa kōyilkaḷi eṅkum kāṇalām.  citamparattil uḷḷāṭa vallāṉ capānātar maṇṭapam marattiṉālē ceyyappaṭṭatu.  iṉṟum appaṭiyē kāṭci aḷikkiṟatu.  citamparattilē uḷḷa ūrttuva
tāṇṭava mūrttiyiṉ kōyil ātiyilē marattiṉālē kaṭṭap peṟṟiruntatu.  appāl atu karuṅkallāl kaṭṭappaṭṭatu eṉṟālum ataṉ tūṇkaḷum, kūri mutaliya amippukaḷ marattiṉālē amikkappaṭṭatāy iruppatu atu paḻiya marakkōyil eṉpati meyppippatāyk kāṇappaṭukiṟatu.  citamparam āṭavallāṉ kōyiliṉ paḻiya kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ aṉittum ātiyil marattiṉālum amikkap paṭṭiruntatu eṉpatil aṇuvaḷavum aiyam illi.  muṟkālattil eṅkum marakkōyilkaḷē nilaviṉa eṉpataṟku itu ēṟṟa eṭuttuk kāṭṭākum.  piṟkālattil kōyilkaḷ karuṅkallil amikkap paṭṭaṉa eṉṟālum, marattic cetukki amikkappaṭṭatu pōṉṟa amippukaḷi kaṟkōyililē kāṇappaṭuvatu namatu karutti araṇ ceyvatāka amintuḷḷatu.  
marak kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ taṭpa veppa niliyiṉāl tākkuṇṭu virivil paḻutuṇṭu aḻintu viṭum.  intat tākkutalāl mukkiyamāka marattiṉālāṉa mēṟkūriyē peritum tāṅki aḻiyum.  ākavē marak kūri eḷitil paḻutuṟāta vaṇṇam kūriyiṉ mītu muṟkāla makkaḷ cemput takaṭukaḷi vēyntu vantaṉar. cemput takaṭu maratti viṭa nīṇṭa kālam maḻi veyyil kāṟṟu mutaliyavikaḷit tāṅki paḻutuṟātu iruntu vantaṉa.
āṭa vallāṉ kōyilil mikap paḻamiyāṉatu tiru nelvēliyil uḷḷa muṉitāṇṭava mūrttiyiṉ ampalamēyākum.  ittāṇṭava mūrtti paṭipput toḻilik kāṭṭum kāḷi kātāṇṭava mūrtti eṉṟum kūṟuvar.  intat tāṇṭava mūrtti āṭiya nirutta capi cempu ampalam allatu ceppaṟi eṉṟu kūṟappaṭum.  ātiyil makkaḷ poruḷātāra nili kuṉṟiya kālattil eḻunta ampalamāka iruppatāl inta capi tūṇkaḷum, uttaraṅ
kaḷum, caṭṭaṅkaḷum, viṭṭaṅkaḷum, malkikaḷum paṭṭiyalkaḷum marattiṉāl ceytu mēṟ kūri marattiṉāl amittu mēlē cemput takaṭṭi vēyntaṉar.  ataṉāl inta nirutta capi tāmpira capi eṉṟu aḻikkappaṭṭatu.
tamiḻnāṭṭil āṭavallāṉ āṭiya capikaḷ aintu tōṉṟiyatu. (1) nelliyil uḷḷa tāmpira capi, (2) maturiyil uḷḷa iracita capi (veḷḷiyampalam) (3) tirukkuṟṟālattil uḷḷa cittira capi (4)tiruvālaṅkāṭṭil uḷḷa irattiṉa capi (5) tilliyil uḷḷa poṉṉampalam eṉpar.  nelliyi aṭuttu ellā ampalaṅkaḷum ātiyil marattiṉālē amikkappaṭṭu appāl aracarkaḷāl kūrikaḷ veḷḷit takaṭukaḷum, poṉ takaṭukaḷum vēyappaṭṭaṉa.
ceṅkal kaṭṭiṭam
maraṅkaḷ oru cila āṇṭukaḷilum maḻiyālum veyyilā lum kāṟṟālum paḻutaṭivati eṇṇiyum eḷitil tīppiṭittuk koḷvati uṇarntum iṟivaṉ uṟiyum illam uṟuti uṭiyatāy irukka vēṇṭum eṉpatik karuti ceṅkalliṉālum cuṇṇāmpiṉālum kōyilkaḷ kaṭṭat toṭaṅkiṉar.  ceṅkaṟ kōyilkaḷ maṇkōyilkaḷi viṭa, marak kōyilkaḷē neṭunāḷ uṟutiyāka iruntaṉa.  āṉālum ceṅkaṟ kōyilkaḷ taṭpa veppaṅkaḷi oru nūṟṟāṇṭiṟku mēl tāṅkak kūṭiyatāka illi.  ceṅkallāl kaṭṭiya kōyilkaḷ muṉṉūṟu nāṉūṟu āṇṭukaḷukku mēl eṅkum nīṭittu niṟkavilli.  ki.pi.600-kku mēl tamiḻ nāṭṭil eṭuppikkappaṭṭa kōyilkaḷ aṉittum ceṅkaṟkaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷēyākum.  avikaḷ aṭikkaṭi paḻutu pārkka vēṇṭivikaḷāka iruntaṉa.  paḻutu pārttu vantālum āṟu nūṟṟāṇṭiṟku mēl avaṟṟāl nilittu niṟka muṭiya villi.  kallip pōl cuṭumaṇ ceṅkalkaḷ taṭpa veppa nilikaḷi etirttu niṟka muṭiyavilli.  kaṭaṟkarikaḷil uḷḷa kōyil cuvariṉ uppuk kāṟṟiṉāl poṭippaṭiyāki utirntu viḻuntu kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ cāyntuḷḷaṉa.
iṉṟu tiruccentūril uḷḷa murukaṉ kōyil eṉṟu kūṟappaṭuvatu ātiyil civaṉ kōyilāka iruntatu.  tiruccentūr cācaṉaṅkaḷ ikkōyili uṭiyavar (civaṉ) kōyil eṉṟē kūṟukiṉṟaṉa.  civaṉ kōyilil irunta iliṅkatti oru puṟam (iṉṟiya murukaṉ kōyil tiru uṇṇāḻikikkup piṉpuṟam, otukki vittu viṭṭu inta murukaṉ kōyilip putitāy eḻuppiyuḷḷaṉar.  kaṭal arukē iruppatāl kaṭaliṉ uppuk kāṟṟāl paḻiya kōyiliṉ kaṟkaḷ kūṭa uvar paṭṭu kal tūḷ tūḷāka utirntu tēyntu pōṉatik kāṇa muṭiyum.	
kōyil amippum uṟuppum
namatu kaṭṭiṭak kali iṉṟu, nēṟṟu ēṟpaṭṭa oru kali alla.  aiyāyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ tōṉṟi paṭṭaṟivāl uṟutiyum uyarvum aḻakum, vacatiyum uḷḷatāy amikkap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  namatu kōyil kaṭṭiṭak kali ākamaṅkaḷi aṭippaṭiyākak koṇṭatu.  civākamaṅkaḷ irupatteṭṭu.   ivi muṟiyē (1) kāmi (2) yōkacam (3) cintiyam (4) kāraṇam (5) acitam (6) tīpattam (7) cūkkumam (8) cattiram (9) añcumāṉ (10) cuppirapētakam (11) vicayam (12) vicuvācam (13) cuvāyam puvam (14) aṉalam (15) vīram (16) iruparam (17) makuṭam (18) vimalam (19) cantira ñāṉam (20) vimapam (21) purōṟ kītam (22) ilaḷitam (23) cittam (24) cantāṉa caruvōttam (25) pāramēccuram (26) kīraṇam (27) pētam (28) vātuḷam eṉappaṭum.
iḵtaṉṟi pañcarātrā ākamaṅkaḷum, cākta ākamaṅkaḷum uḷḷaṉa.
namatu tirukkōyilkaḷ ākamaṅkaḷiṉ aṭippaṭiyilē, amikkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  pūci muṟikaḷum, mantiraṅkaḷum, ākama vitippaṭiyē ceyyap peṟṟu varukiṉṟaṉa.  civa neṟikkum civarkaḷukkum ākamamē muṭivāṉa caṭṭa nūl.  ataṟku muraṇāka etuvum naṭi peṟuvatu muṟi kēṭāṉatu.
uṟuppukaḷ
namatu civākamaṅkaḷum ciṟpa nūṟkaḷum kōyil kaṭṭuvataṟku nilam eppaṭi irukka vēṇṭum, eppaṭik kaṭṭa vēṇṭum eṉṟu virivāka eṭuttuk kūṟukiṉṟaṉa.  avikaḷip paṟṟi iṅku virivāka viḷakka innūl iṭantarātatāl curukkamāka āṉāl teḷivāka iṅku āyvōm.
kōyil kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷi ākamaṅkaḷ āṟu pirivākap pirikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  avi 1 atirṣṭāṉam 2 pātam 3 mañcam 4 kaṇṭam 5 paṇṭiki 6 tūpi eṉappaṭum.  ivikaḷit tamiḻil, 1 aṭi, 2 uṭal 3 tōḷ 4 kaḻuttu 5 tali eṉṟu kūṟappaṭum.
1. atirṣṭāṉam
itaṟku aṭi, nilam, talam, pūmi ātāram, macūkam pōṉṟa peyarkaḷ uṇṭu.
2. pātam
itaṟku uṭal, uṇṇāḻiki (aka nāḷiki) kāl, pātam, kampam tampam eṉṟa peyarkaḷ uṇṭu.  ippeyarkaḷ uṇṇāḻikiyiṉic cūḻntirukkum cuvarkaḷi kuṟikkiṉṟaṉa.
3. mañcam
itu tōḷ, taḷavarici piratāram, kapōtam pōṉṟa peyarkaḷi uṭiyatu.
4. kaṇṭam
itu kaḻuttu, karṇam, mutaliya peyarkaḷip peṟṟuḷḷatu.
5. paṇṭiki
itu tali, kūri, ciram, cikaram, paṇṭiki, matakam pōṉṟa peyarkaḷāl aḻikkap peṟum. 
6. tūpi
itu muṭi, tūpi, kalacam(kalayam), ciki, cūḷam, ucci mutaliya peyarkaḷāl aḻikkappaṭum.
tirukkōyil kaṭṭiṭattil irukkavēṇṭiya inta āṟu uṟuppukaḷum makkaḷ uṭalil kāṇappaṭum aṭi(pātam) uṭal, tōḷ, kaḻuttu, tali, muṭi (ucci) eṉṉum uṟuppukaḷi aṭippaṭiyāka vittē peyarkaḷ amikkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
maṉitaṉ, mēṟkē tali vittu, kiḻakkē kāl nīṭṭi mallāntu paṭuttiruppatik kāṭṭuvatu namatu tirukkōyiliṉ tiru uṇṇāḻiki (mūlatāṉam) mutal vāyil kōpuram variyuḷḷa pakuti.  (paṭam 1 pārkka)  eṭṭuc cāṇ aḷavuḷḷa eḻil uṭampiṟkuc ciracē piratāṉam eṉpatu pōṉṟu namatu tirukkōyilkaḷukku tiru uṇṇāḻiki (karuvaṟi) mukam.  artta maṇṭapam kaḻuttu; tuvāra pālakarkaḷ (vāyiṟ kāvalarkaḷ niṟkum iṭaṅkaḷ makkaḷ uṭaliṉik kāval puriyum iru tōḷkaḷ; koṭi maram (tuvajatampam) variyuḷḷa pakuti iṭuppiṟkum tōḷukkum iṭiyēyuḷḷa uṭampākum; iṉi koṭi mara nili kutāṉamākavum, koṭi maram mutukut taṇṭākavum, kuṭivari vāyiṟ kōpuram uyarntu niṟkum pātaṅkaḷ; eṉṟu civākamaṅkaḷ uruvakappaṭuttik kāṭṭukiṉṟaṉa.  uṭali uṭampu aṉṉatti uṇṭu vaḷarntu nili peṟṟiruppatāl aṉṉamaya kōcam aṉi uṭampu eṉappaṭum.  uṭal aimporuḷkaḷik koṇṭu iyaṅkuvatāl tūla uṭampu eṉṟum kūṟappaṭum.
civālayaṅkaḷ perumpālum kiḻakku nōkkiyē irukkum.  ataṟku, nāṉku ticikaḷilum matil vāyilkaḷ iruppiṉum kōyil pukuntu vaḻipaṭac celpavar kiḻakku vāyil vaḻiyē celvatu muṟi.  kiḻakkiliruntu varupavaṉ mutalāvatu kāṇpatu paṭuttirup
pavaṉuṭiya pātaṅkaḷēyām.  aviyē paṭuttiruppavaṉ uṭampil kūṭutalāka uyarntirukkum uṟuppukaḷ.  ataṉāl muṉ kōpuraṅkaḷ kōvil caṟṟu uyaramākak kaṭṭappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  kōpuratti naṭuvil kaṭṭātu mukappil kaṭṭiyiruppatu intak karuttik koṇṭēyākum.  mūlatāṉattiṟku mēl uḷḷa vimāṉam maṉitaṉuṭiya pirammarantiram eṉṟa cakarārac cakkarattiṉ aṟikuṟiyāka irukkiṟatu.  accakkaram āyiram itaḻkaḷiyuṭiya iraṇṭaṭukkut tāmari malar pōṉṟatu.  inta aṭippaṭiyilē vimāṉaṅkaḷ amikkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  atika uyaramiṉṟi tāmari malar vaṭivil periya kōyilkaḷ poṟṟa kaṭṭāl kūri vēyappaṭṭu oḷi vīcuvatu, civaṉ muttaṉuṭiya cakarāram pōṉṟu oḷi vīcum.  tirumūlar tamiḻakattiṉ tali ciṟanta cittar.  avar eḻutiya tirumantiram tamiḻ ākamam ākum.  atil uṭalil uyir vāḻvatum uyiriṉukkuyirāy uṭiyavaṉ iruppatiyum uṇartta uṭampiṉ amippil iṟi illam-tirukkōyil amikkap peṟṟatu eṉṟu ulakiṟku uṇarttu kiṉṟār.
uṭampiṉi muṉṉam iḻukkeṉṟu iruntēṉ
uṭampiṉuk kuḷḷē uṟu poruḷ kaṇṭēṉ
uṭampuḷē uttamaṉ kōyil koṇṭāṉ eṉṟu
uṭampiṉi yāṉ iruntu ōmpukiṉṟēṉē - tirumantiram
uḷḷam peruṅkōyil ūṇ uṭampu ālayam
vaḷḷal pirāṉārkku vāykō puravācal
teḷḷat teḷintārkkuc civaṉ civaliṅkam
kaḷḷap pulaṉ aintum kāḷā maṇi viḷakkē 
						 - tirumantiram 1792
uṭampil uḷḷa uṟuppukaḷ oru aḷaviṟku uṭpaṭṭiruppatu pōl kōyilil uḷḷa uṟuppukaḷukkum aḷavukaḷ aḷikkap paṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  anta aḷavukaḷ namatu camayac cāṉṟōrkaḷāl mika uyariya tattuva muṟippaṭi tērntu teḷintu tarap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  avikaḷ aṭiyil varumāṟākum;
1.  atirṣṭāṉam (aṭi) 	uyaram 1-paṅku
2.  pātam (uṭal)	uyaram 2 paṅku
3.  mañcam (tōḷ)	uyaram 1 paṅku
4.  kaṇṭam (kaḻuttu)	uyaram 1 paṅku
5.  paṇṭiki (tali)	uyaram 2 paṅku
6.  tūpi (muṭi)	uyaram 1 paṅku
inta aḷavukaḷ oru niliyi uṭiya kōyilkaḷukku uriyaṉa.  iḵtaṉṟi vēṟu aḷavikaḷi aṭippaṭiyākak koṇṭu oru nilik kōyil amippatum uṇṭu.  cila ciṟpa nūṟkaḷil pala nilikaḷiyuṭiya kōyilkaḷum palavita aḷavikaḷum tarap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
amippu
1.  iraṇṭu nilik kōyilkaḷ piṉvarum amippukaḷi aṭippaṭiyākak koṇṭu amikkap peṟuvatākum 1) tari 2) cuvar 3) taḷavarici 4) cuvar 5) taḷavarici 6) kaḻuttu 7) kūri 8) kalayam
2. mūṉṟu nilik kōyilkaḷ, aṭiyil varum amippukaḷi aṭippaṭiyākak koṇṭu amikkap peṟuvatākum: 1) tari 2) cuvar 3) taḷavarici 4) cuvar 5) taḷavarici 6) cuvar 7) taḷavarici 8) kaḻuttu 9) kūri 10) kalacam.
iḵtaṉṟi iṉṉum pala amippukaḷum ciṟpa nūṟkaḷil eṭuttuk kāṭṭap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
kōyilkaḷ 1) cuttam 2) micuram 3) caṅkīraṇam eṉṟu mūṉṟu vakiyāka kaṭṭap peṟukiṉṟaṉa.  1) cuttam muḻuvatum marattiṉālō ceṅkalliṉālō, kalliṉālō kaṭṭappaṭuvatu.  2) miciram, iraṇṭu poruḷkaḷic cērttu kaṭṭappaṭuvatu.  3) iraṇṭiṟku mēṟpaṭṭa poruḷkaḷic cērttuk kaṭṭappaṭuvatu  caṅkīraṇam
kōyil, vimāṉam 1) atirṣṭāṉam, 2) pātam, 3) mañcam, 4) kaṇṭam 5) paṇṭiki  6) tūpi eṉṟa āṟu uṟuppukaḷ iruppatu paṟṟi mēlē kūṟiyuḷḷōm.   inta āṟu uṟuppukaḷ ovvoṉṟum pala tuṇi uṟuppukaḷi uṭiyatāka irukkiṉṟaṉa.  avi aṭiyil varumāṟu;
1. atirṣṭāṉam (aṭi)
1) tuṇi uṟuppukaḷāvaṉa: 1) pirattāṉam 2) upāṉam 3) makāpatmam 4) palaki 5) atōpatmam 6) kumutam 7) kavōnta patmam 8) tukkōṭu 9) vētiki 10) kaṇṭap parappu 11) kaṇṭam 12) kaṇṭa vētiki 13) cekati
2. tampam (tiruuṇṇāḻiki)
1. vētiki 2. nāka pantam, 3. kāl, 4. kalacam, 5. kuṭam, 6. palaki - pōtiki (ivi tūṇiṉ uṟuppukaḷ)
3. piratāram (tōḷ)
1. uttiram 2. eḻutakam 3. kapōtakam 4. yāḷam eṉappaṭum.
4. kaṇṭam (kaḻuttu)
1. vētiki 2. kāl 3. pōtiki 4. paṇṭiki 5. kalacam itil pañcarak kūṭu miyacāli, pañcaram karṇak kūṭu ākiyavikaḷu muṇṭu.
5.  paṇṭiki (tali);
1. uttiram 2. eḻutakam 3. tūkkōṭu 4. mālit taṭṭu 5. patmam 6. mālikkaṭṭu 7. iṭikkaṭṭu 8. paṇṭiki 9. mālikkaṭṭu 
10. kaṇṇāṭik kaṭṭam 11. mālik kaṭṭu 12. makāpatmam eṉappaṭum.
6. tūpi (muṭi):
1. makāpatmam 2. makāpatram 3. kaṇṭam 4. araṭā 5. kaṇṭam 6. kaṇṭā 7. araṭā 8. alā 9. kirīvā 10. kāl mutaliya uṟuppukaḷi uṭiyatu.
9. kaṇṭam 10. nakatalippū
kuṟippu:-  atirṣṭāṉattiṟku aṭiyil upapīṭam uḷḷatu.  atuvum kapōtam kāntam kumutam upāṉam pōṉṟa uṭpirivukaḷi uṭiyatu.  muḻu niṟivāṉa vimāṉattiṉ atirṣṭāṉam aintu varikaḷi (pañca varikaḷi)p peṟṟirukkum iṅku kuṟippiṭṭa vimāṉam
kōyil amippu muṟi
tamiḻarkaḷiṉ kōyil amippu muṟikaḷ aṉittum ākamaṅkaḷi aṭippaṭiyākak koṇṭē amikkap paṭṭuḷḷatu.  tamiḻil ākamaṅkaḷ iyaṟṟa vanta tirumūlar tām peṟṟa oṉpatu ākamaṅkaḷiṉ peyarkaḷik kuṟippiṭum tarumattup pālil mutalāvatākak kāraṇam eṉṟa ākamattiṉ peyarik kuṟippiṭu
kiṉṟār.  tirukkōyiliṉ amippukaḷip paṟṟi kāraṇam eṉṉum ākamam pala ariya viḷakkaṅkaḷi namakku aḷikkiṟatu.
iṭam
āṇṭavaṉ amarntu aruḷpuriyum illamāṉa kōyilkaḷ tūymiyāṉa iṭattil irukka vēṇṭum.  nalla maṉaniṟivu aḷikkum nilattil virivāṉa aṭippaṭiyiṭṭuk kaṭṭa vēṇṭum.  puṉitamāṉa civālayaṅkaḷi eḻuppum iṭattiṉ kīḻ elumpukaḷ, nakaṅkaḷ, mayir mutaliya poruḷ irukkak kūṭātu.  tirukkōyilkaḷ eṭuppikkum iṭattiṉ kīḻē āḻamāka akaḻntu aruvaruppāṉa poruḷkaḷi akaṟṟiviṭa vēṇṭum eṉṟu karcaṇaviti eṉṟa pakuti kūṟukiṟatu.
amippu muṟi
tiruk kōyiliṉ mukkiyamāṉa pakuti tiru uṇṇāḻikiyum (karppak kiruhamum) mēluḷḷa vimāṉamumēyākum.  tiru uṇṇāḻikiyi mūlatāṉa eṉṟum moḻivārkaḷ.  itaṉuḷḷē mūlavarāṉa iṟivaṉiṉ ciṉṉamāka iliṅkam amikkap peṟṟatu.  uṇṇāḻikiyiṉ mēl amikkappaṭṭa vimāṉattiṉ amippik koṇṭē kōyilkaḷiṉ vakikaḷ pirikkappaṭṭaṉa.  tiru uṇṇāḻikiyi mutalāvatāka vittē artta maṇṭapam, makā maṇṭapam, kuḷippu maṇṭapam, alaṅkāra maṇṭapam, tirumaṇa maṇṭapam, vacanta maṇṭapam, nūṟṟeṭṭuk
kāl maṇṭapam, āyiraṅkāl maṇṭapam, āṭal maṇṭapam, nāṭaka maṇṭapam pōṉṟavikaḷ amikkappaṭṭaṉa.  appāl irāya kōpuraṅkaḷum valam varuvataṟkēṟṟa cuṟṟup pirakāraṅkaḷ oṉṟu iraṇṭu mūṉṟu ēḻu eṉṟu virivaṭintum tirukkōyilkaḷiṉ tōṟṟam viriṭintu vantatu.
mūvaki amippu
tiruk kōyilkaḷukku uyir pōṉṟatu iliṅka vaṭivam iṭam peṟṟirukkum tiru uṇṇāḻiki.  inta uṇṇāḻikiyiṉ tōṟṟa amippi ākamaṅkaḷ mūṉṟu  vakiyākak kaṇṭuḷḷaṉa. atāvatu 1. tirāviṭam, 2. nākaram 3. vēcaram eṉappaṭum.
kāraṇam eṉṟum ākamam, tirāviṭam nākaram, vēcaram eṉa mūṉṟu kōyilkaḷ uṇṭu eṉṟu urikkiṟatu.  1. nilattiṉ maṭṭattiliruntu tūpi vari nāṉku paṭṭamuḷḷa caturak kōyil nākaram eṉappaṭum.  2. vēti (mēṭi) yiliruntu eṇ kōṇa vaṭivamāka amikkappaṭum kōyilukku tirāviṭam eṉappaṭum.  karṇa kūṭattiliruntu vaṭṭavaṭivamāka amikkappaṭum kōyilukku vēcaram eṉṟu kūṟappaṭum.  caturam, eṇkōṇam, vaṭṭam ākiya mūvakit tōṟṟamuḷḷa kōyilkaḷ kūṟap paṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  inta mūvakit tōṟṟaṅkaḷiyum muṟiyē kōyiliṉ aṭittalat
tiṉiṉṟu cikaram varik kāṇa vēṇṭum.  tamiḻ nāṭṭil pūmi maṭṭattiliruntu cikaram vari nāṉku mūli paṭṭiyuḷḷa nākaram eṉṟa kōyil amippu muṟiyip peritum kāṇalām  vimāṉattil uḷḷa karṇa kūṭattiṟku mēl cikaram muṭiya vaṭṭa vaṭivamuḷḷa vēcam eṉṟa kōyil amippiyum eḷitākak kāṇalām.  mēṭikku mēl eṇ kōṇa vaṭivamāka vimāṉa ucci vari amintuḷḷa tirāviṭam eṉṟa kōyil amippik kāṇpatu mika aritu.

aka nāḻiki (karppak kirakam)
aka nāḻiki (karppak kirakam),  tirukkōyiliṉ iṉṟiyami yāta pakuti.  muṟkālat tamiḻ makkaḷ aka nāḻikiyittāṉ kōyil eṉṟu aḻittaṉar.  inta akanāḻikiyi mūlattāṉam (mūlatāṉam) eṉṟum kūṟuvar.  iṅkutāṉ mūlavar iruppar.  atāvatu civaliṅkam irukkum.  ovvoru kōyilukkum uyar niliyāy iruppatu mūlatāṉa mūrttiyākiya aka nāḻikit tiru uruvam vāyil kōpuram pātamākavum aka nāḻikiyic ciracākavum matikkappaṭum.
aka nāḻiki, uṇṇāḻiki, karuvaṟi, (karppak kirukam) tiruvaṟi, puṉita uṟiyuḷ, puṉita iṭam, teyvamaṉi vaḻipāṭṭiṭam eṉṟellām tamiḻar aḻippar. vaṭa moḻiyāḷar karpakkirakam eṉṟu kūṟuvar.  āṅkilattil, cāṅṭam cāṅṭam (sanctum sanctum)  eṉṟu aḻikkappaṭum
tirukkōyiliṉ uṟuppukaḷi makāṅkam, aṅkam, upāṅkam pirattiyāṅkam eṉṟum nāṉku vakiyākap pirikkappaṭum.  akanāḻiki makāṅkam eṉṟum artta maṇṭapam aṅka meṉṟum, makāmaṇṭapam mutalāṉavi upāṅkam eṉṟum pirakāraṅkaḷ pirattiyāṅkam eṉavum potuvāṉa aṅkam collappaṭukiṟatu.
aka nāḻiki (karppak kirakam) taliyākavum, antarāḷam mukamākavum kaṇṭamākavum artta maṇṭapam mārpākavum, makā maṇṭapam vayirākavum pirakāraṅkaḷ muḻaṅkāl kaṇukkālākavum kōpurattuvāram pātamākavum ciṟpa nūṟkaḷil kūṟappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.1
uṇṇāḻiki (aka nāḻiki) yiṉ - karuvaṟiyiṉ vimāṉatti  tūlaliṅkam eṉṟum ataṉ uḷḷirukkum tiru uru cūṭcama liṅkam eṉṟum kūṟappaṭum.  vicuvakarmīyam eṉṟa ciṟpa nūl, vimāṉatti civaṉuru eṉṟum civaṉ uṭal eṉṟum civa perumāṉiṉ niṉṟa kōlattiṟku viḷakkam tarukiṟatu.  uṇṇāḻikiyiṉ mēluḷḷa eḻilārnta vaṭivattiṉ vēlip pāṭukaḷum uṟuppukaḷum aṭukkukaḷum ciṟpa nūṟkaḷil ciṟappittup pārāṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  avaṟṟi aṭiyiliruntu 
1. upāṉam. 2. cekati 3. kumutam 4. kantaram 5. paṭṭiki 6. vētiki 7. tūṇ (tampam) 8. uttaram 9. kapōtam, 10. pirataram 11. hati vētiki 12. kirīvam 13. mañcam 14. makā nāci 15. pār cuva nāci 16. cantira maṇṭalam 17. pāliki 18. patmam 19. makā patmam 20. tūpi (cikaram) vari 20- uṟuppukaḷ āka vakuttu kūṟap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  ivaṟṟi civa vaṭivattiṉ pātam, keṇṭik kāl, muḻaṅkāl toṭi, ari(mēṭram), nāpi, utaram, mārpu, tōḷ, puṣṭitam, kaḻuttu, rēki, utaṭu, mūkku, kātu, kaṇ, neṟṟi, tali, ciracu, ciki mutaliya uṟuppukaḷākap pāvikkap peṟukiṉṟatu.
iḵtaṉṟi, uṇṇāḻikiyiyum (karuvaṟiyiyum) vimāṉattiyum peṇ vaṭivam eṉṟum, ataṉ uḷḷirukkum tiru uruvi, utarattiluḷḷa karppam eṉṟum viḷakkam tarappaṭukiṟatu.  utarattil karppamākiya mūrtti amikkap peṟṟiruppatālēyē uṇṇāḻikik kaṭṭiṭatti karppak kirakam (karuvaṟi) eṉṟu aḻikkappaṭukiṟatu.  ikkaruttiṉi uḷattil koṇṭu mūla mūrtti vīṟṟirukkum kaṭṭiṭattic ciṟpa nūl vallunarkaḷ kukkuṭāṇṭam- kōḻi muṭṭi vaṭivamākavum amikkalām eṉṟu kūṟukiṉṟārkaḷ.  ittakiya, kukkuṭāṇṭa vaṭivattil kōyilkaḷ amippatum uṇṭu.  
civaperumāṉiṉ niṉṟa kōlattiyum naṉṟākat tīṭṭappaṭṭa tiru uruvatti oru niṟivāka uruvākkappeṟṟa vimāṉattiyum arukarukē vittu oppunōkkiṉāl uṇmi pulaṉākum.
makkaḷ uṭampiṉ uṟuppukaḷi aṅkam (uṟuppu), makāṅkam, upāṅkam, pirattiyāṅkam eṉṟu pirittuḷḷatu pōl iṟivaṉiṉ tiru vaṭivamākak kaṟpikkap peṟṟa vimāṉattiṉ atirṣṭāṉam  (Basement) eṉṟa uṟuppi makāṅkam eṉṟum tampam allatu cuvarppakutiyi (Superstructure) aṅkam eṉṟum, piratāratti (Entablature) upāṅkam eṉṟum cikaratti (Doom or roof) pirattiyāṅkam eṉṟum ciṟpa nūṟkaḷil kūṟukiṉṟaṉa kōyil eṉṟu kūṟappaṭuvatu kuṟippāka - ēṉ? ciṟappāka uṇṇāḻikiyiyum ataṉmītuḷḷa vimāṉattiyumē kuṟippiṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.1
vimāṉam
vimāṉam eṉṟāl akanāḻiki mītuḷḷa tūpi eṉṟu akarātikaḷil poruḷ kūṟap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  ciṟpa nūṟkaḷil vimāṉam eṉpataṟku, naṉṟāka aḷakkappaṭṭatu eṉṟu viḷakkantarap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  vimāṉaṅkaḷip paṟṟi atikāra pūrvamāka viḷakkan
tarum nūṟkaḷ ākamaṅkaḷ ākum.  tamiḻ ākamamākap pōṟṟap peṟum nūl tiru mantiram ākum.  atil
tūya vimāṉamum tūlama tākum - 1689eṉṟu kūṟap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  itaṟku viḷakkam, aka nāḻiki mītu amikkap peṟṟuḷḷa mēṉ mūṭi- ucciyākiya vimāṉam tūymiyum parumiyum vāynta civak kuṟiyākum.  (civak kuṟi - civaliṅkam) vimāṉattiṉ kīḻ akattē aka nāḻikiyil (karuvaṟiyil) viḷaṅkum aruḷōṉ ākiya catācivaṉ nuṇṇiya civak kuṟiyāvaṉ eṉṟu kūṟappaṭukiṟatu.
potuvāka vimāṉam eṉpatu uyarnta māṭi eṉṟu poruḷ tantālum, ciṟappāka tirukkōyilil karuvaṟiyiṉ mītuḷḷa uyarnta amippiyē kuṟippiṭukiṟatu eṉpati evarum maṟukkār.  māṭam, eṉpatu māḷikikaḷiṉ mītuḷḷa māṭikaḷik kuṟippiṭum patamākum.  eṉṟālum tirukkōyilil uḷḷa uyarnta amippukaḷē māṭam eṉṟu ciṟappākak kūṟappaṭukiṟatu.  kōyilkaḷiṉ vakikaḷik kuṟippiṭum poḻutu māṭak kōyil eṉṟē kuṟippiṭappaṭukiṟatu.  māṭam, uppariki, upariki eṉṟum kūṟap paṭukiṉṟaṉa.
irukkilaṅku tiru moḻivāy eṇṭōḻīcaṟku
eḻil māṭam eḻupatucey tulaka māṇṭa
tirukkulattu vaḷac cōḻaṉ
eṉṟu cōḻaṉ ceṅkaṇāṉ civaperumāṉukkum, tirumālukkum āka eḻupatukku mēṟpaṭṭa vimāṉaṅkaḷi kaṭṭiṉāṉ eṉṟu tirumaṅkiyāḻvār kūṟukiṉṟār.  mēlum avar,
tiru naṟiyūr maṇi māṭam cērmiṉkaḷē 
eṉṟum kūṟukiṉṟār.
eṉṟālum, karuvaṟiyiṉ mītuḷḷa uyarnta kaṭṭiṭa amippiṟku vimāṉam eṉṟa peyarē poruttamāṉatākum.  māṭam eṉpatu vīṭu, māḷiki, araṇmaṉi pōṉṟavikaḷiṉ uparikkikaḷik kuṟippiṭuvataṟkup payaṉpaṭuttik koḷvatu cālap poruttamāṉatākum.  karuvaṟiyiṉ mītuḷḷa mēl aṭukkukaḷi, civa camaya nāyaṉmārkaḷ pala iṭaṅkaḷil vimāṉam eṉṟē kuṟippiṭukiṉṟārkaḷ.

vimāṉam
vimāṉam eṉṟāl naṉṟāka aḷakkappaṭṭatu eṉpatu poruḷākum.  kōyilkaḷil tiru uṇṇāḻikiyiṉuḷ tiru uruvam iṭam peṟṟirukkum.  ataṉ mītu uyaramāka vimāṉam amikkappaṭum.  ayal ūrkaḷiliruntu varum makkaḷ tolivil varum poḻutē vimāṉattik kaṇṭatum iṟivaṉ tirumuṭiyik kaṇṭatāka eṇṇi vaḻipaṭuvar.  muṟkālattil kōyiliṉ uyarnta pakutiyāka vimāṉam irukkum.  vāyil kōpuraṅkaḷ uyaramāka amippatilli.  kōpurattik kaṇṭu iṟivaṉ tiru muṭiyāka eṇṇi vaḻipaṭuvatu tamiḻar marapaṉṟu.  atu muṟiyum aṉṟu.   vimāṉam oru niliyiṉiṉṟu patiṉāṉ nili vari tamiḻ nāṭṭil iruntatu eṉṟu kūṟappaṭum.  tamiḻnāṭṭil araṇmaṉikaḷum ēḻu nilikaḷi uṭiyatāy iruntaṉa eṉṟu caṅka nūlkaḷ cāṉṟu tarukiṉṟaṉa.  piṟkālattil tamiḻakattil eḻunta vimāṉaṅ kaḷil taṭcaṇāmūrtti, iliṅkōṟpa mūrtti, kāḷi tirumāl mutaliyavarkaḷiṉ tiru uruvaṅkaḷ iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
civa perumāṉukku tirāviṭa muṟiyilum, umātēvikku nākara muṟiyilum, murukaṉukku tirāviṭa muṟiyilum, piḷḷiyārkku vēcara muṟiyilum piṟkālattil kaṭṭappaṭṭaṉa eṉṟu cila ciṟpa nūl vallunarkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟārkaḷ.  itu vaṭa moḻiyil uḷḷa ciṟpap pirivukaḷi aṭippaṭiyākak koṇṭu eḻuntaṉa eṉṟu eṇṇappaṭukiṟatu.  tamiḻ nāṭṭil vēṟu cila ciṟpap pirivukaḷ payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  catura vaṭivilāṉa tiru uṇṇāḻiki, nīṇṭa catura vaṭivilāṉa tiru uṇṇāḻiki vaṭṭa vaṭivilāṉa tiru uṇṇāḻiki ari vaṭṭavaṭivilāṉa tiruuṇṇāḻiki pōṉṟa palvēṟu amippuḷḷa tiru uṇṇāḻikikaḷ kūṟappaṭṭālum eṅkum caturat tiru uṇṇāḻikikaḷ tāṉ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  āṉāl toṇṭi nāṭṭil ari vaṭṭattiru uṇṇāḻikikaḷ mikutiyāka uḷḷaṉa.  tiru niṉṟa ūr, paṉaṅkāṭṭūr, maḻīci, māṭam pākkam mutalāṉa iṭaṅkaḷiluḷḷa kōyilkaḷiṉ vimāṉaṅkaḷ ari vaṭṭak karuvaṟikaḷik koṇṭatākum.  karuvaṟikaḷukku mēl  vimāṉam caturam, nellik kaṉi, vaṭṭam mutaliya uruvaṅkaḷil uḷḷaṉa.  ari vaṭṭak karuvaṟiyiṉ mītu yāṉi mutukum pōl ceyyap
paṭṭirukkum.  tiruniṉṟūr mutaliya kōyilkaḷil kāṇappaṭuvatu itu pōṉṟatēyākum.  tiruttaṇi nantiyāṟṟaṅ kariyil yāṉi mutukum arivaṭṭa mukamum uṭiya vimāṉam uṇṭu.  perumāḷ kōyilkaḷil mūṉṟu aṭukkuḷḷa aṣṭāṅka vimāṉam uṇṭu.  kāñci vikuṇṭa nātar kōyililum tiruk kōṭṭiyūrk kōyililum inta aṣṭāṅka vimāṉam kāṭci aḷikkiṟatu.  tiru atikiyil karppakirakattiṉ mītu eḻuppap peṟṟirukkum vimāṉatti tiripurat takaṉattērākak kaṭṭiya ciṟpikaḷiṉ tiṟami pōṟṟattakkatu.
viruppoṭumāl vaḻipāṭu ceyya viḻi
vimāṉañ cēr miḻali yāmē
eṉṟa tēvārap pāṭal vimāṉattiṉ ēṟṟattik kuṟikkiṉṟatu.  karuvaṟikaḷiṉ mēl. uḷḷē irukkum teyva uruvaṅkaḷukku makuṭam cūṭṭiṉāṟ pōṉṟu uyarnta oṟṟik kōpuraṅkaḷ amikkum vaḻakkam tamiḻakattil iruntatu eṉṟu kūṟap paṭuvataṟkuc cāṉṟāka iṉṟu tañcāvūril irācarācaṉ kaṭṭiya tirukkōyilum, kaṅki koṇṭa cōḻapurattil irā cēntiraṉ kaṭṭiya kōyilum ciṟanta eṭuttuk kāṭṭāy ilaṅkukiṟatu.
ciṟpa nūṟkaḷil vimāṉaṅkaḷ amippatip paṟṟi virivāṉa viḷakkam tarap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  vimāṉattiṉ vakikaḷ, peyarkaḷ,  uruvaṅkaḷ māṭikaḷ, vāyilkaḷ palakaṇikaḷ akalam, nīḷam, uyaram mutaliyaṉa aṉittum teḷivākak kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  avi aṭiyil varumāṟākum:
1. mēru:   aṟu kōṇa uruvattil paṉṉiraṇṭu māṭikaḷi yuṭiyatāy nāṉku vāyilkaḷum paṉṉiṟap palakaṇikaḷum pāṅkuṟa amikkap peṟṟatāy irukkum itu muppattiraṇṭu muḻa akalam uṭiyatu.
2. mantāram:   itu muppatu muḻam akalam uṭiyatu.  pattu māṭikaḷum cikaraṅkaḷum uṭiyatu.
3.  kilācam: itu eṭṭu māṭaṅkaḷiyum 28 muḻam akalamum uṭiyatu.
4.  vimāṉam:   itu irupattoru muḻam akalamum kirātikaḷiyum pala kaṇikaḷiyum 10 māṭikaḷiyum uṭiyatu.
5.  nantaṉam: itu āṟu māṭaṅkaḷiyum patiṉāṟu kapālaṅ kaḷiyum uṭiyatu.  32 muḻam akalam uṭiyatu.
6.  camukkam: itu vaṭṭamāṉa peṭṭi vaṭivil irukkum.
7.  patmam: itu tāmari vaṭivil eṭṭu muḻa uyaramāṉa oru tūpiyiyum oru māṭattiyum uṭiyatu.
8-9.  karuṭaṉ, nataṉam: ivi cūriyak kaḻuku pōṉṟa amippil 24 muḻa akalamum ēḻu māṭaṅkaḷiyum uṭiyatu.  itil irupatu kapālaṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa. 
10.  varttaṉā:   ..........................................................
11.  kuñcaram:  itu yāṉiyiṉ mutuku pōṉṟatāka irukkum 16 muḻa nīḷam uṭiyatāy aṭi akaṉṟatāyum irukkum.
12.  kuka rājaṉ:  ituvum kuñcaram pōṉṟu 16 aṭi muḻam akalamum atē pōṉṟa mēṟ kūṟiyum mūṉṟu ceṅkuttāka untik koṇṭirukkum pala kaṇiyum peṟṟirukkum.
13.  iṭapam:  itu kāḷi  māṭṭiṉ vaṭivil oru māṭamum oru tūpiyum vaṭṭa vaṭivil 12 muḻa akalam uḷḷatu.
14.  amcam:  aṉṉap paṟaviyiṉ vaṭivil aḻakāka amintirukka vēṇṭum.
15.  kaṭam:  itu kuṭattiṉ vaṭivattiṉip peṟṟirukkum 
8 - muḻa akalam irukkum.
16.  carvatōpattiram:  itu nāṉku vāyilkaḷi uṭiyatu.  pala, ceṅkuttāka untik koṇṭirukkum palakaṇikaḷiyum uṭiyatu.  aintu māṭaṅkaḷ amintatu 25 muḻam akalam vāyntatu.
17.  ciṉha:  itu ciṅkattiṉ tōṟṟam vāynta paṉṉiraṇṭu paṭṭaṅkaḷiyuṭiyatu.  25 muḻam akalam uṭiyatu.
18-20. eñci niṟkum  rōṭṭuṇṭa, caturppuyam  eṇṭōḷ ākiya mūṉṟu māṭaṅkaḷum patiṉāṟupaṭṭikaḷiyumuṭiyaṉa.  caturppuyam aintu kapōlaṅkaḷiyuṭiyatu maṟṟavi orē kapōlatti uṭiyaṉa.
cintu veḷi akaḻ āyviṟ kaṇṭa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷiṉ mūlam 5000 - āṇṭukaḷukku muṉpē tirāviṭarkaḷ kaṭṭiṭak kali amippil vallunarāy viḷaṅkiṉar eṉpatu naṉku peṟappaṭum.  tamiḻarkaḷukku cintu veḷi makkaḷiṉ pārampariyattuvam uṇṭu eṉṟu car. cāṇ mārcal, cōviyō tuprayal hirā aṭikaḷ pōṉṟa pēraṟiñarkaḷ uṟutippaṭuttiyuḷḷaṉar.  kiṟittuva ūḻi arumpuvataṟku muṉpē tamiḻ nāṭṭil periya kōyilkaḷum, aḻakiya araṇmaṉikaḷum, māperum māḷikikaḷum, aḷappariya maliyeṉṉa uyarnta māperum araṇkaḷum iruntaṉa.  viṇmuṭṭum eḻunili māṭaṅkaḷum mukil tavaḻum nāṉ māṭak kūṭaṅkaḷum, pattukku mēṟpaṭṭa pala aṭukkukaḷi vimāṉak kōyilkaḷum, poṟ kōṭṭikaḷum, kaṟkōṭṭikaḷum, cempuk kōṭṭikaḷum iruntaṉa eṉṟu namatu ilakkiyaṅkaḷum, ciṟpa nūlkaḷum, purāṇak katikaḷum cāṉṟu tarukiṉṟaṉa.  āriyarkaḷ aiyāyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ aḻitta arappāviṉ aṉṟu uyarntu niṉṟu vīḻnta araṇi iṉṟu pākkitāṉ akaḻ āyvuttuṟi iyakkunarkaḷiṉ taḷapati car. kh®£ok® cÆy® mfœªJ f©L gl« ão¤J¡ fh£o., itu tāṉ āriyarkaḷ teyvamākiya intiraṉ aḷittatāka irukku vētam kūṟum āriyar allātāriṉ (tirāviṭarkaḷiṉ) kōṭṭi eṉṟu ulakiṟku eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷār.
kiṟittuva ūḻi arumpumuṉ tirāviṭa makkaḷ tamiḻakattil kaṭṭiya kōyilkaḷum, kōpuraṅkaḷum, kōṭṭikaḷum, māḷiki kaḷum, maṇṭapaṅkaḷum, ceṅkallālum, maṇṇālum kaṭṭap paṭṭatāl iyaṟkiyiṉ cīṟṟattālum, pakivarkaḷiṉ tākkutal kaḷiṉālum aḻikkappaṭṭu viṭṭaṉa.  iṉṟu namakku cāṉṟu kāṭṭa muṭiyavilli.  āṉāl ilakkiyac cāṉṟukaḷ pala uṇṭu.
iṅku nām ciṟappākac cintikkak kūṭiya ceytikaḷ cila uḷa.  puttar kālattiṟkup piṉṉarē vaṭa nāṭṭilum naṭu nāṭṭilum kōyilkaḷ tōṉṟiṉa.  akkōyilkaḷil kōpuraṅkaḷō, vimāṉaṅkaḷō amikkap peṟavilli.  kuptarkaḷiṉ iṟutik kālattilē tāṉ vimāṉaṅkaḷ tōṉṟiṉa.  ki.mu. 1000-āṇṭiṟku muṉ naṭipeṟṟatākak kūṟappaṭum irāma kātiyil, irāmaṉ pāṇṭiya nāṭṭiṉ talinakarāṉa kapāṭapurattil uḷḷa pāṇṭiyaṉ talinakariyum, araṇiyum ataṉ poṉṉālāṉa kōṭṭi vāyiṟ katavukaḷiyum paṟṟik kūṟuvatu vāṉmīki irāmāyaṇattil kūṟap peṟṟuḷḷatu. atil irāvaṇaṉiṉ vāṉaḷāviya araṇ
kaḷiyum, māperum aḻakiya māḷiki kaḷiyum paṟṟi virivāṉa viḷakkam tarap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  ki.pi. iraṇṭām, mūṉṟām nūṟṟāṇṭiṟku muṟpaṭṭa tamiḻ nūṟkaḷāṉavi tamiḻ nāṭṭil māḷikikaḷum, māṭaṅkaḷum, kōyilkaḷum kōpuraṅkaḷum, vimāṉaṅkaḷum iruntaṉa eṉpataṟkuc cāṉṟu tarukiṉṟaṉa.  ki.pi. iraṇṭām mūṉṟām nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷil tamiḻakattil ceṅkaṟ
kaḷālum, cutic cāntālum kaṭṭap peṟṟa kōyilkaḷ, kōpuraṅkaḷ, vimāṉaṅkaḷiruntaviyāyiṉ ki.mu. nālām, aintām nūṟṟāṇṭil irunta vaṭa nāṭṭiṉar vimāṉaṅkaḷ amikkum muṟiyit tamiḻarkaḷiṭamiruntu aṟintu koṇṭiruntaṉar eṉṟu eṇṇuvatil tavaṟilli eṉka.
tamiḻ nāṭṭil vimāṉaṅkaḷ.
pallava maṉṉaṉ mutalām naracimmavarmaṉ (ki.pi 630-660)  māmallapurattil oṟṟik kallil camitta mātirik kōyilkaḷē tamiḻ nāṭṭil vimāṉaṅkaḷuṭaṉ mutaṉ mutalāka amitta kaṟkōyil eṉpatu ciṟpa vallunarkaḷ karuttu.  intak kōyil
kaḷi muṉ mātiriyākak koṇṭē tamiḻakattil kōyilkaḷ, vimāṉaṅkaḷuṭaṉ amikkappaṭṭaṉa eṉṟu cilar karutukiṉṟaṉar.  ikkaruttu nām muṉṉar, eṭuttukkāṭṭiya pattuppāṭṭu, cilappatikāram, maṇimēkali, perumpāṇāṟṟup paṭi, neṭunal vāṭi mutaliya nūṟkaḷil uḷḷa naṟcāṉṟukku māṟāṉatākum.  iḵtaṉṟi ki.pi.6-ām nūṟṟāṇṭiṉ toṭakkattil vāḻnta appar aṭikaḷum, tiruñāṉa campantap piḷḷiyārum,  avarkaḷ kālattiṟku muṟpaṭṭa citamparam, cīrkāḻi, peṇṇāṭakam, maturi, tirunelvēli, vikal, tiruppātirip puliyūr mutaliya ūrkaḷil uḷḷa peruṅkōyil, karakkōyil, ñāḻaṟ kōyil, kokuṭik kōyil, tūṅkāṉi māṭak kōyil, iḷaṅkōyil, maṇik kōyil, māṭak kōyil pōṉṟa kōyilkaḷukkuc ceṉṟu aṅkuḷḷa teyvaṅkaḷi vaḻipaṭṭatu uḷḷaṅki nellik kaṉi pōl naṉkaṟiyappaṭukiṉṟatu.  ki.pi. nāṉkām nūṟṟāṇṭilirunta kōcceṅkaṇṇāṉ eṉṉum cōḻa vēntaṉ eḻupatu māṭak kōyilkaḷik kaṭṭiyati campantarum, tirumaṅkiyāḻvārum pāṭiya pākkaḷ maṟukkaṟpālataṉṟām.
makēntara varmaṉum, paramēcuvaravarmaṉum, ivarkaḷukkup 
piṉ vanta maṉṉarkaḷum, māmallapurattilum, kāñcipurattilum kaṭṭiya kōyilkaḷum, kōpuraṅkaḷum, vimāṉaṅkaḷum paṇṭiyat tamiḻarkaḷ kaṇṭa vaḻiyil eṭuppitta kōyilkaḷ eṉpatil eḷḷaḷavum aiyamilli.1  kōyilkaḷ kōpuraṅkaḷ vimāṉaṅkaḷ amikkum vaḻakkut tamiḻ nāṭṭil kiṟittava ūḻi eḻuvataṟku muṉpē iruntatākum.  pallavarkaḷ tamiḻar neṟiyākiya civaneṟiyit taḻuviya piṉ tamiḻar vaḻakkiṉiyoṭṭi karuṅkaṟ kōyilkaḷit tamiḻakattil amikkat toṭaṅkiṉar.  avarkaḷukku tamiḻar kaṇṭa ākamaṅkaḷum, ciṟpanūṟkaḷum 
tamiḻ nāṭṭuc ciṟpikaḷiṉ paṭṭaṟivum vaḻi kāṭṭiyāka iruntaṉa.  tamiḻarkaḷ caṅka kālattil ceṅkaṟkaḷālum, cāntiṉālum amitta atika kōyilkaḷ appāl karuṅkaṟ kōpuramāka kōyilāka vimāṉamākap pariṇamittaṉa eṉṟu namatu kaṭṭiṭak kali varalāṟu kūṟukiṉṟatu.  ikkālattilum pala vaṇṇaṅkaḷ tīṭṭap peṟṟa cuti uruvaṅkaḷiyuṭiya kōpuraṅkaḷum vimāṉaṅkaḷum tamiḻ nāṭṭil tāṉ uṇṭu.  kōpuraṅ
kaḷi māṭaṅkaḷip pōl aṭukkaṭukkāy aḻakupeṟa, aṇitikaḻa, oḷiyuṟa amikkum vaḻakku tirāviṭarkaḷ kik koṇṭa uyariya muṟiyākum.1  itaṉi perkūcaṉ, cōviyō
tuprayal, ṭellākiremariṣ pōṉṟa mēṉāṭṭuk kaṭṭiṭak kali vallunarkaḷ naṉku eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṉṟaṉar.
tirukkōyilil ciṟappāṉa pakuti aka nāḻiki (uṇṇāḻiki)  eṉṟu kūṟum karuvaṟiyum ataṉ mēl eḻuppap peṟṟa vimāṉamum ākum.  tirumatilil uṭpuṟam cellum vāyiliṉ mēl eḻuppappeṟṟa mēl taḷam kōpuram eṉappaṭum.  itaṉ poruḷ yātā yiruppiṉum karuvaṟiyiṉ mītu eḻuppap peṟṟa vimāṉatti uṇṇāḻikiyiṉ uḷḷē urup peṟṟirukkum teyva uruviṉ maṇi muṭiyāka eṇṇi makkaḷ tolivil varum poḻutē vimāṉattik kaṇṭatum iṟivaṉ tiru uruvik kaṇṭāṟ pōṉṟu paktiyuṭaṉ kikuvittu vaḻipaṭuvar.  vāyiṟ kōpurattik kaṇṭu evarum vaḻipaṭuvatilli.  atu ākama vitiyum illi tamiḻar marapum aṉṟu.
āṉāl cilar vimāṉattik, kōpuram eṉṟum kōpuratti vimāṉam eṉṟum kūṟi iṭarppaṭukiṉṟaṉar.  atu camaya aṟivilār kūṟṟu eṉṟu kūṟiviṭalām.   āṉāl namatu nāṭṭut tirukkōyilkaḷi ciṟpa nūṟkaḷiṉ vitippaṭiyum civākama muṟikku māṟupāṭiṉṟiyum amittuttarum tapatikaḷ tam nūṟkaḷil vimāṉattik kōpuram eṉṟu kūṟuvatōṭu kōpurak kaṭṭiṭa amippum ataṉ peyarum eṉṟa talippiṉ kīḻ 
oru tapati I- vaṭṭamāy irukkum kōpuraṅkaḷukku virutta vimāṉam  II-  caturamāy irukkum kōpuraṅkaḷukku catura vimāṉam eṉṟum kūṟi vimāṉaṅkaḷukku viḷakkam tantu koṇṭu pōkiṟār.  itu ciṟpa nūṟpayiṟci illāta potu makkaḷukkuk kuḻappantaruvatāy irukkiṟatu.  ittavaṟukaḷ tiruttap peṟa vēṇṭum.  
vimāṉak kaṭṭiṭa aḷavum peyarum.
1.  ēkapūma vimāṉam:
akalam irukkum aḷavu uyaram vittuk kaṭṭiya vimāṉat tiṟku ēka taḷa vimāṉam allatu ēkapūma vimāṉam eṉṟu peyar.
2.  cāntīka vimāṉam:
akalam ēḻu paṅku ceytu uyaram pattup paṅku ceytuk kaṭṭappaṭṭa vimāṉam cāntīka vimāṉam eṉṟu aḻikkappaṭum.
3.  pavuṣṭīka vimāṉam:
akalam oru paṅku uyaram 1 1/2  paṅku vittuk kaṭṭiya vimāṉattiṟku pavuṣṭīka vimāṉam eṉṟu peyar.
4.  ceyṅkaḷa vimāṉam:
akalam oru paṅku uyaram 1 3/4 paṅku vittuk kaṭṭappaṭṭa vimāṉattiṟku ceyṅkaḷa vimāṉam eṉṟu peyar.
5.  aṟputa vimāṉam:
akalam oru paṅku uyaram iraṇṭu paṅku vittuk kaṭṭiya vimāṉattukku aṟputa vimāṉam eṉṟu peyar.  eṉṟu ālaya vikkiraka nirmāṇa āyāti ciṟpa irakaciyam eṉṟa nūl aintu vita vimāṉaṅkaḷukku aḷavu tarukiṟatu.  itaṉ mūlam namatu muṉṉōrkaḷ kaṇṭa vimāṉaṅkaḷiṉ vakikaḷum ataṉ aḷavukaḷum naṉku pulaṉākiṉṟaṉa.
vimāṉa amippum ataṉ peyarum
ēka taḷa vimāṉam allatu vimāṉattiṉ mēl nili kaḻuttaṭiyil iruntu paṇṭi makāpatmam variyil uḷḷatākum.
1.  virutta vimāṉam.
vaṭṭamāka irukkum vimāṉattiṟku virutta vimāṉam eṉṟu peyar.
2.  catura vimāṉam:
catura vaṭivil amikkappaṭum vimāṉam catura vimāṉam eṉṟu cāṟṟappaṭum.
3.  caṭ kōṇa vimāṉam:
āṟu paṭṭiyāy irukkum vimāṉam ṣaṭkōṇa vimāṉam eṉṟu collappaṭum.
4.  aṣṭa kōṇa vimāṉam:
eṭṭup paṭṭiyāy amikkappaṭṭirukkum vimāṉam aṣṭa kōṇa vimāṉam eṉappaṭum.
5.  tūṅkāṉi māṭa vimāṉam:
etirppuṟam mara māṭi pōlum iraṇṭu mūliyāy piṉṉāl yāṉi mutuku pōl amikkappaṭum vimāṉaṅkaḷukku kajap piruṣṭa vimāṉam, atti puṣṭa vimāṉam, tūṅkāṉi māṭam eṉṟellām aḻikkappaṭum.
6.  cakti niḷa vimāṉam:
iraṇṭu pakkam maramāṭiyum oṉṟukku mēṟpaṭṭa kalayaṅkaḷum irukkum vimāṉaṅkaḷukku cakti niḷam, makā tuvāra kōpuram, irāca kōpuram1 eṉṟellām aḻikkappaṭum.2
aka nāḻiki
aka nāḻiki kōyiliṉ kēntira niliyamāka uyir nili (jīva nāṭi) yāka viḷaṅkukiṟatu.  kōyiliṉ ciṟappellām uṇṇāḻikiyilum, ataṉ mēluḷḷa vimāṉattilum aṭaṅki yuḷḷatu.  aka nāḻikiyiṉ muṉpuṟam uḷḷa ciṟu maṇṭapatti iṭi nāḻiki (artta maṇṭapam) eṉṟu kūṟuvar.  aka nāḻiki perumpālum catura vaṭivāka irukkum.  cila iṭaṅkaḷil nīṇṭa catura vaṭivākavum amikkap peṟṟirukkiṟatu.  cila aka nāḻikikaḷ vaṭṭa vaṭivilum cila ari vaṭṭa vaṭivilum cila muṭṭi vaṭivilum - atāvatu nīḷ uruṇṭi vaṭivilum (Coval) uḷḷaṉa.  iḵtaṉṟi mukkōṇa vaṭivilō, aiṅkōṇa vaṭivilō, aṟu kōṇa vaṭivilō, aiṅ  kōṇa vaṭivilō, aṟukōṇa vaṭivilō eṇ kōṇa vaṭivilō aka nāḻikikaḷ kaṭṭappaṭṭiruppatākat teriyavilli.  āṉāl vimāṉaṅkaḷil āṟu paṭṭi vaṭivaṅ
kaḷum eṭṭup paṭṭi vaṭivaṅkaḷum uḷḷaṉa.  avikaḷukku taṉittaṉi peyarkaḷum uḷḷaṉa.
uṇṇāḻiki
āṉāl vaṭa intiyāvil aṟu kōṇa vaṭivilum eṇ kōṇa vaṭivilum karppak kirakaṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉaveṉṟu cilar kūṟukiṟārkaḷ.  nāṉ aṟinta aḷavil eṅkum attakiya amippuṭiya kōyilkaḷ iruppatākat teriyavilli.  namatu nāṭṭil palvēṟu iṭaṅkaḷilum uḷḷa kōyilkaḷi nēriṟ ceṉṟu pārttu uṇṇāḻikiyiṉ tariyiṉ varipaṭaṅkaḷi naṉku veḷiyiṭṭa perkūcaṉ, hēval, ṭellā kiremariṣ, lāṅkarṭ, cōviyōtuprayal, kirēvli pōṉṟa enta mēṉāṭṭāciriyarum inta uṇṇāḻikikaḷippaṟṟi etuvum kūṟavilli.
tamiḻ nāṭṭuk kōyil amippukaḷi āyntāl āyiram āyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṉpē tamiḻarkaḷ vaṭiviyal cārnta kaṇitattil (Geometrical) nuṇukkamāṉa kaṇitap pulami peṟṟiruntatu naṉku pulaṉākiṟatu.
nīṇṭa catura vaṭiva aka nāḻiki
tamiḻ nāṭṭil uḷḷa cila periya kōyilkaḷ ellām nīṇṭa catura aka nāḻikiyi uṭiya kōyilākavē kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  caturak kōyilkaḷi viṭa nīṇṭa catura aka nāḻikiyiyuṭiya kōyilkaḷē tamiḻakattil atikamākak kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  nīṇṭa catura vaṭivāṉa kōyilkaḷ, aka nāḻikiyil uḷḷa tiru uruva amippiṟkum pūci ceyyum civāccāriyārkaḷiṉ vacatikkum ēṟpavē amikkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  paṭuttirukkum niliyil uḷḷa tirumāliṉ kōyil uṇṇāḻikikaḷ cila nīṇṭa caturamāka irukkiṉṟaṉa.  
tirukkaḻukkuṉṟattiṟku aṇmiyil uḷḷa uttaraṉ kōyil eṉṉum ūril uḷḷa kōyilāṉatu nīṇṭa catura aka nāḻikiyi (karuppakirukatti) uṭiya aḻakāṉa amippiyuṭiya kōyi
lākum. (paṭam  pārkka)  intak kōyilil iṭi nāḻikiyi (artta maṇṭapatti) tavira vēṟu makā maṇṭapamō maṇi
maṇṭapamō pirakāraṅkaḷō amikkappaṭavilli.  ivvāṟu akanāḻikiyic cūḻntu maṇṭapaṅkaḷum pirakāraṅkaḷum iruntāl maṇṭapaṅkaḷiṉ naṭuvil akanāḻiki iṭam peṟṟu kōyilil aḻakiyum pārviyiyum ciṟpac ciṟappiyum maṟittu viṭum.  pala kōyilkaḷil maṇṭapaṅkaḷum pirakāraṅkaḷum peritāka eḻuntu mūlavar amarntirukkum aka nāḻikiyiṉ mītuḷḷa vimāṉamē teriyā vaṇṇam maṟittu viṭṭiruppatu kavaṉikkattakkatu.  mēlum kōyilukkuḷ kāṟṟum veḷiccamum pukāta paṭi maṟittup paṭṭap pakalil iruḷ cūḻntu vuvālkaḷ uṟiyum pāḻum iṭam pōlāki viṭṭaṉa.  namatu puṉitamāṉa tirukkōyilkaḷil iruḷ cūḻntiruppataṟku mukkiya kāraṇam cuṟṟu maṇṭapaṅkaḷēyākum.  ātiyil tamiḻar kaṇṭa kōyilkaḷ aka nāḻiyi maṭṭum uṭiyātu appāl iṭi nāḻiki eḻuntatu.  ati aṭuttē eṇṇilā maṇṭapaṅkaḷum piṟkālattil eḻuntu aka nāḻikiyiṉ aḻakiyum, ciṟpac ciṟappiyum kaṇṭu kaḷikka muṭiyāmalum tūymiyi uṇara muṭiyāmalum cukātārak kuṟivu uṇṭākumpaṭi ceytu viṭṭatu.
catura vaṭiva aka nāḻiki
mikat toṉmiyāṉa kālattil, aka nāḻiki (karuppak kirakam) perumpālum catura vaṭivilē amikkappaṭṭatākat terikiṟatu.  akalamum, nīḷamum camamāka aḷavil vittu  amitta aka nāḻiki aḻakum vacatiyum uṭiyatāka iruntatu.
turōpati iratam
catura amippuṭiya aka nāḻikiyik koṇṭa oru kōyilukku  eṭuttukkāṭṭāka māmallapurattil uḷḷa turōpati iratatti ēṟṟa eṭuttuk kāṭṭākak koḷḷalām.  itu turōpatikkāka eṭuppikkappaṭṭa kōyil alla.  turkki eṉṉum koṟṟavikkāka eṭuppikkappaṭṭa kōyil ākum.  itu orē pāṟiyil cīr peṟac cetukki, mikak kaccitamākak kaviṉ peṟak, kāṭcik kiṉiyatākak kaṭṭap peṟṟa karuṅkaṟ kōyilākum.  itu 1300- āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ amikkappaṭṭa mātirik kōyil eṉṟālum itu puttam putiya kōyil pōl kāṇappaṭukiṟatu.  ikkōyiliṉ muṉ mūṉṟu paṭikaḷ naṉku amintuḷḷaṉa.
intak kōyilukku iṭi nāḻikiyum (artta maṇṭapamum) muka maṇṭapamum illi.  aka nāḻiki maṭṭum aḻakuṟap polikiṉṟatu.  aka nāḻiki catura vaṭivil amikkappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  vāyilukku mēlē iraṇṭu vaḷivuḷḷa makara tōraṇaṅkaḷum irukkiṟatu.  vāyiliṉ iru maruṅkiṉum tuvāra pālikiyar (peṇ vāyiṟ kāppāḷarkaḷ) uruvaṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  intak karuvaṟiyiṉ uḷḷē teyvat tiru uruvam illi.  āṉāl uḷ cuvaril koṟṟaviyiṉ vaṭivam puṭippuc ciṟpamāka cetukkap paṭṭuḷḷatu.  cuvariṉ veḷippuṟattil mūṉṟu pakkaṅkaḷilum koṟṟaviyiṉ uruvam cetukkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  namatu varalāṟṟaṟivō, camaya aṟivō, ciṟpa nuṇakkumō atikam peṟāta āṅkila aṟiñarkaḷ ikkōyili turōpati iratam eṉṟum uḷḷē irukkum uruvam tirumakaḷ vaṭivam eṉṟum, vāyil kākkum makaḷir puttarkaḷiṉ talip pākikaḷi uṭiyavarkaḷ eṉṟum kūṟiyuḷḷārkaḷ.1  tamiḻk kali aṟivum, moḻi aṟivum mikka eṉatu matippiṟkuriya naṇpar uyartiru mayili cīṉi vēṅkaṭacāmi avarkaḷ itaṟku, tam nūṟkaḷil teḷivāṉa viḷakkam aḷittuḷḷārkaḷ.2  intak kōyil aka nāḻikiyiṉ mītu amikkappaṭṭa vimāṉam nāṉku paṭṭiyāka kāṇappaṭukiṟatu ataṉ nāṉku mūlikaḷilum curuḷ koṭi aḻakuṟac cetukkappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  vimāṉattil ēṉiya kōyil vimāṉam pōl karṇak kūṭu pañcaram cāli pōṉṟa uṟuppukaḷ illi.  mēlē ucciyil uḷḷa kumpak kalacamum kāṇappaṭa villi.  aka nāḻiki muṉ, iṭi nāḻikiyum (artta maṇṭapamum) illi.  ikkōyil eḷiya vaṭivil eḻil peṟa amikkap
paṭṭuḷḷatu.  itu iḷaṅkōyil amippiyuṭiyatu.
iṅku inta iḷaṅkōyiliṉ uruvappaṭamum ataṉ catura vaṭivāṉa tarippaṭamum amikkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  itē pōṉṟa catura vaṭivilāṉa tiruvaṟikaḷ (karuvaṟikaḷ) paṉamalik kōyililum, kāñcipuram kayilāca nātar kōyililum nākārccuṉa koṇṭāvil kuṭiyēṟiya putta tuṟavikaḷukkāka putta camaya pakti mikka peṇ cīmāṭṭiyāl kaṭṭappaṭṭa iru vikārikaḷum, tirukkaḻukkuṉṟam kukik kōyililum ciṟṟaṉṉal vāyil aṟivaṉ kōyililum, mēlic cēri civa ceñcikkuṭivarik kōyililum tiruppāppuliyūr kōyililum uḷḷaṉa.
iṅku eṭuttuk kāṭṭap paṭṭirukkum uttaraṉ kōyil kāḷi kuṭi koṇṭirukkum aka nāḻiki cumār 15 aṭi akalamum 20- aṭi akalamum uḷḷa aḻakāṉa aka nāḻikiyuṭiyatu.  muṉpuṟam oru ciṟu iṭi nāḻikiyum peṟṟu māmallapurattil uruvākkap peṟṟa mātirik kōyilip pōl kaccitamāka viḷaṅkukiṟatu.
namatu nāṭṭilē nīṇṭa catura amippuḷḷa karuvaṟikaḷik koṇṭa kōyilkaḷ pala.  māmallapurattil mātirik kōyilāka uruvākkap peṟṟa kaṇēcaratam - nīṇṭa catura aka nāḻikiyik koṇṭatu.
- tamiḻ nāṭṭil maṭṭumalla kēraḷam, āntiram, kaṉṉaṭam pōṉṟa nāṭṭilum vaṭa intiyāvilum pala catura vaṭivāṉa aka nāḻikiyiyuṭiya kōyilkaḷ iruppatāka collappaṭukiṟatu.  avikaḷ aṉittum uṇmiyil catura vaṭivāṉa amip puṭiyatalla.  nīṇṭa catura vaṭivamippi uṭiyavikaḷēyākum.  āṉāl akalatti viṭa nīḷam iraṭṭippu maṭaṅku koṇṭavikaḷ alla.  āṉāl akalam 10 aṭiyum nīḷam 11 aṭiyum irukkum.  ivaṟṟi yellām nīṇṭa catura vaṭivak kōyilākak karutalām.  eṭuttuk kāṭṭāka taḷavāṉūrk kōyil karuvaṟiyiṉ nīḷam 8 aṭi 6 aṅkulam akalam 7 aṭi 10 aṅkulam; uyaram 6 aṭi 10 aṅkulam  1ivaṟṟip perumpālōr catura vaṭivak karuvaṟi eṉṟu kūṟukiṉṟaṉar. itu tavaṟu; nīṇṭa catura vaṭiva aka nāḻikiyēyākum.
muṭṭi vaṭiva aka nāḻiki
muṭṭi vaṭivil tamiḻ nāṭṭil aka nāḻiki amikkap paṭṭirukkiṟatu.  muṭṭi vaṭivāṉa aka nāḻiki (karppak kirakam) atikam illi.  oṉṟē yoṉṟu tāṉ uṇṭu.  atu kāñcipurattil uḷḷa curaharēcuvarar kōyil ākum.
curaharēcuvarar kōyil
kāñcipuram māvaṭṭattil uḷḷa kāñcipurattil (periya kāñcipurattil) kāñci ēkāmparēcuvarar kōyiliṉ teṟkut teruvil jvara harēvaram eṉṟa peyaril oru kōyil amintirukkiṟatu.  ikkōyilil iṉṟu pūci naṭi peṟuvatākat teriyavilli.  itu tilli miya araciṉ tol poruḷ āyvut tuṟiyiṉariṉ ātikkattil irukkiṟatu.
pala kōyilkaḷil aka nāḻikiyiṉ (mūlatāṉattiṉ) mēl uḷḷa vimāṉattiyum maṇṭapaṅkaḷiyum, kōpuraṅkaḷiyum āyntāl aka nāḻikiyiṉ mēl vimāṉam ciṟitākavum ēka taḷatti uṭiyatākavum, tāḻntum amikkappaṭṭirukkum.  pirakāraṅkaḷum, kōpuraṅkaḷum, tirumatilkaḷum aṭukkaṭukkākap parantum virintum uyarntum kāṇappaṭum.  ivi, virintu parantu viyāpittuḷḷa pirapañcattiyum ataṉuḷ cūṭcamamāka iṟivaṉ uḷḷāṉ eṉpatiyum kāṭṭukiṟatu eṉṟu ciṟpa nūṟ pulavarkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟārkaḷ.
namatu tiruk kōyiliṉ amippi pirapañcattiṉ mātiri uruvam (Universe in Miniature) eṉṟu aṟiñarkaḷ kūṟuvar.
kāñci curaharēcuvarar kōyil (civaṉ kōyil) vimāṉam vaṭṭa vaṭivilē amikkap peṟṟirukkiṟatu.  eṉavē aka nāḻikiyum vaṭṭa vaṭivamāka amintuḷḷatu eṉṟu kūṟiviṭukiṉṟārkaḷ.  kōyilkaḷip paṟṟi nūl eḻutukiṟavarkaḷ kōyiliṉ uyir nāṭiyāka ilaṅkum aka nāḻikiyip paṟṟi naṉku āyntu nūl eḻutuvatilli.  akalam nīḷam, uyaram, ākiyavikaḷi aḷantu viḷakkam kūṟuvatilli. karuvaṟi caturamā nīṇṭa caturamā, vaṭṭamā nīḷ uruṇṭi vaṭivamā (Oval) eṉṟu āyntu pārttu eḻutuvatilli.  pala aṟiñarkaḷ curakarēcuvarar kōyil vimāṉam vaṭṭa vaṭivam eṉṟu eḻuti muṭittu viṭṭārkaḷē yoḻiya aka nāḻiki ettakiya amippuṭiyatu eṉṟu eḻutat tavaṟiviṭṭaṉar.  eṉatu matippiṟkum, aṉpiṟkum uriyavarāy viḷaṅkiya maṟinta (mārc 1940) māmēti ṭākṭar ci. mīṉāṭci em. ē. pi. eyc. ṭi. avarkaḷ kūṭa vaṭṭa vaṭivamāṉa aka nāḻiki eṉṟu tāṉ kuṟippiṭṭirun
tārkaḷē allatu itu muṭṭi vaṭivamāṉatu eṉṟu kuṟippiṭat tavaṟiviṭṭār eṉṟu tāṉ kūṟa vēṇṭum.1  āṉāl namatu tamiḻ nāṭṭu tapatikaḷiṉ parampariyil utittavarum, māmallapuram ciṟpakkallūri mutalvarumāṉa uyar tiru. vi. kaṇapati āccāri. pī.ē. avarkaḷ jcurakarēcuvarar kōyiliṉ karuvaṟiyi (aka nāḻikiyi)  nēril pārttu āyntu itu nīḷ uruṇṭi vaṭivāṉatu - atāvatu muṭṭi tothdJ(Oval) eṉṟu aiyamaṟa eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷār.  atu aṭiyil varumāṟākum:
karuvaṟi eṉṟu collappaṭum vimāṉattip peṇ vaṭivam eṉṟum ataṉuḷḷirukkum mūrttiyi utarattil uḷḷa karppam eṉṟum varuṇikkappaṭukiṟatu.  utarattil karppamāka mūrtti amiyap peṟṟiruppatālēyē ik kaṭṭiṭattik karppak kiruham eṉṉum karuvaṟi eṉṟum aḻikkiṉṟōm ikkaruttiṉi valiyuṟuttum poruṭṭē mūlamūrtti vīṟṟiruntaruḷum kaṭṭiṭattik kukkiṭāṇṭa (kōḻi muṭṭi) vaṭivamākavum amikkalām eṉṟu ciṟpa nūlkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟaṉa.  ittakiya kukkiṭāṇṭa vaṭivattil oru kōyil kāñcipurattil nirmāṇikkappaṭṭirukkiṟatu ikkōyil kāñci ēkāmparēcuvarar kōyil teṟku vītiyil jvara harēvaram  eṉṟa peyaril amikkap peṟṟirukkiṟatu.  eṉṟu kukkiṭāṇṭak karuvaṟi amippiṟku viḷakkam kūṟi cāṉṟum eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷaṉar.2
nīḷ uruṇṭi vaṭivil, kāñci curakarīracuvarar kōyilit tavira vēṟu kōyil eṅkum iruppatākat teriyavilli.
curakarēcuvarar kōyil atirṣṭāṉamum, karuvaṟiyiṉ veḷippuṟap pakutiyum vimāṉamum aḻakiya ciṟpa nuṭpam ceṟi
vatākat tikaḻkiṉṟatu.
vaṭṭa vaṭivāṉa aka nāḻiki
vaṭṭa vaṭivamāṉa kōyil intiyāvil illi.  tamiḻar
kaḷukku ēṉ?  intiyarkaḷukkum vaṭṭamāṉa vaṭivil kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ amikkat teriyātu eṉṟu kūṟi vantuḷḷaṉar.  ivarkaḷiṉ pēccu aṟiyāmiyāl eḻunta pēccākum.  ēṉ?  eṉil tamiḻarkaḷil palarukku, tamiḻ nāṭṭil vaṭṭa vaṭivil kōyil iruppatu teriyātu.  vdJ cwÉd® xUt®; fšÿÇ MáÇa®, v«.V., pi.ṭi. paṭṭatāri avar oru nāḷ eṉṉiṭam, muṟkālattil tamiḻarkaḷukku vaṭiviyal kaṇita aṟivu uṇṭā?  (Geometrical knowledge) eṉṟu viṉāviṉār.  avarukku viṭiyāka tampī!  nīr eṉṟikkāvatu namatu tirukkōyilukkuc ceṉṟa tuṇṭā?  itaṟku muṉ pōkā
tiruntālum iṉṟāvatu kōyilukkup pōṅkaḷ.  iṟivaṉ, tamiḻarkaḷiṉ nuṇṇiya vaṭiviyal kaṇita nuṭpam ettuṇi ciṟappuvāyntatu eṉpati uṇarttuvāṉ:  namatu kōyilil uḷḷa caturam, nīṇṭa caturam, vaṭṭam, ari vaṭṭam āṟu paṭṭam, eṭṭup paṭṭam mukkōṇam, aṟu kōṇam ākiya vaṭivil āyiram āṇṭu kaḷukku muṉ amikkappaṭṭa tūṇkaḷum, uṇṇāḻikikaḷum vimāṉaṅkaḷum ōma kuṇṭaṅkaḷum, kuḷaṅ
kaḷum maṇṭapaṅkaḷum, pōtikikaḷum, kōyilil tīṭṭappaṭṭa kōlaṅkaḷum malarkaḷiṉ ciṟpaṅkaḷum  kōyilkaḷum teḷivāka uṇarttum eṉṟēṉ.  kaṇitap pulamiyil paṇṭum, iṉṟum eṉṟum, āṅkilēyar, amerikkar maṭṭumalla uruciyarkaḷum tamiḻarkaḷi miñca muṭiyātu eṉṟu patil viṭuttēṉ.  avar vāy aṭipaṭṭup pōy viṭṭatu.    
paṇṭiyat tamiḻar ulakilē kaṇitat tuṟiyil mika nuṭpamāṉa pulami vāyntavarkaḷ eṉpataṟkuc cāṉṟāka īṇṭu iraṇṭōr aḷavi vāyppāṭukaḷi eṭuttuk kāṭṭu kiṉṟōm.

mēṟkūṟiya kīḻvāy ilakkattic cērnta aḷavukaḷum tolkāppiyar kālattilē vaḻaṅkiṉatākat terikiṟatu.  nāṉ iṟṟikku 65-āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ cāttaṉkuḷattil cūci muttu vāttiyāriṭam inta vāyppāṭukaḷ payiṉṟiruntatōṭu perukkal, pakuttal, kaḻittal, kūṭṭal mutaliya tamiḻk kaṇakkum ceyyap payiṉṟiruntēṉ.  20-āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ vari tiṇṇip paḷḷik kūṭaṅkaḷ eṇ cuvaṭi, tāṉap perukkam pōṉṟa kaṇitam ēṭukaḷ eḻuti nāḷ tōṟum paṭittu āciriyariṭam oppuvittuḷḷēṉ.
